verses.Genesis|1|1: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
verses.Genesis|1|2: And the earth was without form and void; and darkness was on the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved over the surface of the waters.
verses.Genesis|1|3: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
verses.Genesis|1|4: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.
verses.Genesis|1|5: And God called the light Day, and the darkness He called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, one day.
verses.Genesis|1|6: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide water from water.
verses.Genesis|1|7: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
verses.Genesis|1|8: And God called the firmament Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, a second day.
verses.Genesis|1|9: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.
verses.Genesis|1|10: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters He called Seas: and God saw that it was good.
verses.Genesis|1|11: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, herb yielding seed, and fruit tree yielding fruit after its kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.Genesis|1|12: And the earth brought forth grass, herb yielding seed after its kind, and tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after its kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.Genesis|1|13: And there was evening and there was morning, a third day.
verses.Genesis|1|14: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:
verses.Genesis|1|15: and let them be for lights in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.Genesis|1|16: And God made the two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: and the stars also.
verses.Genesis|1|17: And God set them in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth,
verses.Genesis|1|18: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
verses.Genesis|1|19: And there was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
verses.Genesis|1|20: And God said, Let the waters swarm abundantly with moving creatures that have life, and let birds fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.
verses.Genesis|1|21: And God created the great crocodiles, and every living creature that moves, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.Genesis|1|22: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply in the earth.
verses.Genesis|1|23: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
verses.Genesis|1|24: And God said, Let the earth bring forth living creatures after their kind, cattle, and creeping things, and beasts of the earth after their kind: and it was so.
verses.Genesis|1|25: And God made the beasts of the earth after their kind, and cattle after their kind, and everything that creeps on the earth after its kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.Genesis|1|26: And God said, Let Us make Mankind in Our image, after Our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.
verses.Genesis|1|27: So God created Mankind in His own image, in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
verses.Genesis|1|28: And God blessed them, and God said to them, Be fruitful, and multiply, replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the air, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.
verses.Genesis|1|29: And God said, Behold I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, on which is the fruit yielding seed; to you it shall be for food.
verses.Genesis|1|30: And to every beast of the earth, and to every bird of the air, and to everything that creeps on the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for food: and it was so.
verses.Genesis|1|31: And God saw everything that He had made, and, behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
verses.Genesis|2|1: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all their host.
verses.Genesis|2|2: And by the seventh day God ended His work which He had done; and He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had done.
verses.Genesis|2|3: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because in it He rested from all his work which God had created and performed.
verses.Genesis|2|4: These are the generations of the heaven and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the Lord God made the earth and the heavens.
verses.Genesis|2|5: And no plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet grown: for the Lord God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.
verses.Genesis|2|6: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
verses.Genesis|2|7: And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
verses.Genesis|2|8: And the Lord God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there He put the man whom He had formed.
verses.Genesis|2|9: And out of the ground the Lord God made to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
verses.Genesis|2|10: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and branched into four streams.
verses.Genesis|2|11: The name of the first is Pison: that it is which compasses the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
verses.Genesis|2|12: and the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the shoham stone.
verses.Genesis|2|13: And the name of the second river is Gihon: it compasses the whole land of Ethiopia.
verses.Genesis|2|14: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goes toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.
verses.Genesis|2|15: And the Lord God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to till it and to keep it.
verses.Genesis|2|16: And the Lord God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayst freely eat:
verses.Genesis|2|17: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for on the day that thou eatest of it thou shalt surely die.
verses.Genesis|2|18: And the Lord God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a help to match him.
verses.Genesis|2|19: And out of the ground the Lord God formed every beast of the field, and every bird of the air; and brought them to the man to see what he would call them: and whatever the man called every living creature, that was its name.
verses.Genesis|2|20: And the man gave names to all cattle, and to the birds of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for the man there was not found a help to match him.
verses.Genesis|2|21: And the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man, and he slept: and He took one of his sides, and closed up the flesh in its place,
verses.Genesis|2|22: and of the side, which the Lord God had taken from the man, He made a woman, and brought her to the man.
verses.Genesis|2|23: And the man said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.
verses.Genesis|2|24: That is why a man leaves his father and his mother, and cleaves to his wife: and they become one flesh.
verses.Genesis|2|25: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and they felt no shame.
verses.Genesis|3|1: Now the serpent was craftier than all the beasts of the field which the Lord God had made. And he said to the woman, Has God said, You shall not eat of any tree of the garden?
verses.Genesis|3|2: And the woman said to the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:
verses.Genesis|3|3: but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God has said, You shall not eat of it, neither shall you touch it, lest you die.
verses.Genesis|3|4: And the serpent said to the woman, You shall not surely die:
verses.Genesis|3|5: for God knows that on the day you eat of it, then your eyes shall be opened, and you shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
verses.Genesis|3|6: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of its fruit, and did eat, and gave also to her husband with her; and he did eat.
verses.Genesis|3|7: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves loincloths.
verses.Genesis|3|8: And they heard the voice of the Lord God walking in the garden in the breeze of the day: and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God amongst the trees of the garden.
verses.Genesis|3|9: And the Lord God called to the man, and said to him, Where art thou?
verses.Genesis|3|10: And he said, I heard Thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
verses.Genesis|3|11: And He said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee that thou shouldst not eat?
verses.Genesis|3|12: And the man said, The woman whom Thou didst give to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
verses.Genesis|3|13: And the Lord God said to the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
verses.Genesis|3|14: And the Lord God said to the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
verses.Genesis|3|15: and I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
verses.Genesis|3|16: Unto the woman He said, I will greatly multiply the pain of thy childbearing; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and yet thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
verses.Genesis|3|17: And to the man He said, Because thou hast hearkened to the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;
verses.Genesis|3|18: thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;
verses.Genesis|3|19: in the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return to the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and to dust shalt thou return.
verses.Genesis|3|20: And the man called his wife's name Habba; because she was the mother of all living (Hai).
verses.Genesis|3|21: For the man also and for his wife did the Lord God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
verses.Genesis|3|22: And the Lord God said, Behold, the man is become like one of Us, knowing good and evil: and now, what if he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eating, live for ever:
verses.Genesis|3|23: therefore the Lord God sent him out of the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
verses.Genesis|3|24: So He drove out the man; and He placed the keruvim at the east of the garden of Eden, and the bright blade of a revolving sword to guard the way to the tree of life.
verses.Genesis|4|1: And the man knew Habba his wife; and she conceived, and bore Cain saying, I have acquired a manchild from the Lord.
verses.Genesis|4|2: And she again bore, his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
verses.Genesis|4|3: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering to the Lord.
verses.Genesis|4|4: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat parts thereof. And the Lord had respect to Abel and to his offering:
verses.Genesis|4|5: but to Cain and to his offering He had not respect. And Cain was very angry, and his face fell.
verses.Genesis|4|6: And the Lord said to Cain, Why art thou angry? and why art thou crestfallen?
verses.Genesis|4|7: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin crouches at the door, and to thee shall be his desire. Yet thou mayst rule over him.
verses.Genesis|4|8: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.
verses.Genesis|4|9: And the Lord said to Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: am I my brother's keeper?
verses.Genesis|4|10: And He said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood cries to Me from the ground.
verses.Genesis|4|11: And now cursed art thou from the earth, which has opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;
verses.Genesis|4|12: when thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield to thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be on the earth.
verses.Genesis|4|13: And Cain said to the Lord, My punishment is greater than I can bear.
verses.Genesis|4|14: Behold, Thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from Thy face I shall be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that anyone that finds me shall slay me.
verses.Genesis|4|15: And the Lord said to him, Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the Lord set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should smite him.
verses.Genesis|4|16: And Cain went out from the presence of the Lord, and dwelt in the land of Nod, to the east of Eden.
verses.Genesis|4|17: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bore Enoch: and he built a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.
verses.Genesis|4|18: And to Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begot Mehujael: and Mehujael begot Methusael: and Methusael begot Lamech.
verses.Genesis|4|19: And Lamech took to him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
verses.Genesis|4|20: And Adah bore Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.
verses.Genesis|4|21: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the lyre and pipe.
verses.Genesis|4|22: And Zillah, she also bore Tubal-cain, forger of every sharp instrument in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
verses.Genesis|4|23: And Lamech said to his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; wives of Lamech, hearken to my speech: for I have slain a man for wounding me, and a young man for my hurt.
verses.Genesis|4|24: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
verses.Genesis|4|25: And Adam (Man) knew his wife again; and she bore a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she, has appointed me another seed instead of Abel whom Cain slew.
verses.Genesis|4|26: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then men began to call upon the Lord by name.
verses.Genesis|5|1: This is the book of the generations of Adam (Man). In the day that God created mankind, in the likeness of God He made him;
verses.Genesis|5|2: male and female He created them; and blessed them, and called their name Man, in the day when they were created.
verses.Genesis|5|3: And Adam lived a hundred and thirty years, and begot a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:
verses.Genesis|5|4: and the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begot sons and daughters:
verses.Genesis|5|5: and all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.
verses.Genesis|5|6: And Seth lived a hundred and five years, and begot Enos:
verses.Genesis|5|7: and Seth lived after he begot Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begot sons and daughters:
verses.Genesis|5|8: and all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.
verses.Genesis|5|9: And Enos lived ninety years, and begot Cainan:
verses.Genesis|5|10: and Enos lived after he begot Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begot sons and daughters:
verses.Genesis|5|11: and all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
verses.Genesis|5|12: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begot Mahalaleel:
verses.Genesis|5|13: and Cainan lived after he begot Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begot sons and daughters:
verses.Genesis|5|14: and all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
verses.Genesis|5|15: And Mahalaleel lived sixty five years, and begot Jared:
verses.Genesis|5|16: and Mahalaleel lived after he begot Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and he begot sons and daughters:
verses.Genesis|5|17: and all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred and ninety five years: and he died.
verses.Genesis|5|18: And Jared lived a hundred and sixty two years, and he begot Enoch:
verses.Genesis|5|19: and Jared lived after he begot Enoch eight hundred years, and begot sons and daughters:
verses.Genesis|5|20: and all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty two years: and he died.
verses.Genesis|5|21: And Enoch lived sixty five years, and begot Methuselah:
verses.Genesis|5|22: and Enoch walked with God after he begot Methuselah three hundred years, and begot sons and daughters:
verses.Genesis|5|23: and all the days of Enoch were three hundred and sixty five years:
verses.Genesis|5|24: and Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
verses.Genesis|5|25: And Methuselah lived a hundred and eighty seven years, and begot Lamech:
verses.Genesis|5|26: and Methuselah lived after he begot Lamech seven hundred and eighty two years, and begot sons and daughters:
verses.Genesis|5|27: and all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred and sixty nine years: and he died.
verses.Genesis|5|28: And Lamech lived a hundred and eighty two years, and begot a son:
verses.Genesis|5|29: and he called his name Noah, saying, This one shall comfort us for our work and the toil of our hands, because of the ground which the Lord has cursed.
verses.Genesis|5|30: And Lamech lived after he begot Noah five hundred and ninety five years, and begot sons and daughters:
verses.Genesis|5|31: and all the days of Lamech were seven hundred and seventy seven years: and he died.
verses.Genesis|5|32: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begot Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.Genesis|6|1: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born to them,
verses.Genesis|6|2: that the distinguished men saw that the daughters of men were fair; and they took them wives of all whom they chose.
verses.Genesis|6|3: And the Lord said, My spirit shall not always strive on account of man, for that he also is flesh: and his days shall be a hundred and twenty years.
verses.Genesis|6|4: There were Nephilim in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the distinguished men came in to the daughters of men, and they bore children to them; the same were mighty men of old, men of renown.
verses.Genesis|6|5: And the Lord saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that all the impulse of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
verses.Genesis|6|6: And the Lord repented that He had made man on the earth, and it grieved Him at His heart.
verses.Genesis|6|7: And the Lord said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth: both man, and beast, and creeping things, and the birds of the air; for I repent that I have made them.
verses.Genesis|6|8: But Noah found favour in the eyes of the Lord.
verses.Genesis|6|9: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.
verses.Genesis|6|10: And Noah begot three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.Genesis|6|11: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
verses.Genesis|6|12: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted its way upon the earth.
verses.Genesis|6|13: And God said to Noah, The end of all flesh is come before Me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
verses.Genesis|6|14: Make thee an ark of gofer wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
verses.Genesis|6|15: And this is the fashion of which thou shalt make it: the length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
verses.Genesis|6|16: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and to a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in its side; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.
verses.Genesis|6|17: And, behold, I will bring the flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, in which is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is on the earth shall die.
verses.Genesis|6|18: But with thee will I establish My covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.
verses.Genesis|6|19: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
verses.Genesis|6|20: Of birds after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after its kind, two of every sort shall come to thee, to keep them alive.
verses.Genesis|6|21: And take thou to thee of all food that is eaten, and gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.
verses.Genesis|6|22: So Noah did according to all that God commanded him; thus he did.
verses.Genesis|7|1: And the Lord said to Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before Me in this generation.
verses.Genesis|7|2: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, male and female: and of beasts that are not clean by twos, male and female.
verses.Genesis|7|3: Of birds of the air, also by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.
verses.Genesis|7|4: For in another seven days, I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.
verses.Genesis|7|5: And Noah did according to all that the Lord commanded him.
verses.Genesis|7|6: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
verses.Genesis|7|7: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.
verses.Genesis|7|8: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of birds and of everything that creeps upon the earth,
verses.Genesis|7|9: there went in two and two to Noah into the ark, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.
verses.Genesis|7|10: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
verses.Genesis|7|11: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, on that same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken open, and the windows of heaven were opened.
verses.Genesis|7|12: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
verses.Genesis|7|13: In the selfsame day Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ark;
verses.Genesis|7|14: they, and every beast after its kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.
verses.Genesis|7|15: And they went in to Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh in which is the breath of life.
verses.Genesis|7|16: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the Lord shut him in.
verses.Genesis|7|17: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bore up the ark, and it was raised above the earth.
verses.Genesis|7|18: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
verses.Genesis|7|19: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high mountains, that were under the whole heaven, were covered.
verses.Genesis|7|20: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.
verses.Genesis|7|21: And all flesh perished that moved upon the earth, both of birds, and of cattle, and of beasts, and of every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth, and all mankind:
verses.Genesis|7|22: all in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was on the dry land, died.
verses.Genesis|7|23: And He destroyed every living substance which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and creeping things, and the birds of the heaven; they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.
verses.Genesis|7|24: And the waters prevailed upon the earth a hundred and fifty days.
verses.Genesis|8|1: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that were with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters were assuaged;
verses.Genesis|8|2: the fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped,
verses.Genesis|8|3: and the rain from heaven was restrained; and the waters receded from the earth continually: and after the end of a hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.
verses.Genesis|8|4: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
verses.Genesis|8|5: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
verses.Genesis|8|6: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:
verses.Genesis|8|7: and he sent forth the raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
verses.Genesis|8|8: Also he sent forth the dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from the face of the ground;
verses.Genesis|8|9: but the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned to him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put out his hand, and took her, and pulled her in to him into the ark.
verses.Genesis|8|10: And he waited yet another seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;
verses.Genesis|8|11: and the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf plucked off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
verses.Genesis|8|12: And he waited yet another seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again to him any more.
verses.Genesis|8|13: And it came to pass in the six hundred and first year, in the first month on the first day of the month, that the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.
verses.Genesis|8|14: And in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, was the earth dried.
verses.Genesis|8|15: And God spoke to Noah, saying,
verses.Genesis|8|16: Go out of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.
verses.Genesis|8|17: Bring out with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of birds, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creeps on the earth; that they may breed abundantly on the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
verses.Genesis|8|18: And Noah went out, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:
verses.Genesis|8|19: every beast, every creeping thing, and every bird, and whatever creeps on the earth, after their kinds, went out of the ark.
verses.Genesis|8|20: And Noah built an altar to the Lord; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
verses.Genesis|8|21: And the Lord smelled the sweet savour; and the Lord said in His heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the impulse of man's heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more everything living, as I have done.
verses.Genesis|8|22: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
verses.Genesis|9|1: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.
verses.Genesis|9|2: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every bird of the air, upon all that moves upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
verses.Genesis|9|3: Every moving thing that lives shall be food for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.
verses.Genesis|9|4: But flesh with its life, which is its blood, you shall not eat.
verses.Genesis|9|5: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.
verses.Genesis|9|6: Whoso sheds man's blood by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made He man.
verses.Genesis|9|7: And as for you, be fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.
verses.Genesis|9|8: And God spoke to Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,
verses.Genesis|9|9: And behold, I establish My covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
verses.Genesis|9|10: and with every living creature that is with you, of the birds, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that came out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.
verses.Genesis|9|11: And I will establish My covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of the flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
verses.Genesis|9|12: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between Me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
verses.Genesis|9|13: I have set My bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between Me and the earth.
verses.Genesis|9|14: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:
verses.Genesis|9|15: and I will remember My covenant, which is between Me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.Genesis|9|16: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.
verses.Genesis|9|17: And God said to Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between Me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
verses.Genesis|9|18: And the sons of Noah, that went out of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
verses.Genesis|9|19: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
verses.Genesis|9|20: And Noah began to be a husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
verses.Genesis|9|21: And he drank of the wine, and was drunk; and he was uncovered within his tent.
verses.Genesis|9|22: And Ham, the father of Canaan saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren outside.
verses.Genesis|9|23: And Shem and Japheth took the garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.
verses.Genesis|9|24: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done to him.
verses.Genesis|9|25: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be to his brethren.
verses.Genesis|9|26: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
verses.Genesis|9|27: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
verses.Genesis|9|28: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
verses.Genesis|9|29: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
verses.Genesis|10|1: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and to them were sons born after the flood.
verses.Genesis|10|2: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.Genesis|10|3: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.Genesis|10|4: And the sons of Javan; Elisha, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.Genesis|10|5: By these were the isles of the nations divided in their lands; everyone after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
verses.Genesis|10|6: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Egypt, and Put, and Canaan.
verses.Genesis|10|7: And the sons of Cush; Sheba, and Havilah, and Sabtecha, and Ramah, and Sabtecha, and the sons of Ramah; Seba, and Dedan.
verses.Genesis|10|8: And Cush begot Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
verses.Genesis|10|9: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord: wherefore it is said, Like Nimrod the mighty hunter before the Lord.
verses.Genesis|10|10: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babylon, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.Genesis|10|11: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and built Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah.
verses.Genesis|10|12: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: that is a great city.
verses.Genesis|10|13: And Egypt begot Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim and Naftuhim.
verses.Genesis|10|14: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistines) and Caphtorim.
verses.Genesis|10|15: And Canaan begot Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,
verses.Genesis|10|16: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite.
verses.Genesis|10|17: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.Genesis|10|18: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterwards the families of the Canaanite were spread abroad.
verses.Genesis|10|19: And the border of the Canaanite was from Zidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest to Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboyim, unto Lasha.
verses.Genesis|10|20: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, in their nations.
verses.Genesis|10|21: To Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, to him were children born.
verses.Genesis|10|22: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
verses.Genesis|10|23: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
verses.Genesis|10|24: And Arphaxad begot Salah, and Salah begot Eber.
verses.Genesis|10|25: And to Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.
verses.Genesis|10|26: And Joktan begot Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.Genesis|10|27: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.Genesis|10|28: and Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.Genesis|10|29: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.Genesis|10|30: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest to Sephar a mountain of the east.
verses.Genesis|10|31: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
verses.Genesis|10|32: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and from these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
verses.Genesis|11|1: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.
verses.Genesis|11|2: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
verses.Genesis|11|3: And they said to one another, Come, let us make bricks, and burn them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for mortar.
verses.Genesis|11|4: And they said, Come, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach to heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
verses.Genesis|11|5: And the Lord came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men were building.
verses.Genesis|11|6: And the Lord said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be withheld from them, which they have schemed to do.
verses.Genesis|11|7: Come, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.
verses.Genesis|11|8: So the Lord scattered them abroad from there upon the face of all the earth: and they ceased to build the city.
verses.Genesis|11|9: Therefore is the name of it called Babylon; because the Lord did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the Lord scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
verses.Genesis|11|10: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was a hundred years old, and begot Arphaxad two years after the flood:
verses.Genesis|11|11: and Shem lived after he begot Arphaxad five hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.Genesis|11|12: And Arphaxad lived thirty five years, and begot Salah.
verses.Genesis|11|13: And Arphaxad lived after he begot Salah four hundred and three years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.Genesis|11|14: And Salah lived thirty years, and begot Eber:
verses.Genesis|11|15: and Salah lived after he begot Eber four hundred and three years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.Genesis|11|16: And Eber lived thirty four years, and begot Peleg:
verses.Genesis|11|17: and Eber lived after he begot Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.Genesis|11|18: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begot Reu:
verses.Genesis|11|19: and Peleg lived after he begot Reu two hundred and nine years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.Genesis|11|20: And Reu lived thirty two years, and begot Serug:
verses.Genesis|11|21: and Reu lived after he begot Serug two hundred and seven years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.Genesis|11|22: And Serug lived thirty years, and begot Nahor:
verses.Genesis|11|23: and Serug lived after he begot Nahor two hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.Genesis|11|24: And Nahor lived twenty nine years, and begot Terah:
verses.Genesis|11|25: and Nahor lived after he begot Terah a hundred and nineteen years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.Genesis|11|26: And Terah lived seventy years, and begot Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.Genesis|11|27: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begot Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begot Lot.
verses.Genesis|11|28: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
verses.Genesis|11|29: And Abram and Nahor took wives for themselves; the name of Abram's wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
verses.Genesis|11|30: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.
verses.Genesis|11|31: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went out with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came to Haran, and dwelt there.
verses.Genesis|11|32: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
verses.Genesis|12|1: Now the Lord said to Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, to the land that I will show thee:
verses.Genesis|12|2: and I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
verses.Genesis|12|3: and I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curses thee: and in thee shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
verses.Genesis|12|4: So Abram departed, as the Lord had spoken to him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy five years old when he departed out of Haran.
verses.Genesis|12|5: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had acquired in Haran; and they went forth to go to the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
verses.Genesis|12|6: And Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem unto the terebinth of More. And the Canaanite was then in the land.
verses.Genesis|12|7: And the Lord appeared to Abram, and said, To thy seed will I give this land: and there he built an altar to the Lord, who had appeared to him.
verses.Genesis|12|8: And he removed from there to a mountain on the east of Beth-el, and pitched his tent, having Beth-el on the west, and Ai on the east: and there he built an altar to the Lord, and called upon the name of the Lord.
verses.Genesis|12|9: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.
verses.Genesis|12|10: And there was famine in the land: and Abram went down to Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was severe in the land.
verses.Genesis|12|11: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter to Egypt that he said to Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:
verses.Genesis|12|12: therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
verses.Genesis|12|13: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.
verses.Genesis|12|14: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come to Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
verses.Genesis|12|15: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.
verses.Genesis|12|16: And he treated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.
verses.Genesis|12|17: And the Lord plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram's wife.
verses.Genesis|12|18: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done to me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
verses.Genesis|12|19: Why didst thou say, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.
verses.Genesis|12|20: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
verses.Genesis|13|1: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.
verses.Genesis|13|2: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
verses.Genesis|13|3: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Beth-el, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Beth-el and Ai;
verses.Genesis|13|4: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the Lord.
verses.Genesis|13|5: And Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.
verses.Genesis|13|6: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
verses.Genesis|13|7: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelt then in the land.
verses.Genesis|13|8: And Abram said to Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen, for we are brethren.
verses.Genesis|13|9: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
verses.Genesis|13|10: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well watered everywhere, before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of the Lord, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest to Zoar.
verses.Genesis|13|11: Then Lot chose him all the plain of the Jordan; and Lot journeyed east; and they separated themselves one from the other.
verses.Genesis|13|12: Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelt in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
verses.Genesis|13|13: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the Lord exceedingly.
verses.Genesis|13|14: And the Lord said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thy eyes, and look from the place where thou art, northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward;
verses.Genesis|13|15: for all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
verses.Genesis|13|16: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.
verses.Genesis|13|17: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it to thee.
verses.Genesis|13|18: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt by the terebinths of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar to the Lord.
verses.Genesis|14|1: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations,
verses.Genesis|14|2: that these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of Zeboyim, and the king of Bela which is Zoar.
verses.Genesis|14|3: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.
verses.Genesis|14|4: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.Genesis|14|5: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him and smote the Rephaim in Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shabe-ciryataiim,
verses.Genesis|14|6: and the Hori in their mount Seir, unto El-paran, which is by the wilderness.
verses.Genesis|14|7: And they returned, and came to En-mishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekite, and also the Amorite, that dwelt in Hazazon-tamar.
verses.Genesis|14|8: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboyim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;
verses.Genesis|14|9: with Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal, king of nations, and Amraphel, king of Shinar, and Arioch, king of Ellasar; four kings against five.
verses.Genesis|14|10: And the vale of Siddim was full of slime pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.
verses.Genesis|14|11: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their foodstuff, and went their way.
verses.Genesis|14|12: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
verses.Genesis|14|13: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt by the terebinths of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.
verses.Genesis|14|14: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he led forth his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them to Dan.
verses.Genesis|14|15: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants by night, and smote them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
verses.Genesis|14|16: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought back his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
verses.Genesis|14|17: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king's dale.
verses.Genesis|14|18: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine: and he was a priest of the most high God.
verses.Genesis|14|19: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, Possessor of heaven and earth:
verses.Genesis|14|20: and blessed be the most high God, Who has delivered thy enemies into thy hand. And he gave him a tithe of everything.
verses.Genesis|14|21: And the king of Sodom said to Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.
verses.Genesis|14|22: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have raised my hand to the Lord, the most high God, the Possessor of heaven and earth,
verses.Genesis|14|23: that I will take nothing from a thread even to a shoe-latchet, and that I will not take anything that is thine, lest thou shouldst say, I have made Abram rich:
verses.Genesis|14|24: save only that which the young men have eaten, and the share of the men who went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their share.
verses.Genesis|15|1: After these things the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield; thy reward will be very great.
verses.Genesis|15|2: And Abram said, Lord God, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?
verses.Genesis|15|3: And Abram said, Behold, to me Thou hast given no seed: and, one born in my house is my heir.
verses.Genesis|15|4: And, behold, the word of the Lord came to him, saying, This shall not be thy heir; but he that shall come forth out of thy own bowels shall be thy heir.
verses.Genesis|15|5: And He brought him outside, and said, Look now toward heaven, and count the stars, if thou be able to number them: and He said to him, So shall thy seed be.
verses.Genesis|15|6: And he believed in the Lord; and He counted it to him for righteousness.
verses.Genesis|15|7: And He said to him, I am the Lord that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
verses.Genesis|15|8: And he said, Lord God, by what shall I know that I shall inherit it?
verses.Genesis|15|9: And He said to him, Take Me a heifer three years old, and a goat three years old, and a ram three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.
verses.Genesis|15|10: And he took to Him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each half against the other: but the birds he divided not.
verses.Genesis|15|11: And the eagle came down upon the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.
verses.Genesis|15|12: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, a horror of great darkness fell upon him.
verses.Genesis|15|13: And He said to Abram, Know surely that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
verses.Genesis|15|14: and also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterwards shall they come out with great substance.
verses.Genesis|15|15: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
verses.Genesis|15|16: But in the fourth generation they shall come back here, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.
verses.Genesis|15|17: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning torch that passed between those pieces.
verses.Genesis|15|18: In the same day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying, To thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:
verses.Genesis|15|19: the Kenites, and the Kenezite, and the Kadmonites,
verses.Genesis|15|20: and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Rephaim,
verses.Genesis|15|21: and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Girgashite, and the Jebusite.
verses.Genesis|16|1: Now Sarai Abram's wife bore him no children: and she had a Egyptian handmaid, whose name was Hagar.
verses.Genesis|16|2: And Sarai said to Abram, Behold now, the Lord has restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in to my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.
verses.Genesis|16|3: And Sarai Abram's wife took Hagar, her maid, the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram for a wife.
verses.Genesis|16|4: And he went in to Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
verses.Genesis|16|5: And Sarai said to Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the Lord judge between me and thee.
verses.Genesis|16|6: But Abram said to Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her as it pleases thee. And when Sarai dealt harshly with her, she fled from her face.
verses.Genesis|16|7: And an angel of the Lord found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.
verses.Genesis|16|8: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.
verses.Genesis|16|9: And the angel of the Lord said to her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself to her hands.
verses.Genesis|16|10: And the angel of the Lord said to her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
verses.Genesis|16|11: And the angel of the Lord said to her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the Lord has heard thy affliction.
verses.Genesis|16|12: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.
verses.Genesis|16|13: And she called the name of the Lord that spoke to her, Thou God seest me: for she said,
verses.Genesis|16|14: Have I also here looked after Him that sees me? Therefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.Genesis|16|15: And Hagar bore Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
verses.Genesis|16|16: And Abram was eighty six years old, when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
verses.Genesis|17|1: And when Abram was ninety nine years old, the Lord appeared to Abram, and said to him, I am the Almighty God; walk before Me, and be perfect.
verses.Genesis|17|2: And I will make My covenant between Me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.
verses.Genesis|17|3: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,
verses.Genesis|17|4: As for Me, behold, My covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.
verses.Genesis|17|5: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
verses.Genesis|17|6: And I will make thee exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
verses.Genesis|17|7: And I will establish My covenant between Me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to thee, and to thy seed after thee.
verses.Genesis|17|8: And I will give to thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land in which thou dost sojourn, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.
verses.Genesis|17|9: And God said to Abraham, Thou shalt keep My covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.
verses.Genesis|17|10: This is My covenant, which you shall keep, between Me and you and thy seed after thee; Every manchild among you shall be circumcised.
verses.Genesis|17|11: And you shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant between Me and you.
verses.Genesis|17|12: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every manchild in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, who is not of thy seed.
verses.Genesis|17|13: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
verses.Genesis|17|14: And the uncircumcised manchild the flesh of whose foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant.
verses.Genesis|17|15: And God said to Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarai shall her name be.
verses.Genesis|17|16: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: and I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of peoples shall issue from her.
verses.Genesis|17|17: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born to him that is a hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, give birth?
verses.Genesis|17|18: And Abraham said to God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!
verses.Genesis|17|19: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish My covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.
verses.Genesis|17|20: And as for Ishmael I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
verses.Genesis|17|21: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear to thee at this time next year.
verses.Genesis|17|22: And He finished talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
verses.Genesis|17|23: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said to him.
verses.Genesis|17|24: And Abraham was ninety nine years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.Genesis|17|25: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.Genesis|17|26: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
verses.Genesis|17|27: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of a stranger, were circumcised with him.
verses.Genesis|18|1: And the Lord appeared to him by the terebinths of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
verses.Genesis|18|2: and he raised his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him; and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the ground,
verses.Genesis|18|3: and said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:
verses.Genesis|18|4: let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:
verses.Genesis|18|5: and I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort your hearts; after that you shall pass on: seeing that you are come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.
verses.Genesis|18|6: And Abraham hastened into the tent to Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.
verses.Genesis|18|7: And Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a calf tender and good, and gave it to the young man; and he hurried to prepare it.
verses.Genesis|18|8: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they ate.
verses.Genesis|18|9: And they said to him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
verses.Genesis|18|10: And he said, I will certainly return to thee at this season; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.
verses.Genesis|18|11: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, advanced in age; and it had ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
verses.Genesis|18|12: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am grown old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
verses.Genesis|18|13: And the Lord said to Abraham, Why did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I indeed bear a child, who am old?
verses.Genesis|18|14: Is anything too hard for the Lord? At the time appointed I will return to thee, at this season, and Sarah shall have a son.
verses.Genesis|18|15: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And He said, No; but thou didst laugh.
verses.Genesis|18|16: And the men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.
verses.Genesis|18|17: And the Lord said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I intend to do;
verses.Genesis|18|18: seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
verses.Genesis|18|19: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the Lord, to do justice and judgment; that the Lord may bring upon Abraham that which He has spoken of him.
verses.Genesis|18|20: And the Lord said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;
verses.Genesis|18|21: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come to Me; and if not, I will know.
verses.Genesis|18|22: And the men turned their faces from there and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the Lord.
verses.Genesis|18|23: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt Thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
verses.Genesis|18|24: Perhaps there are fifty righteous within the city: wilt Thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
verses.Genesis|18|25: Far be it from Thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, far be it from Thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
verses.Genesis|18|26: And the Lord said, If I find in Sodom fifty just men within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.
verses.Genesis|18|27: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak to the Lord, who am but dust and ashes:
verses.Genesis|18|28: perhaps there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt Thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And He said, If I find there forty five, I will not destroy it.
verses.Genesis|18|29: And he spoke to him yet again, and said, perhaps there shall be forty found there. And He said, I will not do it for the forty's sake.
verses.Genesis|18|30: And he said to him, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: perhaps there shall thirty be found there. And He said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.
verses.Genesis|18|31: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak to the Lord: perhaps there shall be twenty found there. And He said, I will not destroy it for the twenty's sake.
verses.Genesis|18|32: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: perhaps ten shall be found there. And He said, I will not destroy it for the sake of the ten.
verses.Genesis|18|33: And the Lord went His way, as soon as He had left speaking to Abraham: and Abraham returned to his place.
verses.Genesis|19|1: And there came two angels to Sodom at evening, and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face to the ground;
verses.Genesis|19|2: and he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and you may rise up early, and go your ways. And they said, No; but we will abide in the street all night.
verses.Genesis|19|3: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in to him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.
verses.Genesis|19|4: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:
verses.Genesis|19|5: and they called to Lot, and said to him, Where are the men who came in to thee this night? bring them out to us, that we may know them.
verses.Genesis|19|6: And Lot went out at the door to them, and shut the door after him,
verses.Genesis|19|7: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.
verses.Genesis|19|8: Behold now, I have two daughters who have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do to them as is good in your eyes: only to these men do nothing; seeing that they have come under the shadow of my roof.
verses.Genesis|19|9: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee than with them. And they strongly urged the man, Lot, and came near to break the door.
verses.Genesis|19|10: But the men put out their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.
verses.Genesis|19|11: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
verses.Genesis|19|12: And the men said to Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:
verses.Genesis|19|13: for we will destroy this place, because the cry of them has grown great before the face of the Lord; and the Lord has sent us to destroy it.
verses.Genesis|19|14: And Lot went out, and spoke to his sons in law, who married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the Lord will destroy the city. But he seemed to his sons in law as one that jested.
verses.Genesis|19|15: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, who are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.
verses.Genesis|19|16: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the Lord being merciful to him: and they brought him out, and set him outside the city.
verses.Genesis|19|17: And it came to pass, when they had brought them outside, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.
verses.Genesis|19|18: And Lot said to them, Oh, not so, my Lord:
verses.Genesis|19|19: behold now, thy servant has found favour in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shown to me in saving my life; I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:
verses.Genesis|19|20: behold now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape there, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.
verses.Genesis|19|21: And he said to him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for which thou hast spoken.
verses.Genesis|19|22: Haste thee, escape there; for I cannot do anything till thou be come there. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
verses.Genesis|19|23: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.
verses.Genesis|19|24: Then the Lord rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the Lord out of heaven;
verses.Genesis|19|25: and He overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.
verses.Genesis|19|26: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
verses.Genesis|19|27: And Abraham went early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the Lord:
verses.Genesis|19|28: and he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up like the smoke of a furnace.
verses.Genesis|19|29: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when He overthrew the cities in which Lot dwelt.
verses.Genesis|19|30: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
verses.Genesis|19|31: And the firstborn said to the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us after the manner of all the earth:
verses.Genesis|19|32: come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
verses.Genesis|19|33: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.Genesis|19|34: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said to the younger, Behold, I lay last night with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
verses.Genesis|19|35: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.Genesis|19|36: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.
verses.Genesis|19|37: And the firstborn bore a son, and called his name Moab: he is the father of Moab to this day.
verses.Genesis|19|38: And the younger, she also bore a son, and called his name Ben-ammi: he is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.
verses.Genesis|20|1: And Abraham journeyed from there toward the south, and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.
verses.Genesis|20|2: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
verses.Genesis|20|3: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art a dead man, because of the woman whom thou hast taken, for she is a man's wife.
verses.Genesis|20|4: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt Thou slay also a righteous nation?
verses.Genesis|20|5: Said he not to me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.
verses.Genesis|20|6: And God said to him in a dream, I too know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against Me: therefore I did not permit thee to touch her.
verses.Genesis|20|7: Now therefore restore the man's wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.
verses.Genesis|20|8: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.
verses.Genesis|20|9: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, What hast thou done to us? and in what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds to me that ought not to be done.
verses.Genesis|20|10: And Abimelech said to Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
verses.Genesis|20|11: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.
verses.Genesis|20|12: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
verses.Genesis|20|13: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said to her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt show to me; at every place where we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.
verses.Genesis|20|14: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
verses.Genesis|20|15: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleases thee.
verses.Genesis|20|16: And to Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, it is to thee a covering of the eyes, to all that are with thee, and unto all others: thus she was reproved.
verses.Genesis|20|17: So Abraham prayed to God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bore children.
verses.Genesis|20|18: For the Lord had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.
verses.Genesis|21|1: And the Lord visited Sarah as He had said, and the Lord did to Sarah as He had spoken.
verses.Genesis|21|2: For Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
verses.Genesis|21|3: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.
verses.Genesis|21|4: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.
verses.Genesis|21|5: And Abraham was a hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born to him.
verses.Genesis|21|6: And Sarah said, God has made laughter for me, so that all that hear will laugh with me.
verses.Genesis|21|7: And she said, Who would have said to Abraham, that Sarah should give children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.
verses.Genesis|21|8: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast on the same day that Isaac was weaned.
verses.Genesis|21|9: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had born to Abraham, mocking.
verses.Genesis|21|10: So she said to Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, with Isaac.
verses.Genesis|21|11: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's eyes because of his son.
verses.Genesis|21|12: And God said to Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah has said to thee, hearken to her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.
verses.Genesis|21|13: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
verses.Genesis|21|14: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.
verses.Genesis|21|15: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
verses.Genesis|21|16: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.
verses.Genesis|21|17: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said to her, What ails thee, Hagar? fear not; for God has heard the voice of the lad where he is.
verses.Genesis|21|18: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thy hand; for I will make him a great nation.
verses.Genesis|21|19: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
verses.Genesis|21|20: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
verses.Genesis|21|21: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
verses.Genesis|21|22: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol captain of his host spoke to Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:
verses.Genesis|21|23: now therefore swear to me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: but according to the kindness that I have done to thee, thou shalt do to me, and to the land in which thou hast sojourned.
verses.Genesis|21|24: And Abraham said, I will swear.
verses.Genesis|21|25: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of the well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.
verses.Genesis|21|26: And Abimelech said, I know not who has done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but today.
verses.Genesis|21|27: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them to Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
verses.Genesis|21|28: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
verses.Genesis|21|29: And Abimelech said to Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
verses.Genesis|21|30: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.
verses.Genesis|21|31: Therefore he called that place Beer-sheba; because there they swore both of them.
verses.Genesis|21|32: Thus they made a covenant at Beer-sheba; then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the captain of his host, and they returned to the land of the Philistines.
verses.Genesis|21|33: And Abraham planted a tamarisk in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of the Lord, the everlasting God.
verses.Genesis|21|34: And Abraham sojourned in the land of the Philistines many days.
verses.Genesis|22|1: And it came to pass after these things, that God did test Abraham, and said to him, Abraham: and he said, Here I am!
verses.Genesis|22|2: And He said, Take now thy son, thy only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
verses.Genesis|22|3: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and broke up the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.
verses.Genesis|22|4: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
verses.Genesis|22|5: And Abraham said to his young men, stay here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and prostrate ourselves, and come again to you.
verses.Genesis|22|6: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and the knife; and they went both of them together.
verses.Genesis|22|7: And Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here I am, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
verses.Genesis|22|8: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
