verses.Genesis|22|9: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.
verses.Genesis|22|10: And Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
verses.Genesis|22|11: And an angel of the Lord called to him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here I am.
verses.Genesis|22|12: And he said, Lay not thy hand upon the lad, neither do anything to him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thy only son from me.
verses.Genesis|22|13: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked and behold behind him a ram caught in the thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in place of his son.
verses.Genesis|22|14: And Abraham called the name of that place Adonai-jire: as it is said to this day, In the mount the Lord will appear.
verses.Genesis|22|15: And the angel of the Lord called to Abraham out of heaven the second time,
verses.Genesis|22|16: and said, By myself have I sworn, says the Lord, because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thy only son:
verses.Genesis|22|17: that I will exceedingly bless thee, and I will exceedingly multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of its enemies;
verses.Genesis|22|18: and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed My voice.
verses.Genesis|22|19: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.
verses.Genesis|22|20: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold Milcah, she also has born children to thy brother Nahor;
verses.Genesis|22|21: Uz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,
verses.Genesis|22|22: and Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
verses.Genesis|22|23: And Bethuel begot Rebekah: these eight did Milcah bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.
verses.Genesis|22|24: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bore also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.
verses.Genesis|23|1: And Sarah was a hundred and twenty seven years old: these were the years of Sarah's life.
verses.Genesis|23|2: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; that is Hebron, in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
verses.Genesis|23|3: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spoke to the sons of Heth, saying,
verses.Genesis|23|4: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
verses.Genesis|23|5: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,
verses.Genesis|23|6: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall with- hold from thee his tomb, but that thou mayst bury thy dead.
verses.Genesis|23|7: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth.
verses.Genesis|23|8: And he spoke with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
verses.Genesis|23|9: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field; for the full price he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.
verses.Genesis|23|10: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
verses.Genesis|23|11: No, my lord, hear me: the field I give thee, and the cave that is in it, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people I give it thee: bury thy dead.
verses.Genesis|23|12: And Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.
verses.Genesis|23|13: And he spoke to Ephron in the hearing of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee the price of the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.
verses.Genesis|23|14: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,
verses.Genesis|23|15: My lord, hearken to me: a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that between me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.
verses.Genesis|23|16: And Abraham hearkened to Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the hearing of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.
verses.Genesis|23|17: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made over
verses.Genesis|23|18: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
verses.Genesis|23|19: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.
verses.Genesis|23|20: And the field, and the cave that is in it, were made over to Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.
verses.Genesis|24|1: And Abraham was old, advanced in age: and the Lord had blessed Abraham in all things.
verses.Genesis|24|2: And Abraham said to the eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:
verses.Genesis|24|3: and I will make thee swear by the Lord, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanite, among whom I dwell;
verses.Genesis|24|4: but thou shalt go to my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife to my son Isaac.
verses.Genesis|24|5: And the servant said to him, Perhaps the woman will not be willing to follow me to this land: must I needs bring thy son back to the land from where thou didst come?
verses.Genesis|24|6: And Abraham said to him, Beware lest thou bring my son back there.
verses.Genesis|24|7: The Lord God of heaven, Who took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and Who spoke to me, and swore to me, saying, To thy seed will I give this land; He shall send His angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife for my son from there.
verses.Genesis|24|8: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son back there.
verses.Genesis|24|9: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning that matter.
verses.Genesis|24|10: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.
verses.Genesis|24|11: And he made his camels kneel down outside the city by a well of water at the time of evening, at the time that the women go out to draw water.
verses.Genesis|24|12: And he said, O Lord God of my master Abraham, I pray Thee, send me good speed this day, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
verses.Genesis|24|13: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:
verses.Genesis|24|14: and let it come to pass, that the girl to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let her be she that Thou hast appointed for Thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that Thou hast shown kindness to my master.
verses.Genesis|24|15: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
verses.Genesis|24|16: And the girl was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
verses.Genesis|24|17: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.
verses.Genesis|24|18: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hastened, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
verses.Genesis|24|19: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
verses.Genesis|24|20: And she hastened, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.
verses.Genesis|24|21: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to know whether the Lord had made his journey prosperous or not.
verses.Genesis|24|22: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;
verses.Genesis|24|23: and said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?
verses.Genesis|24|24: And she said to him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.
verses.Genesis|24|25: And she said to him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
verses.Genesis|24|26: And the man bowed down his head, and prostrated himself to the Lord.
verses.Genesis|24|27: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of my master Abraham, Who has not left my master destitute of His love and His truth: as for me, the Lord has guided me in the way to the house of my master's brethren.
verses.Genesis|24|28: And the girl ran, and told them of her mother's house these things.
verses.Genesis|24|29: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out to the man, to the well.
verses.Genesis|24|30: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spoke the man to me; that he came to the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.
verses.Genesis|24|31: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the Lord; why dost thou stand outside? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
verses.Genesis|24|32: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men's feet that were with him.
verses.Genesis|24|33: And there was set food before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told my errand. And he said, Speak on.
verses.Genesis|24|34: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.
verses.Genesis|24|35: And the Lord has blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and He has given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.
verses.Genesis|24|36: And Sarah my master's wife bore a son to my master when she was old: and to him he has given all that he has.
verses.Genesis|24|37: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanite, in whose land I dwell:
verses.Genesis|24|38: but thou shalt go to my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son.
verses.Genesis|24|39: And I said to my master, Perhaps the woman will not follow me.
verses.Genesis|24|40: And he said to me, The Lord, before Whom I walk, will send His angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:
verses.Genesis|24|41: then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they grant it not to thee, thou shalt be clear of my oath.
verses.Genesis|24|42: And I came this day to the well, and said, O Lord God of my master Abraham, if now Thou do prosper my way which I go:
verses.Genesis|24|43: behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that the maid who comes forth to draw, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water from thy pitcher to drink;
verses.Genesis|24|44: and she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: she shall be the woman whom the Lord has appointed for my master's son.
verses.Genesis|24|45: And before I had done speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down to the well, and drew water: and I said to her, Let me drink, I pray thee.
verses.Genesis|24|46: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels to drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.
verses.Genesis|24|47: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bore to him: and I put the ring upon her nose, and the bracelets upon her hands.
verses.Genesis|24|48: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the Lord, and blessed the Lord God of my master Abraham, Who had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter for his son.
verses.Genesis|24|49: And now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; so that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.
verses.Genesis|24|50: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing comes from the Lord: we cannot speak to thee bad or good.
verses.Genesis|24|51: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as the Lord has spoken.
verses.Genesis|24|52: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he prostrated himself to the earth before the Lord.
verses.Genesis|24|53: And the servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and garments, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
verses.Genesis|24|54: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away to my master.
verses.Genesis|24|55: And her brother and her mother said, Let the girl stay with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.
verses.Genesis|24|56: And he said to them, Hinder me not, seeing the Lord has prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.
verses.Genesis|24|57: And they said, We will call the girl, and inquire at her mouth.
verses.Genesis|24|58: And they called Rebekah, and said to her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.
verses.Genesis|24|59: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.
verses.Genesis|24|60: And they blessed Rebekah, and said to her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.
verses.Genesis|24|61: And Rebekah, and her maids arose, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
verses.Genesis|24|62: And Isaac came from the way of Beer-lahai-roi; for he dwelt in the land of the south.
verses.Genesis|24|63: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening time: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, camels were coming.
verses.Genesis|24|64: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she descended from the camel.
verses.Genesis|24|65: And she said to the servant, What man is this that walks in the field to meet us? And the servant said, It is my master: therefore she took her veil, and covered herself.
verses.Genesis|24|66: And the servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.
verses.Genesis|24|67: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.
verses.Genesis|25|1: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.
verses.Genesis|25|2: And she bore him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.Genesis|25|3: And Jokshan begot Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
verses.Genesis|25|4: And the sons of Midian; Ephah and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
verses.Genesis|25|5: And Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac.
verses.Genesis|25|6: But to the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from his son, while he yet lived, eastward, to the east country.
verses.Genesis|25|7: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, a hundred and seventy five years.
verses.Genesis|25|8: Then Abraham expired, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.
verses.Genesis|25|9: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;
verses.Genesis|25|10: the field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
verses.Genesis|25|11: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by Beer-lahai-roi.
verses.Genesis|25|12: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bore to Abraham:
verses.Genesis|25|13: and these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.Genesis|25|14: and Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,
verses.Genesis|25|15: Hadad, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
verses.Genesis|25|16: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their encampments; twelve princes according to their nations.
verses.Genesis|25|17: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, a hundred and thirty seven years: and he expired and died; and was gathered to his people.
verses.Genesis|25|18: And they dwelt from Havilah to Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he dwelt in the presence of all his brethren.
verses.Genesis|25|19: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son: Abraham begot Isaac:
verses.Genesis|25|20: and Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan-aram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.
verses.Genesis|25|21: And Isaac entreated the Lord for his wife, because she was barren: and the Lord was entreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
verses.Genesis|25|22: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to inquire of the Lord.
verses.Genesis|25|23: And the Lord said to her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two peoples shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.
verses.Genesis|25|24: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
verses.Genesis|25|25: And the first came out red, all over like a hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.
verses.Genesis|25|26: And after that came out his brother, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.
verses.Genesis|25|27: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.
verses.Genesis|25|28: And Isaac loved Esau, for he relished his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.Genesis|25|29: And Jacob cooked pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:
verses.Genesis|25|30: and Esau said to Jacob, Give me to swallow, I pray thee, of that red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom (red).
verses.Genesis|25|31: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.
verses.Genesis|25|32: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point of death, and what profit shall this birthright do to me?
verses.Genesis|25|33: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he swore to him: and he sold his birthright to Jacob.
verses.Genesis|25|34: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentils; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised the birthright.
verses.Genesis|26|1: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went to Abimelech, king of the Philistines to Gerar.
verses.Genesis|26|2: And the Lord appeared to him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:
verses.Genesis|26|3: sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for to thee, and to thy seed, I will give all these countries and I will perform the oath which I swore to Abraham thy father;
verses.Genesis|26|4: and I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and will give to thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;
verses.Genesis|26|5: because Abraham obeyed My voice, and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes, and My laws.
verses.Genesis|26|7: and the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me on account of Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.
verses.Genesis|26|8: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.
verses.Genesis|26|9: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, surely she is thy wife: and how didst thou say, She is my sister? And Isaac said to him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.
verses.Genesis|26|10: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done to us? one of the people might easily have lain with thy wife, and thou shouldst have brought guiltiness upon us.
verses.Genesis|26|11: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that touches this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
verses.Genesis|26|12: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year a hundredfold: for the Lord blessed him.
verses.Genesis|26|13: And the man grew great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:
verses.Genesis|26|14: for he had possessions of flocks, and possessions of herds, and a great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.
verses.Genesis|26|15: For all the wells which his father's servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them up, and filled them with earth.
verses.Genesis|26|16: And Abimelech said to Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.
verses.Genesis|26|17: And Isaac departed from there, and pitched in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
verses.Genesis|26|18: And Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them up after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
verses.Genesis|26|19: And Jizhac's servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.
verses.Genesis|26|20: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Jizhac's herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.
verses.Genesis|26|21: And they dug another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.
verses.Genesis|26|22: And he removed from there, and dug another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the Lord has made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.
verses.Genesis|26|23: And he went up from there to Beer-sheba.
verses.Genesis|26|24: And the Lord appeared to him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for My servant Abraham's sake.
verses.Genesis|26|25: And he built an altar there, and called upon the name of the Lord, and pitched his tent there: and there Jizhac's servants dug a well.
verses.Genesis|26|26: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath his friend, and Phichol the captain of his army.
verses.Genesis|26|27: And Isaac said to them, Why do you come to me, seeing you hate me, and have sent me away from you?
verses.Genesis|26|28: And they said, We saw indeed that the Lord was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath between us, between us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;
verses.Genesis|26|29: that thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done to thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the Lord.
verses.Genesis|26|30: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
verses.Genesis|26|31: And they rose up early in the morning, and swore one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
verses.Genesis|26|32: And it came to pass the same day, that Jizhac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, We have found water.
verses.Genesis|26|33: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beer-sheba to this day.
verses.Genesis|26|34: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:
verses.Genesis|26|35: and they were a grief of mind to Isaac and to Rebekah.
verses.Genesis|27|1: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said to him, My son: and he said to him, Here I am.
verses.Genesis|27|2: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:
verses.Genesis|27|3: now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and catch me some venison;
verses.Genesis|27|4: and make me savoury food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, that my soul may bless thee before I die.
verses.Genesis|27|5: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
verses.Genesis|27|6: And Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak to Esau thy brother, saying,
verses.Genesis|27|7: Bring me venison, and make me savoury food, that I may eat, and bless thee before the Lord before my death.
verses.Genesis|27|8: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.
verses.Genesis|27|9: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from there two good kids of the goats; and I will make them into savoury food for thy father, such as he loves:
verses.Genesis|27|10: and thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.
verses.Genesis|27|11: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:
verses.Genesis|27|12: my father perhaps will feel me, and I shall seem to him a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.
verses.Genesis|27|13: And his mother said to him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.
verses.Genesis|27|14: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury food, such as his father loved.
verses.Genesis|27|15: And Rebekah took the best clothes of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:
verses.Genesis|27|16: and she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
verses.Genesis|27|17: and she gave the savoury food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
verses.Genesis|27|18: And he came to his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I: who art thou, my son?
verses.Genesis|27|19: And Jacob said to his father, I am Esau thy firstborn; I have done according as thou didst tell me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.
verses.Genesis|27|20: And Isaac said to his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because, the Lord thy God sent me good speed.
verses.Genesis|27|21: And Isaac said to Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou art really my son Esau or not.
verses.Genesis|27|22: And Jacob went near to Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
verses.Genesis|27|23: And he recognised him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands: so he blessed him.
verses.Genesis|27|24: And he said, Art thou really my son Esau? And he said, I am.
verses.Genesis|27|25: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.
verses.Genesis|27|26: And his father Isaac said to him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.
verses.Genesis|27|27: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelt the smell of his garments, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field which the Lord has blessed:
verses.Genesis|27|28: therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
verses.Genesis|27|29: let peoples serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: cursed be those that curse thee, and blessed be those that bless thee.
verses.Genesis|27|30: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
verses.Genesis|27|31: And he also had made savoury food, and brought it to his father, and said to his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.
verses.Genesis|27|32: And Isaac his father said to him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.
verses.Genesis|27|33: And Isaac trembled very much, and said, Who then is he that has taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? moreover, he shall be blessed.
verses.Genesis|27|34: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceedingly bitter cry, and said to his father, Bless me, me also, O my father.
verses.Genesis|27|35: And he said, Thy brother came with cunning and has taken away thy blessing.
verses.Genesis|27|36: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he has supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he has taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?
verses.Genesis|27|37: And Isaac answered and said to Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now for thee, my son?
verses.Genesis|27|38: And Esau said to his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father.
verses.Genesis|27|39: And Esau raised his voice, and wept. And Isaac his father answered and said to him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be of the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;
verses.Genesis|27|40: and by thy sword shalt thou live, and thou shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.
verses.Genesis|27|41: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, When the days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.
verses.Genesis|27|42: And these words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said to him, Behold, thy brother Esau comforts himself, purposing to kill thee.
verses.Genesis|27|43: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee to Laban my brother, to Haran;
verses.Genesis|27|44: and dwell with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away;
verses.Genesis|27|45: until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from there: why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?
verses.Genesis|27|46: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life be to me?
verses.Genesis|28|1: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said to him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
verses.Genesis|28|2: Arise, go to Padan-aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from there of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.
verses.Genesis|28|3: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayst be a multitude of people;
verses.Genesis|28|4: and give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayst inherit the land in which thou art a sojourner, and which God gave to Abraham.
verses.Genesis|28|5: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padan-aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, mother of Jacob and Esau.
verses.Genesis|28|6: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padan-aram, to take him a wife from there; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan:
verses.Genesis|28|7: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padan-aram,
verses.Genesis|28|8: and Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;
verses.Genesis|28|9: then Esau went and took to wife besides the wives he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebaioth.
verses.Genesis|28|10: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.
verses.Genesis|28|11: And he lighted on a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.
verses.Genesis|28|12: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
verses.Genesis|28|13: And, behold, the Lord stood above it, and said, I am the Lord God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land on which thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;
verses.Genesis|28|14: and thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
verses.Genesis|28|15: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places to which thou goest, and will bring thee back to this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
verses.Genesis|28|16: And Jacob awoke out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the Lord is in this place; and I knew it not.
verses.Genesis|28|17: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is no other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.
verses.Genesis|28|18: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on the top of it.
verses.Genesis|28|19: And he called the name of that place Beth-el: but the name of that city was called Luz at first.
verses.Genesis|28|20: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to wear,
verses.Genesis|28|21: so that I come back to my father's house in peace, then the Lord shall be my God:
verses.Genesis|28|22: and this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God's house: and of all that Thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth to Thee.
verses.Genesis|29|1: Then Jacob lifted up his feet, and went to the land of the people of the east.
verses.Genesis|29|2: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well's mouth.
verses.Genesis|29|3: And there were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone back upon the well's mouth in its place.
verses.Genesis|29|4: And Jacob said to them, My brethren, where are you from? And they said, Of Haran are we.
verses.Genesis|29|5: And he said to them, Do you know Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.
verses.Genesis|29|6: And he said to them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter comes with the sheep.
verses.Genesis|29|7: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water the sheep, and go and feed them.
verses.Genesis|29|8: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks are gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well's mouth; then we may water the sheep.
verses.Genesis|29|9: And while he was still speaking with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep: for she kept them.
verses.Genesis|29|10: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.
verses.Genesis|29|11: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and raised his voice, and wept.
verses.Genesis|29|12: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.
verses.Genesis|29|13: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.
verses.Genesis|29|14: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he stayed with him a month.
verses.Genesis|29|15: And Laban said to Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldst thou therefore serve me for nothing? tell me, what shall thy wages be?
verses.Genesis|29|16: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
verses.Genesis|29|17: And Leah's eyes were weak; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.
verses.Genesis|29|18: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.
verses.Genesis|29|19: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: stay with me.
verses.Genesis|29|20: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel and they seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had to her.
verses.Genesis|29|21: And Jacob said to Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.
verses.Genesis|29|22: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
verses.Genesis|29|23: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in to her.
verses.Genesis|29|24: And Laban gave to his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for a handmaid.
verses.Genesis|29|25: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done to me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? why then hast thou beguiled me?
verses.Genesis|29|26: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.
verses.Genesis|29|27: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet another seven years.
verses.Genesis|29|28: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.
verses.Genesis|29|29: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his maid to be her handmaid.
verses.Genesis|29|30: And he went in also to Rachel, and moreover he loved Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet another seven years.
verses.Genesis|29|31: And when the Lord saw that Leah was hated, He opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.
verses.Genesis|29|32: And Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the Lord has looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.
verses.Genesis|29|33: And she conceived again, and bore a son; and said, Because the Lord has heard that I was hated, He has therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.
verses.Genesis|29|34: And she conceived again, and bore a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined to me, because I have born him three sons; therefore was his name called Levi.
verses.Genesis|29|35: And she conceived again, and bore a son and she said, Now will I praise the Lord: therefore she called his name Judah, and she left off bearing.
verses.Genesis|30|1: And when Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said, Give me children, or else I die.
verses.Genesis|30|2: And Jacob's anger burned against Rachel: and he said, Am I in the place of God, Who has withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?
verses.Genesis|30|3: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in to her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.
verses.Genesis|30|4: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in to her.
verses.Genesis|30|5: And Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.
verses.Genesis|30|6: And Rachel said, God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.
verses.Genesis|30|7: And Bilhah Rachel's maid conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.
verses.Genesis|30|8: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.
verses.Genesis|30|9: When Leah saw that she had stopped bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her to Jacob to wife.
verses.Genesis|30|10: And Zilpah Leah's maid bore Jacob a son.
verses.Genesis|30|11: And Leah said, Fortune comes, and she called his name Gad.
verses.Genesis|30|12: And Zilpah Leah's maid bore Jacob a second son.
verses.Genesis|30|13: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.
verses.Genesis|30|14: And Reuben went in the days of the wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.
verses.Genesis|30|15: And she said to her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldst thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee tonight for thy son's mandrakes.
verses.Genesis|30|16: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in to me; for indeed I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.
verses.Genesis|30|17: And God hearkened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.
verses.Genesis|30|18: And Leah said, God has given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.
verses.Genesis|30|19: And Leah conceived again, and bore Jacob a sixth son.
verses.Genesis|30|20: And Leah said, God has endowed me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.
verses.Genesis|30|21: And afterwards she bore a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
verses.Genesis|30|22: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
verses.Genesis|30|23: And she conceived, and bore a son; and said, God has taken away my reproach:
verses.Genesis|30|24: and she called his name Joseph; and said, The Lord shall add to me another son.
verses.Genesis|30|25: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said to Laban, Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.
verses.Genesis|30|26: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowst my service which I have done thee.
verses.Genesis|30|27: And Laban said to him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, I have learned by signs that the Lord has blessed me for thy sake.
verses.Genesis|30|28: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.
verses.Genesis|30|29: And he said to him, Thou knowst how I have served thee, and how thy cattle were with me.
verses.Genesis|30|30: For the little which thou hadst before I came is now increased to a multitude; and the Lord has blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for my own house also?
verses.Genesis|30|31: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me anything: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock.
verses.Genesis|30|32: I will pass through all thy flock today, removing from there all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown ones among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.
verses.Genesis|30|33: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when thou shalt come to see my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.
verses.Genesis|30|34: And Laban said, Behold, would it might be according to thy word.
verses.Genesis|30|35: And he removed that day the he goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
verses.Genesis|30|36: And he set three days' journey between himself and Jacob: and Jacob tended the rest of Laban's flocks.
verses.Genesis|30|37: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the almond and plane tree; and peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
verses.Genesis|30|38: And he set the rods which he had peeled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.
verses.Genesis|30|39: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle streaked, speckled, and spotted.
verses.Genesis|30|40: And Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not to Laban's cattle.
verses.Genesis|30|41: And it came to pass, whenever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.
verses.Genesis|30|42: But when the cattle were feeble, he did not put them in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.
verses.Genesis|30|43: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.
verses.Genesis|31|1: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob has taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's has he gotten all his glory.
verses.Genesis|31|2: And Jacob beheld the face of Laban, and, behold, it was not towards him as before.
verses.Genesis|31|3: And the Lord said to Jacob, Return to the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.
verses.Genesis|31|4: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,
verses.Genesis|31|5: and he said to them, I see your father's face, that it is not towards me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.
verses.Genesis|31|6: And you know that with all my power I have served your father.
verses.Genesis|31|7: And your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God did not allow him to hurt me.
verses.Genesis|31|8: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the flock bore speckled: and if he said thus, The streaked shall be thy hire; then all the flock bore streaked.
verses.Genesis|31|9: Thus God has taken away the cattle of your father, and given it to me.
verses.Genesis|31|10: And it came to pass at the time that the flock conceived, that I raised my eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were streaked, speckled, and grizzled.
verses.Genesis|31|11: And the angel of God spoke to me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here I am.
verses.Genesis|31|12: And he said, Lift up now thy eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the flock are streaked, speckled, and grizzled: for I have seen all that Laban does to thee.
verses.Genesis|31|13: I am the God of Beth-el, where thou didst anoint a pillar, and where thou didst vow a vow to me: now arise, get out of this land, and return to the land of thy birth.
verses.Genesis|31|14: And Rachel and Leah answered and said to him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
verses.Genesis|31|15: Are we not counted strangers by him? for he has sold us, and has quite devoured also our money.
verses.Genesis|31|16: For all the riches which God has taken from our father, it is ours, and our children's: now then, whatever God has said to thee, do.
verses.Genesis|31|17: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels;
verses.Genesis|31|18: and he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had acquired, the cattle of his getting, which he had acquired in Padan-aram, to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.
verses.Genesis|31|19: And Laban went to shear his sheep. Now Rachel had stolen the images that were her father's.
verses.Genesis|31|20: And Jacob outwitted Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
verses.Genesis|31|21: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river and set his face toward the mount Gilead.
verses.Genesis|31|22: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
verses.Genesis|31|23: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him a seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.
verses.Genesis|31|24: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said to him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad. Then Laban overtook Jacob.
verses.Genesis|31|25: Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.
verses.Genesis|31|26: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast cheated me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?
verses.Genesis|31|27: Why didst thou flee away secretly, and rob me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with timbrel, and with lyre?
verses.Genesis|31|28: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly.
verses.Genesis|31|29: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.Genesis|31|30: And now, though thou wouldst needs be gone, because thou dost long after thy father's house, yet why hast thou stolen my gods?
verses.Genesis|31|31: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Perhaps thou wouldst take by force thy daughters from me.
verses.Genesis|31|32: Anyone with whom thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.
verses.Genesis|31|33: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found them not. Then he went out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.
verses.Genesis|31|34: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's saddle, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.
verses.Genesis|31|35: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the way of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.
verses.Genesis|31|36: And Jacob was angry and strove with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?
verses.Genesis|31|37: Although thou hast searched all my stuff what hast thou found of all thy household goods? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge between us both.
verses.Genesis|31|38: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.
verses.Genesis|31|39: That which was torn of beasts I brought not to thee; I bore the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.
verses.Genesis|31|40: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from my eyes.
verses.Genesis|31|41: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.
verses.Genesis|31|42: Were it not that the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the Fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God has seen my affliction and the labour of my hands, and He rebuked thee last night.
verses.Genesis|31|43: And Laban answered and said to Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day for these my daughters, or for their children whom they have born?
verses.Genesis|31|44: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.
verses.Genesis|31|45: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
verses.Genesis|31|46: And Jacob said to his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made a heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.
verses.Genesis|31|47: And Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.
verses.Genesis|31|48: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day.
verses.Genesis|31|49: Therefore was the name of it called Galeed; and also Mizpah; for he said, The Lord watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
verses.Genesis|31|50: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness between me and thee.
verses.Genesis|31|51: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have set between me and thee;
verses.Genesis|31|52: this heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.
verses.Genesis|31|53: The God of Abraham, and the god of Nahor, the god of their father, judge between us. And Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.
verses.Genesis|31|54: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night on the mountain.
verses.Genesis|32|1: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned to his place.
verses.Genesis|32|2: And Jacob went on his way, and angels of God met him.
verses.Genesis|32|3: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's camp: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
verses.Genesis|32|4: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother to the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
verses.Genesis|32|5: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall you speak to my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob says thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:
verses.Genesis|32|6: and I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favour in thy sight.
verses.Genesis|32|7: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he is coming to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.
verses.Genesis|32|8: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that were with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two camps;
verses.Genesis|32|9: and said, If Esau come to the one camp, and smite it, then the camp which is left shall escape.
verses.Genesis|32|10: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the Lord Who did say to me, Return to thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:
verses.Genesis|32|11: I am unworthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which Thou hast shown Thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two camps.
verses.Genesis|32|12: Deliver me, I pray Thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he come and smite me, the mother with the children.
verses.Genesis|32|13: And Thou didst say, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed like the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
verses.Genesis|32|14: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;
verses.Genesis|32|15: two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,
verses.Genesis|32|16: thirty milch camels with their colts, forty cows, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.
verses.Genesis|32|17: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by itself; and said to his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space between drove and drove.
verses.Genesis|32|18: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meets thee, and asks thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither dost thou go? and whose are these before thee?
verses.Genesis|32|19: Then thou shalt say, They are thy servant Jacob's, it is a present sent to my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.
verses.Genesis|32|20: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, In this manner shall you speak to Esau, when you find him.
verses.Genesis|32|21: And say moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterwards I will see his face; perhaps he will accept me.
verses.Genesis|32|22: So the present went over before him: and he himself lodged that night in the camp.
verses.Genesis|32|23: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford of Jabbok.
verses.Genesis|32|24: And he took them, and sent them over the wadi, and sent over that which he had.
verses.Genesis|32|25: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
verses.Genesis|32|26: And when he saw that he did not prevail against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was put out of joint, as he wrestled with him.
verses.Genesis|32|27: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaks. And he said, I will not let thee go, unless thou bless me.
verses.Genesis|32|28: And he said to him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.
verses.Genesis|32|29: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for thou hast contended with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
verses.Genesis|32|30: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Why is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.
verses.Genesis|32|31: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.
verses.Genesis|32|32: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he limped upon his thigh.
verses.Genesis|32|33: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew of the vein, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, to this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew of the vein.
verses.Genesis|33|1: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children to Leah, and to Rachel, and to the two handmaids.
verses.Genesis|33|2: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph last of all.
verses.Genesis|33|3: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
verses.Genesis|33|4: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
verses.Genesis|33|5: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God has graciously given thy servant.
verses.Genesis|33|6: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
verses.Genesis|33|7: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
verses.Genesis|33|8: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find favour in the sight of my lord.
verses.Genesis|33|9: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep what thou hast to thyself.
verses.Genesis|33|10: And Jacob said, By no means, if now I have found favour in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for truly I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of an angel, and thou wast pleased with me.
verses.Genesis|33|11: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.
verses.Genesis|33|12: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.
verses.Genesis|33|13: And he said to him, My lord knows that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds giving suck are a care for me: and if they should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.
verses.Genesis|33|14: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on slowly, according to the pace of the cattle that goes before me and the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.
verses.Genesis|33|15: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What need is there? let me find favour in the sight of my lord.
verses.Genesis|33|16: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.
verses.Genesis|33|17: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him a house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
verses.Genesis|33|18: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan-aram; and pitched his tent before the city.
verses.Genesis|33|19: And he bought the piece of land on which he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for a hundred pieces of money.
verses.Genesis|33|20: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-elohe-Israel.
verses.Genesis|34|1: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
verses.Genesis|34|2: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.
verses.Genesis|34|3: And his soul was drawn to Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the girl, and spoke kindly to the girl.
verses.Genesis|34|4: And Shechem spoke to his father Hamor, saying, Get me this child for a wife.
verses.Genesis|34|5: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.
verses.Genesis|34|6: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to speak with him.
verses.Genesis|34|7: And the sons of Jacob came from the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done a disgraceful thing in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done.
verses.Genesis|34|8: And Hamor spoke with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longs for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.
verses.Genesis|34|9: And make marriages with us; give your daughters to us, and take our daughters to you.
verses.Genesis|34|10: And you shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade in it, and get property in it.
verses.Genesis|34|11: And Shechem said to her father and to her brethren, Let me find favour in your eyes, and what you shall say to me I will give.
verses.Genesis|34|12: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as you shall say to me: but give me the girl for a wife.
verses.Genesis|34|13: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with cunning, because he had defiled Dinah their sister, and they spoke:
verses.Genesis|34|14: and they said to them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that would be a reproach to us:
verses.Genesis|34|15: but in this will we consent to you: If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised;
verses.Genesis|34|16: then will we give our daughters to you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
verses.Genesis|34|17: But if you will not hearken to us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
verses.Genesis|34|18: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem, Hamor's son.
verses.Genesis|34|19: And the young man did not delay to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he was the most honoured of all the house of his father.
verses.Genesis|34|20: And Hamor and Shechem his son came to the gate of their city, and spoke with the men of their city, saying,
verses.Genesis|34|21: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade in it; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
verses.Genesis|34|22: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
verses.Genesis|34|23: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent to them, and they will dwell with us.
verses.Genesis|34|24: And to Hamor and to Shechem his son all that went out of the gate of his city hearkened; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
verses.Genesis|34|25: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were in pain, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city unresisted, and slew all the males.
verses.Genesis|34|26: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.
verses.Genesis|34|27: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.
verses.Genesis|34|28: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,
verses.Genesis|34|29: and all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives they took captive, and plundered all that was in the house.
verses.Genesis|34|30: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, You have brought trouble on me to make me odious among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanite and the Perizzite; and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.
verses.Genesis|34|31: But they said, Should he deal with our sister as with a harlot?
verses.Genesis|35|1: And God said to Jacob, Arise, go up to Beth-el, and dwell there: and make there an altar to God, Who appeared to thee when thou didst flee from the face of Esau thy brother.
verses.Genesis|35|2: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and make yourselves clean, and change your garments:
verses.Genesis|35|3: and let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar to God, Who answers me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way on which I went.
verses.Genesis|35|4: And they gave to Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
verses.Genesis|35|5: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
verses.Genesis|35|6: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Beth-el, he and all the people that were with him.
verses.Genesis|35|7: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el: because there God appeared to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
verses.Genesis|35|8: And Deborah, Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried beneath Beth-el under an oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bachuth.
verses.Genesis|35|9: And God appeared to Jacob again, when he came out of Padan-aram, and blessed him.
verses.Genesis|35|10: And God said to him, Thy name Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and He called his name Israel.
verses.Genesis|35|11: And God said to him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
verses.Genesis|35|12: and the land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.
verses.Genesis|35|13: And God went up from him in the place where He talked with him.
verses.Genesis|35|14: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He talked with him, a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering on it, and he poured oil on it.
verses.Genesis|35|15: And Jacob called the name of the place where God had spoken with him, Beth-el.
verses.Genesis|35|16: And they journeyed from Beth-el; and there was but a little way to come to Ephratah: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.
verses.Genesis|35|17: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said to her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.
verses.Genesis|35|18: And it came to pass, as her soul was departing (for she died), that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.
verses.Genesis|35|19: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephratah, which is Beth-lehem.
verses.Genesis|35|20: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel's grave to this day.
verses.Genesis|35|21: And Israel journeyed, and pitched his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
verses.Genesis|35|22: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
verses.Genesis|35|23: the sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob's first-born, and Simeon and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar and Zebulun.
verses.Genesis|35|24: The sons of Rachel; Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.Genesis|35|25: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali.
verses.Genesis|35|26: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob who were born to him in Padan-aram.
verses.Genesis|35|27: And Jacob came to Isaac his father to Mamre, to the city of Arba, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
verses.Genesis|35|28: And the days of Isaac were a hundred and eighty years.
verses.Genesis|35|29: And Isaac expired, and died, and was gathered to his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
verses.Genesis|36|1: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.
verses.Genesis|36|2: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah, daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
verses.Genesis|36|3: and Bashemath, daughter of Ishmael, sister of Nebaioth.
verses.Genesis|36|4: And Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bore Reuel;
verses.Genesis|36|5: and Aholibamah bore Jeush and Jaalam, and Korah: these were the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
verses.Genesis|36|6: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had acquired in the land of Canaan; and went into another country away from his brother Jacob.
verses.Genesis|36|7: For their property was too great for them to dwell together; and the land in which they sojourned could not bear them because of their cattle.
verses.Genesis|36|8: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.
verses.Genesis|36|9: And these are the generations of Esau the father of Edom in mount Seir:
verses.Genesis|36|10: these are the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.
verses.Genesis|36|11: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.Genesis|36|12: And Timnah was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek; these were the sons of Adah Esau's wife.
verses.Genesis|36|13: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
verses.Genesis|36|14: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bore to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.Genesis|36|15: These were the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; the chief Teman, the chief Omar, the chief Zepho, the chief Kenaz,
verses.Genesis|36|16: the chief Korah, the chief Gatam, the chief Amalek: these are the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.
verses.Genesis|36|17: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau's son; the chief Nahath, the chief Zerah, the chief Shammah, the chief Mizzah: these are the chiefs that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
verses.Genesis|36|18: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau's wife; the chief Jeush, the chief Jaalam, the chief Korah: these were the chiefs that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.
verses.Genesis|36|19: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their chiefs.
verses.Genesis|36|20: These are the sons of Seir the Horite who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon and Anah.
verses.Genesis|36|21: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the chiefs of the Hori, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.Genesis|36|22: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timnah.
verses.Genesis|36|23: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
verses.Genesis|36|24: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Aiah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
verses.Genesis|36|25: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
verses.Genesis|36|26: And these are the children of Dishan; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.Genesis|36|27: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
verses.Genesis|36|28: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.
verses.Genesis|36|29: These are the chiefs that came of the Hori: the chief Lotan, the chief Shobal, the chief Zibeon, the chief Anah,
verses.Genesis|36|30: the chief Dishon, the chief Ezer, the chief Dishan: these are the chiefs that came of the Hori, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.
verses.Genesis|36|31: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.
verses.Genesis|36|32: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.Genesis|36|33: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place;
verses.Genesis|36|34: and Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temani reigned in his place;
verses.Genesis|36|35: and Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.Genesis|36|36: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place;
verses.Genesis|36|37: and Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his place;
verses.Genesis|36|38: and Saul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place;
verses.Genesis|36|39: and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place, and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, daughter of Matred, daughter of Mezahab.
verses.Genesis|36|40: And these are the names of the chiefs that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; the chief Timnah, the chief Alvah, the chief Jetheth,
verses.Genesis|36|41: the chief Aholibamah, the chief Elah, the chief Pinon,
verses.Genesis|36|42: the chief Kenaz, the chief Teman, the chief Mibzar,
verses.Genesis|36|43: the chief Magdiel, the chief Iram: these are the chiefs of Edom, according to their settlements in the land of their possession. He is Esau the father of Edom.
verses.Genesis|37|1: And Jacob dwelt in the land in which his father had sojourned, in the land of Canaan.
verses.Genesis|37|2: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought to his father their evil report.
verses.Genesis|37|3: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat with long sleeves.
verses.Genesis|37|4: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably to him.
verses.Genesis|37|5: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
verses.Genesis|37|6: And he said to them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:
verses.Genesis|37|7: for, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and bowed down to my sheaf.
verses.Genesis|37|8: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.
verses.Genesis|37|9: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have again dreamed a dream; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars bowed down to me.
verses.Genesis|37|10: And he told it to his father, and to his brothers: and his father rebuked him, and said to him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brothers indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?
verses.Genesis|37|11: And his brothers envied him; but his father kept the matter in mind.
