verses.Exodus|21|29: But if the ox was wont to gore with his horn in time past, and his owner had been warned, yet he had not kept him in, but it killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and its owner also shall be put to death.
verses.Exodus|21|30: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatever is laid upon him.
verses.Exodus|21|31: Whether he has gored a son, or gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done to him.
verses.Exodus|21|32: If the ox shall gore a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give to their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
verses.Exodus|21|33: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall into it;
verses.Exodus|21|34: the owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money to the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.
verses.Exodus|21|35: And if one man's ox hurt another's, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.
verses.Exodus|21|36: Or if it be known that the ox has long been in the habit of goring, and his owner has not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
verses.Exodus|21|37: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
verses.Exodus|22|1: If a thief be found breaking in, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed on his account.
verses.Exodus|22|2: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed on his account. He should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.Exodus|22|3: If the theft be at all found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
verses.Exodus|22|4: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of his field, and of the best of his vineyard, shall he make restitution
verses.Exodus|22|5: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the sheaves, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
verses.Exodus|22|6: If a man shall deliver to his neighbour money or vessels to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, he shall pay double.
verses.Exodus|22|7: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought to the judges, to swear that he has not put his hand to his neighbour's goods.
verses.Exodus|22|8: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for a garment, or for any manner of lost thing, of which one can say, This is it, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double to his neighbour.
verses.Exodus|22|9: If a man deliver to his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or be driven away, no man seeing it:
verses.Exodus|22|10: then shall an oath of the Lord be between them both, that he has not put his hand to his neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall accept this, and he shall not make it good.
verses.Exodus|22|11: But if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution to its owner.
verses.Exodus|22|12: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it as evidence; he shall not make good that which was torn.
verses.Exodus|22|13: And if a man borrow aught of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make it good.
verses.Exodus|22|14: But if its owner be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be a hired thing, it came for his hire.
verses.Exodus|22|15: And if a man seduce a virgin that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall pay the bride price for her to be his wife.
verses.Exodus|22|16: If her father utterly refuse to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the marriage price of virgins.
verses.Exodus|22|17: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
verses.Exodus|22|18: Whoever cohabits with a beast shall surely be put to death.
verses.Exodus|22|19: He that sacrifices to any god, save to the Lord only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.Exodus|22|20: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.Exodus|22|21: You shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
verses.Exodus|22|22: If thou at all afflict them, and they cry to me, I will surely hear their cry;
verses.Exodus|22|23: and my anger shall be inflamed, and I will kill you with the sword; then your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
verses.Exodus|22|24: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as a creditor, neither shall you lay upon him interest.
verses.Exodus|22|25: If thou at all take thy neighbour's garment for a pledge, thou shalt deliver it to him by sundown:
verses.Exodus|22|26: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin: in what shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he cries to me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.
verses.Exodus|22|27: Thou shalt not revile the judges, nor curse the ruler of thy people.
verses.Exodus|22|28: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give to me.
verses.Exodus|22|29: In like manner shalt thou do with thy oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
verses.Exodus|22|30: And you shall be holy men to me: neither shall you eat any meat that is torn of beasts in the field; you shall cast it to the dogs.
verses.Exodus|23|1: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thy hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
verses.Exodus|23|2: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to incline after a multitude to pervert justice:
verses.Exodus|23|3: nor shalt thou favour a poor man in his cause.
verses.Exodus|23|4: If thou meet thy enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
verses.Exodus|23|5: If thou see the ass of him that hates thee lying under its burden, and wouldst forbear to unload it, thou shalt surely unload it with him.
verses.Exodus|23|6: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
verses.Exodus|23|7: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
verses.Exodus|23|8: And thou shalt take no bribe: for the bribe blinds the wise, and perverts the words of the righteous.
verses.Exodus|23|9: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for you know the heart of a stranger, seeing you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.Exodus|23|10: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in its fruits:
verses.Exodus|23|11: but the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie fallow; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave, the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy olive grove.
verses.Exodus|23|12: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thy ox and thy ass may rest; and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
verses.Exodus|23|13: And all things that I have said to you be mindful of: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
verses.Exodus|23|14: Three times thou shalt keep a feast to me in the year.
verses.Exodus|23|15: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou didst come out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
verses.Exodus|23|16: and the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is at the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.
verses.Exodus|23|17: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord God.
verses.Exodus|23|18: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.
verses.Exodus|23|19: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring to the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not boil a kid in its mother's milk.
verses.Exodus|23|20: Behold, I send an angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee to the place which I have prepared.
verses.Exodus|23|21: Take heed of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.
verses.Exodus|23|22: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy to thy enemies, and an adversary to thy adversaries.
verses.Exodus|23|23: For my angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Canaanite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.
verses.Exodus|23|24: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and completely break down their images.
verses.Exodus|23|25: And you shall serve the Lord your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
verses.Exodus|23|26: None shall miscarry, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfill.
verses.Exodus|23|27: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thy enemies turn their backs to thee.
verses.Exodus|23|28: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
verses.Exodus|23|29: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the wild beasts multiply against thee.
verses.Exodus|23|30: Little by little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
verses.Exodus|23|31: And I will set thy bounds from the Red Sea even to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
verses.Exodus|23|32: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
verses.Exodus|23|33: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to thee.
verses.Exodus|24|1: And he said to Moses, Come up to the Lord, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and bow down afar off.
verses.Exodus|24|2: And Moses alone shall come near the Lord: but they shall not come near; nor shall the people go up with him.
verses.Exodus|24|3: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the Lord, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the Lord has said will we do.
verses.Exodus|24|4: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord, and rose up early in the morning, and built an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.Exodus|24|5: And he sent the young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen to the Lord.
verses.Exodus|24|6: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basins; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
verses.Exodus|24|7: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the hearing of the people: and they said, All that the Lord has said will we do, and obey.
verses.Exodus|24|8: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord has made with you concerning all these words.
verses.Exodus|24|9: Then Moses went up, and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
verses.Exodus|24|10: and they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet a kind of paved work of sapphire stone, and as it were the very heaven for clearness.
verses.Exodus|24|11: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: and they beheld God, and did eat and drink.
verses.Exodus|24|12: And the Lord said to Moses, Come up to me to the mountain, and be there: and I will give thee the tablets of stone, and the law, and the commandments which I have written; that thou mayst teach them.
verses.Exodus|24|13: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
verses.Exodus|24|14: And he said to the elders, Wait here for us, until we come back to you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters, let him come to them.
verses.Exodus|24|15: And Moses went up into the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
verses.Exodus|24|16: And the glory of the Lord rested upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it for six days: on the seventh day he called to Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
verses.Exodus|24|17: And the sight of the glory of the Lord was like a devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.
verses.Exodus|24|18: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and went up into the mountain: and Moses was in the mountain forty days and forty nights.
verses.Exodus|25|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Exodus|25|2: Speak to the children of Israel that they bring me an offering: of every man whose heart prompts him to give you shall take my offering.
verses.Exodus|25|3: And this is the offering which you shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.Exodus|25|4: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,
verses.Exodus|25|5: and rams' skins dyed red, and tahash skins, and shittim wood,
verses.Exodus|25|6: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
verses.Exodus|25|7: shoham stones, and stones to be set in the efod, and in the breastplate.
verses.Exodus|25|8: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
verses.Exodus|25|9: According to all that I show thee, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all its vessels, even so shall you make it.
verses.Exodus|25|10: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.
verses.Exodus|25|11: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, inside and outside shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a rim of gold round about.
verses.Exodus|25|12: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four corners, and two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
verses.Exodus|25|13: And thou shalt make poles of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.Exodus|25|14: And thou shalt put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, that the ark may be carried therewith.
verses.Exodus|25|15: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
verses.Exodus|25|16: And thou shalt put into the ark the Testimony which I shall give thee.
verses.Exodus|25|17: And thou shalt make a covering of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth.
verses.Exodus|25|18: And thou shalt make two keruvim of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, at the two ends of the covering.
verses.Exodus|25|19: And make one keruv on the one end, and the other keruv on the other end: of the covering shall you make the keruvim on the two ends of it.
verses.Exodus|25|20: And the keruvim shall stretch out their wings on high, overspreading the covering with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the covering shall the faces of the keruvim be.
verses.Exodus|25|21: And thou shalt put the covering above, upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the Testimony that I shall give thee.
verses.Exodus|25|22: And there I will meet with thee, and I will speak with thee from above the covering, from between the two keruvim which are upon the ark of the Testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment to the children of Israel.
verses.Exodus|25|23: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be its length, and a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.
verses.Exodus|25|24: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make for it a rim of gold round about.
verses.Exodus|25|25: And thou shalt make for it a border of a handbreadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown for its border round about.
verses.Exodus|25|26: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four legs.
verses.Exodus|25|27: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the poles to bear the table.
verses.Exodus|25|28: And thou shalt make the poles of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and they shall be for carrying the table.
verses.Exodus|25|29: And thou shalt make its dishes, and its spoons, and its jars, and its bowls, used for pouring out: of pure gold shalt thou make them.
verses.Exodus|25|30: And thou shalt set upon the table showbread before me always.
verses.Exodus|25|31: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: its shaft, and its branches, its bowls, its bulbs, and its flowers, shall be of the same.
verses.Exodus|25|32: And six branches shall come out of its sides; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
verses.Exodus|25|33: three cups made like almonds, with a bulb and a flower in one branch; and three cups made like almonds in the other branch, with a bulb and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
verses.Exodus|25|34: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like almonds, with their bulbs and flowers.
verses.Exodus|25|35: And there shall be a bulb under two branches of the same piece, and a bulb under two branches of the same piece, and a bulb under two branches of the same piece, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
verses.Exodus|25|36: Their bulbs and their branches shall be made of the same piece: all shall be one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.Exodus|25|37: And thou shalt make its seven lamps: and they shall light its lamps, that they may give light over against it.
verses.Exodus|25|38: And its tongs, and its ashpans, shall be of pure gold.
verses.Exodus|25|39: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
verses.Exodus|25|40: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shown thee in the mountain.
verses.Exodus|26|1: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with keruvim of artistic work shalt thou make them.
verses.Exodus|26|2: The length of one curtain shall be twenty eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the curtains shall be all of one measure.
verses.Exodus|26|3: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and the other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.
verses.Exodus|26|4: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain that is at the edge of the first coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of the curtain, that is outmost in the second coupling.
verses.Exodus|26|5: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling; that the loops may take hold one of another.
verses.Exodus|26|6: And thou shalt make fifty golden clasps, and couple the curtains together with the clasps: that the tabernacle may be one.
verses.Exodus|26|7: And thou shalt make curtains of goats' hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.
verses.Exodus|26|8: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.
verses.Exodus|26|9: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.
verses.Exodus|26|10: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain of the second coupling.
verses.Exodus|26|11: And thou shalt make fifty clasps of brass, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
verses.Exodus|26|12: And the remnant that remains of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
verses.Exodus|26|13: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
verses.Exodus|26|14: And thou shalt make a covering for the Tent, of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above of tahash skins.
verses.Exodus|26|15: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.
verses.Exodus|26|16: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.
verses.Exodus|26|17: Two tenons shall there be in one board, connected one with the other: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.Exodus|26|18: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.
verses.Exodus|26|19: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
verses.Exodus|26|20: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:
verses.Exodus|26|21: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.Exodus|26|22: And for the side of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.
verses.Exodus|26|23: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the west side.
verses.Exodus|26|24: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
verses.Exodus|26|25: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.Exodus|26|26: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.Exodus|26|27: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the third side of the tabernacle, for the side westward.
verses.Exodus|26|28: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.
verses.Exodus|26|29: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold as places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
verses.Exodus|26|30: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to its fashion which was shown thee in the mountain.
verses.Exodus|26|31: And thou shalt make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen with keruvim shall it be made of artistic work:
verses.Exodus|26|32: and thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon four sockets of silver.
verses.Exodus|26|33: And thou shalt hang up the veil under the clasps, that thou mayst bring in there within the veil the ark of the Testimony: and the veil shall be for you as a division between the holy place and the most holy.
verses.Exodus|26|34: And thou shalt put the covering upon the ark of the Testimony in the most holy place.
verses.Exodus|26|35: And thou shalt set the table outside the veil, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.
verses.Exodus|26|36: And thou shalt make a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer.
verses.Exodus|26|37: And thou shalt make for the screen five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.
verses.Exodus|27|1: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height of it shall be three cubits.
verses.Exodus|27|2: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon its four corners: its horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
verses.Exodus|27|3: And thou shalt make its pans to receive its ashes, and its shovels, and its basins, and its forks, and its firepans: all its vessels thou shalt make of brass.
verses.Exodus|27|4: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brazen rings on its four corners.
verses.Exodus|27|5: And thou shalt put it under the ledge of the altar beneath, that the net may reach to the midst of the altar.
verses.Exodus|27|6: And thou shalt make poles for the altar, poles of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.
verses.Exodus|27|7: And the poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to carry it.
verses.Exodus|27|8: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shown thee in the mountain, so shall they make it.
verses.Exodus|27|9: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of a hundred cubits long for one side:
verses.Exodus|27|10: and its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their joints shall be of silver.
verses.Exodus|27|11: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of a hundred cubits long, and its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their joints of silver.
verses.Exodus|27|12: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
verses.Exodus|27|13: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
verses.Exodus|27|14: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.Exodus|27|15: And on the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.Exodus|27|16: And for the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with embroidery: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.
verses.Exodus|27|17: All the pillars round about the court shall be bound with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.
verses.Exodus|27|18: The length of the court shall be a hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty everywhere, and the height, five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
verses.Exodus|27|19: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pegs, and all the pegs of the court, shall be of brass.
verses.Exodus|27|20: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.
verses.Exodus|27|21: In the Tent of Meeting outside the veil, which is before the Testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the Lord: it shall be a statute for ever to their generations on behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.Exodus|28|1: And take thou to thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel that he may minister to me in the priest's office, Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron.
verses.Exodus|28|2: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for honour and for beauty.
verses.Exodus|28|3: And thou shalt speak to all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may minister to me in the priest's office.
verses.Exodus|28|4: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an efod, and a robe, and a quilted undercoat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest's office.
verses.Exodus|28|5: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.Exodus|28|6: And they shall make the efod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an artist.
verses.Exodus|28|7: It shall have its two shoulderpieces joined at its two edges; and so it shall be joined together.
verses.Exodus|28|8: And the finely wrought girdle of the efod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to its work; namely, of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.Exodus|28|9: And thou shalt take two shoham stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel:
verses.Exodus|28|10: six of their names on one stone, and the other six names on the other stone, according to their birth.
verses.Exodus|28|11: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in fixtures of gold.
verses.Exodus|28|12: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the efod for stones of memorial to the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the Lord upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
verses.Exodus|28|13: And thou shalt make fixtures of gold;
verses.Exodus|28|14: and two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the fixtures.
verses.Exodus|28|15: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment the work of an artist; after the work of the efod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.
verses.Exodus|28|16: Foursquare it shall be, being doubled; a span shall be its length, and a span shall be the breadth of it.
verses.Exodus|28|17: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a ruby, a chrysolithe, and a beryl: this shall be the first row.
verses.Exodus|28|18: And the second row shall be a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond.
verses.Exodus|28|19: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and a jasper.
verses.Exodus|28|20: And the fourth row an emerald, and a shoham, and a jade: they shall be enclosed in settings of gold.
verses.Exodus|28|21: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with its name shall they be, according to the twelve tribes.
verses.Exodus|28|22: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate plaited chains of wreathen work of pure gold.
verses.Exodus|28|23: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.Exodus|28|24: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.
verses.Exodus|28|25: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two fixtures, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the efod toward its forepart.
verses.Exodus|28|26: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in its border, which is on the side of the efod inward.
verses.Exodus|28|27: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two shoulderpieces of the efod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against its coupling, above the finely wrought girdle of the efod.
verses.Exodus|28|28: And they shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the efod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the finely wrought girdle of the efod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the efod.
verses.Exodus|28|29: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel on the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before the Lord continually.
verses.Exodus|28|30: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron's heart, when he goes in before the Lord: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the Lord continually.
verses.Exodus|28|31: And thou shalt make the robe of the efod all of blue.
verses.Exodus|28|32: And there shall be a hole for the head, in the midst of it: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole, as it were the hole of a suit of armour, that it be not torn.
verses.Exodus|28|33: And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about its hem; and bells of gold between them round about:
verses.Exodus|28|34: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.
verses.Exodus|28|35: And it shall be upon Aaron when he comes to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before the Lord, and when he comes out, that he die not.
verses.Exodus|28|36: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and engrave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS to the Lord.
verses.Exodus|28|37: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
verses.Exodus|28|38: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the Lord.
verses.Exodus|28|39: And thou shalt weave the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of embroidery.
verses.Exodus|28|40: And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and turbans shalt thou make for them, for honour and for beauty.
verses.Exodus|28|41: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest's office.
verses.Exodus|28|42: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even to the thighs they shall reach:
verses.Exodus|28|43: and they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever to him and his seed after him.
verses.Exodus|29|1: And this is the thing that thou shalt do to them to hallow them, to minister to me in the priest's office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,
verses.Exodus|29|2: and unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened mingled with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.
verses.Exodus|29|3: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
verses.Exodus|29|4: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shalt wash them with water.
verses.Exodus|29|5: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the efod, and the efod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the finely wrought girdle of the efod:
verses.Exodus|29|6: and thou shalt put the mitre on his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
verses.Exodus|29|7: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.
verses.Exodus|29|8: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.
verses.Exodus|29|9: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the turbans on them: and the priest's office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.
verses.Exodus|29|10: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the Tent of Meeting: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands on the head of the bullock.
verses.Exodus|29|11: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the Lord, by the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.Exodus|29|12: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it on the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.
verses.Exodus|29|13: And thou shalt take all the fat that covers the inwards, and the appendage that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.
verses.Exodus|29|14: But the flesh of the bullock, and its skin, and its dung, shalt thou burn with fire outside the camp: it is a sin offering.
verses.Exodus|29|15: And thou shalt take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.Exodus|29|16: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take its blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.
verses.Exodus|29|17: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash its inward parts and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.
verses.Exodus|29|18: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt offering to the Lord: it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.Exodus|29|19: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.Exodus|29|20: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of its blood, and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.Exodus|29|21: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
verses.Exodus|29|22: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the fat tail, and the fat that covers the inwards, and the appendage of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:
verses.Exodus|29|23: and one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the Lord:
verses.Exodus|29|24: and thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the Lord.
verses.Exodus|29|25: And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the Lord: it is an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.Exodus|29|26: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the Lord: and it shall be thy part.
verses.Exodus|29|27: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up of the ram of the consecration, of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:
verses.Exodus|29|28: and it shall be Aaron's and his sons' by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it is a heave offering: and it shall be a heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, their heave offering to the Lord.
verses.Exodus|29|29: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.
verses.Exodus|29|30: And that son that is priest in his place shall put them on seven days, when he enters the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.
verses.Exodus|29|31: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and boil its flesh in the holy place.
verses.Exodus|29|32: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.Exodus|29|33: And they shall eat those things with which atonement was made to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat of them, because they are holy.
verses.Exodus|29|34: And if aught of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain to the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
verses.Exodus|29|35: And thus shalt thou do to Aaron, and to his sons, according to all which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
verses.Exodus|29|36: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.
verses.Exodus|29|37: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatever touches the altar shall be holy.
verses.Exodus|29|38: Now this is what thou shalt offer on the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
verses.Exodus|29|39: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer towards evening.
verses.Exodus|29|40: And with the one lamb thou shalt bring a tenth measure of flour mingled with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.
verses.Exodus|29|41: And the other lamb thou shalt offer towards evening, and shalt do to it according the meal offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering of it, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.Exodus|29|42: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before the Lord: where I will meet you, to speak there to thee.
verses.Exodus|29|43: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and it shall be sanctified by my glory.
verses.Exodus|29|44: And I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest's office.
verses.Exodus|29|45: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
verses.Exodus|29|46: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, that brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the Lord their God.
verses.Exodus|30|1: And thou shalt make an altar for the burning of incense: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.
verses.Exodus|30|2: A cubit shall be the length of it, and a cubit its breadth; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be its height: the horns thereof shall be of the same.
verses.Exodus|30|3: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, its top, and its sides round about, and its horns; and thou shalt make for it a rim of gold round about.
verses.Exodus|30|4: And two golden rings shalt thou make for it under its rim, by its two corners upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it; and they shall be for places for the poles with which to bear it.
verses.Exodus|30|5: And thou shalt make the poles of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.Exodus|30|6: And thou shalt put it before the veil that is by the ark of the Testimony, before the covering that is over the Testimony, where I will meet with thee.
verses.Exodus|30|7: And Aaron shall burn upon it sweet incense every morning: when he dresses the lamps, he shall burn incense on it.
verses.Exodus|30|8: And when Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the Lord throughout your generations.
verses.Exodus|30|9: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meal offering; neither shall you pour drink offering upon it.
verses.Exodus|30|10: And Aaron shall sprinkle upon the horns of it once in a year the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy to the Lord.
verses.Exodus|30|11: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Exodus|30|12: When thou dost take the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul to the Lord, when thou dost number them; that there be no plague among them, when thou dost number them.
verses.Exodus|30|13: This they shall give, every one that passes among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gera:) a half shekel shall be the offering of the Lord.
verses.Exodus|30|14: Every one that passes among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give the offering of the Lord.
verses.Exodus|30|15: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give the offering of the Lord, to make atonement for your souls.
verses.Exodus|30|16: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting; that it may be a memorial to the children of Israel before the Lord, to make atonement for your souls.
verses.Exodus|30|17: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Exodus|30|18: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and its pedestal also of brass, for washing: and thou shalt put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and thou shalt put water in it.
verses.Exodus|30|19: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
verses.Exodus|30|20: when they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire to the Lord:
verses.Exodus|30|21: so they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, to him and to his seed throughout their generations.
verses.Exodus|30|22: Moreover the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Exodus|30|23: Take thou also to thee the best spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,
verses.Exodus|30|24: and of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of olive oil a hin:
verses.Exodus|30|25: and thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.
verses.Exodus|30|26: And thou shalt anoint the Tent of Meeting with it, and the ark of the Testimony,
verses.Exodus|30|27: and the table and all its vessels, and the candlestick and its vessels, and the altar of incense,
verses.Exodus|30|28: and the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, and the laver and its pedestal.
verses.Exodus|30|29: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatever touches them shall be holy.
verses.Exodus|30|30: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister to me in the priest's office.
verses.Exodus|30|31: And thou shalt speak to the children of Israel, saying, This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.
verses.Exodus|30|32: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall you make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and holy shall it be for you.
verses.Exodus|30|33: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.
verses.Exodus|30|34: And the Lord said to Moses, Take to thee sweet spices, storax, and onycha, and galbanum; sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:
verses.Exodus|30|35: and thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the perfumer, mingled with salt, pure and holy:
verses.Exodus|30|36: and thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with thee: it shall be to you most holy.
verses.Exodus|30|37: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, you shall not make it for yourselves according to its prescribed composition: it shall be holy for the Lord.
verses.Exodus|30|38: Whoever shall make like to that, to partake of its scent, shall even be cut off from his people.
verses.Exodus|31|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Exodus|31|2: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
verses.Exodus|31|3: and I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
verses.Exodus|31|4: to contrive works of art, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.Exodus|31|5: and in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
verses.Exodus|31|6: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;
verses.Exodus|31|7: the Tent of Meeting, and the ark of the Testimony, and the covering that is on it, and all the furniture of the Tent,
verses.Exodus|31|8: and the table and its furniture, and the pure candlestick with all its furniture, and the altar of incense,
verses.Exodus|31|9: and the altar of burnt offering with all its furniture, and the laver and its pedestal,
verses.Exodus|31|10: and the uniforms, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,
verses.Exodus|31|11: and the anointing oil, and incense of spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.
verses.Exodus|31|12: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Exodus|31|13: Speak also to the children of Israel saying, Verily my sabbaths shall you keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that you may know that I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
verses.Exodus|31|14: You shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy to you: everyone that profanes it shall surely be put to death: for whoever does any work on it, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.Exodus|31|15: Six days may work be done; but on the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the Lord: whoever does any work on the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.Exodus|31|16: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
verses.Exodus|31|17: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.
verses.Exodus|31|18: And he gave to Moses, when he had made an end of speaking to him upon mount Sinai, two tablets of the Testimony, tablets of stone, written with the finger of God.
verses.Exodus|32|1: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this man Moses, who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we know not what is become of him.
verses.Exodus|32|2: And Aaron said to them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.
verses.Exodus|32|3: And all the people broke off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.
verses.Exodus|32|4: And he received the gold at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool and made it a molten calf: and they said, These are thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.Exodus|32|5: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, Tomorrow is a feast to the Lord.
verses.Exodus|32|6: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to disport themselves.
verses.Exodus|32|7: And the Lord said to Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest up out of the land of Egypt, have become corrupt:
verses.Exodus|32|8: they have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, These are thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.Exodus|32|9: And the Lord said to Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
verses.Exodus|32|10: now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may burn against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.
verses.Exodus|32|11: And Moses besought the Lord his God, and said, Lord, why does thy wrath burn against thy people, whom thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?
verses.Exodus|32|12: Wherefore should Egypt speak, and say, In an evil hour did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce anger, and relent of this evil against thy people.
verses.Exodus|32|13: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou didst swear by thy own self, and didst say to them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give to your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.
verses.Exodus|32|14: And the Lord relented of the evil which he thought to do to his people.
verses.Exodus|32|15: And Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, and the two tablets of the Testimony were in his hand: tablets written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
verses.Exodus|32|16: And the tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved upon the tablets.
verses.Exodus|32|17: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
verses.Exodus|32|18: But he said, It is not the voice of those who shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of those who cry for being overcome: but the noise of those who sing do I hear.
verses.Exodus|32|19: And it came to pass, as soon as he came near to the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses anger burned, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them at the foot of the mountain.
verses.Exodus|32|20: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and scattered it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.
verses.Exodus|32|21: And Moses said to Aaron, What has this people done to thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
verses.Exodus|32|22: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord burn: thou knowst the people, that they are bent on mischief.
verses.Exodus|32|23: For they said to me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we know not what is become of him.
verses.Exodus|32|24: And I said to them, Who has any gold? They broke it off and gave it me: then I threw it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
verses.Exodus|32|25: And when Moses saw that the people were in disorder; (for Aaron had made them disorderly to the scandal of their enemies:)
verses.Exodus|32|26: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the Lord's side? let him come to me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.
verses.Exodus|32|27: And he said to them, Thus says the Lord God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go to and fro from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.
verses.Exodus|32|28: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
verses.Exodus|32|29: For Moses said, Consecrate yourselves today to the Lord, even every man against his son, and against his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
verses.Exodus|32|30: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said to the people, You have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up to the Lord; perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.
verses.Exodus|32|31: And Moses returned to the Lord, and said, Oh, this people has sinned a great sin, and they have made them gods of gold.
verses.Exodus|32|32: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin – ; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.
verses.Exodus|32|33: And the Lord said to Moses, Whoever has sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
verses.Exodus|32|34: Therefore now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to thee: behold, my angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I punish, I will punish their sin upon them.
verses.Exodus|32|35: And the Lord plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron had made.
verses.Exodus|33|1: And the Lord said to Moses, Depart, and go up from here, thou and the people whom thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, To thy seed will I give it:
verses.Exodus|33|2: and I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
verses.Exodus|33|3: into a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee on the way.
verses.Exodus|33|4: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man put on him his ornaments.
verses.Exodus|33|5: For the Lord had said to Moses, Say to the children of Israel, You are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee for a moment and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do to thee.
verses.Exodus|33|6: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.
verses.Exodus|33|7: And Moses would take the Tent, and pitch it outside the camp, afar off from the camp, and he called it the Tent of Meeting. And it came to pass, that everyone who sought the Lord went out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside the camp.
verses.Exodus|33|8: And it came to pass, when Moses went out to the Tent, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses until he was gone into the Tent.
verses.Exodus|33|9: And it came to pass, as Moses entered the Tent, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the Tent, and one talked with Moses.
verses.Exodus|33|10: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the door of the Tent: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.
verses.Exodus|33|11: And the Lord spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. And he turned back to the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, did not depart out of the Tent.
verses.Exodus|33|12: And Moses said to the Lord, See, thou sayst to me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found favour in my sight.
verses.Exodus|33|13: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thy sight, show me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find favour in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.
verses.Exodus|33|14: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
verses.Exodus|33|15: And he said to him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up from here.
verses.Exodus|33|16: For in what shall it be known here that I and thy people have found favour in thy sight? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be differentiated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.Exodus|33|17: And the Lord said to Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found favour in my sight, and I know thee by name.
verses.Exodus|33|18: And he said, I pray thee, show me thy glory.
verses.Exodus|33|19: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the Lord before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.
verses.Exodus|33|20: And he said, Thou canst not see my face; for no man shall see me, and live.
verses.Exodus|33|21: And the Lord said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:
verses.Exodus|33|22: and it shall come to pass, while my glory passes by, that I will put thee in a cleft of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:
verses.Exodus|33|23: and I will take away my hand and thou shalt see my back: but my face shall not be seen.
verses.Exodus|34|1: And the Lord said to Moses, Hew for thyself two tablets of stone like the first: and I will write upon these tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which thou didst break.
verses.Exodus|34|2: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning to mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me on the top of the mountain.
verses.Exodus|34|3: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mountain; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mountain.
verses.Exodus|34|4: And he hewed two tablets of stone like the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up to mount Sinai, as the Lord had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tablets of stone.
verses.Exodus|34|5: And the Lord descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the Lord.
verses.Exodus|34|6: And the Lord passed by before him, and proclaimed, The Lord, The Lord, mighty, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in love and truth,
verses.Exodus|34|7: keeping troth to thousands, forgiving iniquity, and transgression, and sin, but who will by no means clear the guilty; punishing the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children's children, to the third and to the fourth generation.
verses.Exodus|34|8: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.
verses.Exodus|34|9: And he said, If now I have found favour in thy sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thy inheritance.
verses.Exodus|34|10: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among whom thou art shall see the work of the Lord that I will do with thee, that it is tremendous.
verses.Exodus|34|11: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.Exodus|34|12: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land to which thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:
verses.Exodus|34|13: but you shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their asherim:
verses.Exodus|34|14: for thou shalt worship no other god: for the Lord, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:
verses.Exodus|34|15: lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go astray after their gods, and do sacrifice to their gods, and call thee, and thou eat of their sacrifice;
verses.Exodus|34|16: and thou take of their daughters to thy sons, and their daughters play the harlot after their gods, and make thy sons play the harlot after their gods.
verses.Exodus|34|17: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.
verses.Exodus|34|18: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: (for in the month Abib thou didst come out from Egypt.)
verses.Exodus|34|19: All that opens the womb is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.
verses.Exodus|34|20: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem it not, then shalt thou break its neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.
verses.Exodus|34|21: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in plowing and in harvest thou shalt rest.
verses.Exodus|34|22: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year's end.
verses.Exodus|34|23: Three times in the year shall all your males appear before the Lord God, the God of Israel.
verses.Exodus|34|24: For I will cast the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the Lord thy God three times in the year.
verses.Exodus|34|25: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left to the morning.
verses.Exodus|34|26: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring to the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not boil a kid in its mother's milk.
verses.Exodus|34|27: And the Lord said to Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.
verses.Exodus|34|28: And he was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten Words.
verses.Exodus|34|29: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tablets of Testimony in Moses hand, when he came down from the mountain, that Moses knew not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
verses.Exodus|34|30: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.
verses.Exodus|34|31: And Moses called to them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him: and Moses talked with them.
verses.Exodus|34|32: And afterwards all the children of Israel came near: and he gave them in commandment all that the Lord had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
verses.Exodus|34|33: And when Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.
verses.Exodus|34|34: But when Moses went in before the Lord to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out. And he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
verses.Exodus|34|35: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses face shone: and Moses put the veil upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
verses.Exodus|35|1: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said to them, These are the words which the Lord has commanded, that you should do them.
verses.Exodus|35|2: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you a holy day, a sabbath of rest to the Lord: whoever does work on it shall be put to death.
verses.Exodus|35|3: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the sabbath day.
verses.Exodus|35|4: And Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord commanded, saying,
verses.Exodus|35|5: Take from among you an offering to the Lord: whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the Lord; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.Exodus|35|6: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,
verses.Exodus|35|7: and rams' skins dyed red, and tahash skins, and shittim wood,
verses.Exodus|35|8: and oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
verses.Exodus|35|9: and shoham stones, and stones to be set for the efod, and for the breastplate.
verses.Exodus|35|10: And every wisehearted man among you shall come, and make all that the Lord has commanded;
verses.Exodus|35|11: the tabernacle, its tent, and its covering, its clasps, and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets,
verses.Exodus|35|12: the ark, and its poles, with the covering, and the veil of the screen,
verses.Exodus|35|13: the table, and its poles, and all its vessels, and the showbread,
verses.Exodus|35|14: the candlestick also for the light, and its vessels, and its lamps, with the oil for the light,
verses.Exodus|35|15: and the incense altar, and its poles, and the anointing oil, and the incense of spices, and the screen for the door at the entrance of the tabernacle,
verses.Exodus|35|16: the altar of burnt offering, with its brazen grate, its poles, and all its vessels, the laver and its pedestal,
verses.Exodus|35|17: the hangings of the court, its pillars, and their sockets, and the screen for the door of the court,
verses.Exodus|35|18: the pegs of the tabernacle, and the pegs of the court, and their cords,
verses.Exodus|35|19: the uniforms, to do service in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.
verses.Exodus|35|20: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
verses.Exodus|35|21: And they came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the Lord's offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all its service, and for the holy garments.
verses.Exodus|35|22: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing of heart, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and bracelets, all jewels of gold: and every man that had offered an offering of gold to the Lord.
verses.Exodus|35|23: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair, and red skins of rams, and tahash skins, brought them.
verses.Exodus|35|24: Everyone that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the Lord's offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it.
verses.Exodus|35|25: And all the women that were wisehearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.
verses.Exodus|35|26: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats' hair.
verses.Exodus|35|27: And the rulers brought shoham stones, and stones to be set, for the efod, and for the breastplate;
verses.Exodus|35|28: and spice, and oil: for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the incense of spices.
verses.Exodus|35|29: The children of Israel brought a willing offering to the Lord, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the Lord had commanded by the hand of Moses, to be made.
verses.Exodus|35|30: And Moses said to the children of Israel, See, the Lord has called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
verses.Exodus|35|31: and he has filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
verses.Exodus|35|32: and to contrive works of art, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.Exodus|35|33: and in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make all manner of artistic work.
verses.Exodus|35|34: And he has put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.Exodus|35|35: Them has he filled with wisdom of heart, to do all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the craftsman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise artistic work.
verses.Exodus|36|1: Then Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wisehearted man, in whom the Lord put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, did according to all that the Lord had commanded.
verses.Exodus|36|2: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wisehearted man, in whose heart the Lord had put wisdom, everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it:
verses.Exodus|36|3: and they received from Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. And they brought yet to him free will offerings every morning.
verses.Exodus|36|4: And all the wise men, that carried out all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they did;
verses.Exodus|36|5: and they spoke to Moses saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the Lord commanded to do.
verses.Exodus|36|6: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp saying, Let neither man nor woman do any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
verses.Exodus|36|7: For the material they had was sufficient for all the work to do it, and too much.
verses.Exodus|36|8: And all wisehearted men among them that carried out the work made the tabernacle; they made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with keruvim of artistic work he made them.
verses.Exodus|36|9: The length of one curtain was twenty eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.
verses.Exodus|36|10: And he coupled the five curtains one to another: and the other five curtains he coupled one to another.
verses.Exodus|36|11: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain that was at the edge of the first coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of the curtain in the second coupling.
verses.Exodus|36|12: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the second coupling: the loops held one curtain to another.
verses.Exodus|36|13: And he made fifty golden clasps, and coupled the curtain one to another with the clasps: so that the tabernacle was one.
verses.Exodus|36|14: And he made curtains of goats' hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
verses.Exodus|36|15: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.
verses.Exodus|36|16: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
verses.Exodus|36|17: And he made fifty loops upon the edge of the curtain that was outmost in the first coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain of the second coupling.
verses.Exodus|36|18: And he made fifty clasps of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
verses.Exodus|36|19: And he made a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of tahash skins above that.
verses.Exodus|36|20: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.
verses.Exodus|36|21: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
verses.Exodus|36|22: One board had two tenons, connected one with the other: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.Exodus|36|23: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:
verses.Exodus|36|24: and forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
verses.Exodus|36|25: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north side, he made twenty boards,
verses.Exodus|36|26: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.Exodus|36|27: And for the side of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
verses.Exodus|36|28: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle on the two sides.
verses.Exodus|36|29: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.
verses.Exodus|36|30: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen, sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.
verses.Exodus|36|31: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.Exodus|36|32: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the side westward.
verses.Exodus|36|33: And he made the middle bar to slide through the boards from the one end to the other.
verses.Exodus|36|34: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
verses.Exodus|36|35: And he made a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with keruvim he made it, of artistic work.
verses.Exodus|36|36: And he made for it four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.
verses.Exodus|36|37: And he made a screen for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of embroidered work;
verses.Exodus|36|38: and the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their capitals and their joints with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.
verses.Exodus|37|1: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height:
verses.Exodus|37|2: and he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a rim of gold to it round about.
verses.Exodus|37|3: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by its four corners; even two rings on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
verses.Exodus|37|4: And he made poles of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.Exodus|37|5: And he put the poles into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
verses.Exodus|37|6: And he made the covering of pure gold: two cubits and a half was its length, and one cubit and a half its breadth.
verses.Exodus|37|7: And he made two keruvim of gold, beaten out of one piece he made them, on the two ends of the covering;
verses.Exodus|37|8: one keruv on the end on this side, and another keruv on the other end on that side: out of the covering made he the keruvim at the two ends of it.
verses.Exodus|37|9: And the keruvim spread out their wings on high, and spread with their wings over the covering, with their faces one to another; toward the covering were the faces of the keruvim.
verses.Exodus|37|10: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was its length, and a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height:
verses.Exodus|37|11: and he overlaid it with pure gold, and made for it a rim of gold round about.
verses.Exodus|37|12: Also he made for it a border of a handbreadth round about; and made a rim of gold for its border round about.
