verses.Leviticus|27|17: If he dedicate his field from the year of jubilee, according to the estimation it shall stand.
verses.Leviticus|27|18: But if he dedicate his field after the jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain, even to the year of the jubilee, and it shall be abated from the estimation.
verses.Leviticus|27|19: And if he that sanctified the field will redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of the estimation to it, and it shall become his property.
verses.Leviticus|27|20: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
verses.Leviticus|27|21: But the field, when it goes out in the jubilee, shall be holy to the Lord, as a field devoted; the possession of it shall be the priest's.
verses.Leviticus|27|22: And if a man dedicate to the Lord a field which he has bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;
verses.Leviticus|27|23: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of the estimation, to the year of the jubilee, and he shall give the estimation in that day, as a holy thing to the Lord.
verses.Leviticus|27|24: In the year of the jubilee the field shall return to him of whom it was bought, to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.
verses.Leviticus|27|25: And all estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gera shall be the shekel.
verses.Leviticus|27|26: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the Lord's firstling, no man shall dedicate that; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the Lord's.
verses.Leviticus|27|27: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to the estimation, and shall add to it a fifth part of it: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to the estimation.
verses.Leviticus|27|28: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote to the Lord of all that he has, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy to the Lord.
verses.Leviticus|27|29: None devoted of men, which shall be doomed to death, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.
verses.Leviticus|27|30: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the Lord's: it is holy to the Lord.
verses.Leviticus|27|31: And if a man will at all redeem of his tithes, he shall add to it the fifth part of it.
verses.Leviticus|27|32: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, of whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to the Lord.
verses.Leviticus|27|33: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and its substitute shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
verses.Leviticus|27|34: These are the commandments, which the Lord commanded Moses for the children of Israel in Mount Sinai.
verses.Numbers|1|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.Numbers|1|2: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the houses of their fathers, by the number of names, every male by their polls;
verses.Numbers|1|3: from twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their hosts.
verses.Numbers|1|4: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
verses.Numbers|1|5: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.Numbers|1|6: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.Numbers|1|7: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.Numbers|1|8: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.Numbers|1|9: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.Numbers|1|10: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh, Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.Numbers|1|11: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.Numbers|1|12: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.Numbers|1|13: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.Numbers|1|14: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel,
verses.Numbers|1|15: Of Naphtali, Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.Numbers|1|16: These were the men of mark in the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
verses.Numbers|1|17: And Moses and Aaron took these men who were pointed out by their names:
verses.Numbers|1|18: and they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the houses of their fathers, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
verses.Numbers|1|19: As the Lord commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.Numbers|1|20: And the children of Reuben, Israel's oldest son, their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.Numbers|1|21: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty six thousand, five hundred.
verses.Numbers|1|22: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.Numbers|1|23: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty nine thousand, three hundred.
verses.Numbers|1|24: Of the children of Gad, their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.Numbers|1|25: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty five thousand, six hundred and fifty.
verses.Numbers|1|26: Of the children of Judah, their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.Numbers|1|27: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy four thousand, six hundred.
verses.Numbers|1|28: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.Numbers|1|29: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty four thousand, four hundred.
verses.Numbers|1|30: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.Numbers|1|31: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty seven thousand, four hundred.
verses.Numbers|1|32: Of the children of Joseph, of the children of Ephraim, their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.Numbers|1|33: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand, five hundred.
verses.Numbers|1|34: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.Numbers|1|35: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty two thousand, two hundred.
verses.Numbers|1|36: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.Numbers|1|37: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty five thousand, four hundred.
verses.Numbers|1|38: Of the children of Dan, their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.Numbers|1|39: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty two thousand, seven hundred.
verses.Numbers|1|40: Of the children of Asher, their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.Numbers|1|41: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty one thousand, five hundred.
verses.Numbers|1|42: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.Numbers|1|43: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty three thousand, four hundred.
verses.Numbers|1|44: These are those that were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one represented the house of his fathers.
verses.Numbers|1|45: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
verses.Numbers|1|46: all they that were numbered were six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty.
verses.Numbers|1|47: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
verses.Numbers|1|48: For the Lord had spoken to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|1|49: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, nor take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
verses.Numbers|1|50: but thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all its vessels, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all its vessels; and they shall minister to it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
verses.Numbers|1|51: And when the tabernacle sets forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that comes near shall be put to death.
verses.Numbers|1|52: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.
verses.Numbers|1|53: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.Numbers|1|54: And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so they did.
verses.Numbers|2|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.Numbers|2|2: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensigns of their father's house: far off about the Tent of Meeting shall they pitch.
verses.Numbers|2|3: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch by their hosts: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.
verses.Numbers|2|4: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were seventy four thousand, six hundred.
verses.Numbers|2|5: And those that pitch next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.
verses.Numbers|2|6: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty four thousand, four hundred.
verses.Numbers|2|7: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.
verses.Numbers|2|8: And his host, and those that were numbered of it, were fifty seven thousand, four hundred.
verses.Numbers|2|9: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were a hundred and eighty six thousand, four hundred, by their hosts. These shall first set forth.
verses.Numbers|2|10: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben by their hosts: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.Numbers|2|11: And his host, and those that were numbered of it, were forty six thousand, five hundred.
verses.Numbers|2|12: And those who pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.Numbers|2|13: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty nine thousand, three hundred.
verses.Numbers|2|14: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
verses.Numbers|2|15: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty five thousand, six hundred and fifty.
verses.Numbers|2|16: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were a hundred and fifty one thousand, four hundred and fifty, by their hosts. And they shall set forth in the second rank.
verses.Numbers|2|17: Then the Tent of Meeting shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.
verses.Numbers|2|18: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim by their hosts: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.Numbers|2|19: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand, five hundred.
verses.Numbers|2|20: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.Numbers|2|21: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty two thousand, two hundred.
verses.Numbers|2|22: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.Numbers|2|23: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty five thousand, four hundred.
verses.Numbers|2|24: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were a hundred and eight thousand and one hundred, by their hosts. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
verses.Numbers|2|25: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their hosts: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.Numbers|2|26: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were sixty two thousand, seven hundred.
verses.Numbers|2|27: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.Numbers|2|28: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty one thousand, five hundred.
verses.Numbers|2|29: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.Numbers|2|30: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty three thousand, four hundred.
verses.Numbers|2|31: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were a hundred and fifty seven thousand, six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
verses.Numbers|2|32: These are those who were numbered of the children of Israel by the houses of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps by their hosts were six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty.
verses.Numbers|2|33: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.Numbers|2|34: And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, everyone after their families, according to the houses of their fathers.
verses.Numbers|3|1: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the Lord spoke with Moses in mount Sinai.
verses.Numbers|3|2: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.Numbers|3|3: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.
verses.Numbers|3|4: And Nadab and Abihu died before the Lord, when they offered strange fire before the Lord, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.
verses.Numbers|3|5: And the Lord spoke to Moses saying,
verses.Numbers|3|6: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.
verses.Numbers|3|7: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.Numbers|3|8: And they shall keep all the instruments of the Tent of Meeting, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.Numbers|3|9: And thou shalt give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given to him out of the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|3|10: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priest's office: and the stranger that comes near shall be put to death.
verses.Numbers|3|11: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|3|12: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that opens the womb among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;
verses.Numbers|3|13: because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the Lord.
verses.Numbers|3|14: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
verses.Numbers|3|15: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
verses.Numbers|3|16: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the Lord, as he was commanded.
verses.Numbers|3|17: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
verses.Numbers|3|18: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.Numbers|3|19: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.Numbers|3|20: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.
verses.Numbers|3|21: Of Gershon was the family of the Libni, and the family of the Shimei: these are the families of the Gershon.
verses.Numbers|3|22: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand five hundred.
verses.Numbers|3|23: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
verses.Numbers|3|24: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
verses.Numbers|3|25: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, its covering, and the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
verses.Numbers|3|26: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all its service.
verses.Numbers|3|27: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzi'eli: these are the families of the Kohathites.
verses.Numbers|3|28: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand, six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.Numbers|3|29: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.Numbers|3|30: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan, the son of Uzziel.
verses.Numbers|3|31: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, and the screen, and all its service.
verses.Numbers|3|32: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chiefs of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.Numbers|3|33: Of Merari was the family of the Mahli, and the family of the Mushi: these are the families of Merari.
verses.Numbers|3|34: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.
verses.Numbers|3|35: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
verses.Numbers|3|36: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets, and all its vessels, and all that belongs to it.
verses.Numbers|3|37: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pegs, and their cords.
verses.Numbers|3|38: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, before the Tent of Meeting eastward, shall be Moses and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that comes near shall be put to death.
verses.Numbers|3|39: All that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the Lord, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty two thousand.
verses.Numbers|3|40: And the Lord said to Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
verses.Numbers|3|41: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the Lord) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|3|42: And Moses numbered, as the Lord commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|3|43: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty two thousand, two hundred and seventy three.
verses.Numbers|3|44: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|3|45: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the Lord.
verses.Numbers|3|46: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and seventy three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who are more than the Levites:
verses.Numbers|3|47: thou shalt take five shekels for every man, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gera:)
verses.Numbers|3|48: and thou shalt give the money, with which the surplus of them is to be redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.
verses.Numbers|3|49: And Moses took the redemption money of those who were over and above those who were redeemed by the Levites:
verses.Numbers|3|50: of the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money; a thousand three hundred and sixty five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.Numbers|3|51: and Moses gave the money of those who were redeemed to Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the Lord, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.Numbers|4|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.Numbers|4|2: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
verses.Numbers|4|3: from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.Numbers|4|4: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, namely, the most holy things:
verses.Numbers|4|5: and when the camp sets forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the veil of the screen, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
verses.Numbers|4|6: and they shall put on it the covering of tahash skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in its poles.
verses.Numbers|4|7: And upon the table of showbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put on it the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and the jars for pouring out: and the continual bread shall be on it:
verses.Numbers|4|8: and they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of tahash skins, and shall put in its poles.
verses.Numbers|4|9: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and its lamps, and its tongs, and its pans, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it:
verses.Numbers|4|10: and they shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of tahash skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
verses.Numbers|4|11: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of tahash skins, and shall put in its poles.
verses.Numbers|4|12: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of tahash skins, and shall put them on a bar:
verses.Numbers|4|13: and they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it:
verses.Numbers|4|14: and they shall put upon it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the pans, the forks, and the shovels, and the basins, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of tahash skins, and put in its poles.
verses.Numbers|4|15: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.Numbers|4|16: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertains the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meal offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, as to the sanctuary, and as to its vessels.
verses.Numbers|4|17: And the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.Numbers|4|18: Do not cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
verses.Numbers|4|19: but thus do to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
verses.Numbers|4|20: but they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
verses.Numbers|4|21: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|4|22: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, by the houses of their fathers, by their families;
verses.Numbers|4|23: from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.Numbers|4|24: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, both for serving and for carrying:
verses.Numbers|4|25: and they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, and the covering of the tahash skins that is above upon it, and the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
verses.Numbers|4|26: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
verses.Numbers|4|27: By the order of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and you shall appoint to them in charge all their burden.
verses.Numbers|4|28: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.Numbers|4|29: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
verses.Numbers|4|30: from thirty years old and upward to fifty years old shalt thou number them, everyone that enters into the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.Numbers|4|31: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting; the boards of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets,
verses.Numbers|4|32: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pegs, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name you shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
verses.Numbers|4|33: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.Numbers|4|34: And Moses and Aaron and the chiefs of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
verses.Numbers|4|35: from thirty years old and upward to fifty years old, everyone that enters into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting:
verses.Numbers|4|36: and those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
verses.Numbers|4|37: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.Numbers|4|38: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
verses.Numbers|4|39: from thirty years old and upward to fifty years old, everyone that enters into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting,
verses.Numbers|4|40: even those that were numbered of them, by their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand, six hundred and thirty.
verses.Numbers|4|41: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord.
verses.Numbers|4|42: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by the house of their fathers,
verses.Numbers|4|43: from thirty years old and upward to fifty years old, everyone that enters into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting,
verses.Numbers|4|44: even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand, two hundred.
verses.Numbers|4|45: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.Numbers|4|46: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chiefs of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
verses.Numbers|4|47: from thirty years old and upward to fifty years old, everyone that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of carrying in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.Numbers|4|48: Those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand, five hundred and eighty.
verses.Numbers|4|49: According to the commandment of the Lord they were numbered by the hand of Moses, everyone according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.Numbers|5|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|5|2: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp everyone with zaraat, and everyone that has an issue, and whoever is defiled by the dead:
verses.Numbers|5|3: both male and female shall you put out, outside the camp shall you put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst of which I dwell.
verses.Numbers|5|4: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out outside the camp: as the Lord spoke to Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|5|5: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|5|6: Speak to the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the Lord, and that person be guilty;
verses.Numbers|5|7: then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall make restitution for his trespass in full, and add to it its fifth part, and give it to him against whom he has trespassed.
verses.Numbers|5|8: But if the man have no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the trespass, let the trespass which is recompensed to the Lord, be the priest's; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby atonement shall be made for him.
verses.Numbers|5|9: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring to the priest, shall be his.
verses.Numbers|5|10: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.
verses.Numbers|5|11: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|5|12: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
verses.Numbers|5|13: and a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and she be undetected, and she be defiled, and there is no witness against her, nor is she taken in the act;
verses.Numbers|5|14: and the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:
verses.Numbers|5|15: then shall the man bring his wife to the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an efa of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense on it; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
verses.Numbers|5|16: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the Lord:
verses.Numbers|5|17: and the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle shall the priest take, and put it into the water:
verses.Numbers|5|18: and the priest shall set the woman before the Lord, and loosen the hair of the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causes the curse:
verses.Numbers|5|19: and the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say to the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causes the curse:
verses.Numbers|5|20: but if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee other than thy husband:
verses.Numbers|5|21: then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say to the woman, The Lord make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the Lord makes thy thigh to fall away, and thy belly to swell;
verses.Numbers|5|22: and this water that causes the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to fall away: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
verses.Numbers|5|23: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:
verses.Numbers|5|24: and he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causes the curse: and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.
verses.Numbers|5|25: Then the priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the Lord, and offer it upon the altar:
verses.Numbers|5|26: and the priest shall take a handful of the offering, the memorial part of it, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.
verses.Numbers|5|27: And when he has made her drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall fall away: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
verses.Numbers|5|28: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
verses.Numbers|5|29: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goes aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;
verses.Numbers|5|30: or when the spirit of jealousy comes upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and shall set the woman before the Lord, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law:
verses.Numbers|5|31: then shall the man be guiltless of iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
verses.Numbers|6|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|6|2: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When either man or woman shall pronounce a special vow of a Nazarite to separate themselves to the Lord:
verses.Numbers|6|3: he shall abstain from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, nor shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
verses.Numbers|6|4: All the days of his abstinence shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.
verses.Numbers|6|5: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come on his head: until the days are fulfilled, during which he separates himself to the Lord, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
verses.Numbers|6|6: All the days that he separates himself to the Lord he shall come at no dead body.
verses.Numbers|6|7: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the crown of his God is upon his head.
verses.Numbers|6|8: All the days of his separation he is holy to the Lord.
verses.Numbers|6|9: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he has defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
verses.Numbers|6|10: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtle doves, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting:
verses.Numbers|6|11: and the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
verses.Numbers|6|12: And he shall consecrate to the Lord the days of his abstinence, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a guilt offering: and the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
verses.Numbers|6|13: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought to the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.Numbers|6|14: And he shall offer his offering to the Lord, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for a peace offering,
verses.Numbers|6|15: and a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meal offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.Numbers|6|16: And the priest shall bring them before the Lord, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:
verses.Numbers|6|17: and he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offering to the Lord, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meal offering, and his drink offering.
verses.Numbers|6|18: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offering.
verses.Numbers|6|19: And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaved:
verses.Numbers|6|20: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the Lord: this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.
verses.Numbers|6|21: This is the law of the Nazarite who has vowed, and of his offering to the Lord for his separation, beside that which his means allow: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do beside the law of his abstinence.
verses.Numbers|6|22: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|6|23: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, In this way you shall bless the children of Israel, saying to them,
verses.Numbers|6|24: The Lord bless thee, and keep thee:
verses.Numbers|6|25: the Lord make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious to thee:
verses.Numbers|6|26: the Lord lift up his countenance to thee, and give thee peace.
verses.Numbers|6|27: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.
verses.Numbers|7|1: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all its instruments, both the altar and all its vessels, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
verses.Numbers|7|2: that the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:
verses.Numbers|7|3: and they brought their offering before the Lord, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
verses.Numbers|7|4: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|7|5: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the Tent of Meeting; and thou shalt give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service.
verses.Numbers|7|6: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.
verses.Numbers|7|7: Two wagons and four oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
verses.Numbers|7|8: and four wagons and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.Numbers|7|9: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they bore it on their shoulders.
verses.Numbers|7|10: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, and the princes offered their offering before the altar.
verses.Numbers|7|11: And the Lord said to Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.
verses.Numbers|7|12: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:
verses.Numbers|7|13: and his offering was one silver dish, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering:
verses.Numbers|7|14: one spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:
verses.Numbers|7|15: one young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.Numbers|7|16: one kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.Numbers|7|17: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.Numbers|7|18: On the second day Nethaneel, the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:
verses.Numbers|7|19: he offered for his offering one silver dish, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering:
verses.Numbers|7|20: one spoon of gold of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.Numbers|7|21: one young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.Numbers|7|22: one kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.Numbers|7|23: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.Numbers|7|24: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun, did offer:
verses.Numbers|7|25: his offering was one silver dish, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering:
verses.Numbers|7|26: one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.Numbers|7|27: one young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.Numbers|7|28: one kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.Numbers|7|29: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.Numbers|7|30: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben, did offer:
verses.Numbers|7|31: his offering was one silver dish of the weight of a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering:
verses.Numbers|7|32: one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.Numbers|7|33: one young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.Numbers|7|34: one kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.Numbers|7|35: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.Numbers|7|36: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon, did offer:
verses.Numbers|7|37: his offering was one silver dish, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering:
verses.Numbers|7|38: one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.Numbers|7|39: one young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.Numbers|7|40: one kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.Numbers|7|41: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.Numbers|7|42: On the sixth day Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad, offered:
verses.Numbers|7|43: his offering was one silver dish of the weight of a hundred and thirty shekels, a silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering:
verses.Numbers|7|44: one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.Numbers|7|45: one young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.Numbers|7|46: one kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.Numbers|7|47: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year; this was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.Numbers|7|48: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim, offered:
verses.Numbers|7|49: his offering was one silver dish, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering:
verses.Numbers|7|50: one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.Numbers|7|51: one young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.Numbers|7|52: one kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.Numbers|7|53: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.Numbers|7|54: On the eighth day Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, prince of the children of Manasseh offered:
verses.Numbers|7|55: his offering was one silver dish of the weight of a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering:
verses.Numbers|7|56: one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.Numbers|7|57: one young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.Numbers|7|58: one kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.Numbers|7|59: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.Numbers|7|60: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin, offered:
verses.Numbers|7|61: his offering was one silver dish, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary: both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering:
verses.Numbers|7|62: one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.Numbers|7|63: one young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.Numbers|7|64: one kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.Numbers|7|65: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Abidan son of Gideoni.
verses.Numbers|7|66: On the tenth day Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, prince of the children of Dan, offered:
verses.Numbers|7|67: his offering was one silver dish, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering:
verses.Numbers|7|68: one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.Numbers|7|69: one young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.Numbers|7|70: one kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.Numbers|7|71: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.Numbers|7|72: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ocran, prince of the children of Asher, offered:
verses.Numbers|7|73: his offering was one silver dish, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering:
verses.Numbers|7|74: one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.Numbers|7|75: one young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.Numbers|7|76: one kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.Numbers|7|77: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.Numbers|7|78: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, offered:
verses.Numbers|7|79: his offering was one silver dish, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal offering:
verses.Numbers|7|80: one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.Numbers|7|81: one young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.Numbers|7|82: one kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.Numbers|7|83: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.Numbers|7|84: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve dishes of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:
verses.Numbers|7|85: each dish of silver weighing a hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.Numbers|7|86: the golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was a hundred and twenty shekels.
verses.Numbers|7|87: All the oxen for the burnt offerings were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meal offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.
verses.Numbers|7|88: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after it was anointed.
verses.Numbers|7|89: And when Moses was gone into the Tent of Meeting to speak with Him, then he heard the voice speaking to him from off the covering that was upon the ark of Testimony, from between the two keruvim: and it spoke to him.
verses.Numbers|8|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|8|2: Speak to Aaron, and say to him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light towards the body of the candlestick.
verses.Numbers|8|3: And Aaron did so; he lighted its lamps over against the body of the candlestick, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.Numbers|8|4: And this was the work of the candlestick: it was of beaten gold, from its shaft, to its flowers, it was beaten work: according to the pattern which the Lord had shown Moses, so he made the candlestick.
verses.Numbers|8|5: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|8|6: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
verses.Numbers|8|7: And thus shalt thou do to them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying on them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.
verses.Numbers|8|8: Then let them take a young bullock with its meal offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.
verses.Numbers|8|9: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the Tent of Meeting: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:
verses.Numbers|8|10: and thou shalt bring the Levites before the Lord: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:
verses.Numbers|8|11: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the Lord for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the Lord.
verses.Numbers|8|12: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, to the Lord, to make atonement for the Levites.
verses.Numbers|8|13: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for a wave offering to the Lord.
verses.Numbers|8|14: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.
verses.Numbers|8|15: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.
verses.Numbers|8|16: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them to me.
verses.Numbers|8|17: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.
verses.Numbers|8|18: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|8|19: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.
verses.Numbers|8|20: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did to the Levites according to all that the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel to them.
verses.Numbers|8|21: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the Lord; and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
verses.Numbers|8|22: And after that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron, and before his sons: as the Lord had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
verses.Numbers|8|23: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|8|24: This is that which belongs to the Levites: from twenty five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the Tent of Meeting:
verses.Numbers|8|25: and from the age of fifty years they shall go out of the ranks of the service, and shall serve no more:
verses.Numbers|8|26: but shall minister with their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do to the Levites as regards their charge.
verses.Numbers|9|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.Numbers|9|2: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at its appointed season.
verses.Numbers|9|3: In the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies of it, shall you keep it.
verses.Numbers|9|4: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.
verses.Numbers|9|5: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at evening in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|9|6: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
verses.Numbers|9|7: and those men said to him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: why are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the Lord in its appointed season among the children of Israel?
verses.Numbers|9|8: And Moses said to them, Stand still, and I will hear what the Lord will command concerning you.
verses.Numbers|9|9: And the Lord spoke to Moses saying,
verses.Numbers|9|10: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be on a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover to the Lord.
verses.Numbers|9|11: On the fourteenth day of the second month at evening they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
verses.Numbers|9|12: They shall leave none of it to the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.
verses.Numbers|9|13: But the man that is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the passover, then that person shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the Lord in its appointed season; that man shall bear his sin.
verses.Numbers|9|14: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover to the Lord; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to its prescribed manner, so shall he do: you shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.
verses.Numbers|9|15: And on the day that the tabernacle was erected the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at evening there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.
verses.Numbers|9|16: So it was always: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
verses.Numbers|9|17: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel encamped.
verses.Numbers|9|18: At the commandment of the Lord the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the Lord they encamped: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they remained encamped.
verses.Numbers|9|19: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the Lord, and journeyed not.
verses.Numbers|9|20: And at times it was, that the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the Lord they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of the Lord they journeyed.
verses.Numbers|9|21: And at times it was, that the cloud abode from evening until morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
verses.Numbers|9|22: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining over it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.
verses.Numbers|9|23: At the commandment of the Lord they remained encamped, and at the commandment of the Lord they journeyed: they kept the charge of the Lord, at the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.Numbers|10|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|10|2: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou shalt use them for calling the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.
verses.Numbers|10|3: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.Numbers|10|4: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to thee.
verses.Numbers|10|5: When you blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
verses.Numbers|10|6: When you blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
verses.Numbers|10|7: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.
verses.Numbers|10|8: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.
verses.Numbers|10|9: And if you go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresses you, then you shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and you shall be remembered before the Lord your God, and you shall be saved from your enemies.
verses.Numbers|10|10: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the Lord your God.
verses.Numbers|10|11: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the Testimony.
verses.Numbers|10|12: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.Numbers|10|13: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.Numbers|10|14: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.Numbers|10|15: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.Numbers|10|16: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.Numbers|10|17: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.
verses.Numbers|10|18: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.Numbers|10|19: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.Numbers|10|20: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.Numbers|10|21: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: that they might set up the tabernacle against their arrival.
verses.Numbers|10|22: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.Numbers|10|23: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.Numbers|10|24: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.Numbers|10|25: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rearward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.Numbers|10|26: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.Numbers|10|27: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.Numbers|10|28: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies; then they set forward.
verses.Numbers|10|29: And Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel, the Midianitish, Moses father in law, We are journeying to the place of which the Lord said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the Lord has spoken good concerning Israel.
verses.Numbers|10|30: And he said to him, I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my kindred.
verses.Numbers|10|31: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; since thou knowst how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayst be to us instead of eyes.
verses.Numbers|10|32: And it shall be, if thou go with us, it shall be, that what good the Lord shall do to us, the same will we do to thee.
verses.Numbers|10|33: And they departed from the mountain of the Lord three days' journey: and the ark of the covenant of the Lord went before them in the three days' journey, to search out a resting place for them.
verses.Numbers|10|34: And the cloud of the Lord was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.
verses.Numbers|10|35: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, Lord, and let thy enemies be scattered; and let those who hate thee flee before thee.
verses.Numbers|10|36: And when it rested, he said, Return, Lord, to the ten thousand thousands of Israel.
verses.Numbers|11|1: And when the people complained, it displeased the Lord: and the Lord heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the Lord burned among them, and consumed those who were in the uttermost parts of the camp.
verses.Numbers|11|2: And the people cried out to Moses; but Moses prayed to the Lord, and the fire was quenched.
verses.Numbers|11|3: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the Lord burned among them.
verses.Numbers|11|4: And the mixed multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us meat to eat?
verses.Numbers|11|5: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic:
verses.Numbers|11|6: but now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.
verses.Numbers|11|7: And the manna was like coriander seed, and its colour was like the colour of bdellium.
verses.Numbers|11|8: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and boiled it in a pot, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was like the taste of oil cake.
verses.Numbers|11|9: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
verses.Numbers|11|10: And Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the Lord burned greatly; Moses also was displeased.
verses.Numbers|11|11: And Moses said to the Lord, Why hast thou afflicted thy servant? and why have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layst the burden of all this people upon me?
verses.Numbers|11|12: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldst say to me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father carries the sucking child, to the land which thou hast sworn to their fathers?
verses.Numbers|11|13: Whence should I have meat to give to all this people? for they weep to me, saying, Give us meat, that we may eat.
verses.Numbers|11|14: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
verses.Numbers|11|15: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight: and let me not see my own wretchedness.
verses.Numbers|11|16: And the Lord said to Moses, Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowst to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with thee.
verses.Numbers|11|17: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee that thou bear it not thyself alone.
verses.Numbers|11|18: And say to the people, Sanctify yourselves against tomorrow, and you shall eat meat: for you have wept in the ears of the Lord, saying, Who shall give us meat to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the Lord will give you meat, and you shall eat.
verses.Numbers|11|19: Not one day shall you eat, nor two days, nor five days, nor ten days, nor twenty days;
verses.Numbers|11|20: but a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome to you: because you have despised the Lord who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why did we come out of Egypt?
verses.Numbers|11|21: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.
verses.Numbers|11|22: Shall flocks and herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
verses.Numbers|11|23: And the Lord said to Moses, Is the Lord's hand too short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass to thee or not.
verses.Numbers|11|24: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the Lord, and gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tent.
verses.Numbers|11|25: And the Lord came down in a cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it to the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, but continued not.
verses.Numbers|11|26: And there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out to the tent: and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.Numbers|11|27: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
verses.Numbers|11|28: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses from his youth, answered and said, My lord Moses restrain them.
verses.Numbers|11|29: And Moses said to him, Enviest thou for my sake? would that all the Lord's people were prophets, and that the Lord would put his spirit upon them!
verses.Numbers|11|30: And Moses retired into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
verses.Numbers|11|31: And a wind went out from the Lord, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day's journey on this side, and about a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and about two cubits high upon the face of the earth.
verses.Numbers|11|32: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered a quantity of ten homer: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
verses.Numbers|11|33: And while the meat was yet between their teeth, before it was chewed, the wrath of the Lord was inflamed against the people, and the Lord smote the people with a very great plague.
verses.Numbers|11|34: And he called the name of that place Kibroth-hattaavah (Graves of Lust): because there they buried the people that lusted.
verses.Numbers|11|35: And the people journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah to Hazeroth, and at Hazeroth they made a stay.
verses.Numbers|12|1: And Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had taken, for he had taken a Ethiopian woman.
verses.Numbers|12|2: And they said, Has the Lord indeed spoken only with Moses? has he not spoken also with us? And the Lord heard it.
verses.Numbers|12|3: (Now the man Moses was very meek, more so than all the men that were upon the face of the earth.)
verses.Numbers|12|4: And the Lord spoke suddenly to Moses, and to Aaron, and to Miriam, Come out you three to the Tent of Meeting. And they three came out.
verses.Numbers|12|5: And the Lord came down in the pillar of cloud, and stood in the door of the tent, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came out.
verses.Numbers|12|6: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the Lord make myself known to him in a vision, and speak to him in a dream.
verses.Numbers|12|7: My servant Moses is not so, for he is the trusted one in all my house.
verses.Numbers|12|8: With him I speak mouth to mouth, manifestly, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the Lord does he behold: why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?
verses.Numbers|12|9: And the anger of the Lord was inflamed against them; and he departed.
verses.Numbers|12|10: And the cloud was removed from the tent; and, behold, Miriam was snow white, stricken with zaraat; and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and behold, she was diseased.
verses.Numbers|12|11: And Aaron said to Moses, Alas, my lord, I pray thee, lay no sin upon us, for we have done foolishly, and we have sinned.
verses.Numbers|12|12: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother's womb.
verses.Numbers|12|13: And Moses cried to the Lord, saying, Heal her now, O God, I pray thee.
verses.Numbers|12|14: And the Lord said to Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed for seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.
verses.Numbers|12|15: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people did not journey until Miriam was brought in again.
verses.Numbers|12|16: And afterwards the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.Numbers|13|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|13|2: Send thou men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall you send a man, every one a ruler among them.
verses.Numbers|13|3: And Moses by the commandment of the Lord sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|13|4: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zaccur.
verses.Numbers|13|5: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori.
verses.Numbers|13|6: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb, son of Jephunneh.
verses.Numbers|13|7: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph.
verses.Numbers|13|8: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun.
verses.Numbers|13|9: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti, son of Raphu.
verses.Numbers|13|10: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi.
verses.Numbers|13|11: Of the tribe of Joseph, that is of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi son of Susi.
verses.Numbers|13|12: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli.
verses.Numbers|13|13: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael.
verses.Numbers|13|14: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi, son of Vophsi.
verses.Numbers|13|15: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Machi.
verses.Numbers|13|16: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Hoshea son of Nun, Joshua.
verses.Numbers|13|17: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and he said to them, Go up this way by the south, and go up into the high land:
verses.Numbers|13|18: and see the country, what it is; and the people who dwell in it, whether they are strong or weak, few or many;
verses.Numbers|13|19: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strongholds;
verses.Numbers|13|20: and what the land is, whether fat or lean, whether there are trees in it, or not. And be of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.
verses.Numbers|13|21: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, on the way to Hamath.
verses.Numbers|13|22: And they ascended into the south, and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
verses.Numbers|13|23: And they came to the wadi of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they carried it between two on a pole; and they brought of the pomegranates, and the figs.
verses.Numbers|13|24: The place was called the wadi of Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from there.
verses.Numbers|13|25: And they returned from searching the land after forty days.
verses.Numbers|13|26: And they went and came to Moses and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them, and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.
verses.Numbers|13|27: And they told him, and said, We came to the land where thou didst send us, and indeed it flows with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.
verses.Numbers|13|28: But the people are strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are fortified, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
verses.Numbers|13|29: Amalek dwells in the land of the south: and the Hittite, and the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the mountain: and the Canaanite dwell by the sea and by the side of the Jordan.
