verses.Numbers|13|30: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
verses.Numbers|13|31: But the men who went up with him said, We are not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
verses.Numbers|13|32: And they spread an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.
verses.Numbers|13|33: And there we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak who come of the Nephilim: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
verses.Numbers|14|1: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
verses.Numbers|14|2: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said to them, Would that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would we had died in this wilderness!
verses.Numbers|14|3: And why has the Lord brought us to this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return to Egypt?
verses.Numbers|14|4: And they said to one another, Let us appoint a chief, and let us return to Egypt.
verses.Numbers|14|5: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|14|6: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, of those who spied out the land, rent their clothes:
verses.Numbers|14|7: and they spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.
verses.Numbers|14|8: If the Lord delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which flows with milk and honey.
verses.Numbers|14|9: Only rebel not against the Lord, nor fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the Lord is with us: fear them not.
verses.Numbers|14|10: But all the congregation said to stone them with stones. And the glory of the Lord appeared in the Tent of Meeting before all the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|14|11: And the Lord said to Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be before they believe me, for all the signs which I have performed among them?
verses.Numbers|14|12: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.
verses.Numbers|14|13: And Moses said to the Lord, Then Egypt shall hear it, (for thou didst bring up this people in thy might from among them;)
verses.Numbers|14|14: and they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: who have heard that thou Lord art among this people, that thou Lord art seen face to face, and that thy cloud stands over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.Numbers|14|15: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
verses.Numbers|14|16: Because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.
verses.Numbers|14|17: And now, I pray thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
verses.Numbers|14|18: The Lord is longsuffering, and great in love, forgiving iniquity and transgression, but by no means clearing the guilty, punishing the iniquity of the fathers upon the children to the third and fourth generation.
verses.Numbers|14|19: Pardon, I pray thee, the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of thy love, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt until now.
verses.Numbers|14|20: And the Lord said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
verses.Numbers|14|21: but truly, as I live, and all the earth is filled with the glory of the Lord:
verses.Numbers|14|22: surely, all those men who have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and yet have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice:
verses.Numbers|14|23: surely, they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, nor shall any of those who provoked me see it:
verses.Numbers|14|24: but my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and followed me fully, him will I bring into the land into which he went; and his seed shall possess it,
verses.Numbers|14|25: (Now the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwelt in the valley.) Tomorrow turn, and get you into the wilderness by way of the Red Sea.
verses.Numbers|14|26: And the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.Numbers|14|27: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, who murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
verses.Numbers|14|28: Say to them, As I live, says the Lord, as you have spoken in my ears, so will I do to you:
verses.Numbers|14|29: your carcasses shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have murmured against me,
verses.Numbers|14|30: shall by no means come into the land, concerning which I swore to make you dwell there, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.Numbers|14|31: But your little ones, who, you said, should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which you have despised.
verses.Numbers|14|32: But as for you, your carcasses shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.Numbers|14|33: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your backslidings, until your carcasses be consumed in the wilderness.
verses.Numbers|14|34: According to the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall you bear your iniquities, namely, forty years, and you shall know my displeasure.
verses.Numbers|14|35: I the Lord have said, I will surely do it to all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
verses.Numbers|14|36: And the men, whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned, and made all the congregation murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land;
verses.Numbers|14|37: now those men that brought up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the Lord,
verses.Numbers|14|38: but Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, of the men who went to spy out the land; they lived.
verses.Numbers|14|39: And Moses told these sayings to all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.
verses.Numbers|14|40: And they rose up early in the morning, and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, We are here, and will go up to the place which the Lord has promised: for we have sinned.
verses.Numbers|14|41: And Moses said, Why now do you transgress the commandment of the Lord? it shall not prosper.
verses.Numbers|14|42: Go not up, for the Lord is not among you: so that you may not be smitten before your enemies.
verses.Numbers|14|43: For the Amalekite and the Canaanite are there before you, and you shall fall by the sword: because you have turned away from the Lord, therefore the Lord will not be with you.
verses.Numbers|14|44: But they presumed to go up to the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
verses.Numbers|14|45: Then the Amalekite came down, and the Canaanite who dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, as far as Hormah.
verses.Numbers|15|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|15|2: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When you come to the land of your habitations, which I give to you,
verses.Numbers|15|3: and will make an offering by fire to the Lord, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, in performing a pronounced vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour to the Lord, of the herd, or of the flock:
verses.Numbers|15|4: then shall he that offers his offering to the Lord bring a meal offering of a tenth measure of flour mingled with the fourth part of a hin of oil.
verses.Numbers|15|5: And the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
verses.Numbers|15|6: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meal offering two tenth measures of flour mingled with the third part of a hin of oil.
verses.Numbers|15|7: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of a hin of wine, for a sweet savour to the Lord.
verses.Numbers|15|8: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice, in performing a pronounced vow, or in offering a peace offering to the Lord:
verses.Numbers|15|9: then shall he bring with a bullock a meal offering of three tenth measures of flour mingled with half a hin of oil.
verses.Numbers|15|10: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour to the Lord.
verses.Numbers|15|11: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
verses.Numbers|15|12: According to the number that you shall prepare, so shall you do to every one according to their number.
verses.Numbers|15|13: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour to the Lord.
verses.Numbers|15|14: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour to the Lord; as you do, so he shall do.
verses.Numbers|15|15: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourns with you, an ordinance for ever throughout your generations: as you are, so shall the stranger be before the Lord.
verses.Numbers|15|16: One law and one code shall there be for you, and for the stranger that sojourns with you.
verses.Numbers|15|17: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|15|18: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When you come into the land into which I bring you,
verses.Numbers|15|19: then it shall be, that, when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a gift to the Lord.
verses.Numbers|15|20: You shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for a gift: as you do the gift of the threshingfloor, so shall you set it apart.
verses.Numbers|15|21: Of the first of your dough you shall give to the Lord an offering throughout your generations.
verses.Numbers|15|22: And if you have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the Lord spoke to Moses,
verses.Numbers|15|23: all that the Lord has commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the Lord gave command, and henceforward throughout your generations;
verses.Numbers|15|24: then it shall be, if it be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour to the Lord, with its meal offering, and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.
verses.Numbers|15|25: And the priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance, and they have brought their offering, a sacrifice made by fire to the Lord, and their sin offering before the Lord, for their ignorance.
verses.Numbers|15|26: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourns among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.
verses.Numbers|15|27: And if a single person sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
verses.Numbers|15|28: And the priest shall make atonement for the person that sins ignorantly, when he sins by ignorance before the Lord, to make atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.Numbers|15|29: You shall have one law for him who sins through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourns among them.
verses.Numbers|15|30: But the person that acts presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, that person dishonours the Lord; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.Numbers|15|31: Because he has despised the word of the Lord, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
verses.Numbers|15|32: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks upon the sabbath day.
verses.Numbers|15|33: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.
verses.Numbers|15|34: And they put him in custody, because it was not declared what should be done to him.
verses.Numbers|15|35: And the Lord said to Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones outside the camp.
verses.Numbers|15|36: And all the congregation brought him outside the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.Numbers|15|37: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|15|38: Speak to the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the corners of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of each corner a thread of blue:
verses.Numbers|15|39: and it shall be to you as a fringe, that you may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the Lord, and do them; and that you seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which you go astray:
verses.Numbers|15|40: that you may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.
verses.Numbers|15|41: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord your God.
verses.Numbers|16|1: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Levi, and On, the son of Pelet, of the sons of Reuben, took men:
verses.Numbers|16|2: and they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, regularly summoned to the congregation, men of renown:
verses.Numbers|16|3: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, You take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the Lord is among them: why then do you raise yourselves up above the congregation of the Lord?
verses.Numbers|16|4: And when Moses heard it, he fell on his face:
verses.Numbers|16|5: and he spoke to Korah and to all his company, saying, Tomorrow morning the Lord will show who is his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near to him: even him whom he has chosen will he cause to come near to him.
verses.Numbers|16|6: This do; Take censers, Korah, and all his company;
verses.Numbers|16|7: and put fire in them, and put incense in them before the Lord tomorrow: and it shall be that the man whom the Lord chooses, he shall be holy: you take too much upon you, you sons of Levi.
verses.Numbers|16|8: And Moses said to Korah, Hear, I pray you, sons of Levi:
verses.Numbers|16|9: is it but a small thing to you, that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the Lord, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them?
verses.Numbers|16|10: And he has brought thee near to him, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and do you seek the priesthood also?
verses.Numbers|16|11: For which cause both thou and all thy company who are gathered together are against the Lord: and what is Aaron, that you murmur against him?
verses.Numbers|16|12: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; but they said, We will not come up:
verses.Numbers|16|13: is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, and dost thou also make thyself a prince over us?
verses.Numbers|16|14: Moreover thou hast not brought us to a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
verses.Numbers|16|15: And Moses was much angered, and said to the Lord, Have no regard to their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, nor have I hurt one of them.
verses.Numbers|16|16: And Moses said to Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the Lord, thou, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow:
verses.Numbers|16|17: and take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and present before the Lord every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.
verses.Numbers|16|18: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense on them, and stood in the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.
verses.Numbers|16|19: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them to the door of the Tent of Meeting: and the glory of the Lord appeared to all the congregation.
verses.Numbers|16|20: And the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.Numbers|16|21: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
verses.Numbers|16|22: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be angry with all the congregation?
verses.Numbers|16|23: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|16|24: Speak to the congregation, saying, Get up from about the dwelling of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
verses.Numbers|16|25: And Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
verses.Numbers|16|26: And he spoke to the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins.
verses.Numbers|16|27: So they went up from the dwelling of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
verses.Numbers|16|28: And Moses said, Hereby you shall know that the Lord has sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of my own mind.
verses.Numbers|16|29: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the Lord has not sent me.
verses.Numbers|16|30: But if the Lord creates a new thing, and the earth opens her mouth, and swallows them up, with all that appertain to them, and they go down alive into Sheol; then you shall understand that these men have provoked the Lord.
verses.Numbers|16|31: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground split beneath them:
verses.Numbers|16|32: and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained to Korah, and all their goods.
verses.Numbers|16|33: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into Sheol, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
verses.Numbers|16|34: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.
verses.Numbers|16|35: And there came out a fire from the Lord, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered the incense.
verses.Numbers|17|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses saying,
verses.Numbers|17|2: Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they have become holy.
verses.Numbers|17|3: As for the censers of these sinners against their own lives, let them make them into beaten plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the Lord, therefore they have become holy: and they shall be a sign to the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|17|4: And Eleazar the priest took the brazen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they made them into beaten plates for a covering of the altar:
verses.Numbers|17|5: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, that no stranger, who is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the Lord: that he be not like Korah and his company: as the Lord said to him by the hand of Moses.
verses.Numbers|17|6: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, You have killed the people of the Lord.
verses.Numbers|17|7: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the Tent of Meeting: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the Lord appeared.
verses.Numbers|17|8: And Moses and Aaron came before the Tent of Meeting.
verses.Numbers|17|9: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|17|10: Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
verses.Numbers|17|11: And Moses said to Aaron. Take a censer, and put fire in it from off the altar, and put on incense, and take it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them: for wrath is gone out from the Lord; the plague has begun.
verses.Numbers|17|12: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague had begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made atonement for the people.
verses.Numbers|17|13: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
verses.Numbers|17|14: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand, seven hundred, besides those who died about the matter of Korah.
verses.Numbers|17|15: And Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting: and the plague was stayed.
verses.Numbers|17|16: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|17|17: Speak to the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod, one for each father's house, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers: twelve rods: write every man's name upon his rod.
verses.Numbers|17|18: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.
verses.Numbers|17|19: And thou shalt lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the Testimony, where I will meet with you.
verses.Numbers|17|20: And it shall come to pass, that the man's rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.
verses.Numbers|17|21: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses: twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
verses.Numbers|17|22: And Moses laid up the rods before the Lord in the tent of the Testimony.
verses.Numbers|17|23: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tent of the Testimony: and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi had sprouted, and brought forth buds, and blossomed, and yielded almonds.
verses.Numbers|17|24: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the Lord to all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.
verses.Numbers|17|25: And the Lord said to Moses, Put Aaron's rod back before the Testimony, to be kept for a token against rebels; that there may be an end of their murmurings against me, that they die not.
verses.Numbers|17|26: And Moses did so: as the Lord commanded him, so he did.
verses.Numbers|17|27: And the children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.
verses.Numbers|17|28: Everyone that comes at all near the tabernacle of the Lord dies; shall we totally perish?
verses.Numbers|18|1: And the Lord said to Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
verses.Numbers|18|2: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou near with thee, that they may be joined to thee, and minister to thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tent of the Testimony.
verses.Numbers|18|3: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tent: only they shall not come near the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor you, die.
verses.Numbers|18|4: And they shall be joined to thee, and keep the charge of the Tent of Meeting, for all the service of the tent, and a stranger shall not come near to you.
verses.Numbers|18|5: And you shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|18|6: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are given as a gift for the Lord, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.Numbers|18|7: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest's office for everything that concerns the altar, and within the veil: and you shall serve: I have given your priest's office to you as a service of gift: and the stranger that comes near shall be put to death.
verses.Numbers|18|8: And the Lord spoke to Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of my heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.
verses.Numbers|18|9: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every offering of theirs, every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every guilt offering of theirs, which they shall render to me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.
verses.Numbers|18|10: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy to thee.
verses.Numbers|18|11: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, for all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them to thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.
verses.Numbers|18|12: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the first of them which they shall offer to the Lord, them have I given thee.
verses.Numbers|18|13: The first ripe fruit of all that is in the land, which they shall bring to the Lord, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.
verses.Numbers|18|14: Everything devoted in Israel shall be thine.
verses.Numbers|18|15: Everything that opens the womb in all flesh, which they bring to the Lord, whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.
verses.Numbers|18|16: And those that are to be redeemed shall be redeemable from a month old according to the usual estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gera.
verses.Numbers|18|17: But the firstling of an ox, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour to the Lord.
verses.Numbers|18|18: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder shall they be thine.
verses.Numbers|18|19: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer to the Lord, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the Lord to thee and to thy seed with thee.
verses.Numbers|18|20: And the Lord spoke to Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy portion and thy inheritance among the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|18|21: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.Numbers|18|22: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.
verses.Numbers|18|23: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.
verses.Numbers|18|24: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as a gift to the Lord, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said to them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
verses.Numbers|18|25: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|18|26: Thus speak to the Levites, and say to them, When you take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up from it a gift for the Lord, even a tenth part of the tithe.
verses.Numbers|18|27: And this your gift shall be reckoned to you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
verses.Numbers|18|28: Thus you also shall offer a gift to the Lord of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Israel; and you shall give of it the Lord's gift to Aaron the priest.
verses.Numbers|18|29: Out of all that is given to you, you shall set aside all that is due as a gift to the Lord, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part of it.
verses.Numbers|18|30: Therefore thou shalt say to them, When you have set aside the best of it, then it shall be counted to the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.
verses.Numbers|18|31: And you shall eat it in every place, you and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.Numbers|18|32: And you shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have set aside from it the best of it: nor shall you pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest you die.
verses.Numbers|19|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.Numbers|19|2: This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord has commanded, saying, Speak to the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without defect, in which there is no blemish, and upon which never came a yoke:
verses.Numbers|19|3: and you shall give her to Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her outside the camp, and she shall be slaughtered before his face:
verses.Numbers|19|4: and Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood towards the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times:
verses.Numbers|19|5: and the heifer shall be burnt in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall be burnt:
verses.Numbers|19|6: and the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
verses.Numbers|19|7: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterwards he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.Numbers|19|8: And he that burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.Numbers|19|9: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them outside the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for the water of sprinkling: it is a purification offering.
verses.Numbers|19|10: And he that gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening: and it shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger that sojourns among them, for a statute for ever.
verses.Numbers|19|11: He that touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
verses.Numbers|19|12: If he purify himself with it on the third day and on the seventh day, he shall be clean: but if he do not purify himself on the third day and the seventh day, he shall not be clean.
verses.Numbers|19|13: Whoever touches the dead body of any man that has died, and purifies not himself, he defiles the tabernacle of the Lord; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of sprinkling was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
verses.Numbers|19|14: This is the law: when a man dies in a tent, all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.Numbers|19|15: And every open vessel, which has no covering bound upon it, is unclean.
verses.Numbers|19|16: And whoever touches one that is slain with a sword in the open field, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.Numbers|19|17: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt purification offering, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
verses.Numbers|19|18: and a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
verses.Numbers|19|19: and the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.
verses.Numbers|19|20: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the Lord: the water of sprinkling has not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
verses.Numbers|19|21: And it shall be a perpetual statute to them, that he that sprinkles the water of sprinkling shall wash his clothes; and he that touches the water of sprinkling shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.Numbers|19|22: And whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the person that touches it shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.Numbers|20|1: Then came the children of Israel, the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh, and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
verses.Numbers|20|2: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
verses.Numbers|20|3: And the people quarrelled with Moses, and spoke, saying, Would that we had died when our brethren died before the Lord!
verses.Numbers|20|4: And why have you brought up the congregation of the Lord into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
verses.Numbers|20|5: And why have you made us come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; nor is there any water to drink.
verses.Numbers|20|6: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the Lord appeared to them.
verses.Numbers|20|7: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|20|8: Take the rod, and gather the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth its water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.
verses.Numbers|20|9: And Moses took the rod from before the Lord, as he commanded him.
verses.Numbers|20|10: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said to them, Hear now, you rebels; shall we fetch you water out of this rock?
verses.Numbers|20|11: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.
verses.Numbers|20|12: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, Because you did not believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this congregation in to the land which I have given them.
verses.Numbers|20|13: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the Lord, and he was sanctified by them.
verses.Numbers|20|14: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, Thus says thy brother Israel, Thou knowst all the travail that has befallen us:
verses.Numbers|20|15: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and Egypt vexed us, and our fathers:
verses.Numbers|20|16: and when we cried to the Lord, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:
verses.Numbers|20|17: let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, nor will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king's highway, we will not turn to the right hand or to the left, until we have passed thy borders.
verses.Numbers|20|18: And Edom said to him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.
verses.Numbers|20|19: And the children of Israel said to him, We will go by the highway: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will do thee no injury, only on foot will I pass through.
verses.Numbers|20|20: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
verses.Numbers|20|21: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: so that Israel turned away from him.
verses.Numbers|20|22: And they journeyed from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, the whole congregation came to mount Hor.
verses.Numbers|20|23: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,
verses.Numbers|20|24: Aaron shall be gathered to his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.
verses.Numbers|20|25: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to mount Hor:
verses.Numbers|20|26: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered to his people, and shall die there.
verses.Numbers|20|27: And Moses did as the Lord commanded: and they went up to mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
verses.Numbers|20|28: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
verses.Numbers|20|29: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron, thirty days, all the house of Israel.
verses.Numbers|21|1: And when the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of Atharim; then he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.
verses.Numbers|21|2: And Israel vowed a vow to the Lord, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will devote their cities to destruction.
verses.Numbers|21|3: And the Lord hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanite; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.
verses.Numbers|21|4: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red Sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
verses.Numbers|21|5: And the people spoke against God, and against Moses, Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, nor is there any water; and our soul loathes this miserable bread.
verses.Numbers|21|6: And the Lord sent venomous serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and many people of Israel died.
verses.Numbers|21|7: Therefore the people came to Moses and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the Lord, and against thee; pray to the Lord, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
verses.Numbers|21|8: And the Lord said to Moses, Make thee a venomous serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looks upon it, shall live.
verses.Numbers|21|9: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
verses.Numbers|21|10: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.Numbers|21|11: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ije-abarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
verses.Numbers|21|12: From thence they removed, and pitched in the wadi of Zered.
verses.Numbers|21|13: From thence they removed, and pitched on the side of Arnon which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorite: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorite.
verses.Numbers|21|14: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the Lord, Vaheb in Suphah and the wadis of Arnon.
verses.Numbers|21|15: And the stream of the wadis that goes down to the dwelling of Ar, and lies upon the border of Moab.
verses.Numbers|21|16: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well of which the Lord spoke to Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
verses.Numbers|21|17: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing to it:
verses.Numbers|21|18: the well that the princes dug out, that the nobles of the people delved, with the sceptre, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:
verses.Numbers|21|19: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:
verses.Numbers|21|20: and from Bamoth to the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks out towards the desert.
verses.Numbers|21|21: And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorite, saying,
verses.Numbers|21|22: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn aside into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king's highway, until we have past thy borders.
verses.Numbers|21|23: And Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.Numbers|21|24: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon to Jabbok, as far as the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
verses.Numbers|21|25: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorite, in Heshbon, and in all its hamlets.
verses.Numbers|21|26: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorite, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, as far as Arnon.
verses.Numbers|21|27: Wherefore they who speak in similes say, Come to Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and established:
verses.Numbers|21|28: for there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it has consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.
verses.Numbers|21|29: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters, as captives to Sihon king of the Amorite.
verses.Numbers|21|30: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even to Dibon, and we have laid them waste to Nophah, which reaches to Medeba.
verses.Numbers|21|31: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorite.
verses.Numbers|21|32: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took its hamlets, and drove out the Amorite who were there.
verses.Numbers|21|33: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.
verses.Numbers|21|34: And the Lord said to Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst to Sihon king of the Amorite, who dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.Numbers|21|35: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.
verses.Numbers|22|1: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on the far side of the Jordan by Jericho.
verses.Numbers|22|2: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorite.
verses.Numbers|22|3: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was seized with dread because of the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|22|4: And Moab said to the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.
verses.Numbers|22|5: So he sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:
verses.Numbers|22|6: come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: perhaps I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I know that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.
verses.Numbers|22|7: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.
verses.Numbers|22|8: And he said to them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you back word, as the Lord shall speak to me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
verses.Numbers|22|9: And God came to Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?
verses.Numbers|22|10: And Balaam said to God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent to me, saying,
verses.Numbers|22|11: Behold, the people that is come out of Egypt, covers the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; perhaps I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.
verses.Numbers|22|12: And God said to Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.
verses.Numbers|22|13: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, Go back to your land: for the Lord refuses to give me leave to go with you.
verses.Numbers|22|14: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, Balaam refuses to come with us.
verses.Numbers|22|15: And Balak sent again princes, greater, and more honourable than they.
verses.Numbers|22|16: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus says Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming to me:
verses.Numbers|22|17: for I will promote thee to very great honour, and I will do whatever thou sayst to me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
verses.Numbers|22|18: And Balaam answered and said to the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the Lord my God, to do less or more.
verses.Numbers|22|19: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry you also here this night, that I may know what the Lord will say further to me.
verses.Numbers|22|20: And God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but only that word which I shall say to thee, shalt thou do.
verses.Numbers|22|21: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
verses.Numbers|22|22: And God's anger burned because he went: and the angel of the Lord stood in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.
verses.Numbers|22|23: And the ass saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
verses.Numbers|22|24: But the angel of the Lord stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
verses.Numbers|22|25: And when the ass saw the angel of the Lord, she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he struck her again.
verses.Numbers|22|26: And the angel of the Lord went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
verses.Numbers|22|27: And when the ass saw the angel of the Lord, she lay down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger burned, and he struck the ass with a staff.
verses.Numbers|22|28: And the Lord opened the mouth of the ass, and she said to Balaam, What have I done to thee, that thou hast struck me these three times?
verses.Numbers|22|29: And Balaam said to the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in my hand, for now I would kill thee.
verses.Numbers|22|30: And the ass said to Balaam, Am not I thy ass, upon which thou hast ridden all thy life to this day? was I ever wont to do so to thee? And he said, No,
verses.Numbers|22|31: Then the Lord opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell on his face.
verses.Numbers|22|32: And the angel of the Lord said to him, Why hast thou struck thy ass these three times? behold, I went out to waylay thee, because thy path is perverse before me:
verses.Numbers|22|33: and the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, I would now have slain thee, and saved her alive.
verses.Numbers|22|34: And Balaam said to the angel of the Lord, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou didst stand in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.
verses.Numbers|22|35: And the angel of the Lord said to Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak to thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
verses.Numbers|22|36: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him to a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, in the utmost border.
verses.Numbers|22|37: And Balak said to Balaam, Did I not earnestly send to thee to call thee? Why camest thou not to me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?
verses.Numbers|22|38: And Balaam said to Balak, Lo, I am come to thee: have I now any power at all to say anything? the word that God puts in my mouth, that I shall speak.
verses.Numbers|22|39: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kirjath-huzoth.
verses.Numbers|22|40: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam and to the princes that were with him.
verses.Numbers|22|41: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into Bamoth-baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.
verses.Numbers|23|1: And Balaam said to Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
verses.Numbers|23|2: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.Numbers|23|3: And Balaam said to Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: perhaps the Lord will come to meet me; and whatever he shows me I will tell thee. And he went to a steep place.
verses.Numbers|23|4: And God met Balaam: and he said to him, I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.Numbers|23|5: And the Lord put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return to Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
verses.Numbers|23|6: And he returned to him, and behold, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
verses.Numbers|23|7: And he took up his discourse, and said, Balak the king of Moab has brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, denounce Israel.
verses.Numbers|23|8: How shall I curse, whom God has not cursed? or how shall I denounce whom the Lord has not denounced?
verses.Numbers|23|9: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: it is a people that shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
verses.Numbers|23|10: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
verses.Numbers|23|11: And Balak said to Balaam, What hast thou done to me? I took thee to curse my enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.
verses.Numbers|23|12: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the Lord has put in my mouth?
verses.Numbers|23|13: And Balak said to him, Come, I pray thee, with me to another place, from whence thou mayst see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from there.
verses.Numbers|23|14: And he brought him into a field of vantage, at the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
verses.Numbers|23|15: And he said to Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I go to the meeting yonder.
verses.Numbers|23|16: And the Lord met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go back to Balak, and say thus.
verses.Numbers|23|17: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said to him, What has the Lord spoken?
verses.Numbers|23|18: And he took up his discourse, and said, Rise up, Balak and hear; hearken to me, thou son of Zippor:
verses.Numbers|23|19: God is not a man, that he should lie; nor the son of man, that he should repent: has he said, and shall he not perform? or has he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
verses.Numbers|23|20: Behold, I am bidden to bless: and he has blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
verses.Numbers|23|21: He has not beheld iniquity in Jacob nor has he seen perverseness in Israel: the Lord his God is with him, and the trumpet blast of a king is among them.
verses.Numbers|23|22: God who brought them out of Egypt; he has as it were the strength of a wild ox.
verses.Numbers|23|23: Surely there is no enchantment in Jacob, nor is there any divination in Israel: in due time Jacob and Israel are told what God has performed.
verses.Numbers|23|24: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
verses.Numbers|23|25: And Balak said to Balaam, Neither curse them, nor bless them.
verses.Numbers|23|26: But Balaam answered and said to Balak, Did not I tell thee, saying, All that the Lord speaks, that I must do?
verses.Numbers|23|27: And Balak said to Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee to another place; perhaps it will please God that thou mayst curse me them from there.
verses.Numbers|23|28: And Balak brought Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks out towards the desert.
verses.Numbers|23|29: And Balaam said to Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.Numbers|23|30: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
verses.Numbers|24|1: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
verses.Numbers|24|2: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.
verses.Numbers|24|3: And he took up his discourse, and said, The speech of Balaam the son Beor, and the speech of the man whose eyes are open:
verses.Numbers|24|4: the saying of him who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, but having his eyes open:
verses.Numbers|24|5: how goodly are thy tents, O, Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!
verses.Numbers|24|6: like the winding brooks, like gardens by the river's side, like aloes which the Lord has planted, and cedar trees beside the waters.
verses.Numbers|24|7: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, moistening his seed plentifully, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.Numbers|24|8: God brought him out of Egypt: he has as it were the strength of a wild ox: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.
verses.Numbers|24|9: He couched, he lay down like a lion, and like a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesses thee, and cursed is he that curses thee.
verses.Numbers|24|10: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said to Balaam, I called thee to curse my enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.
verses.Numbers|24|11: Therefore now flee to thy place: I thought to promote thee to great honour; but, the Lord has kept thee back from honour.
verses.Numbers|24|12: And Balaam said to Balak, Did I not speak also to thy messengers which thou didst send to me, saying,
verses.Numbers|24|13: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the Lord, to do either good or bad of my own mind; but what the Lord says, that will I speak?
verses.Numbers|24|14: And now, behold, I go to my people: come therefore, and I will advise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
verses.Numbers|24|15: And he took up his discourse, and said, The speech of Balaam the son of Beor, and the speech of the man whose eyes are open:
verses.Numbers|24|16: the saying of him that hears the words of God, and knows the knowledge of the most High, seeing the vision of the Almighty, falling down but having his eyes open:
verses.Numbers|24|17: I see it, but not now: I behold it, but it is not near: there shall come a star out of Jacob, and a sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Seth.
verses.Numbers|24|18: And Edom shall be his possession, Seir also, his enemies, shall be his possession; and Israel shall do valiantly.
verses.Numbers|24|19: Out of Jacob shall come a ruler, and shall destroy him that remains of the city.
verses.Numbers|24|20: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his discourse, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be everlasting perdition.
verses.Numbers|24|21: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his discourse, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.
verses.Numbers|24|22: Nevertheless Cain shall be wasted; whither shall Asshur carry thee away captive?
verses.Numbers|24|23: And he took up his discourse, and said, Alas, who shall live when he does these things.
verses.Numbers|24|24: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
verses.Numbers|24|25: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.
verses.Numbers|25|1: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit harlotry with the daughters of Moab.
verses.Numbers|25|2: And they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods: and the people ate, and bowed down to their gods.
verses.Numbers|25|3: And Israel joined himself to Baal-peor: and the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel.
verses.Numbers|25|4: And the Lord said to Moses, Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up before the Lord against the sun, that the burning anger of the Lord may be turned away from Israel.
verses.Numbers|25|5: And Moses said to the judges of Israel, Slay every one his men that have attached themselves to Baal-peor.
verses.Numbers|25|6: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.Numbers|25|7: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a spear in his hand;
verses.Numbers|25|8: and he went after the man of Israel into the chamber, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|25|9: And those that died in the plague were twenty four thousand.
verses.Numbers|25|10: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|25|11: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
verses.Numbers|25|12: Wherefore say, Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace:
verses.Numbers|25|13: and he shall have it, and his seed after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|25|14: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a father's house among the Simeonites.
verses.Numbers|25|15: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over the people of a father's house in Midian.
verses.Numbers|25|16: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|25|17: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:
verses.Numbers|25|18: for they vex you with their wiles, with which they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain in the day of the plague in the affair of Peor.
verses.Numbers|26|1: And it came to pass after the plague, that the Lord spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
verses.Numbers|26|2: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers' house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.
verses.Numbers|26|3: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.Numbers|26|4: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the Lord commanded Moses and the children of Israel, who went forth out of the land of Egypt.
verses.Numbers|26|5: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, the family of the Hanoch: of Pallu, the family of the Pallui.
verses.Numbers|26|6: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezron: of Carmi, the family of the Carmi.
verses.Numbers|26|7: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty three thousand, seven hundred and thirty.
verses.Numbers|26|8: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.
verses.Numbers|26|9: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, who were regularly summoned to the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the Lord:
verses.Numbers|26|10: and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, at which time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.
verses.Numbers|26|11: But the children of Korah died not.
verses.Numbers|26|12: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemueli: of Jamin, the family of the Jamin: of Jachin, the family of the Jachin:
verses.Numbers|26|13: of Zerah, the family of the Zerah: of Shaul, the family of the Shaul.
verses.Numbers|26|14: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty two thousand, two hundred.
verses.Numbers|26|15: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephon: of Haggi, the family of the Haggi: of Shuni, the family of the Shuni:
verses.Numbers|26|16: of Ozni, the family of the Ozni: of Eri, the family of the Eri:
verses.Numbers|26|17: of Arod, the family of the Arodi: of Areli, the family of the Areli.
verses.Numbers|26|18: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand, five hundred.
verses.Numbers|26|19: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
verses.Numbers|26|20: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Parzi: of Zerah, the family of the Zerah.
verses.Numbers|26|21: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezron: of Hamul, the family of the Hamul.
verses.Numbers|26|22: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, seventy six thousand, five hundred.
verses.Numbers|26|23: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolai: of Pubba, the family of the Punites:
verses.Numbers|26|24: of Jashub, the family of the Jashub: of Shimron, the family of the Shimroni.
verses.Numbers|26|25: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, sixty four thousand, three hundred.
verses.Numbers|26|26: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sered: of Elon, the family of the Eloni: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleel.
verses.Numbers|26|27: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, sixty thousand, five hundred.
verses.Numbers|26|28: The sons of Joseph after their families, Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.Numbers|26|29: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machir: and Machir begot Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gilead.
verses.Numbers|26|30: These are the sons of Gileadite: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezer: of Helek, the family of the Helek:
verses.Numbers|26|31: and of Asriel, the family of the Asrieli: and of Shechem, the the family of the Shechem:
verses.Numbers|26|32: and of Shemida, the family of the Shemidai: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepher.
verses.Numbers|26|33: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah.
verses.Numbers|26|34: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty two thousand seven hundred.
verses.Numbers|26|35: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Becher: of Tahan, the family of the Tahan.
verses.Numbers|26|36: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eran.
verses.Numbers|26|37: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
verses.Numbers|26|38: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Bela: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbeli: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiram:
verses.Numbers|26|39: of Shupham, the family of the Shupham: of Hupham, the family of the Hupham.
verses.Numbers|26|40: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ard: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
verses.Numbers|26|41: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty five thousand, six hundred.
verses.Numbers|26|42: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuham. These are the families of Dan after their families.
verses.Numbers|26|43: All the families of the Shuham, according to those that were numbered of them, were sixty four thousand, four hundred.
verses.Numbers|26|44: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna the family of the Jimna: of Jishbi, the family of the Jishbi: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
verses.Numbers|26|45: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heber: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchiel.
verses.Numbers|26|46: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
verses.Numbers|26|47: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty three thousand, four hundred.
verses.Numbers|26|48: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeel: of Guni, the family of the Guni:
verses.Numbers|26|49: of Jezer, the family of the Jezer: of Shillem, the family of the Shillem.
verses.Numbers|26|50: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty five thousand, four hundred.
verses.Numbers|26|51: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred and one thousand, seven hundred and thirty.
verses.Numbers|26|52: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|26|53: To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
verses.Numbers|26|54: To the more numerous thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to the fewer thou shalt give the less inheritance: to everyone shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.
verses.Numbers|26|55: Nevertheless the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
verses.Numbers|26|56: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between many and few.
verses.Numbers|26|57: And these are they that were numbered of the Levi after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershon: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merari.
verses.Numbers|26|58: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libni, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahli, the family of the Mushi, the family of the Korhites. And Kohath begot Amram.
verses.Numbers|26|59: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, daughter of Levi, whom her mother bore to Levi in Egypt: and she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
verses.Numbers|26|60: And to Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.Numbers|26|61: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the Lord.
verses.Numbers|26|62: And those that were numbered of them were twenty three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|26|63: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.Numbers|26|64: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.Numbers|26|65: For the Lord had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.Numbers|27|1: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah and Tirzah.
verses.Numbers|27|2: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,
verses.Numbers|27|3: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the Lord in the company of Korah; but he died in his own sin, and had no sons.
verses.Numbers|27|4: Why should the name of our father be done away from his family, because he has no son? Give to us a possession among the brethren of our father.
verses.Numbers|27|5: And Moses brought their cause before the Lord.
verses.Numbers|27|6: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|27|7: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.
verses.Numbers|27|8: And thou shalt speak to the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.
verses.Numbers|27|9: And if he have no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
verses.Numbers|27|10: And if he have no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father's brothers.
verses.Numbers|27|11: And if his father have no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be to the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.Numbers|27|12: And the Lord said to Moses, Go up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|27|13: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered to thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
verses.Numbers|27|14: For you rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah-Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
verses.Numbers|27|15: And Moses spoke to the Lord, saying,
verses.Numbers|27|16: Let the Lord, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
verses.Numbers|27|17: who may go out before them, and who may go in before them, and who may lead them out, and may bring them in; that the congregation of the Lord be not as sheep that have no shepherd.
verses.Numbers|27|18: And the Lord said to Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is spirit, and lay thy hand upon him;
verses.Numbers|27|19: and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
verses.Numbers|27|20: And thou shalt put some of thy honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
verses.Numbers|27|21: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of the Urim before the Lord: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
verses.Numbers|27|22: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
verses.Numbers|27|23: and he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.Numbers|28|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|28|2: Command the children of Israel, and say to them, My offering, the provision of my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour to me, shall you observe to offer to me in their due season.
verses.Numbers|28|3: And thou shalt say to them, This is the fire offering which you shall offer to the Lord; two lambs of the first year without blemish day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
verses.Numbers|28|4: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at evening;
verses.Numbers|28|5: and a tenth part of an efa of flour for a meal offering, mingled with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.
verses.Numbers|28|6: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire to the Lord.
verses.Numbers|28|7: And its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong drink to be poured to the Lord for a drink offering.
verses.Numbers|28|8: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at evening: like the meal offering of the morning, and like its drink offering, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour to the Lord.
verses.Numbers|28|9: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without blemish, and two tenth measures of flour for a meal offering, mingled with oil, and its drink offering:
verses.Numbers|28|10: this is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.
verses.Numbers|28|11: And in the beginnings of your months you shall offer a burnt offering to the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.Numbers|28|12: and three tenth measures of flour for a meal offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth measures of flour for a meal offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
verses.Numbers|28|13: and a tenth measure of flour mingled with oil for a meal offering for every lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire to the Lord.
verses.Numbers|28|14: And their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bullock, and the third part of a hin for a ram, and a fourth part of a hin for a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
verses.Numbers|28|15: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering to the Lord shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.
verses.Numbers|28|16: And on the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the Lord.
verses.Numbers|28|17: And on the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
verses.Numbers|28|18: On the first day shall be a holy gathering; you shall do no manner of servile work on it.
verses.Numbers|28|19: And you shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering to the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be to you without blemish:
verses.Numbers|28|20: and their meal offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth measures shall you offer for a bullock, and two tenth measures for a ram;
verses.Numbers|28|21: a tenth measure shalt thou offer for every lamb, for the seven lambs:
verses.Numbers|28|22: and one goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
verses.Numbers|28|23: You shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
verses.Numbers|28|24: After this manner you shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the provision of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour to the Lord: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.
verses.Numbers|28|25: And on the seventh day you shall have a holy gathering; you shall do no servile work.
verses.Numbers|28|26: Also on the day of the firstfruits, when you bring a new meal offering to the Lord, in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy gathering; you shall do no servile work.
verses.Numbers|28|27: And you shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour to the Lord; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;
verses.Numbers|28|28: and their meal offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth measures for one bullock, two tenth measures for one ram,
