verses.Numbers|28|29: a tenth measure for one lamb, for the seven lambs;
verses.Numbers|28|30: and one kid of the goats, to make atonement for you.
verses.Numbers|28|31: You shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, (they shall be to you without blemish) and their drink offerings.
verses.Numbers|29|1: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy gathering; you shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the horn to you.
verses.Numbers|29|2: And you shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour to the Lord: one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.Numbers|29|3: and their meal offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth measures for a bullock, and two tenth measures for a ram,
verses.Numbers|29|4: and one tenth measure for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.Numbers|29|5: and one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make atonement for you:
verses.Numbers|29|6: besides the burnt offering of the month, and its meal offering, and the daily burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire to the Lord.
verses.Numbers|29|7: And you shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month a holy gathering; and you shall afflict your souls: you shall not do any work:
verses.Numbers|29|8: and you shall offer a burnt offering to the Lord for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be to you without blemish:
verses.Numbers|29|9: and their meal offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth measures to a bullock, and two tenth measures to one ram,
verses.Numbers|29|10: a tenth measure for every lamb, for all the seven lambs:
verses.Numbers|29|11: one kid of the goats for a sin offering; besides the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, and their drink offerings.
verses.Numbers|29|12: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy gathering; you shall do no servile work, and you shall keep a feast to the Lord seven days:
verses.Numbers|29|13: and you shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour to the Lord; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year: they shall be without blemish:
verses.Numbers|29|14: and their meal offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth measures to every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth measures to each ram of the two rams,
verses.Numbers|29|15: and a tenth measure to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:
verses.Numbers|29|16: and one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.Numbers|29|17: And on the second day you shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.Numbers|29|18: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:
verses.Numbers|29|19: and one kid of the goats for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.Numbers|29|20: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.Numbers|29|21: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:
verses.Numbers|29|22: and one goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.Numbers|29|23: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.Numbers|29|24: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:
verses.Numbers|29|25: and one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.Numbers|29|26: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.Numbers|29|27: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:
verses.Numbers|29|28: and one goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.Numbers|29|29: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.Numbers|29|30: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:
verses.Numbers|29|31: and one goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offerings.
verses.Numbers|29|32: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.Numbers|29|33: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after their ordinance:
verses.Numbers|29|34: and one goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.Numbers|29|35: On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly: you shall do no servile work:
verses.Numbers|29|36: but you shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour to the Lord: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.Numbers|29|37: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:
verses.Numbers|29|38: and one goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.Numbers|29|39: These things you shall do to the Lord in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meal offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.
verses.Numbers|30|1: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.Numbers|30|2: And Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord has commanded.
verses.Numbers|30|3: If a man vow a vow to the Lord, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
verses.Numbers|30|4: If a woman also vow a vow to the Lord, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father's house in her youth;
verses.Numbers|30|5: and her father hear her vow, and her bond with which she has bound herself, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she has bound herself shall stand.
verses.Numbers|30|6: But if her father disallow her in the day that he hears; not any of her vows, or of her bonds with which she has bound herself, shall stand: and the Lord shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
verses.Numbers|30|7: And if she be married to a husband, when she vowed, or uttered aught out of her lips, with which she bound herself;
verses.Numbers|30|8: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds with which she bound herself shall stand.
verses.Numbers|30|9: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, with which she bound her soul, of no effect: and the Lord shall forgive her.
verses.Numbers|30|10: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, with which they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.
verses.Numbers|30|11: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound herself by a bond with an oath;
verses.Numbers|30|12: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.Numbers|30|13: But if her husband made them void on the day he heard them; then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of the soul, shall not stand: her husband has made them void; and the Lord shall forgive her.
verses.Numbers|30|14: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may let it stand, or her husband may make it void.
verses.Numbers|30|15: But if her husband hold his peace at her from day to day; then he confirms all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirms them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
verses.Numbers|30|16: But if he should annul them after he has heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.
verses.Numbers|30|17: These are the statutes, which the Lord commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father's house.
verses.Numbers|31|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses saying,
verses.Numbers|31|2: Execute the vengeance of the children of Israel on the Midianites: afterwards thou shalt be gathered to thy people.
verses.Numbers|31|3: And Moses spoke to the people, saying, Arm from yourselves men for the army, and let them go against Midian and avenge the Lord on Midian.
verses.Numbers|31|4: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall you send to the war.
verses.Numbers|31|5: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.Numbers|31|6: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
verses.Numbers|31|7: And they warred against Midian, as the Lord commanded Moses, and they slew all the males.
verses.Numbers|31|8: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Evi, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
verses.Numbers|31|9: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
verses.Numbers|31|10: And they burnt all the cities in which they dwelt, and all their encampments, with fire.
verses.Numbers|31|11: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
verses.Numbers|31|12: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, to Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.Numbers|31|13: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside the camp.
verses.Numbers|31|14: And Moses was angry with the officers of the host, the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, who came from the battle.
verses.Numbers|31|15: And Moses said to them, Have you saved all the women alive?
verses.Numbers|31|16: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to revolt against the Lord in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the Lord.
verses.Numbers|31|17: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that has known man by lying with him.
verses.Numbers|31|18: But all the women children, that have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.Numbers|31|19: And abide outside the camp seven days: whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
verses.Numbers|31|20: And purify every garment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood.
verses.Numbers|31|21: And Eleazar the priest said to the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord commanded Moses;
verses.Numbers|31|22: only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.Numbers|31|23: every thing that passes through the fire, you shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of sprinkling: and all that does not pass through the fire shall you make to go through water.
verses.Numbers|31|24: And you shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean, and afterwards you shall come into the camp.
verses.Numbers|31|25: And the Lord spoke to Moses saying,
verses.Numbers|31|26: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
verses.Numbers|31|27: and divide the prey into two parts; between those who took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
verses.Numbers|31|28: and levy a tribute to the Lord of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beef cattle, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
verses.Numbers|31|29: from their half shall you take it, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for an offering set apart to the Lord.
verses.Numbers|31|30: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beef cattle, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them to the Levites, who keep the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord.
verses.Numbers|31|31: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.Numbers|31|32: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred and seventy five thousand sheep.
verses.Numbers|31|33: And seventy two thousand head of beef,
verses.Numbers|31|35: and thirty two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
verses.Numbers|31|36: And the half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred and thirty seven thousand, five hundred sheep:
verses.Numbers|31|37: and the Lord's tribute of the sheep was six hundred and seventy five.
verses.Numbers|31|38: And the beef cattle were thirty six thousand; of which the Lord's tribute was seventy two.
verses.Numbers|31|39: And the asses were thirty thousand, five hundred; of which the Lord's tribute was sixty one.
verses.Numbers|31|40: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the Lord's tribute was thirty two persons.
verses.Numbers|31|41: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the Lord's gift, to Eleazar the priest, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.Numbers|31|42: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
verses.Numbers|31|43: (now the half that pertained to the congregation was three hundred and thirty seven thousand, five hundred sheep,
verses.Numbers|31|44: and thirty six thousand head of beef,
verses.Numbers|31|45: and thirty thousand five hundred asses,
verses.Numbers|31|47: and of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them to the Levites, who kept the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.Numbers|31|48: And the officers who were over the thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near to Moses:
verses.Numbers|31|49: and they said to Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our charge, and not one man of us is missing.
verses.Numbers|31|50: We have therefore brought an offering for the Lord, what every man has gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and girdles, to make atonement for our souls before the Lord.
verses.Numbers|31|51: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, all wrought jewels.
verses.Numbers|31|52: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the Lord, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
verses.Numbers|31|53: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
verses.Numbers|31|54: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it to the Tent of Meeting, a memorial for the children of Israel before the Lord.
verses.Numbers|32|1: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
verses.Numbers|32|2: the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,
verses.Numbers|32|3: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
verses.Numbers|32|4: the country which the Lord smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
verses.Numbers|32|5: and they said, If we have found favour in thy sight, let this land be given to thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over the Jordan.
verses.Numbers|32|6: And Moses said to the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall you sit here?
verses.Numbers|32|7: And why do you dishearten the children of Israel from going over into the land which the Lord has given them?
verses.Numbers|32|8: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.
verses.Numbers|32|9: For when they went up to the wadi of Eshcol, and saw the land, they disheartened the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the Lord had given them.
verses.Numbers|32|10: And the Lord's anger burned at that time, and he swore, saying,
verses.Numbers|32|11: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
verses.Numbers|32|12: save Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the Lord.
verses.Numbers|32|13: And the Lord's anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness for forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the Lord, was consumed.
verses.Numbers|32|14: And, behold, you are risen up in place of your fathers, a brood of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the Lord towards Israel.
verses.Numbers|32|15: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all this people.
verses.Numbers|32|16: And they came near to him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
verses.Numbers|32|17: but we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.Numbers|32|18: We will not return to our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
verses.Numbers|32|19: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side of the Jordan, and farther off; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.
verses.Numbers|32|20: And Moses said to them, If you will do this thing, if you will go armed before the Lord to war,
verses.Numbers|32|21: and will go all of you armed over the Jordan before the Lord, until he has driven out his enemies before him,
verses.Numbers|32|22: and the land be subdued before the Lord: then afterwards you shall return, and be guiltless before the Lord, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the Lord.
verses.Numbers|32|23: But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against the Lord: and be sure your sin will find you out.
verses.Numbers|32|24: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.
verses.Numbers|32|25: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commands.
verses.Numbers|32|26: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
verses.Numbers|32|27: but thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the Lord to battle, as my lord says.
verses.Numbers|32|28: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:
verses.Numbers|32|29: and Moses said to them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the Lord, and the land shall be subdued before you; then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
verses.Numbers|32|30: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
verses.Numbers|32|31: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, as the Lord has said to thy servants, so will we do.
verses.Numbers|32|32: We will pass over armed before the Lord into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance may be ours on this side of the Jordan.
verses.Numbers|32|33: And Moses gave to them, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorite, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with its cities in the borders, the cities of the country round about.
verses.Numbers|32|34: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
verses.Numbers|32|35: and Atroth, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
verses.Numbers|32|36: and Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fortified cities: and folds for sheep.
verses.Numbers|32|37: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
verses.Numbers|32|38: and Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Sibmah: and gave other names to the cities which they built.
verses.Numbers|32|39: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite who were in it.
verses.Numbers|32|40: And Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt in it.
verses.Numbers|32|41: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took their villages, and called them Havoth-jair.
verses.Numbers|32|42: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and its hamlets, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
verses.Numbers|33|1: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, who went out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.Numbers|33|2: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the Lord: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
verses.Numbers|33|3: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all Egypt.
verses.Numbers|33|4: And Egypt was burying all their firstborn, whom the Lord had smitten among them: upon their gods also the Lord executed judgments.
verses.Numbers|33|5: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
verses.Numbers|33|6: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etam, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.Numbers|33|7: And they removed from Etam, and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, which is before Baal-zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
verses.Numbers|33|8: And they departed from before Pi-hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etam and pitched in Marah.
verses.Numbers|33|9: And they removed from Marah, and came to Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and seventy palm trees; and they pitched there.
verses.Numbers|33|10: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
verses.Numbers|33|11: And they removed from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.Numbers|33|12: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
verses.Numbers|33|13: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
verses.Numbers|33|14: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.Numbers|33|15: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.Numbers|33|16: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.
verses.Numbers|33|17: And they departed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
verses.Numbers|33|18: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
verses.Numbers|33|19: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon-parez.
verses.Numbers|33|20: And they departed from Rimmon-parez, and pitched in Libnah.
verses.Numbers|33|21: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
verses.Numbers|33|22: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
verses.Numbers|33|23: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
verses.Numbers|33|24: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
verses.Numbers|33|25: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
verses.Numbers|33|26: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
verses.Numbers|33|27: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Terah.
verses.Numbers|33|28: And they removed from Terah, and pitched in Mithcah.
verses.Numbers|33|29: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
verses.Numbers|33|30: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
verses.Numbers|33|31: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene-jaakan.
verses.Numbers|33|32: And they removed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.
verses.Numbers|33|33: And they went from Hor-hagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
verses.Numbers|33|34: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
verses.Numbers|33|35: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion-geber.
verses.Numbers|33|36: And they removed from Ezion-geber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
verses.Numbers|33|37: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.Numbers|33|38: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the Lord, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.
verses.Numbers|33|39: And Aaron was a hundred and twenty three years old when he died in mount Hor.
verses.Numbers|33|40: And the Canaanite king of Arad, who dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|33|41: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
verses.Numbers|33|42: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
verses.Numbers|33|43: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.Numbers|33|44: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.
verses.Numbers|33|45: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibon-gad.
verses.Numbers|33|46: And they removed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.
verses.Numbers|33|47: And they removed from Almon-diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.Numbers|33|48: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.Numbers|33|49: And they pitched by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth to Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.
verses.Numbers|33|50: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.Numbers|33|51: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.Numbers|33|52: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their figured pavements, and destroy all their molten images, and devastate all their high places:
verses.Numbers|33|53: and you shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell in it: for I have given you the land to possess it.
verses.Numbers|33|54: And you shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance: every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falls; according to the tribes of your fathers you shall inherit.
verses.Numbers|33|55: But if you will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those whom you allow to remain of them shall be as thorns in your eyes, and stings in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein you dwell.
verses.Numbers|33|56: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do to you, as I thought to do to them.
verses.Numbers|34|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|34|2: Command the children of Israel, and say to them, When you come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, the land of Canaan with its borders:)
verses.Numbers|34|3: then the south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the border of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the Salt Sea eastward:
verses.Numbers|34|4: and your border shall turn from the south to Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and its limits shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon:
verses.Numbers|34|5: and the border shall turn about, from Azmon to the wadi of Egypt, and its limits shall be at the Sea.
verses.Numbers|34|6: And as for the western border, you shall have the Great Sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
verses.Numbers|34|7: And this shall be your north border: from the Great Sea you shall mark out your frontier at mount Hor:
verses.Numbers|34|8: from mount Hor you shall mark out your border to the entrance of Hamath; and the limits of the border shall be to Zedad:
verses.Numbers|34|9: and the border shall go on to Ziphron, and its limits shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.
verses.Numbers|34|10: And you shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:
verses.Numbers|34|11: and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border descend, and shall reach the eastward projection of the Sea of Chinnereth:
verses.Numbers|34|12: and the border shall go down to the Jordan, and its limits shall be at the Salt Sea: this shall be your land with its borders round about.
verses.Numbers|34|13: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the Lord commanded to give to the nine tribes, and the half tribe:
verses.Numbers|34|14: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
verses.Numbers|34|15: the two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side of the Jordan near Jericho eastward, towards the sunrising.
verses.Numbers|34|16: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|34|17: These are the names of the men who shall share out the land to you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.Numbers|34|18: And you shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
verses.Numbers|34|19: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.Numbers|34|20: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
verses.Numbers|34|21: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
verses.Numbers|34|22: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
verses.Numbers|34|23: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
verses.Numbers|34|24: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
verses.Numbers|34|25: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
verses.Numbers|34|26: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
verses.Numbers|34|27: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
verses.Numbers|34|28: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
verses.Numbers|34|29: These are they whom the Lord commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
verses.Numbers|35|1: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho saying,
verses.Numbers|35|2: Command the children of Israel, that they give to the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and you shall give also to the Levites an open space for the cities round about them.
verses.Numbers|35|3: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and their open spaces shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
verses.Numbers|35|4: And the open spaces of the cities, that you shall give to the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city outwards a thousand cubits round about.
verses.Numbers|35|5: And you shall measure from outside the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits, and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the open spaces of the cities.
verses.Numbers|35|6: And among the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be six cities of refuge, which you shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee there: and to them you shall add forty two cities.
verses.Numbers|35|7: So all the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty eight cities: both them and their open spaces.
verses.Numbers|35|8: And the cities which you shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many you shall give many: and from them that have few you shall give few: every one shall give of the cities to the Levites according to his inheritance which he inherits.
verses.Numbers|35|9: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.Numbers|35|10: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When you come over the Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.Numbers|35|11: then you shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer who kills any person unawares may flee thither.
verses.Numbers|35|12: And they shall be to you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
verses.Numbers|35|13: And the cities which you shall give shall be six cities for refuge.
verses.Numbers|35|14: You shall give three cities on this side of the Jordan, and three cities shall you give in the land of Canaan; cities of refuge shall they be.
verses.Numbers|35|15: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that everyone that kills any person unawares may flee there.
verses.Numbers|35|16: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.Numbers|35|17: And if he smite him by hand with a stone, whereby he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.Numbers|35|18: Or if he smite him with a hand weapon of wood, whereby he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.Numbers|35|19: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meets him, he shall slay him.
verses.Numbers|35|20: And if he thrust him out of hatred, or hurl something at him whilst lying in wait, that he die;
verses.Numbers|35|21: or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he encounters him.
verses.Numbers|35|22: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or cast upon him anything without lying in wait,
verses.Numbers|35|23: or with any stone, whereby a man may die, but without seeing him, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, nor sought his harm:
verses.Numbers|35|24: then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
verses.Numbers|35|25: and the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.Numbers|35|26: But if the slayer shall at any time come outside the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
verses.Numbers|35|27: and the revenger of blood find him outside the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
verses.Numbers|35|28: because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return to the land of his possession.
verses.Numbers|35|29: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.Numbers|35|30: Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.
verses.Numbers|35|31: Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer, who is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
verses.Numbers|35|32: And you shall take no ransom for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come back to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
verses.Numbers|35|33: So you shall not pollute the land in which you are: for blood pollutes the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
verses.Numbers|35|34: And thou shalt not defile the land which you shall inhabit, in which I dwell: for I the Lord dwell among the children of Israel.
verses.Numbers|36|1: And the chief fathers of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spoke before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:
verses.Numbers|36|2: and they said, The Lord commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the Lord to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.
verses.Numbers|36|3: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they are joined: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
verses.Numbers|36|4: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be added to the inheritance of the tribe unto which they are joined: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
verses.Numbers|36|5: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the Lord, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph has said well.
verses.Numbers|36|6: This is the thing which the Lord commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry whom they think best; only within the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
verses.Numbers|36|7: So the inheritance of the children of Israel shall not remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall cleave to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
verses.Numbers|36|8: And every daughter, who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
verses.Numbers|36|9: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
verses.Numbers|36|10: Even as the Lord commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
verses.Numbers|36|11: for Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their uncles' sons:
verses.Numbers|36|12: and they were married to the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
verses.Numbers|36|13: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|1: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel on the other side of the Jordan, in the wilderness over against Suf, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|2: It is eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir to Kadesh-barnea.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|3: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spoke to the children of Israel, according to all that the Lord had given him in commandment to them;
verses.Deuteronomy|1|4: after he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorite, who dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, who dwelt at Ashtaroth in Edrei:
verses.Deuteronomy|1|5: beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,
verses.Deuteronomy|1|6: The Lord our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, You have dwelt long enough in this mountain:
verses.Deuteronomy|1|7: turn, and take your journey, and go to the mountain of the Amorite, and to all the places near it, in the plain, in the hills, and in the lowland, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanite, and the Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|8: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the Lord swore to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give to them and to their seed after them.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|9: And I spoke to you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
verses.Deuteronomy|1|10: the Lord your God has multiplied you, and, behold, you are this day like the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|11: (The Lord God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as you are, and bless you, as he has promised you!)
verses.Deuteronomy|1|12: How can I myself alone bear your care, and your burden, and your strife?
verses.Deuteronomy|1|13: Take wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|14: And you answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|15: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|16: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|17: Do not respect persons in judgment; but hear the small as well as the great; do not be afraid of the face of any man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it to me, and I will hear it.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|18: And I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|19: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which you saw; by the way of the mountain of the Amorite, as the Lord our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|20: And I said to you, You are come to the mountain of the Amorite, which the Lord our God gives to us.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|21: Behold, the Lord thy God has set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the Lord God of thy fathers has said to thee; fear not, nor be discouraged.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|22: And you came near to me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us back word by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|23: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one for a tribe:
verses.Deuteronomy|1|24: and they turned and went up to the mountain, and came to the wadi of Eshcol, and searched it out.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|25: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down to us, and brought us back word, and said, It is a good land which the Lord our God gives us.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|26: Yet you would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the Lord your God:
verses.Deuteronomy|1|27: and you murmured in your tents, and said, Because the Lord hated us, he has brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorite, to destroy us.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|28: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have made our heart faint, saying, The people are greater and taller than we; the cities are great and fortified up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|29: Then I said to you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|30: The Lord your God who goes before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
verses.Deuteronomy|1|31: and in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the Lord thy God bore thee, as a man bears his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|32: Yet in this thing you did not believe the Lord your God,
verses.Deuteronomy|1|33: who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in a cloud by day.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|34: And the Lord heard the voice of your words, and was angry, and swore, saying,
verses.Deuteronomy|1|35: Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see that good land, which I swore to give to your fathers,
verses.Deuteronomy|1|36: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he has trodden upon, and to his children, because he has wholly followed the Lord.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|37: Also the Lord was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in there.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|38: But Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before thee, he shall go in there: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|39: And your little ones, concerning whom you said they should be a prey, and your children who in that day had no knowledge of good and evil, they shall go in there, and to them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|40: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|41: Then you answered and said to me, We have sinned against the Lord, we will go up and fight, according to all that the Lord our God commanded us. And you girded on every man his weapons of war, and ventured to go up into the hill.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|42: And the Lord said to me, Say to them, Neither go up, nor fight; for I am not among you; lest you be smitten before your enemies.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|43: So I spoke to you; and you would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the Lord, and went presumptuously up into the hill.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|44: And the Amorite, who dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, as far as Hormah.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|45: And you returned and wept before the Lord; but the Lord would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear to you.
verses.Deuteronomy|1|46: So you abode in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you abode there.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|1: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea, as the Lord spoke to me: and we went about mount Seir many days.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|2: And the Lord spoke to me, saying,
verses.Deuteronomy|2|3: You have compassed this mountain long enough: turn northwards.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|4: And command the people, saying, You are to pass through the border of your brethren the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take good heed to yourselves therefore:
verses.Deuteronomy|2|5: meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir to Esau for a possession.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|6: You shall buy food of them for money, that you may eat; and you shall also buy water of them for money, that you may drink.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|7: For the Lord thy God has blessed thee in all the work of thy hand: he knows thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the Lord thy God has been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|8: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, who dwelt in Seir, through the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion-geber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|9: And the Lord said to me, Do not harass Moab, nor contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|10: (The Emims dwelt there in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, like the Anakims;
verses.Deuteronomy|2|11: who also were considered Rephaim as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|12: The Horites also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, and they destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their place; as Israel did to the land of his possession, which the Lord gave to them.)
verses.Deuteronomy|2|13: Now rise up, and get you over the wadi Zered. And we went over the wadi Zered.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|14: And the days in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the wadi Zered, were thirty eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the Lord swore to them.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|15: For indeed the hand of the Lord was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|16: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
verses.Deuteronomy|2|17: that the Lord spoke to me, saying,
verses.Deuteronomy|2|18: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the border of Moab, this day:
verses.Deuteronomy|2|19: and when thou comest near, opposite the children of Ammon, harass them not, nor contend with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|20: (That also was considered a land of Rephaim: Rephaim dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonim call them Zamzummims.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|21: A people great, and many, and tall, like the Anakims; but the Lord destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their place:
verses.Deuteronomy|2|22: as he did to the children of Esau, who dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead until this very day:
verses.Deuteronomy|2|23: and the Avim who dwelt in Hazerim, as far as Azzah; Caphtorim who came from Caphtor, destroyed them and dwelt in their stead.)
verses.Deuteronomy|2|24: Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the wadi Arnon: behold, I have given into thy hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|25: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and quake because of thee.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|26: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
verses.Deuteronomy|2|27: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn to the right hand nor to the left.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|28: Thou shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through with those who follow me;
verses.Deuteronomy|2|29: (as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me;) until I shall pass over the Jordan into the land which the Lord our God gives us.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|30: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the Lord thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as is apparent this day.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|31: And the Lord said to me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayst inherit his land.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|32: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|33: And the Lord our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
verses.Deuteronomy|2|34: And we took all his cities at that time, and devoted to destruction every city, the men, and the women, and the little ones; we left none remaining:
verses.Deuteronomy|2|35: only the cattle we took for a prey to ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took;
verses.Deuteronomy|2|36: From Aroer, which is by the edge of the wadi of Arnon, and from the city that is by the wadi, as far as Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the Lord our God delivered all to us:
verses.Deuteronomy|2|37: only to the land of the children of Ammon thou didst not come, nor to any place of the torrent of Jabbok, nor to the cities in the mountains, nor to whatever place the Lord our God forbad us.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|1: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|2: And the Lord said to me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst to Sihon king of the Amorite, who dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|3: So the Lord our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|4: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|5: All these cities were fortified with high walls, gates, and bars; besides unwalled towns a great many.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|6: And we devoted them to destruction, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|7: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|8: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorite the land that was on this side of the Jordan, from the wadi of Arnon to mount Hermon;
verses.Deuteronomy|3|9: (which Hermon the Zidonians call Sirion; and the Amorite call it Senir;)
verses.Deuteronomy|3|10: all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, as far as Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|11: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim; behold, his bed is a bed of iron; is it not in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? nine cubits is the length of it, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|12: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the wadi Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|13: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of Rephaim.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|14: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob as far as the border of the Geshuri and the Maachathites; and called them (that is the Bashan) after his name, Havoth-jair, to this day.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|15: And I gave Gilead to Machir.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|16: And to the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead to the wadi Arnon, the middle of the wadi as a border, as far as the torrent of Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.Deuteronomy|3|17: the Arabah also and the Jordan, as a border, from Chinnereth as far as the Sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|18: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The Lord your God has given you this land to possess it: pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are fit for the war.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|19: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that you have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
verses.Deuteronomy|3|20: until the Lord gives rest to your brethren, as well as to you, and until they also possess the land which the Lord our God has given them beyond the Jordan: and then shall you return every man to his possession, which I have given you.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|21: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thy eyes have seen all that the Lord your God has done to these two kings; so shall the Lord do to all the kingdoms into which thou dost pass.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|22: You shall not fear them: for the Lord your God he shall fight for you.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|23: And I besought the Lord at that time, saying,
verses.Deuteronomy|3|24: O Lord God, thou hast begun to show thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what god is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?
verses.Deuteronomy|3|25: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that goodly mountain region and the Lebanon.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|26: But the Lord was angry with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the Lord said to me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more to me of this matter.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|27: Go up to the top of the Pisgah, and lift up thy eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold with thy eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|28: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.
verses.Deuteronomy|3|29: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|1: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, to the statutes and to the judgments, which I teach you, to do them, that you may live, and go in and possess the land which the Lord God of your fathers gives you.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|2: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you diminish from it, that you may keep the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|3: Your eyes have seen what the Lord did because of Baal-peor: for all the men that followed Baal-peor, the Lord thy God destroyed them from among you.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|4: But you that did cleave of the Lord your God are alive every one of you this day.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|5: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the Lord my God commanded me, that you should act accordingly in the land whither you go to possess it.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|6: Keep them therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, who shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|7: For what nation is there so great, that has God so near to them, as the Lord our God is in all things that we call upon him for?
verses.Deuteronomy|4|8: And what nation is there so great, that has statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
verses.Deuteronomy|4|9: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thy eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons—
verses.Deuteronomy|4|10: the day that thou stoodest before the Lord thy God in Horeb, when the Lord said to me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|11: And you came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire to the heart of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|12: And the Lord spoke to you out of the midst of the fire: you heard the voice of the words, but saw no form; only a voice.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|13: And he declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, the ten Words; and he wrote them upon two tablets of stone.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|14: And the Lord commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that you might do them in the land into which you go over to possess it.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|15: Take therefore good heed to yourselves; for you saw no manner of form on the day that the Lord spoke to you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
verses.Deuteronomy|4|16: lest you become corrupt, and make a carved idol, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
verses.Deuteronomy|4|17: the likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the air,
verses.Deuteronomy|4|18: the likeness of any thing that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.Deuteronomy|4|19: and lest thou lift up thy eyes to heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, all the host of heaven, thou shouldst be misled to worship them, and serve them, which the Lord thy God has allotted to all the nations under the whole heaven.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|20: But the Lord has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as you are this day.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|21: But the Lord was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land, which the Lord thy God gives thee for an inheritance:
verses.Deuteronomy|4|22: but I must die in this land, I must not go over the Jordan: but you shall go over, and possess that good land.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|23: Take heed to yourselves, lest you forget the covenant of the Lord your God, which he made with you, and make you a carved idol, or the likeness of anything, which the Lord thy God has forbidden thee.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|24: For the Lord thy God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|25: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and you shall have remained long in the land, and shall deal corruptly, and make a carved idol, the likeness of anything, and shall do evil in the sight of the Lord thy God, to provoke him to anger:
verses.Deuteronomy|4|26: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that you shall soon utterly perish from off the land into which you go over the Jordan to possess it; you shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|27: And the Lord shall scatter you among the nations, and you shall be left few in number among the nations, where the Lord shall lead you.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|28: And there you shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|29: But if from there thou shalt seek the Lord thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|30: When thou art in distress, and all these things are come upon thee, in the latter days, if thou turn to the Lord thy God, and art obedient to his voice;
verses.Deuteronomy|4|31: (for the Lord thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, nor will he destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he swore to them.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|32: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and from the one side of heaven to the other, whether there has been any such thing as this great thing is, or whether aught has been heard like it?
verses.Deuteronomy|4|33: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
verses.Deuteronomy|4|34: Or has God ventured to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by trials, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the Lord your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.Deuteronomy|4|35: To thee it was shown, that thou mightest know that the Lord he is God; there is none else beside him.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|36: Out of heaven he made thee hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he showed thee his great fire; and thou didst hear his words out of the midst of the fire.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|37: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore, he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out, he himself being present, with his mighty power out of Egypt;
verses.Deuteronomy|4|38: to drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|39: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thy heart, that the Lord he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is no other.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|40: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayst prolong thy days upon the earth, which the Lord thy God gives thee, for ever.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|41: Then Moses set apart three cities on this side of the Jordan toward the sun rising;
verses.Deuteronomy|4|42: that the slayer might flee there, who should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
verses.Deuteronomy|4|43: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth of Gilead, for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|44: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:
verses.Deuteronomy|4|45: these are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spoke to the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt.
verses.Deuteronomy|4|46: Beyond the Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorite, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:
verses.Deuteronomy|4|47: and they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorite, which were beyond the Jordan toward the sun rising;
verses.Deuteronomy|4|48: from Aroer, which is by the bank of the wadi of Arnon, to mount Sion, which is Hermon,
verses.Deuteronomy|4|49: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the Sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of the Pisgah.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|1: And Moses called all Israel, and said to them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that you may learn them, and keep, and do them.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|2: The Lord our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|3: The Lord made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|4: The Lord talked with you face to face in the mountain out of the midst of the fire,
verses.Deuteronomy|5|5: (I stood between the Lord and you at that time, to show you the word of the Lord: for you were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up to the mountain;) saying,
verses.Deuteronomy|5|6: I am the Lord thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|7: Thou shalt have no other gods beside me.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|8: Thou shalt not make for thyself any carved idol, or any likeness of anything that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.Deuteronomy|5|9: thou shalt not bow down to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, punishing the iniquity of the fathers upon the children to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,
verses.Deuteronomy|5|10: and showing mercy to the thousandth generation of those who love me and keep my commandments.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|11: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain: for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that takes his name in vain.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|12: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the Lord thy God has commanded thee.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|13: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:
verses.Deuteronomy|5|14: but the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: on it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy ox, nor thy ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|15: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the Lord thy God brought thee out from there with a mighty hand and a stretched out arm: therefore the Lord thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|16: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the Lord thy God has commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the Lord thy God gives thee.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|17: Thou shalt not murder. Neither shalt thou commit adultery. Neither shalt thou steal. Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|18: Neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or anything that is thy neighbour's.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|19: These words the Lord spoke to all your assembly in the mountain out of the midst of the fire, the cloud, and the thick darkness, with a great voice which was not heard again. And he wrote them on two tablets of stone, and delivered them to me.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|20: And it came to pass, when you heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that you came near to me, all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
verses.Deuteronomy|5|21: and you said, Behold, the Lord our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God does talk with man, and he lives.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|22: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the Lord our God any more, then we shall die.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|23: For who is there of all flesh, that has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
verses.Deuteronomy|5|24: Go thou near, and hear all that the Lord our God shall say: and speak to us all that the Lord our God shall speak to thee; and we will hear it, and do it.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|25: And the Lord heard the voice of your words, when you spoke to me; and the Lord said to me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken to thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|26: O that there were such a heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
verses.Deuteronomy|5|27: Go say to them, Return again to your tents.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|28: But as for thee, stand here by me, and I will speak to thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I gave them to possess it.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|29: You shall observe to do therefore as the Lord your God has commanded you: you shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.Deuteronomy|5|30: You shall walk in all the ways which the Lord your God has commanded you, that you may live, and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.
verses.Deuteronomy|6|1: Now this is the commandment, the statutes, and the judgments, which the Lord your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land into which you go to possess it:
verses.Deuteronomy|6|2: that thou mightest fear the Lord thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.
verses.Deuteronomy|6|3: Hear therefore, O Israel, and take care to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that you may increase mightily, as the Lord God of thy fathers has promised thee, in the land that flows with milk and honey.
verses.Deuteronomy|6|4: Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God; the Lord is one.
verses.Deuteronomy|6|5: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
verses.Deuteronomy|6|6: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thy heart:
verses.Deuteronomy|6|7: and thou shalt teach them diligently to thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verses.Deuteronomy|6|8: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thy arm, and they shall be as frontlets between thy eyes.
verses.Deuteronomy|6|9: And thou shalt write them upon the doorposts of thy house, and on thy gates.
verses.Deuteronomy|6|10: And it shall be, when the Lord thy God shall bring thee to the land of which he swore to thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou didst not build,
verses.Deuteronomy|6|11: and houses full of all good things, which thou didst not fill, and hewn out wells, which thou didst not dig, vineyards and olive trees, which thou didst not plant; when thou shalt eat and be replete;
verses.Deuteronomy|6|12: beware lest thou forget the Lord, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.Deuteronomy|6|13: Thou shalt fear the Lord thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.
verses.Deuteronomy|6|14: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people who are round about you;
verses.Deuteronomy|6|15: (for the Lord thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the Lord thy God be inflamed against thee, and he destroy thee from off the face of the earth.
verses.Deuteronomy|6|16: Do not tempt the Lord your God, as you tempted him in Massah.
verses.Deuteronomy|6|17: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the Lord your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded thee.
verses.Deuteronomy|6|18: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the Lord: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayst go in and possess the good land which the Lord swore to thy fathers,
verses.Deuteronomy|6|19: to cast out all thy enemies from before thee, as the Lord has spoken.
verses.Deuteronomy|6|20: When thy son asks thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the Lord our God has commanded you?
verses.Deuteronomy|6|21: Then thou shalt say to thy son, We were the bondmen of Pharaoh in Egypt; and the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:
verses.Deuteronomy|6|22: and the Lord showed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:
verses.Deuteronomy|6|23: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.
verses.Deuteronomy|6|24: And the Lord commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the Lord our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.
verses.Deuteronomy|6|25: And it shall be accounted virtue in us, if we take care to do all these commandments before the Lord our God, as he has commanded us.
verses.Deuteronomy|7|1: When the Lord thy God shall bring thee to the land into which thou goest to possess it, and shall cast out many nations before thee, the Hittite, and the Girgashite, and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;
verses.Deuteronomy|7|2: and when the Lord thy God shall deliver them before thee, and thou shalt smite them, then thou shalt devote them to utter destruction; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them:
verses.Deuteronomy|7|3: neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give to his son, nor shalt thou take his daughter to thy son.
verses.Deuteronomy|7|4: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the Lord be inflamed against you, and he will destroy thee speedily.
verses.Deuteronomy|7|5: But thus shall you deal with them: you shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their asherim, and burn their carved idols with fire.
verses.Deuteronomy|7|6: For thou art a holy people to the Lord thy God: the Lord thy God has chosen thee to be a special people to himself, above all peoples that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.Deuteronomy|7|7: The Lord did not set his love upon you, or choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples:
