verses.Joshua|8|3: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.
verses.Joshua|8|4: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, you shall lie in wait against the city, behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be all of you ready:
verses.Joshua|8|5: and I and all the people that are with me, will approach the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,
verses.Joshua|8|6: (for they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.
verses.Joshua|8|7: Then you shall rise up from the ambush, and take possession of the city: for the Lord your God will deliver it into your hand.
verses.Joshua|8|8: And it shall be, when you have taken the city, that you shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of the Lord shall you do. See, I have commanded you.
verses.Joshua|8|9: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.
verses.Joshua|8|10: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.
verses.Joshua|8|11: And all the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew near, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.
verses.Joshua|8|12: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Beth-el and Ai on the west side of the city.
verses.Joshua|8|13: And when they had set the people, even all the encampment that was on the north of the city, and their ambush party on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.
verses.Joshua|8|14: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it, that they hastened and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he knew not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.
verses.Joshua|8|15: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
verses.Joshua|8|16: And all the people that were in Ai were called out to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.
verses.Joshua|8|17: And there was not a man left in Ai or Beth-el, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city unguarded, and pursued after Israel.
verses.Joshua|8|18: And the Lord said to Joshua, Stretch out the javelin that is in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thy hand. And Joshua stretched out the javelin that he had in his hand toward the city.
verses.Joshua|8|19: And the ambush rose quickly out of their place, and they ran when he stretched out his hand: and they entered the city, and took it, and hastily set the city on fire.
verses.Joshua|8|20: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to the sky, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.
verses.Joshua|8|21: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush party had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned and slew the men of Ai.
verses.Joshua|8|22: And the others issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.
verses.Joshua|8|23: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.
verses.Joshua|8|24: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness into which they had pursued them, and when they were all fallen by the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that then all Israel returned to Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.
verses.Joshua|8|25: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both men and women, were twelve thousand, all the men of Ai.
verses.Joshua|8|26: For Joshua did not withdraw his hand, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.
verses.Joshua|8|27: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for plunder to themselves, according to the word of the Lord which he commanded Joshua.
verses.Joshua|8|28: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it a perpetual mound, a desolation to this day.
verses.Joshua|8|29: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until evening: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcass down from the tree, and cast it at the entrance of the gate of the city, and raise over it a great heap of stones, to this day.
verses.Joshua|8|30: Then Joshua built an altar to the Lord God of Israel in mount Ebal,
verses.Joshua|8|31: as Moses the servant of the Lord commanded the children of Israel as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man lifted up any iron instrument: and they offered on it burnt offerings to the Lord, and sacrificed peace offerings.
verses.Joshua|8|32: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.
verses.Joshua|8|33: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord, both stranger, and native born; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded that they should first bless the people of Israel.
verses.Joshua|8|34: And afterwards he read all the words of the law, the blessing and the curse, according to all that is written in the book of the law.
verses.Joshua|8|35: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that went amongst them.
verses.Joshua|9|1: And it came to pass, when all the kings who were on this side of the Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and on all the coast of the great sea over against the Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard of it,
verses.Joshua|9|2: that they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel with one accord.
verses.Joshua|9|3: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,
verses.Joshua|9|4: they acted cunningly, and went and took provisions, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old and rent, and patched up;
verses.Joshua|9|5: and old worn and patched shoes upon their feet, and worn garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and had become crumbs.
verses.Joshua|9|6: And they went to Joshua to the camp at Gilgal, and said to him, and to the men of Israel, We are come from a far country: now therefore make a covenant with us.
verses.Joshua|9|7: And the men of Israel said to the Hivite, Perhaps you dwell among us; and how shall we then make a covenant with you?
verses.Joshua|9|8: And they said to Joshua, We are thy servants. And Joshua said to them, Who are you? and from where do you come?
verses.Joshua|9|9: And they said to him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the Lord thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,
verses.Joshua|9|10: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorite, that were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.
verses.Joshua|9|11: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spoke to us, saying, Take provision with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say to them, We are your servants: therefore now make a covenant with us.
verses.Joshua|9|12: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we went out to go to you; but now, behold, it is dry, and is become crumbs:
verses.Joshua|9|13: and these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they are split: and these our garments and our shoes are worn out by reason of the very long journey.
verses.Joshua|9|14: And the men took of their provisions, and did not ask counsel at the mouth of the Lord.
verses.Joshua|9|15: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a covenant with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation swore to them.
verses.Joshua|9|16: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.
verses.Joshua|9|17: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.
verses.Joshua|9|18: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn to them by the Lord God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.
verses.Joshua|9|19: But all the princes said to all the congregation, We have sworn to them by the Lord God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.
verses.Joshua|9|20: This we will do to them; we will let them live, so that no fierce anger be upon us, because of the oath which we swore to them.
verses.Joshua|9|21: And the princes said to them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water for all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.
verses.Joshua|9|22: And Joshua called for them, and he spoke to them, saying, Wherefore have you deceived us, saying, We are very far from you; when yet you dwell among us?
verses.Joshua|9|23: Now therefore you are cursed, and there shall not cease to be of you bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.
verses.Joshua|9|24: And they answered Joshua and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how the Lord thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were greatly afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
verses.Joshua|9|25: And now, behold, we are in thy hand: do as it seems good and right to thee to do to us.
verses.Joshua|9|26: And so he did to them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew them not.
verses.Joshua|9|27: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the Lord, to this day, in the place which he should choose.
verses.Joshua|10|1: Now it came to pass, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;
verses.Joshua|10|2: that they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai and all its men were mighty.
verses.Joshua|10|3: And Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, and to Piram king of Jarmuth, and to Japhia, king of Lachish, and to Debir king of Eglon, saying,
verses.Joshua|10|4: Come up to me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it has made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.
verses.Joshua|10|5: Therefore the five kings of the Amorite, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon and made war against it.
verses.Joshua|10|6: And the men of Gibeon sent to Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Do not withdraw thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorite that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.
verses.Joshua|10|7: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.
verses.Joshua|10|8: And the Lord said to Joshua, Do not fear them: for I have delivered them into thy hand; not a man of them shall stand before thee.
verses.Joshua|10|9: So Joshua came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.
verses.Joshua|10|10: And the Lord struck them with confusion before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goes up to Beth-horon, and smote them as far as Azekah, and Makkedah.
verses.Joshua|10|11: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel and were on the descent to Beth-horon, that the Lord cast down great stones from heaven upon them as far as Azekah, and they died: they were more that died with the hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.
verses.Joshua|10|12: Then spoke Joshua to the Lord on the day when the Lord delivered up the Amorite before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand still upon Gibeon; and moon, in the valley of Ajalon;
verses.Joshua|10|13: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the Book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the middle of the sky, and hastened not to go down about a whole day.
verses.Joshua|10|14: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the Lord hearkened to the voice of a man: for the Lord fought for Israel.
verses.Joshua|10|15: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.
verses.Joshua|10|16: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.
verses.Joshua|10|17: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.
verses.Joshua|10|18: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it to keep them:
verses.Joshua|10|19: and stay not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; let them not enter their cities: for the Lord your God has delivered them into your hand.
verses.Joshua|10|20: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest who remained of them entered the fortified cities.
verses.Joshua|10|21: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.
verses.Joshua|10|22: Then said Joshua, Open the entrance of the cave, and bring out those five kings to me out of the cave.
verses.Joshua|10|23: And they did so, and brought out those five kings to him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
verses.Joshua|10|24: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings to Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the captains of the men of war who went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon their necks.
verses.Joshua|10|25: And Joshua said to them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the Lord do to all your enemies against whom you fight.
verses.Joshua|10|26: And afterwards Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.
verses.Joshua|10|27: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua gave command, and they took them down from off the trees, and cast them into the cave in which they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave's mouth, until this very day.
verses.Joshua|10|28: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and its king; he utterly destroyed them, and all the souls that were in it; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did to the king of Jericho.
verses.Joshua|10|29: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah:
verses.Joshua|10|30: and the Lord delivered it also, and its king, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were in it; he let none remain in it; but did to its king as he did to the king of Jericho.
verses.Joshua|10|31: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:
verses.Joshua|10|32: and the Lord delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, who took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were in it, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
verses.Joshua|10|33: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.
verses.Joshua|10|34: And from Lachish Joshua passed to Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:
verses.Joshua|10|35: and they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were in it he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
verses.Joshua|10|36: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron; and they fought against it:
verses.Joshua|10|37: and they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and its king, and all its cities, and all the souls that were in it; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were in it.
verses.Joshua|10|38: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:
verses.Joshua|10|39: and he took it, and its king, and all its cities; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were in it; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to its king; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.
verses.Joshua|10|40: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the plain, and of the slopes, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded.
verses.Joshua|10|41: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh-barnea even to Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, as far as Gibeon.
verses.Joshua|10|42: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the Lord God of Israel fought for Israel.
verses.Joshua|10|43: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.
verses.Joshua|11|1: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
verses.Joshua|11|2: and to the kings that were in the north, in the mountains, and in the Arabah south of Chinneroth, and in the plain, and in the districts of Dor on the west,
verses.Joshua|11|3: and to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.
verses.Joshua|11|4: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, a people numerous like the sand that is upon the sea shore for multitude, with a great many horses and chariots.
verses.Joshua|11|5: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.
verses.Joshua|11|6: And the Lord said to Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time I will deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt lame their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.
verses.Joshua|11|7: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.
verses.Joshua|11|8: And the Lord delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them as far as great Zidon, and as far as Misrephoth-maim, and the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
verses.Joshua|11|9: And Joshua did to them as the Lord bade him: he lamed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
verses.Joshua|11|10: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote its king with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the chief of all those kingdoms.
verses.Joshua|11|11: And they smote all the souls that were in it with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left that breathed: and he burnt Hazor with fire.
verses.Joshua|11|12: And all the cities of those kings, and all their kings, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the Lord commanded.
verses.Joshua|11|13: But as for the cities that stood still on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, except Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.
verses.Joshua|11|14: And all the spoil of those cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for plunder to themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, nor did they leave any that breathed.
verses.Joshua|11|15: As the Lord commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.Joshua|11|16: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south, and all the land of Goshen, and the plain, and the Arabah, and the mountain of Israel, and its plain;
verses.Joshua|11|17: from mount Halak that goes up to Seir, as far as Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon – under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.
verses.Joshua|11|18: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
verses.Joshua|11|19: There was not a city that made peace, with the children of Israel, except the Hivite, the inhabitants of Gibeon: they took all in battle.
verses.Joshua|11|20: For it was of the Lord to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might obtain no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.Joshua|11|21: And at that time Joshua came, and cut off the Anakims from the mountain, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountain of Judah, and from all the mountain of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.
verses.Joshua|11|22: There were none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, did they remain.
verses.Joshua|11|23: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the Lord said to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land had rest from war.
verses.Joshua|12|1: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side of the Jordan towards the rising of the sun, from the wadi of Arnon to mount Hermon, and all the Arabah on the east:
verses.Joshua|12|2: Sihon king of the Amorite, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the wadi of Arnon, and the middle of the wadi, and half the Gilead, as far as the wadi of Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.Joshua|12|3: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and to the sea of the Arabah, the salt sea on the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and from the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:
verses.Joshua|12|4: and the border of Og king of Bashan, who was of the remnant of the Rephaim, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
verses.Joshua|12|5: and reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salchah, and in all Bashan, as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
verses.Joshua|12|6: Them did Moses the servant of the Lord and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the Lord gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.
verses.Joshua|12|7: And these are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side of the Jordan on the west, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon, as far as the mount Halak, that goes up to Seir: which Joshua gave to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
verses.Joshua|12|8: in the mountains, and in the plain, and in the Arabah, and on the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the south; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
verses.Joshua|12|9: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Beth-el, one;
verses.Joshua|12|10: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
verses.Joshua|12|11: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
verses.Joshua|12|12: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
verses.Joshua|12|13: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
verses.Joshua|12|14: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
verses.Joshua|12|15: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
verses.Joshua|12|16: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Beth-el, one;
verses.Joshua|12|17: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
verses.Joshua|12|18: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
verses.Joshua|12|19: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
verses.Joshua|12|20: the king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
verses.Joshua|12|21: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
verses.Joshua|12|22: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;
verses.Joshua|12|23: the king of Dor in the district of Dor, one; the king of nations of Gilgal, one;
verses.Joshua|12|24: the king of Tirzah, one: all the kings being thirty one.
verses.Joshua|13|1: Now Joshua was old and advanced in age; and the Lord said to him, Thou art old and advanced in age, and there remains yet very much land to be occupied.
verses.Joshua|13|2: This is the land that yet remains: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshuri,
verses.Joshua|13|3: from Sihor, which is before Egypt, as far as the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines: the Azzati, and the Ashdodi, the Eshkalonites, the Gittite, and the Ekron; also the Avim:
verses.Joshua|13|4: from the south, all the land of the Canaanite, and Mearah that is beside the Zidonians, as far as Aphek, to the border of the Amorite:
verses.Joshua|13|5: and the land of the Giblites, and all the Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baal-gad under mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.
verses.Joshua|13|6: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon as far as Misrephoth-maim, and all the Zidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide it by lot to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.
verses.Joshua|13|7: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh.
verses.Joshua|13|8: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, as Moses the servant of the Lord gave them;
verses.Joshua|13|9: from Aroer, that is upon the bank of the wadi Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the wadi, and all the tableland of Medeba as far as Dibon;
verses.Joshua|13|10: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorite who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.Joshua|13|11: and the Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan as far as Salchah;
verses.Joshua|13|12: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the Rephaim: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.
verses.Joshua|13|13: Nevertheless the children of Israel did not expel the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell amidst Israel until this day.
verses.Joshua|13|14: Only to the tribe of Levi he gave no inheritance; the fire offerings of the Lord God of Israel are their inheritance, as he said to them.
verses.Joshua|13|15: And Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.
verses.Joshua|13|16: And their border was from Aroer, that is on the border of the wadi of Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the wadi, and all the tableland by Medeba;
verses.Joshua|13|17: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the tableland; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,
verses.Joshua|13|18: and Jahzah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
verses.Joshua|13|19: and Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zareth-shahar in the mount of the valley,
verses.Joshua|13|20: and Beth-peor, and the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,
verses.Joshua|13|21: and all the cities of the tableland, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorite, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Evi, princes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.
verses.Joshua|13|22: Balaam also, of the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.
verses.Joshua|13|23: And the border of the children of Reuben was the Jordan, and its shore. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben by their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.Joshua|13|24: And Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad by their families.
verses.Joshua|13|25: And their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, as far as Aroer that is before Rabbah;
verses.Joshua|13|26: and from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;
verses.Joshua|13|27: and in the valley of Beth-aram and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan and its shore, to the edge of the Sea of Chinnereth on the other side of the Jordan eastward.
verses.Joshua|13|28: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad by their families, the cities, and their villages.
verses.Joshua|13|29: And Moses gave inheritance to the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.
verses.Joshua|13|30: And their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities:
verses.Joshua|13|31: and half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, for the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
verses.Joshua|13|32: These are what Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side of the Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
verses.Joshua|13|33: But to the tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance: the Lord God of Israel is their inheritance, as he said to them.
verses.Joshua|14|1: And these are the places which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, assigned for their inheritance.
verses.Joshua|14|2: By lot was their inheritance, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.
verses.Joshua|14|3: For Moses had given the inheritance of two and a half tribes on the other side of the Jordan: but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.
verses.Joshua|14|4: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: and they gave no part to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture grounds for their cattle and their substance.
verses.Joshua|14|5: As the Lord commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.
verses.Joshua|14|6: Then the children of Judah came to Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said to him, Thou knowst the thing that the Lord said to Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh-barnea.
verses.Joshua|14|7: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land; and I brought him back word as it was in my heart.
verses.Joshua|14|8: But my brethren who went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the Lord my God.
verses.Joshua|14|9: And Moses swore on that day, saying, Surely the land on which thy feet have trodden shall be thy inheritance, and thy children's forever, because thou hast wholly followed the Lord my God.
verses.Joshua|14|10: And now, behold, the Lord has kept me alive, as he said, these forty five years, even since the Lord spoke this word to Moses, while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day eighty five years old.
verses.Joshua|14|11: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.
verses.Joshua|14|12: Now therefore give me this mountain, of which the Lord spoke on that day; for thou didst hear on that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fortified: if so be the Lord will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the Lord said.
verses.Joshua|14|13: And Joshua blessed him, and gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.
verses.Joshua|14|14: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenezite to this day, because he wholly followed the Lord God of Israel.
verses.Joshua|14|15: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjath-arba; this Arba was the biggest man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.
verses.Joshua|15|1: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin towards the south in the far south.
verses.Joshua|15|2: And their south border was from the far shore of the salt sea, from the bay that turns southwards:
verses.Joshua|15|3: and it went out to the south side to Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Addar, and came round to Karkaa:
verses.Joshua|15|4: from there it passed toward Azmon, and went out to the wadi of Egypt; and the terminations of that border were at the sea: this shall be your southern border.
verses.Joshua|15|5: And the east border was the salt sea, even to the end of the Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the extremity of the Jordan.
verses.Joshua|15|6: And the border went up to Beth-hogla, and passed along by the north of Beth-arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
verses.Joshua|15|7: and the border went up towards Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, turning towards Gilgal, which is opposite the ascent to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of En-shemesh, and its terminations were at En-rogel:
verses.Joshua|15|8: and the border went up by the valley of the Hinnom to the south side of the Jebusite; that is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of Rephaim northwards:
verses.Joshua|15|9: and the border was drawn from the top of the hill to the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjath-jearim.
verses.Joshua|15|10: And the border came around from Baal westward to mount Seir and passed along to the spur of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed on to Timnah:
verses.Joshua|15|11: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out to Jabneel; and the terminations of the border were at the sea.
verses.Joshua|15|12: And as for the west border, the great sea was the border. This is the border of the children of Judah round about according to their families.
verses.Joshua|15|13: And to Caleb son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the Lord to Joshua, the city of Arba the father of the Anak, which city is Hebron.
verses.Joshua|15|14: And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of the Anak, Sheshai and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of the Anak.
verses.Joshua|15|15: And he went up from there to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher.
verses.Joshua|15|16: And Caleb said, He that smites Kirjath-sepher and takes it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
verses.Joshua|15|17: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
verses.Joshua|15|18: And it came to pass, when she arrived, that she enticed him to ask of her father a field: and she came down from her ass; and Caleb said to her, What wouldst thou have?
verses.Joshua|15|19: And she answered, give me a blessing; for thou hast given me the land of the south: give me also pools of water. And he gave her the upper pools, and the lower pools.
verses.Joshua|15|20: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
verses.Joshua|15|21: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
verses.Joshua|15|22: and Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,
verses.Joshua|15|23: and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,
verses.Joshua|15|25: and Hazor, Hadattah, and Qeriyot, and Hezron, which is Hazor,
verses.Joshua|15|27: and Hazar-gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-palet,
verses.Joshua|15|28: and Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Bizjothjah,
verses.Joshua|15|30: and Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,
verses.Joshua|15|31: and Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
verses.Joshua|15|32: and Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities were twenty nine, with their villages:
verses.Joshua|15|33: and in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zorah, and Ashnah,
verses.Joshua|15|34: and Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,
verses.Joshua|15|35: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Shocho, and Azekah,
verses.Joshua|15|36: and Shaaraim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:
verses.Joshua|15|38: and Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,
verses.Joshua|15|40: and Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,
verses.Joshua|15|41: And Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:
verses.Joshua|15|43: and Jephthah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,
verses.Joshua|15|44: and Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:
verses.Joshua|15|45: Ekron, with its hamlets and villages:
verses.Joshua|15|46: from Ekron to the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:
verses.Joshua|15|47: Ashdod with its hamlets and villages, Gaza with its hamlets and villages, to the wadi of Egypt, and the great sea, being its border;
verses.Joshua|15|48: and in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Shocho,
verses.Joshua|15|49: and Dannah, and Kirjath-sannah, which is Debir,
verses.Joshua|15|50: and Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
verses.Joshua|15|51: and Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:
verses.Joshua|15|53: and Janum, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah,
verses.Joshua|15|54: and Humtah, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:
verses.Joshua|15|55: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph and Juttah,
verses.Joshua|15|56: and Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,
verses.Joshua|15|57: Cain, Gibeah and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:
verses.Joshua|15|59: and Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:
verses.Joshua|15|60: Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:
verses.Joshua|15|61: in the wilderness, Bet-haaraba, Middin, and Secacah,
verses.Joshua|15|62: and Nibshan, and Ir-hammelah, and En-gedi; six cities with their villages.
verses.Joshua|15|63: As for the Jebusite, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusite dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.
verses.Joshua|16|1: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from the Jordan by Jericho, to the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goes up from Jericho by mount Beth-el,
verses.Joshua|16|2: and goes out from Beth-el to Luz and passes along to the borders of the Archi to Ataroth,
verses.Joshua|16|3: and goes down westward to the border of the Japhleti, to the border of lower Beth-horon, and to Gezer: and its terminations are at the sea.
verses.Joshua|16|4: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim took their inheritance.
verses.Joshua|16|5: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: the border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth-addar, to upper Beth-horon;
verses.Joshua|16|6: and the border went out westward, to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward to Taanath-shiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;
verses.Joshua|16|7: and it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.
verses.Joshua|16|8: The border went out from Tappuah westward to the wadi Kanah; and its terminations were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families;
verses.Joshua|16|9: together with the separate cities for the children of Ephraim among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
verses.Joshua|16|10: And they did not drive out the Canaanite that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanite dwell amongst Ephraim to this day, and became tax-paying servants.
verses.Joshua|17|1: Then came the lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
verses.Joshua|17|2: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.
verses.Joshua|17|3: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.Joshua|17|4: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the Lord he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
verses.Joshua|17|5: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side of the Jordan;
verses.Joshua|17|6: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.
verses.Joshua|17|7: And the border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lies before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand to the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
verses.Joshua|17|8: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;
verses.Joshua|17|9: and the border descended to the wadi Kanah, southward of the wadi: these cities were Ephraim's situated among the cities of Manasseh: the boundary of Manasseh also was on the north side of the wadi; and its terminations were at the sea:
verses.Joshua|17|10: southward it was Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's and the sea was its border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.
verses.Joshua|17|11: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and its hamlets, and Ibleam and its hamlets, and the inhabitants of Dor and its hamlets, and the inhabitants of En-dor and its hamlets, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its hamlets, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its hamlets, three districts in all.
verses.Joshua|17|12: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanite persisted in dwelling in that land.
verses.Joshua|17|13: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel became strong, that they put the Canaanite to tribute; but did not utterly drive them out.
verses.Joshua|17|14: And the children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, when I am a great people, since the Lord has blessed me so much?
verses.Joshua|17|15: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then go up to the forest country, and cut down a space for thyself there in the land of the Perizzite and of the Rephaim, if mount Ephraim is too narrow for thee.
verses.Joshua|17|16: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanite that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Beth-shean and its hamlets, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.
verses.Joshua|17|17: And Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:
verses.Joshua|17|18: but the mountain shall be thine; for it is a forest, and thou shalt cut it down: and its terminations shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanite, though they have iron chariots, and though they are so strong.
verses.Joshua|18|1: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. And the land was conquered before them.
verses.Joshua|18|2: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, who had not yet received their inheritance.
verses.Joshua|18|3: And Joshua said to the children of Israel, How long will you be remiss in going to possess the land, which the Lord God of your fathers has given you?
verses.Joshua|18|4: Assign from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and mark it out according to their inheritance; and they shall come back to me.
verses.Joshua|18|5: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall remain on his boundary in the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain on their boundaries to the north.
verses.Joshua|18|6: You shall therefore mark out the land in seven parts, and bring the description to me here, that I may cast lots for you here before the Lord our God.
verses.Joshua|18|7: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan on the east, that which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them.
verses.Joshua|18|8: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to mark out the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and mark it out, and come back to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the Lord in Shiloh.
verses.Joshua|18|9: And the men went and passed through the land, and wrote it down by cities into seven parts in a book, and came back to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.
verses.Joshua|18|10: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the Lord: and there Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.
verses.Joshua|18|11: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the border of their lot came out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
verses.Joshua|18|12: And their border on the north side was from the Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and its terminations were at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
verses.Joshua|18|13: And the border went over from thence towards Luz, to the south side of Luz, which is Beth-el; and the border descended to Ataroth-addar, near the hill that lies on the south side of the lower Beth-horon.
verses.Joshua|18|14: And the border was drawn, and turned about at its western corner to the south, from the hill that lies before Beth-horon southward; and its terminations were at Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.
verses.Joshua|18|15: And the south quarter was from the far side of Kirjath-jearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of the waters of Nephtoah:
verses.Joshua|18|16: and the border came down to the end of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of Rephaim on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the slope of the Jebusite on the south, and descended to En-rogel,
verses.Joshua|18|17: and was drawn to the north, and went out to En-shemesh, and went out toward Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,
verses.Joshua|18|18: and passed along toward the slope over against the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah:
verses.Joshua|18|19: and the border passed along the slope of Beth-hoglah northward: and the terminations of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the southern extremity of the Jordan: this was the south boundary.
verses.Joshua|18|20: And the Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin by its border round about, according to their families.
verses.Joshua|18|21: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and the valley of Keziz,
verses.Joshua|18|22: and Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Beth-el,
verses.Joshua|18|23: and Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,
verses.Joshua|18|24: and Chephar-haammonai, and Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages:
verses.Joshua|18|26: and Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Moza,
verses.Joshua|18|27: and Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,
verses.Joshua|18|28: and Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusite (which is Jerusalem) Gibeath and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
verses.Joshua|19|1: And the second lot came out in favour of Simeon, for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
verses.Joshua|19|2: And they had in their inheritance Beer-sheba, and Sheba, and Moladah,
verses.Joshua|19|3: and Hazar-shual, and Balah, and Ezem,
verses.Joshua|19|4: and Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,
verses.Joshua|19|5: and Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,
verses.Joshua|19|6: and Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:
verses.Joshua|19|7: Ain, Rimmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:
verses.Joshua|19|8: and all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath-beer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
verses.Joshua|19|9: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of Judah.
verses.Joshua|19|10: And the third lot came out in favour of the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was as far as Sarid:
verses.Joshua|19|11: and their border went up on its western side by Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached the wadi that is before Jokneam;
verses.Joshua|19|12: and turned from Sarid eastward towards the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth-tabor, and then went on to Daberath, and went up to Japhia,
verses.Joshua|19|13: and from there passed on along on the east to Gath-hepher, to Ittah-kazin, and went out to Rimmon, from where it reached to Neah;
verses.Joshua|19|14: and the border turned about on the north side to Hannathon: and its terminations were in the valley of Jiphthah-el:
verses.Joshua|19|15: and Kattath, and Nahalal, and Shimron, and Idalah and Beth-lehem: twelve cities with their villages.
verses.Joshua|19|16: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.Joshua|19|17: And the fourth lot came out in favour of Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.
verses.Joshua|19|18: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,
verses.Joshua|19|19: and Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,
verses.Joshua|19|20: and Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,
verses.Joshua|19|21: and Remeth, and En-gannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez;
verses.Joshua|19|22: and the border reached as far as Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh; and the terminations of their border were at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
verses.Joshua|19|23: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.Joshua|19|24: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
verses.Joshua|19|25: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,
verses.Joshua|19|26: and Alammelech, and Amad, and Mishal; and reached to the Carmel on the west, and to Shihor-libnath;
verses.Joshua|19|27: and turned toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthah-el on the north, then Beth-emek, and Neiel, and proceeded to Cabul on the left hand,
verses.Joshua|19|28: and Ebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, as far as Zidon the great,
verses.Joshua|19|29: and then the border turned to Ramah, and to the fortress city of Tyre; and the boundary turned to Hosah; and its terminations were at the sea from Abel to Achzib:
verses.Joshua|19|30: Ummah also, and Aphek, Rehob: twenty two cities with their villages.
verses.Joshua|19|31: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.Joshua|19|32: The sixth lot came out in favour of the children of Naphtali, for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
verses.Joshua|19|33: And their border was from Heleph, from Elon in Zaanannim, and Adami-neceb, and Jabneel, as far as Lakum; its terminations were at the Jordan:
verses.Joshua|19|34: and then the coast turned westward to Hukok, and reached to Zebulun on the south side, and reached to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon the Jordan toward the sunrising.
verses.Joshua|19|35: And the fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,
verses.Joshua|19|36: and Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,
verses.Joshua|19|37: and Kedesh, and Edrei, and En-hazor,
verses.Joshua|19|38: and Jiron, and Migdal-el, Horem, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
verses.Joshua|19|39: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.Joshua|19|40: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
verses.Joshua|19|41: And the border of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh,
verses.Joshua|19|42: and Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,
verses.Joshua|19|43: and Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,
verses.Joshua|19|44: and Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,
verses.Joshua|19|45: and Jehud, and Bene-berak, and Gath-rimmon,
verses.Joshua|19|46: and Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.
verses.Joshua|19|47: And the border of the children of Dan came out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt in it, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
verses.Joshua|19|48: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.Joshua|19|49: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance according to its boundaries, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:
verses.Joshua|19|50: according to the word of the Lord they gave him the city which he asked, Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt in it.
verses.Joshua|19|51: These are the territories which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the Lord, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they made an end of dividing the country.
verses.Joshua|20|1: And the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,
verses.Joshua|20|2: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Assign for yourselves cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you by the hand of Moses:
verses.Joshua|20|3: that the slayer that kills any person through error and unawares may flee there: and they shall be a refuge for you from the avenger of blood.
verses.Joshua|20|4: And when he that flees to one of those cities shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, then they shall admit him into the city to join them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.
verses.Joshua|20|5: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unawares, and hated him not before that time.
verses.Joshua|20|6: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come into his own city, and his own house, into the city from which he fled.
verses.Joshua|20|7: And they set apart Kedesh in the Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.
verses.Joshua|20|8: And on the other side of the Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.Joshua|20|9: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourned among them, that whoever killed any person in error might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.
verses.Joshua|21|1: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;
verses.Joshua|21|2: and they spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The Lord gave command by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for our cattle.
verses.Joshua|21|3: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the Lord, these cities and their pasture lands.
verses.Joshua|21|4: And the lot came out in favour of the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.
verses.Joshua|21|5: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
verses.Joshua|21|6: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.Joshua|21|7: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.Joshua|21|8: And the children of Israel gave by lot to the Levites these cities with their pasture lands, as the Lord gave command by the hand of Moses.
verses.Joshua|21|9: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,
verses.Joshua|21|10: which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.
verses.Joshua|21|11: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with its pasture lands round about it.
verses.Joshua|21|12: But the fields of the city, and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
verses.Joshua|21|13: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with its pasture lands, a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with its pasture lands,
verses.Joshua|21|14: and Jattir with its pasture lands, and Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
verses.Joshua|21|15: and Holon with its pasture lands, and Debir with its pasture lands,
verses.Joshua|21|16: and Ain with its pasture lands, and Juttah with its pasture, and Beth-shemesh with its pasture lands; nine cities out of those two tribes.
verses.Joshua|21|17: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasture lands, and Geba with its pastures,
verses.Joshua|21|18: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands; four cities.
verses.Joshua|21|19: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, thirteen cities with their pasture lands.
verses.Joshua|21|20: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites who remained of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.Joshua|21|21: For they gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with its pastures,
verses.Joshua|21|22: and Kibzaim with its pasture lands and Beth-horon with its pasture lands; four cities.
verses.Joshua|21|23: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pastures,
verses.Joshua|21|24: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath-rimmon with its pasture lands; four cities.
verses.Joshua|21|25: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with its pasture lands and Gath-rimmon with its pasture lands; two cities.
verses.Joshua|21|26: All the cities were ten with their pasture lands for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.
verses.Joshua|21|27: And to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in the Bashan with its pasture lands, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beesh-terah with its pasture lands; two cities.
verses.Joshua|21|28: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pastures,
verses.Joshua|21|29: Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En-gannim with its pasture lands; four cities.
verses.Joshua|21|30: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,
verses.Joshua|21|31: Helkath with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pastures; four cities.
verses.Joshua|21|32: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammoth-dor with its pasture lands, and Kartan with its pasture lands, three cities.
verses.Joshua|21|33: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.
verses.Joshua|21|34: And to the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, and Kartah with its pasture lands,
verses.Joshua|21|35: Dimnah with its pastures, Nahalal with its pasture lands; four cities.
verses.Joshua|21|36: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with its pasture lands,
verses.Joshua|21|37: Heshbon with its pasture lands, Jazer with its pasture lands; four cities in all.
verses.Joshua|21|38: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which remained of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.
verses.Joshua|21|39: All the cities of the Levites within the domain of the children of Israel were forty eight cities with their pasture lands.
verses.Joshua|21|40: These cities were every one with their pasture lands round about them: thus were all these cities.
verses.Joshua|21|41: And the Lord gave to Israel all the land which He swore to give to their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt in it.
verses.Joshua|21|42: And the Lord gave them rest round about, according to all that he swore to their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the Lord delivered all their enemies into their hand.
verses.Joshua|21|43: Nothing failed of all the good things which the Lord had spoken to the house of Israel; all came to pass.
verses.Joshua|22|1: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
verses.Joshua|22|2: and said to them, You have kept all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:
verses.Joshua|22|3: you have not forsaken your brethren these many days, until this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the Lord your God.
verses.Joshua|22|4: And now the Lord your God has given rest to your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return, and go to your tents, and to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you on the other side of the Jordan.
verses.Joshua|22|5: But take great care to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, to love the Lord your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to hold fast to him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.Joshua|22|6: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went to their tents.
verses.Joshua|22|7: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh, Moses had given possession in Bashan: but to the other half of it, Joshua had given territory among their brethren on this side of the Jordan westward. Moreover when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them,
verses.Joshua|22|8: and he spoke to them, saying, Return with much riches to your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with copper, and with iron, and with very many garments: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.
verses.Joshua|22|9: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, of which they were possessed, according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.Joshua|22|10: And when they came to the districts of the Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by the Jordan, a great and conspicuous altar.
verses.Joshua|22|11: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the districts of the Jordan, on the side of the children of Israel.
verses.Joshua|22|12: And when the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.
verses.Joshua|22|13: And the children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,
verses.Joshua|22|14: and with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one a headman of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.
verses.Joshua|22|15: And they came to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them, saying,
verses.Joshua|22|16: Thus says the whole congregation of the Lord, What trespass is this that you have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the Lord, by building for yourselves an altar, that you might rebel this day against the Lord?
verses.Joshua|22|17: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not been cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the Lord,
verses.Joshua|22|18: but that you must turn away this day from following the Lord? and it will be, if you rebel to day against the Lord, that to morrow he will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.
verses.Joshua|22|19: Howbeit, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass over to the land of the possession of the Lord, where the Lord's tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the Lord, nor rebel against us, in building an altar for yourselves besides the altar of the Lord our God.
verses.Joshua|22|20: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in regard to the devoted property, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.
verses.Joshua|22|21: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said to the heads of the thousands of Israel,
verses.Joshua|22|22: The mighty One, God, the Lord, the mighty One, God, the Lord, he knows and Israel shall know; if in rebellion, or if in transgression against the Lord, (save Thou us not this day,)
verses.Joshua|22|23: if we have built an altar for ourselves to turn from following the Lord, or if to offer a burnt offering or a meal offering upon it, or if to offer peace offerings upon it, let the Lord himself demand reparation;
verses.Joshua|22|24: or if we have not rather done this out of anxiety, saying, In time to come your children might speak to our children, saying, What have you to do with the Lord God of Israel?
verses.Joshua|22|25: For the Lord has made the Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad; you have no part in the Lord: so shall your children make our children cease fearing the Lord.
verses.Joshua|22|26: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:
verses.Joshua|22|27: but that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the Lord before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, You have no part in the Lord.
verses.Joshua|22|28: Therefore we said, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may reply, Behold the pattern of the altar of the Lord, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.
verses.Joshua|22|29: God forbid that we should rebel against the Lord, and turn this day from following the Lord, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meal offerings, or for sacrifices, besides the altar of the Lord our God that is before his tabernacle.
verses.Joshua|22|30: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel who were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them.
verses.Joshua|22|31: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the Lord is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against the Lord: now you have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the Lord.
verses.Joshua|22|32: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them back word.
verses.Joshua|22|33: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and spoke no more of going up against them in battle, to destroy the land where the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.
verses.Joshua|22|34: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the Lord is God.
verses.Joshua|23|1: And it came to pass a long time after the Lord had given rest to Israel from all their enemies round about, that Joshua became old and stricken in days.
verses.Joshua|23|2: And Joshua called for all Israel, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said to them, I am old and stricken in days:
verses.Joshua|23|3: and you have seen all that the Lord your God has done to all these nations because of you; for the Lord your God is he that has fought for you.
verses.Joshua|23|4: Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea westward.
verses.Joshua|23|5: And the Lord your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and you shall possess their land, as the Lord your God has promised you.
verses.Joshua|23|6: Be therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you turn not aside from it to the right hand or to the left;
verses.Joshua|23|7: that you come not among these nations, that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, nor serve them, nor bow yourselves down to them:
verses.Joshua|23|8: but cleave to the Lord your God, as you have done to this day.
verses.Joshua|23|9: For the Lord has driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man has been able to withstand you to this day.
verses.Joshua|23|10: One man of you would chase a thousand: for the Lord your God, he it is that fights for you, as he has promised you.
verses.Joshua|23|11: Take great care therefore to yourselves, that you love the Lord your God.
verses.Joshua|23|12: For if you should at all turn back to attach yourselves to the remnant of these nations, these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:
verses.Joshua|23|13: know for a certainty that the Lord your God will no more drive out any of these nations before you; but they shall be snares and traps to you, and a scourge in your sides, and pricks in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which the Lord your God has given you.
verses.Joshua|23|14: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and you all know in your hearts and in your souls, that not one thing has failed of all the good things which the Lord your God spoke concerning you; all have come to you; not one thing has failed.
verses.Joshua|23|15: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which the Lord your God promised you; so shall the Lord bring upon you all evil things, until he shall have destroyed you from off this good land which the Lord your God has given you,
verses.Joshua|23|16: if you should transgress the covenant of the Lord your God, which he commanded you, and you should go and serve other gods, and bow yourselves down to them. Then shall the anger of the Lord burn against you, and you shall perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you.
verses.Joshua|24|1: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and they presented themselves before God.
verses.Joshua|24|2: And Joshua said to all the people, Thus says the Lord God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the river in old time, Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor: and they served other gods.
verses.Joshua|24|3: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the river, and led him through the whole land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.
verses.Joshua|24|4: And I gave to Isaac, Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down to Egypt.
verses.Joshua|24|5: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, with that which I did among them: and afterwards I brought you out.
verses.Joshua|24|6: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the sea; and Egypt pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen to the Red Sea.
verses.Joshua|24|7: And when they cried to the Lord, he put darkness between you and Egypt, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and you dwelt in the wilderness many days:
verses.Joshua|24|8: and I brought you into the land of the Amorite, who dwelt on the other side of the Jordan, and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that you might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.
verses.Joshua|24|9: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you.
verses.Joshua|24|10: But I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you from his hand.
verses.Joshua|24|11: And you went over the Jordan, and came to Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.
verses.Joshua|24|12: And I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, the two kings of the Amorite; but not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.
verses.Joshua|24|13: And I have given you a land for which you did not labour, and cities which you did not build, and you dwell in them; of vineyards and oliveyards which you did not plant, do you eat.
verses.Joshua|24|14: Now therefore fear the Lord, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the river, and in Egypt; and serve the Lord.
