verses.2 Kings|19|21: This is the word that the Lord has spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion despises thee, and laughs thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem shakes her head at thee.
verses.2 Kings|19|22: Whom hast thou taunted and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou raised thy voice, and lifted up thy eyes on high? against the Holy One of Israel!
verses.2 Kings|19|23: By thy messengers thou hast taunted the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and have cut down its tall cedar trees, and the choice cypresses: and I have entered into its farthest lodge, and into its deepest forest.
verses.2 Kings|19|24: I have dug and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet I have dried up all the canals of Egypt.
verses.2 Kings|19|25: Hast thou not heard long ago how I have done it, and of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass that fortified cities should be laid waste into ruinous heaps.
verses.2 Kings|19|26: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the house tops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.
verses.2 Kings|19|27: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.
verses.2 Kings|19|28: Because thy rage against me and thy confidence is come up to my ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.
verses.2 Kings|19|29: And this shall be a sign to thee, You shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springs of the same; and in the third year sow, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat their fruits.
verses.2 Kings|19|30: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downwards, and bear fruit upwards.
verses.2 Kings|19|31: For out of Jerusalem shall go a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall do this.
verses.2 Kings|19|32: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor throw a mound against it.
verses.2 Kings|19|33: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and he shall not come into this city, says the Lord.
verses.2 Kings|19|34: For I will defend this city, to save it, for my own sake, and for my servant David's sake.
verses.2 Kings|19|35: And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the Lord went out and smote in the camp of Assyria a hundred and eighty five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
verses.2 Kings|19|36: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
verses.2 Kings|19|37: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Ararat. And Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.2 Kings|20|1: In those days Hezekiah fell mortally sick. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said to him, Thus says the Lord, Set thy house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.
verses.2 Kings|20|2: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed to the Lord, saying,
verses.2 Kings|20|3: I beseech Thee, O Lord, remember now how I have walked before Thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in Thy sight. And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
verses.2 Kings|20|4: And it came to pass, before Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of the Lord came to him, saying,
verses.2 Kings|20|5: Turn back and tell Hezekiah the prince of my people, Thus says the Lord, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up to the house of the Lord.
verses.2 Kings|20|6: And I will add to thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for my own sake, and for my servant David's sake.
verses.2 Kings|20|7: And Isaiah said, Take a cake of figs. And they took and laid it on the festering place, and he recovered.
verses.2 Kings|20|8: And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, What shall be the sign that the Lord will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of the Lord on the third day?
verses.2 Kings|20|9: And Isaiah said, This sign shalt thou have of the Lord, that the Lord will do the thing that he has spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees: or shall it go backward ten degrees?
verses.2 Kings|20|10: And Hezekiah answered, It is easier for the shadow to go down ten degrees: no, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.
verses.2 Kings|20|11: And Isaiah the prophet cried to the Lord: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.
verses.2 Kings|20|12: At that time Berodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he heard that Hezekiah had been sick.
verses.2 Kings|20|13: And Hezekiah hearkened to them, and showed them all the house of his treasures, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah did not show them.
verses.2 Kings|20|14: Then came Isaiah the prophet to king Hezekiah, and said to him, What said these men? and from where did they come to thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, from Babylon.
verses.2 Kings|20|15: And he said, What have they seen in thy house? And Hezekiah answered, All the things that are in my house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.
verses.2 Kings|20|16: And Isaiah said to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the Lord.
verses.2 Kings|20|17: Behold, days are coming, when all that is in thy house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store to this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, says the Lord.
verses.2 Kings|20|18: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
verses.2 Kings|20|19: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of the Lord which thou hast spoken. And he said, Is it not good, if there is peace and truth in my days?
verses.2 Kings|20|20: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made the pool, and the aqueduct, and brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.2 Kings|20|21: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.
verses.2 Kings|21|1: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hephzi-bah.
verses.2 Kings|21|2: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, after the abominations of the nations, whom the Lord cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.2 Kings|21|3: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for the Baal, and made an ashera, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
verses.2 Kings|21|4: And he built altars in the house of the Lord, of which the Lord said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.
verses.2 Kings|21|5: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord.
verses.2 Kings|21|6: And he caused his son to pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with mediums and wizards: he did much wickedness in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.
verses.2 Kings|21|7: And he set the carved idol of the ashera that he had made, in that house, of which the Lord said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:
verses.2 Kings|21|8: neither will I make the feet of Israel to wander any more out of the land which I gave their fathers: only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.
verses.2 Kings|21|9: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the Lord destroyed before the children of Israel.
verses.2 Kings|21|10: And the Lord spoke by his servants the prophets, saying,
verses.2 Kings|21|11: Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these abominations, and has done wickedly above all that the Amorite did, which were before him, and has made Judah also to sin with his idols:
verses.2 Kings|21|12: therefore thus says the Lord God of Israel, Behold, I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah that whoever hears of it, both his ears shall tingle.
verses.2 Kings|21|13: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the measuring line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipes a dish, wiping it, and turning it upside down.
verses.2 Kings|21|14: And I will abandon the remnant of my inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;
verses.2 Kings|21|15: because they have done that which was evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came out of Egypt, and to this day.
verses.2 Kings|21|16: Moreover Manasseh shed very much innocent blood, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; besides his sin with which he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.2 Kings|21|17: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.2 Kings|21|18: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.2 Kings|21|19: Amon was twenty two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
verses.2 Kings|21|20: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as his father Manasseh had done.
verses.2 Kings|21|21: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:
verses.2 Kings|21|22: and he forsook the Lord God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the Lord.
verses.2 Kings|21|23: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.
verses.2 Kings|21|24: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
verses.2 Kings|21|25: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.2 Kings|21|26: And he was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.2 Kings|22|1: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty one years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah from Bozkath.
verses.2 Kings|22|2: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand nor to the left.
verses.2 Kings|22|3: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the Lord, saying,
verses.2 Kings|22|4: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum up the silver which is brought into the house of the Lord, which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:
verses.2 Kings|22|5: and let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the Lord: and let them give it to the workers who are in the house of the Lord, to repair the breaches of the house,
verses.2 Kings|22|6: to carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.
verses.2 Kings|22|7: Yet no accounts were kept with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt in good faith.
verses.2 Kings|22|8: And Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found a book of the law in the house of the Lord. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan and he read it.
verses.2 Kings|22|9: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought back word to the king, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the Lord.
verses.2 Kings|22|10: And Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest has given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
verses.2 Kings|22|11: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.
verses.2 Kings|22|12: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king's servant, saying,
verses.2 Kings|22|13: Go inquire of the Lord for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of the Lord that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened to the words of this book, to do according to all that which is written concerning us.
verses.2 Kings|22|14: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asaiah, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the second quarter;) and they spoke with her.
verses.2 Kings|22|15: And she said to them, Thus says the Lord God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,
verses.2 Kings|22|16: Thus says the Lord, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon its inhabitants, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah has read:
verses.2 Kings|22|17: because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.
verses.2 Kings|22|18: But to the king of Judah who sent you to inquire of the Lord, thus shall you say to him, Thus says the Lord God of Israel, Regarding the words which thou hast heard;
verses.2 Kings|22|19: because thy heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the Lord, when thou didst hear what I spoke against this place, and against its inhabitants, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard thee, says the Lord.
verses.2 Kings|22|20: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thy eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought back word to the king.
verses.2 Kings|23|1: And the king sent, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.2 Kings|23|2: And the king went up into the house of the Lord, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the Lord.
verses.2 Kings|23|3: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk after the Lord, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.
verses.2 Kings|23|4: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring out of the temple of the Lord all the vessels that were made for the Baal, and for the ashera, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them outside Jerusalem on the terraces of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them to Beth-el.
verses.2 Kings|23|5: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem, them also that burned incense to Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.
verses.2 Kings|23|6: And he brought out the ashera from the house of the Lord, outside Jerusalem, to the Kidron, and burned it at the wadi Kidron, and beat it into dust, and cast the dust of it upon the graves of the common people.
verses.2 Kings|23|7: And he pulled down the houses of the male prostitutes, that were by the house of the Lord, where the women wove covering for the ashera.
verses.2 Kings|23|8: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba, and pulled down the high places of the gates that were in the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which was on a man's left hand at the gate of the city.
verses.2 Kings|23|9: Nevertheless the priests of the high places did not come up to the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.
verses.2 Kings|23|10: And he defiled the Tophet, which is in the valley of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter pass through the fire to the Molech.
verses.2 Kings|23|11: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, to the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain which was in the suburbs, denying them entrance to the house of the Lord, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
verses.2 Kings|23|12: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the Lord, did the king pull down, and beat them down from there, and cast the dust of them into wadi Kidron.
verses.2 Kings|23|13: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the Mount of Corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.
verses.2 Kings|23|14: And he broke the pillars in pieces, and cut down the asherim, and filled their place with the bones of men.
verses.2 Kings|23|15: Moreover the altar that was at Beth-el, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he pulled down, and burned the high place, and beat it into dust, and burned the ashera.
verses.2 Kings|23|16: And as Josiah turned himself, he saw the graves that were there on the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the graves, and burned them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the Lord which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.
verses.2 Kings|23|17: Then he said, What monument is that that I see? And the men of the city told him, It is the tomb of the man of God, who came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Beth-el.
verses.2 Kings|23|18: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.
verses.2 Kings|23|19: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke to anger, did Josiah remove, and he did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Beth-el.
verses.2 Kings|23|20: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars, and burned men's bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.2 Kings|23|21: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover to the Lord your God, as it is written in the book of the covenant.
verses.2 Kings|23|22: Surely there no such passover was held from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;
verses.2 Kings|23|23: but in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, was this passover held to the Lord in Jerusalem.
verses.2 Kings|23|24: Moreover the mediums, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest had found in the house of the Lord.
verses.2 Kings|23|25: And like him was there no king before him, that turned to the Lord with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.
verses.2 Kings|23|26: Nevertheless, the Lord did not turn back from the fierceness of that great anger with which his anger burned against Judah, on account of all the provocations with which Manasseh had provoked him.
verses.2 Kings|23|27: And the Lord said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and I will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.
verses.2 Kings|23|28: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.2 Kings|23|29: In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.
verses.2 Kings|23|30: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father's stead.
verses.2 Kings|23|31: Jehoahaz was twenty three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.
verses.2 Kings|23|32: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.
verses.2 Kings|23|33: And Pharaoh-nechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of a hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.
verses.2 Kings|23|34: And Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in place of Josiah, his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt where he died.
verses.2 Kings|23|35: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give it to Pharaoh-nechoh.
verses.2 Kings|23|36: Jehoiakim was twenty five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
verses.2 Kings|23|37: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.
verses.2 Kings|24|1: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant for three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.
verses.2 Kings|24|2: And the Lord sent against him bands of Chaldeans, and bands of Syria, and bands of Moab, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the Lord, which he spoke by his servants the prophets.
verses.2 Kings|24|3: Surely at the commandment of the Lord came this upon Judah, to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;
verses.2 Kings|24|4: and also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the Lord would not pardon.
verses.2 Kings|24|5: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.2 Kings|24|6: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.
verses.2 Kings|24|7: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the wadi of Egypt to the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.
verses.2 Kings|24|8: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother's name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
verses.2 Kings|24|9: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father had done.
verses.2 Kings|24|10: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.
verses.2 Kings|24|11: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants besieged it.
verses.2 Kings|24|12: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.
verses.2 Kings|24|13: And he carried out from there all the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king's house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the Lord, as the Lord had said.
verses.2 Kings|24|14: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty warriors, ten thousand exiles, and all the craftsmen and the smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.
verses.2 Kings|24|15: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king's mother, and the king's wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, those he took away into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.2 Kings|24|16: And all the men of might, seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all that were strong and apt for war, even them the king of Babylon took into exile to Babylon.
verses.2 Kings|24|17: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father's brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
verses.2 Kings|24|18: Zedekiah was twenty one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.
verses.2 Kings|24|19: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.2 Kings|24|20: For through the anger of the Lord it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence; and Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.2 Kings|25|1: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and camped against it; and they built a siege wall against it round about.
verses.2 Kings|25|2: And the city was besieged until the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
verses.2 Kings|25|3: And on the ninth day of the (fourth) month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.
verses.2 Kings|25|4: And a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which is by the king's garden: (now the Chaldeans were against the city round about:) and they went in the direction of the Arabah.
verses.2 Kings|25|5: And the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.
verses.2 Kings|25|6: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.
verses.2 Kings|25|7: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.
verses.2 Kings|25|8: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem:
verses.2 Kings|25|9: and he burnt the house of the Lord, and the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great house he burnt with fire.
verses.2 Kings|25|10: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard pulled down the walls of Jerusalem round about.
verses.2 Kings|25|11: Now the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carry away into exile.
verses.2 Kings|25|12: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and fieldworkers.
verses.2 Kings|25|13: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of the Lord, and the bases, and the brazen sea that was in the house of the Lord, did the Chaldeans break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.
verses.2 Kings|25|14: And the pans, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass with which they ministered, they took away.
verses.2 Kings|25|15: And the firepans, and the basins, and such things as were of gold, in gold, and of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.
verses.2 Kings|25|16: The pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the Lord; the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
verses.2 Kings|25|17: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the capital upon it was brass: and the height of the capital three cubits; and there was wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the capital round about, all of brass: and like capital round about, all of brass: and like thee with wreathen work was the second pillar also.
verses.2 Kings|25|18: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah a priest of the second order, and the three keepers of the door:
verses.2 Kings|25|19: and out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king's presence, who were found in the city, and the scribe, of the commander of the host, who kept the muster of the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city:
verses.2 Kings|25|20: and Nebuzar-adan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:
verses.2 Kings|25|21: and the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.
verses.2 Kings|25|22: And as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, he appointed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan over them.
verses.2 Kings|25|23: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, also Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathites, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maachathites, they and their men.
verses.2 Kings|25|24: And Gedaliah swore to them, and to their men, and said to them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.
verses.2 Kings|25|25: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal seed, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, together with the men of Judah and the Chaldeans that were with him of Mizpah.
verses.2 Kings|25|26: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.
verses.2 Kings|25|27: And it came to pass in the thirty seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty seventh day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;
verses.2 Kings|25|28: and he spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the other kings that were with him in Babylon;
verses.2 Kings|25|29: and he changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life:
verses.2 Kings|25|30: and as for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the king, a daily portion for every day, all the days of his life.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|5: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|6: And the sons of Gommer; Ashkenaz, and Difat, and Togarmah.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|7: And the sons of Javan; Elisha, and Tarshisha, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|8: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Egypt, Put, and Canaan.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|9: And the sons of Cush; Sheba, and Havilah, and Sabtecha, and Ramah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Ramah; Seba, and Dedan.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|10: And Cush begot Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|11: And Egypt begot Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naftuhim,
verses.1 Chronicles|1|12: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came to the Philistines,) and Caphtorim.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|13: And Canaan begot Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,
verses.1 Chronicles|1|14: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
verses.1 Chronicles|1|15: and the Hivite and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.1 Chronicles|1|16: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|17: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|18: And Arphaxad begot Shelah, and Shelah begot Eber.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|19: And to Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother's name was Joktan.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|20: And Joktan begot Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.1 Chronicles|1|21: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.1 Chronicles|1|22: and Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.1 Chronicles|1|23: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|28: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|29: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.1 Chronicles|1|30: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
verses.1 Chronicles|1|31: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|32: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bore Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|33: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|34: And Abraham begot Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|35: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|36: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Teman, and Amalek.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|37: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|38: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|39: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timnah was Lotan's sister.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|40: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|41: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Hamran, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|42: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|43: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|44: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|45: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temani reigned in his place.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|46: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place: and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|47: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|48: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his place.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|49: And when Shaul was dead, Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|50: And when Baal-hanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his place: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.1 Chronicles|1|51: Hadad died also. And the chiefs of Edom were; chief Timnah, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
verses.1 Chronicles|1|52: chief Aholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
verses.1 Chronicles|1|53: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
verses.1 Chronicles|1|54: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|1: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
verses.1 Chronicles|2|2: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|3: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born to him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanite woman. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the Lord; and he slew him.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|4: And Tamar his daughter in law bore him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|5: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|6: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dare: five of them in all.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|7: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the devoted property.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|8: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|9: And the sons of Hezron, that were born to him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|10: And Ram begot Amminadab; and Amminadab begot Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
verses.1 Chronicles|2|11: and Nahshon begot Salma, and Salma begot Boaz,
verses.1 Chronicles|2|12: and Boaz begot Obed, and Obed begot Jesse,
verses.1 Chronicles|2|13: and Ishai begot his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,
verses.1 Chronicles|2|14: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
verses.1 Chronicles|2|15: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:
verses.1 Chronicles|2|16: whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel; three.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|17: And Abigail bore Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|18: And Caleb the son of Hezron, begot children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|19: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took to him Ephratah, who bore him Hur.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|20: And Hur begot Uri, and Uri begot Bezaleel.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|21: And afterwards Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|22: And Segub begot Jair, who had twenty three cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|23: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with Havoth-jair, from them, with Kenath, and its hamlets, sixty cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|24: And after Hezron had died in Caleb-ephratah, then Abijah, Hezron's wife bore him Ashur the father of Tekoa.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|25: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|26: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|27: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|28: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|29: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bore him Ahban, and Molid.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|30: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim; but Seled died without children.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|31: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi, And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|32: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|33: And the sons of Jonathan; Pelet, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|34: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. And Sheshan had a slave, a Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|35: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his slave to wife; and she bore him Attai.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|36: And Attai begot Nathan, and Nathan begot Zabad.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|37: and Zabad begot Ephlal, and Ephlal begot Obed,
verses.1 Chronicles|2|38: and Obed begot Jehu, and Jehu begot Azariah,
verses.1 Chronicles|2|39: and Azariah begot Helez, and Helez begot Eleasah,
verses.1 Chronicles|2|40: and Eleasah begot Sisamai, and Sisamai begot Shallum,
verses.1 Chronicles|2|41: and Shallum begot Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begot Elishama.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|42: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|43: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|44: And Shema begot Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begot Shammai.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|45: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|46: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bore Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begot Gazez.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|47: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|48: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bore Sheber, and Tirhanah.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|49: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibeah: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|50: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim,
verses.1 Chronicles|2|51: Salma the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|52: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Menuhot.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|53: And the families of Kirjath-jearim; the Jitri, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zorathites, and the Eshtaulites.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|54: The sons of Salma; Beth-lehem, and the Netophathites, Atrot-bet-joab, and half the Manahti, and the Zorites.
verses.1 Chronicles|2|55: And the families of the scribes who dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, the Suchathites. These are the Qinim who came of Hamath, the father of the house of Rechab.
verses.1 Chronicles|3|1: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess woman; Daniel of Abigail the Carmelite woman:
verses.1 Chronicles|3|2: the third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
verses.1 Chronicles|3|3: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
verses.1 Chronicles|3|4: These six were born to him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty three years.
verses.1 Chronicles|3|5: And these were born to him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon; four, of Bat-Shua the daughter of Ammiel:
verses.1 Chronicles|3|6: and Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
verses.1 Chronicles|3|7: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.1 Chronicles|3|8: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet; nine.
verses.1 Chronicles|3|9: These were all the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
verses.1 Chronicles|3|10: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.1 Chronicles|3|11: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.1 Chronicles|3|12: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.1 Chronicles|3|13: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.1 Chronicles|3|14: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
verses.1 Chronicles|3|15: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
verses.1 Chronicles|3|16: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
verses.1 Chronicles|3|17: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Shealtiel his son.
verses.1 Chronicles|3|18: and Malchiram, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.1 Chronicles|3|19: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah and Shelomith their sister:
verses.1 Chronicles|3|20: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed; five.
verses.1 Chronicles|3|21: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jeshaaia: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
verses.1 Chronicles|3|22: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igal, and Bariah, and Neariah; and Shaphat, six.
verses.1 Chronicles|3|23: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam; three.
verses.1 Chronicles|3|24: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaviah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani; seven.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|1: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|2: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begot Jahath; and Jahath begot Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|3: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi;
verses.1 Chronicles|4|4: and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Beth-lehem.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|5: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|6: And Naarah bore him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|7: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Zohar, and Ethnan.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|8: And Coz begot Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|9: And Jabez was more honourable than his brothers; and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bore him with pain.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|10: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that Thou wouldst bless me indeed, and enlarge my border, and that Thy hand might be with me, and that Thou wouldst keep me from harm, that it may not hurt me! And God granted him that which he requested.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|11: And Chelub the brother of Shuha begot Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|12: And Eshton begot Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Rechah.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|13: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel: Hathath.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|14: And Meonothai begot Ophrah: and Seraiah begot Joab, the father of the Charashim; for they were craftsmen.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|15: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|16: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziph, Tiria, and Asareel.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|17: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she conceived Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|18: And his wife Jehudijah bore Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Shocho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bitya the daughter of Pharaoh whom Mered took.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|19: And the sons of the wife of Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|20: And the sons of Simeon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|21: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of the linen workers, of the house of Ashbea,
verses.1 Chronicles|4|22: and Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who ruled in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem (But the records are ancient.)
verses.1 Chronicles|4|23: These were the potters, and those who dwelt among plantations and hedges: there they dwelt, occupied with the king's work.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|24: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah and Shaul:
verses.1 Chronicles|4|25: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|26: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|27: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers had not many children, nor did all their family multiply, like the children of Judah.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|28: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|29: and at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
verses.1 Chronicles|4|30: and at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
verses.1 Chronicles|4|31: and at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-birei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until the reign of David.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|32: And their settlements were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan; five cities:
verses.1 Chronicles|4|33: and all their settlements that were round about the same cities as far as Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|34: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|35: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
verses.1 Chronicles|4|36: and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|37: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
verses.1 Chronicles|4|38: these mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|39: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, as far as the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|40: And they found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|41: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the Mehunim who were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their stead: because there was pasture there for their flocks.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|42: And some of them, of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having as their leaders Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
verses.1 Chronicles|4|43: And they smote the remnant of Amalek who had escaped, and dwelt there to this day.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|1: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, since he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: but not so as to have the birthright attributed to him by genealogy.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|2: For Judah prevailed over his brothers, and of him came the chief ruler; though the birthright was Joseph's:)
verses.1 Chronicles|5|3: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|4: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
verses.1 Chronicles|5|5: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
verses.1 Chronicles|5|6: Beera his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away into exile: he was prince of the Reubenites.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|7: And his brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
verses.1 Chronicles|5|8: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, as far as Nebo and Baal-meon:
verses.1 Chronicles|5|9: and eastward he inhabited as far as the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle had multiplied in the land of Gilead.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|10: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|11: And the children of Gad dwelt opposite them, in the land of the Bashan as far as Salchah:
verses.1 Chronicles|5|12: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Janai, and Shaphat in the Bashan.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|13: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Eber; seven.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|14: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
verses.1 Chronicles|5|15: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|16: And they dwelt in Gilead in the Bashan, and in its hamlets, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon, to their limits.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|17: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|18: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of men at arms, able to bear shield and sword, and to draw the bow, and skilful in war, were forty four thousand seven hundred and sixty, who went out to war.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|19: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|20: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he granted their entreaty: because they put their trust in him.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|21: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men a hundred thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|22: For there fell down many slain, because the war was from God. And they dwelt in their stead until the exile.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|23: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan to Baal-hermon and Senir, and to mount Hermon.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|24: And these were the heads of the houses of their fathers, Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the houses of their fathers.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|25: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went astray after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|26: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, namely the Reubenites, and the God, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, to this day.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|27: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|28: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|29: And the children of Amram: Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.1 Chronicles|5|30: Eleazar begot Phinehas, Phinehas begot Abishua,
verses.1 Chronicles|5|31: and Abishua begot Bukki, and Bukki begot Uzzi,
verses.1 Chronicles|5|32: and Uzzi begot Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begot Meraioth;
verses.1 Chronicles|5|33: Meraioth begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub,
verses.1 Chronicles|5|34: and Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Ahimaaz,
verses.1 Chronicles|5|35: and Ahimaaz begot Azariah, and Azariah begot Johanan,
verses.1 Chronicles|5|36: and Johanan begot Azariah, (he it is who executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
verses.1 Chronicles|5|37: and Azariah begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub,
verses.1 Chronicles|5|38: and Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Shallum,
verses.1 Chronicles|5|39: and Shallum begot Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begot Azariah,
verses.1 Chronicles|5|40: and Azariah begot Seraiah, and Seraiah begot Josedech,
verses.1 Chronicles|5|41: and Josedech went into exile, when the Lord carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|1: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|2: And these are the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|3: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|4: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|5: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|6: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|7: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|8: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|9: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|10: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|11: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|12: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|13: And the sons of Shemuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abijah.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|14: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|15: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|16: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the Lord, after the ark had rest.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|17: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the Tent of Meeting with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem: and then they performed their office according to their order.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|18: And these are the men who served with their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites; Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|19: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|20: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|21: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|22: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|23: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|24: and his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, Asaph the son of Berechiah, son of Shimea,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|25: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|26: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|27: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|28: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|29: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|30: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|31: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|32: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|33: And their brethren the Levites were appointed to all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|34: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|35: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|36: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|37: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|38: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|39: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their encampments in their borders, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|40: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands round about it.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|41: But the fields of the city, and its farmsteads, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|42: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, and Libnah with its pasture lands, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with its pasture lands,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|43: and Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|44: and Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth-shemesh with its pasture lands:
verses.1 Chronicles|6|45: and out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with its pasture lands, and Alemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|46: And to the rest of the sons of Kohath, were given by lot, out of the family of that tribe, out of the half tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|47: And to the sons of Gershom according to their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in the Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|48: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|49: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their pasture lands.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|50: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are mentioned by names.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|51: And some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|52: For they gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with its pasture lands; and Gezer with its pasture lands,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|53: and Jokmeam with its pasture lands, and Beth-horon with its pasture lands,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|54: and Aijalon with its pasture lands, and Gath-rimmon with its pasture lands:
verses.1 Chronicles|6|55: and out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with its pasture lands, and Balaam with its pasture lands, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|56: To the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in the Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands:
verses.1 Chronicles|6|57: and out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath, with its pasture lands,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|58: and Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands:
verses.1 Chronicles|6|59: and out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with its pasture lands, and Abdon with its pasture lands,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|60: and Hukok with its pasture lands and Rehob with its pasture lands:
verses.1 Chronicles|6|61: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in the Galilee with its pasture lands, and Hammon with its pasture lands, and Kirjathaim with its pasture lands.
verses.1 Chronicles|6|62: To the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with its pasture lands, Tabor with its pasture lands:
verses.1 Chronicles|6|63: and on the other side of Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them out of the tribes of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, and Jahzah with its pasture lands,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|64: and Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands:
verses.1 Chronicles|6|65: and out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in the Gilead with its pasture lands, and Mahanaim with its pasture lands,
verses.1 Chronicles|6|66: and Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|1: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|2: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's houses, that is, of Tola; were valiant men at arms in their generations: their number in the days of David was twenty two thousand six hundred.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|3: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michal, and Obadiah and Joel, Isshiah; five: all of them chief men.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|4: And with them, by their generations, after the houses of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war; thirty six thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|5: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar, valiant men at arms, reckoned in all by their genealogies, eighty seven thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|6: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael; three.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|7: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri; five; heads of the houses of their fathers, mighty men at arms; and were reckoned by their genealogies, twenty two thousand and thirty four.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|8: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jeremoth, and Abijah, and Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|9: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the houses of their fathers, mighty men at arms, was twenty thousand two hundred.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|10: And the sons of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|11: All these were the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men at arms, seventeen thousand two hundred, fit to go out to war and battle.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|12: And Shuppim, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|13: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|14: The sons of Manasseh; Asriel, whom she bore: (but his concubine, the Syrian woman, bore Machir the father of Gilead:
verses.1 Chronicles|7|15: and Machir took to wife one of the family of Huppim and Shuppim, a sister, whose name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|16: And Maachah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rekem.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|17: And the son of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|18: And his sister Hammoleketh bore Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahlah.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|19: And the sons of Shemida were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|20: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
verses.1 Chronicles|7|21: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|22: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|23: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bore a son, and he called his name Beriah, because evil had befallen his house.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|24: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built both the lower and the upper Beth-horon, and Uzzen-sherah.)
verses.1 Chronicles|7|25: And Rephah was his son, and Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
verses.1 Chronicles|7|26: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
verses.1 Chronicles|7|27: Non his son, Joshua his son.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|28: And their possessions and habitations were Beth-el and its hamlets, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with its hamlets; and Shechem and its hamlets, as far as Gaza and its hamlets:
verses.1 Chronicles|7|29: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and its hamlets, Taanach and its hamlets, Megiddo and its hamlets, Dor and its hamlets. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|30: The sons of Asher; Jimna, and Jishba, and Jishbi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|31: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|32: And Heber begot Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|33: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|34: And the sons of Shemer; Ahi, and Rohgah, and Hubbah, and Aram.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|35: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Jimna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|36: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
verses.1 Chronicles|7|37: Bezer, and Hod, and Shammah, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|38: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|39: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Hanniel, and Rezia.
verses.1 Chronicles|7|40: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father's houses, choice and mighty men at arms, chiefs of the princes. And the number reckoned by genealogy of those who were apt for war and battle was twenty six thousand men.
verses.1 Chronicles|8|1: Now Benjamin begot Bela his firstborn. Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
verses.1 Chronicles|8|2: Nohah the fourth, and Raphah the fifth.
verses.1 Chronicles|8|3: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
verses.1 Chronicles|8|4: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
verses.1 Chronicles|8|5: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
verses.1 Chronicles|8|6: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers' houses of the inhabitants of Geba, and they were exiled into Manahath:
verses.1 Chronicles|8|7: and Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he exiled them, and begot Uzza, and Ahihud.
verses.1 Chronicles|8|8: And Shaharaim begot children in the field of Moab, after he had sent away Hushim and Baara his wives.
verses.1 Chronicles|8|9: And he begot of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibiah, and Mesha, and Malcham,
verses.1 Chronicles|8|10: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers' houses.
verses.1 Chronicles|8|11: And of Hushim he begot Abitub, and Elpaal.
verses.1 Chronicles|8|12: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with its hamlets:
verses.1 Chronicles|8|13: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers' houses of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
verses.1 Chronicles|8|15: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Eder,
verses.1 Chronicles|8|16: and Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
verses.1 Chronicles|8|17: and Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
verses.1 Chronicles|8|18: and Ishmerai, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
verses.1 Chronicles|8|19: and Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
verses.1 Chronicles|8|20: and Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
verses.1 Chronicles|8|21: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimei;
verses.1 Chronicles|8|22: and Ishpan, and Eber, and Eliel,
verses.1 Chronicles|8|23: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
verses.1 Chronicles|8|24: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
verses.1 Chronicles|8|25: and Jifdeya, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
verses.1 Chronicles|8|26: and Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
verses.1 Chronicles|8|27: and Jaresiah, and Elijah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
verses.1 Chronicles|8|28: These were heads of the father's houses, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.1 Chronicles|8|29: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name was Maachah:
verses.1 Chronicles|8|30: and his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
verses.1 Chronicles|8|31: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.
verses.1 Chronicles|8|32: And Mikloth begot Shimea. And these also dwelt opposite their brethren in Jerusalem, with their brethren.
verses.1 Chronicles|8|33: And Ner begot Kish, and Kish begot Saul, and Saul begot Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
verses.1 Chronicles|8|34: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begot Micah.
verses.1 Chronicles|8|35: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
verses.1 Chronicles|8|36: And Ahaz begot Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begot Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begot Moza,
verses.1 Chronicles|8|37: and Moza begot Binea: Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
verses.1 Chronicles|8|38: and Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.1 Chronicles|8|39: And the sons of Esek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.1 Chronicles|8|40: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men at arms, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, a hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|1: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel; and Judah was carried away to Babylon for their transgression.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|2: Now the first inhabitants who dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the temple servants.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|3: And in Jerusalem dwelt some of the children of Judah, and some of the children of Benjamin, and some of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;
verses.1 Chronicles|9|4: Utai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|5: And of the Shilonite; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|6: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|7: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Senuah,
verses.1 Chronicles|9|8: and Ibnijah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
verses.1 Chronicles|9|9: and their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty six. All these men were chiefs of the fathers in the houses of their fathers.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|10: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
verses.1 Chronicles|9|11: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
verses.1 Chronicles|9|12: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
verses.1 Chronicles|9|13: and their brethren, heads of the houses of their fathers, a thousand seven hundred and sixty; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|14: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hashshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.1 Chronicles|9|15: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
verses.1 Chronicles|9|16: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who dwelt in the settlements of the Netophathites.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|17: And the gatekeepers were; Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: (Shallum being the chief;)
verses.1 Chronicles|9|18: who were hitherto stationed at the king's gate eastward; they were gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|19: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the threshold of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the camp of the Lord, were keepers of the entry.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|20: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the Lord was with him.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|21: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was keeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|22: All these who were chosen to be keepers in the thresholds were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their settlements, whom David and Samuel the seer did establish in their office of trust.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|23: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the Lord, the house of the tabernacle, by watches.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|24: On the four sides were the gatekeepers; east, west, north, and south.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|25: And their brethren, who were in their settlements, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them.
