verses.1 Chronicles|9|26: For these Levites, the four chief gatekeepers, were in an office of trust, and were appointed over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|27: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and they had the duty of opening it every morning.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|28: And certain of them had the charge of the vessels of service, that they should bring them in by number and out by number.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|29: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|30: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|31: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with that which was prepared in the pans.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|32: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the showbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|33: And these were the singers, chiefs of the fathers' houses of the Levites, dwelling in the temple chambers free from other duties: for they were employed in that work day and night.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|34: These were chiefs of fathers' houses of the Levites, chief men by their generations; these dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|35: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, whose wife's name was Maachah:
verses.1 Chronicles|9|36: and his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
verses.1 Chronicles|9|37: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|38: And Mikloth begot Shimeam. And they also dwelt opposite their brethren in Jerusalem, with their brethren.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|39: And Ner begot Kish; and Kish begot Saul; and Saul begot Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|40: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begot Micah.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|41: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea,
verses.1 Chronicles|9|42: and Ahaz begot Jarah; and Jarah begot Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begot Moza;
verses.1 Chronicles|9|43: and Moza begot Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.1 Chronicles|9|44: And Azel had six sons, whose names were these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
verses.1 Chronicles|10|1: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines and fell down slain on mount Gilboa.
verses.1 Chronicles|10|2: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
verses.1 Chronicles|10|3: And the battle went hard against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was in dread because of the archers.
verses.1 Chronicles|10|4: Then Saul said to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and pierce me with it; lest these uncircumcised ones come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was much afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
verses.1 Chronicles|10|5: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
verses.1 Chronicles|10|6: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
verses.1 Chronicles|10|7: And when all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.1 Chronicles|10|8: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen on mount Gilboa.
verses.1 Chronicles|10|9: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings to their idols, and to the people.
verses.1 Chronicles|10|10: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
verses.1 Chronicles|10|11: And when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.1 Chronicles|10|12: they arose, all the men at arms, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the terebinth in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.1 Chronicles|10|13: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the Lord, against the word of the Lord, which he did not keep, and also for asking counsel of a medium, to make inquiry;
verses.1 Chronicles|10|14: and he inquired not of the Lord: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|1: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|2: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he who didst lead out Israel and bring them in: and the Lord thy God said to thee, Thou shalt be shepherd over my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|3: Therefore all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by Samuel.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|4: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebus were, the inhabitants of the land.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|5: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come here. Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion, which is the city of David.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|6: And David said, Whoever smites the Jebusite first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and became the chief.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|7: And David dwelt in the stronghold; therefore they called it the city of David.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|8: And he built the city round about, even from the Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|9: So David grew greater and greater: for the Lord of hosts was with him.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|10: These also are the chiefs of the mighty men whom David had, who held fast to him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|11: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, the son of Hachmoni, the chief of the captains: he swung his spear over three hundred slain at one time.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|12: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|13: He was with David at Pas-dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|14: And they set themselves in the midst of that plot, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the Lord saved them by a great deliverance.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|15: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|16: And David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then at Beth-lehem.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|17: And David longed, and said, Oh that someone would give me water of the well of Beth-lehem, that is by the gate, to drink!
verses.1 Chronicles|11|18: And those three broke through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the Lord,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|19: and he said, far be it from me before my God, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives have they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|20: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief among the three: and he swung his spear over three hundred slain, and had a name among the three.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|21: Of the three in the second rank he was most honourable; therefore he was their captain: but he attained not to the first three.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|22: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionhearted men of Moab: and he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a time of snow.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|23: And he slew a Egyptian man, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|24: These things Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did, and he had a name among the three mighty ones.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|25: Behold, he was renowned among the thirty, but did not attain to the first three: and David set him over his guard.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|26: And the valiant men of the armies were Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|27: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|28: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi-ezer the Antothite,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|29: Sibbechai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|30: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|31: Itai the son of Rive of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|32: Hurai of the wadis of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|33: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|34: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|35: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|36: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|37: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|38: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|39: Zelek the Ammonite, Nahrai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|40: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|41: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|42: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him.
verses.1 Chronicles|11|43: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|44: Uzziah the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|45: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|46: Eliel from Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Jitma the Moabite,
verses.1 Chronicles|11|47: Eliel, and Obed, and Jaasiel of Mezobaia.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|1: Now these are they who came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself shut up because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|2: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and shooting arrows from the bow; they were of Saul's brethren of Benjamin.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|3: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Met, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,
verses.1 Chronicles|12|4: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty;
verses.1 Chronicles|12|5: and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite,
verses.1 Chronicles|12|6: Eluzai and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
verses.1 Chronicles|12|7: Elkanah, and Isshiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,
verses.1 Chronicles|12|8: and Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|9: And of the Gadites there separated themselves to David into the stronghold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war apt for battle, who could handle shield and spear, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and who were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;
verses.1 Chronicles|12|10: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.1 Chronicles|12|11: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.1 Chronicles|12|12: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.1 Chronicles|12|13: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
verses.1 Chronicles|12|14: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|15: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: the least was over a hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|16: These are they who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all those of the valleys, both towards the east, and towards the west.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|17: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the stronghold, to David.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|18: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said to them, If you are come peaceably to me to help me, my heart shall be knit to you: but if you are come to betray me to my enemies, seeing there is no wrong in my hands, then let the God of our fathers see, and rebuke you.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|19: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be to thee, and peace be to thy helpers; for thy God helps thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|20: And some of Manasseh deserted to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they did not help them: for the lords of the Philistines took counsel and sent him away, saying, He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|21: As he went to Ziklag, there deserted to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|22: And they helped David against the troop of raiders: for they were all mighty men at arms, and they were captains in the host.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|23: For at that time day by day men came over to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|24: And these are the numbers of the bands of the armed troops who came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul over to him, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|25: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed troops.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|26: Of the children of Simeon mighty men at arms for the war, seven thousand one hundred.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|27: Of the children of Levi four thousand six hundred.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|28: And Jehoiada was the leader of the house of Aaron, and with him three thousand seven hundred;
verses.1 Chronicles|12|29: and Zadok, a young mighty man at arms, and of his father's home, twenty two captains.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|30: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to the house of Saul.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|31: And of the children of Ephraim were twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men at arms, famous throughout the houses of their fathers.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|32: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, who were expressly named, to come and make David king.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|33: And of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|34: Of Zebulun, such as went out to battle, expert in war, with all weapons of war, fifty thousand; and who ranged themselves with undivided loyalty.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|35: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty seven thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|36: And of the Danites expert in war twenty eight thousand six hundred.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|37: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|38: And on the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of weapons of war for the battle, a hundred and twenty thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|39: All these men of war, ranged in battle order, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|40: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.
verses.1 Chronicles|12|41: Also their neighbours as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and provisions of meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep in abundance: for there was joy in Israel.
verses.1 Chronicles|13|1: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.
verses.1 Chronicles|13|2: And David said to all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good to you, and that it be of the Lord our God, let us send abroad to our brethren everywhere, who are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites who are in their cities that have pasture lands that they may gather themselves to us:
verses.1 Chronicles|13|3: and let us bring back the ark of our God to us: for we did not inquire at it in the days of Saul.
verses.1 Chronicles|13|4: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing seemed right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.1 Chronicles|13|5: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt as far as the entrance of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.
verses.1 Chronicles|13|6: And David went up, and all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kirjath-jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God the Lord, who dwells above the keruvim, by whose name it is called.
verses.1 Chronicles|13|7: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
verses.1 Chronicles|13|8: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with lyres, and with lutes, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
verses.1 Chronicles|13|9: And when they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen shook it.
verses.1 Chronicles|13|10: And the anger of the Lord burned against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.
verses.1 Chronicles|13|11: And David was vexed, because the Lord had broken out upon Uzza: so that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.
verses.1 Chronicles|13|12: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?
verses.1 Chronicles|13|13: So David did not bring the ark to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
verses.1 Chronicles|13|14: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house for three months. And the Lord blessed the house of Obed-edom and all that he had.
verses.1 Chronicles|14|1: Now Huram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him a house.
verses.1 Chronicles|14|2: And David perceived that the Lord had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for the sake of his people Israel.
verses.1 Chronicles|14|3: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begot more sons and daughters.
verses.1 Chronicles|14|4: Now these are the names of his children whom he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.1 Chronicles|14|5: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
verses.1 Chronicles|14|6: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.1 Chronicles|14|7: and Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.
verses.1 Chronicles|14|8: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.
verses.1 Chronicles|14|9: And the Philistines came and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.1 Chronicles|14|10: And David inquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt Thou deliver them into my hand? And the Lord said to him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thy hand.
verses.1 Chronicles|14|11: So they came up to Baal-perazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God has broken through my enemies by my hand like a bursting flood of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
verses.1 Chronicles|14|12: And they left their gods there and David gave command, that they should be burned with fire.
verses.1 Chronicles|14|13: And the Philistines once again made a raid in the valley.
verses.1 Chronicles|14|14: So David inquired again of God; and God said to him, Do not go up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them opposite the bakha trees.
verses.1 Chronicles|14|15: And let it be, when thou shalt hear a sound of marching in the tops of the bakha trees, then thou shalt go out to battle: for God has gone out before thee to smite the camp of the Philistines.
verses.1 Chronicles|14|16: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the camp of the Philistines from Gibeon as far as Gezer.
verses.1 Chronicles|14|17: And David's renown went out into all the lands; and the Lord brought the fear of him upon all nations.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|1: And David made houses for himself in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|2: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for the Lord has chosen them to carry the ark of God, and to minister to him forever.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|3: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the Lord to its place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|4: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:
verses.1 Chronicles|15|5: of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren a hundred and twenty:
verses.1 Chronicles|15|6: of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:
verses.1 Chronicles|15|7: of the sons of Gershom: Joel the chief, and his brethren a hundred and thirty:
verses.1 Chronicles|15|8: of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:
verses.1 Chronicles|15|9: of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren eighty:
verses.1 Chronicles|15|10: of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren a hundred and twelve.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|11: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.1 Chronicles|15|12: and he said to them, You are the chiefs of the fathers' houses of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, you and your brethren, that you may bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel to the place that I have prepared for it.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|13: For because you did not do so at first, the Lord our God made a breach upon us, because we did not seek him according to the prescribed form.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|14: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|15: And the children of the Levites bore the ark of God upon their shoulders the bars being upon them, as Moses had commanded according to the word of the Lord.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|16: And David spoke to the chiefs of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of music, lutes and lyres and cymbals, playing loudly to raise sounds of joy.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|17: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.1 Chronicles|15|18: and with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the gatekeepers.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|19: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;
verses.1 Chronicles|15|20: and Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with lutes to Alamoth;
verses.1 Chronicles|15|21: and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with lyres to the Sheminith to lead.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|22: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the song: he was master in the song, because he was skilful.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|23: And Berechiah and Elkanah were gatekeepers for the ark.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|24: And Shebaniah, and Joshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow on the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed-edom and Jehiah were gatekeepers for the ark.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|25: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over the thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|26: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|27: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites who bore the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an efod of linen.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|28: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting, and with the sound of the shofar, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with lutes and lyres.
verses.1 Chronicles|15|29: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the Lord came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking through a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|1: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had set up for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|2: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|3: And he distributed to every one of Israel both men and women, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of meat, and a cake of raisins.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|4: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord, and to invoke and to thank and praise the Lord God of Israel.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|5: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom: and Jeiel with lutes and with lyres; but Asaph was to sound the cymbals;
verses.1 Chronicles|16|6: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|7: Then on that day David first delivered this psalm (to thank the Lord) into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|8: Give thanks to the Lord, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the peoples.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|9: Sing to him, sing psalms to him, talk of all his wondrous works.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|10: Glory in his holy name: let the heart of those who seek the Lord rejoice.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|11: Seek the Lord and his strength, seek his face continually.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|12: Remember his marvellous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.1 Chronicles|16|13: O seed of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|14: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are on all the earth.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|15: Be mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;
verses.1 Chronicles|16|16: which he made with Abraham, and of his oath to Isaac;
verses.1 Chronicles|16|17: and he confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
verses.1 Chronicles|16|18: saying, To thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;
verses.1 Chronicles|16|19: when you were but a few men in number, of little account and sojourners there:
verses.1 Chronicles|16|20: when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;
verses.1 Chronicles|16|21: he suffered no man to do them wrong: but he reproved kings for their sakes, saying,
verses.1 Chronicles|16|22: Do not touch any anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|23: Sing to the Lord, all the earth; announce his salvation from day to day.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|24: Declare his glory among the nations; his marvellous works among all peoples.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|25: For great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: and he is to be feared above all gods.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|26: For all the gods of the peoples are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|27: Honour and majesty are before him; strength and gladness are in his place.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|28: Ascribe to the Lord, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|29: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due to his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|30: Tremble before him, all the earth: the world also is established, so that it shall not be moved.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|31: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let it be said among the nations, The Lord reigns.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|32: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the field rejoice, and all that is in it.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|33: Then shall the trees of the wood sing for joy at the presence of the Lord, because he comes to judge the earth.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|34: O give thanks to the Lord; for he is good; for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|35: And say, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Thy holy name, and glory in Thy praise.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|36: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the Lord.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|37: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required:
verses.1 Chronicles|16|38: and Obed-edom with their brethren, sixty eight; and Obed-edom the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers:
verses.1 Chronicles|16|39: and Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place that was at Gibeon,
verses.1 Chronicles|16|40: to offer burnt offerings to the Lord upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the Lord, which he commanded Israel;
verses.1 Chronicles|16|41: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest who were chosen, who were expressly named, to give thanks to the Lord, because his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.1 Chronicles|16|42: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for making a loud sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were posted at the gate.
verses.1 Chronicles|16|43: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|1: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in a house of cedar wood, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord remains under curtains.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|2: Then Nathan said to David, Do all that is in thy heart; for God is with thee.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|3: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.1 Chronicles|17|4: Go and tell David my servant, Thus says the Lord, Thou shalt not build me a house to dwell in:
verses.1 Chronicles|17|5: for I have not dwelt in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|6: Everywhere where I have walked among all Israel, did I speak a word to any of the judges of Israel whom I commanded to be shepherds to my people, saying, Why have you not built me a house of cedar wood?
verses.1 Chronicles|17|7: Now therefore thus shalt thou say to my servant David, Thus says the Lord of hosts, I took thee from the pasture, from following the sheep, that thou shouldst be ruler over my people Israel:
verses.1 Chronicles|17|8: and I have been with thee wherever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thy enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men who are on the earth.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|9: And I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and I will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; nor shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,
verses.1 Chronicles|17|10: and ever since the time when I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. And I will subdue all thy enemies. Moreover I declare to thee that the Lord will build thee a house.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|11: And it shall come to pass, when thy days are fulfilled when thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, who shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|12: He shall build me a house, and I will establish his throne for ever.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|13: I will be his father, and he will be my son: and I will not take my steadfast love away from him, as I took it from the one who was before thee:
verses.1 Chronicles|17|14: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|15: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, did Nathan speak to David.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|16: And David the king came and sat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my house, that Thou hast brought me so far?
verses.1 Chronicles|17|17: And as though this was too little in Thy eyes, O God, Thou hast also spoken of Thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me as a man of high degree, O Lord God.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|18: What more can David say to Thee concerning the honour done to Thy servant? for Thou knowst Thy servant.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|19: O Lord, for Thy servant's sake, and according to Thy own heart, hast Thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|20: O Lord, there is none like Thee, nor is there any God besides Thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|21: And who is like Thy people Israel, a singular nation on the earth, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make Thee a name of greatness and awesomeness, by driving out nations from before Thy people, whom Thou didst redeem out of Egypt?
verses.1 Chronicles|17|22: For Thy people Israel didst Thou make Thy own people forever; and Thou, Lord, didst become their God.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|23: Therefore now, Lord, let the thing that Thou hast spoken concerning Thy servant and concerning his house be established forever, and do as Thou hast said,
verses.1 Chronicles|17|24: So let it be established, that Thy name may be magnified forever, saying, The Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, is a God to Israel: and let the house of David Thy servant be established before Thee.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|25: For Thou, O my God, hast told Thy servant that Thou wilt build him a house: therefore Thy servant has found in his heart to pray before Thee.
verses.1 Chronicles|17|26: And now, Lord, Thou art God, and hast promised this goodness to Thy servant:
verses.1 Chronicles|17|27: and now it has pleased Thee to bless the house of Thy servant, that it may be before Thee forever: for Thou, O Lord, hast blessed it, and it shall be blessed forever.
verses.1 Chronicles|18|1: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and its hamlets out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.1 Chronicles|18|2: And he smote Moab; and Moab became David's servants, and brought tribute.
verses.1 Chronicles|18|3: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah as far as Hamath, as he went to set up his dominion by the river Euphrates.
verses.1 Chronicles|18|4: And David took from him one thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David lamed all the chariot horses, but reserved from them enough for a hundred chariots.
verses.1 Chronicles|18|5: And when Syria of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of Syria twenty two thousand men.
verses.1 Chronicles|18|6: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the people of Syria became David's servants, and brought tribute. Thus the Lord preserved David wherever he went.
verses.1 Chronicles|18|7: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.1 Chronicles|18|8: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, David took very much brass, with which Solomon made the brazen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
verses.1 Chronicles|18|9: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
verses.1 Chronicles|18|10: he sent Hadoram his son to king David, to inquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had wars with Tou;) and he had with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
verses.1 Chronicles|18|11: These also did king David dedicate to the Lord, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.1 Chronicles|18|12: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of Edom in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|18|13: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all Edom became David's servants. Thus the Lord preserved David wherever he went.
verses.1 Chronicles|18|14: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
verses.1 Chronicles|18|15: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, was recorder.
verses.1 Chronicles|18|16: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
verses.1 Chronicles|18|17: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief ministers about the king.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|1: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|2: And David said, I will deal loyally with Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father dealt loyally with me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|3: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David honours thy father, that he has sent comforters to thee? are not his servants come to thee to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?
verses.1 Chronicles|19|4: So Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle to their hips, and sent them away.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|5: Then there went certain persons, and told David how the men had been treated. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards are grown, and then return.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|6: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria-maachah, and out of Zobah.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|7: So they hired thirty two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and encamped before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|8: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|9: And the children of Ammon came out, and ranged themselves in battle before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|10: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice men of Israel, and ranged them against Syria.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|11: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother, and they ranged themselves against the children of Ammon.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|12: And he said, If Syria is too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon are too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|13: Be of good courage, and let us prove strong for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the Lord do that which is good in his sight:
verses.1 Chronicles|19|14: So Joab and the people that were with him drew near before Syria to the battle; and they fled before him.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|15: And when the children of Ammon saw that Syria had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|16: And when Syria saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and brought out the men of Syria who were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|17: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over the Jordan, and came upon them, and ranged himself against them. So David put the battle in array against Syria, and they fought with him.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|18: But Syria fled before Israel; and David slew of Syria seven thousand charioteers, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.
verses.1 Chronicles|19|19: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: and Syria was not willing to help the children of Ammon any more.
verses.1 Chronicles|20|1: And it came to pass, at the time of the return of the year, at the time when the kings go out to battle, that Joab led forth the power of the army, and ravaged the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David remained at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.
verses.1 Chronicles|20|2: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David's head: and he also brought very much spoil out of the city.
verses.1 Chronicles|20|3: And he brought out the people who were in it, and set them to work with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so did David deal with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.1 Chronicles|20|4: And it came to pass after this that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the Raphah; and they were subdued.
verses.1 Chronicles|20|5: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.
verses.1 Chronicles|20|6: And yet again there was war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were twenty four, six on each hand, and six on each foot: and he also was the son of the Raphah.
verses.1 Chronicles|20|7: And he insulted Israel, so Jonathan the son of Shimea, David's brother, slew him.
verses.1 Chronicles|20|8: These were born to the Raphah in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|1: And an adversary angel stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|2: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beer-sheba to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|3: And Joab answered, The Lord make his people a hundred times so many more as they are: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord's servants? why then does my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?
verses.1 Chronicles|21|4: But the king's word prevailed against Joab. So Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|5: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people to David. In all Israel there were one million one hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred and seventy thousand men that drew sword.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|6: But he did not count Levi and Benjamin among them: for the king's word was abhorrent to Joab.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|7: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|8: And David said to God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I pray thee, take away the iniquity of Thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|9: And the Lord spoke to Gad, David's seer, saying,
verses.1 Chronicles|21|10: Go and tell David, saying, Thus says the Lord, I offer thee three things: choose one of them, that I may do it to thee.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|11: So Gad came to David, and said to him, Thus say the Lord, Choose,
verses.1 Chronicles|21|12: either three years famine; or three months to be driven away before thy foes, while the sword of thy enemies overtakes thee; or else three days of the Lord's sword, namely, pestilence in the land, and the angel of the Lord destroying throughout all the border of Israel. Now therefore consider what word I shall bring back to him who sent me.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|13: And David said to Gad, I am in great distress: let me fall rather into the hand of the Lord; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|14: So the Lord sent a plague upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|15: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was about to destroy, the Lord beheld, and he relented of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, now hold thy hand. And the angel of the Lord stood by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|16: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the Lord standing between the earth and the heaven, with a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|17: And David said to God, Is it not I who commanded the people to be numbered? so that it is I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let Thy hand, I pray Thee, O Lord my God, be on me, and on my father's house; but not on Thy people, that they should be plagued.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|18: Then the angel of the Lord commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|19: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in the name of the Lord.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|20: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|21: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|22: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar on it to the Lord: thou shalt give it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|23: And Ornan said to David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering; I give it all.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|24: And king David said to Ornan, No; but I will surely buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the Lord, nor offer burnt offerings without payment.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|25: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|26: And David built there an altar to the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the Lord; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|27: And the Lord commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into its sheath.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|28: At that time when David saw that the Lord had answered him on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|29: But the tabernacle of the Lord, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.
verses.1 Chronicles|21|30: And David could not go before it to inquire of God: for he was terrified because of the sword of the angel of the Lord.
verses.1 Chronicles|22|1: Then David said, This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.
verses.1 Chronicles|22|2: And David commanded to gather together the strangers who were in the land of Israel and he set masons to hew dressed stones to build the house of God.
verses.1 Chronicles|22|3: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
verses.1 Chronicles|22|4: and cedar trees in abundance: for the men of Zidon and of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.
verses.1 Chronicles|22|5: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for the Lord must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all lands: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David provided abundant materials before his death.
verses.1 Chronicles|22|6: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build a house for the Lord God of Israel.
verses.1 Chronicles|22|7: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build a house to the name of the Lord my God:
verses.1 Chronicles|22|8: but the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build a house to my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
verses.1 Chronicles|22|9: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of tranquillity; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.
verses.1 Chronicles|22|10: He shall build a house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.
verses.1 Chronicles|22|11: Now, my son, the Lord be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the Lord thy God, as he has said of thee,
verses.1 Chronicles|22|12: Only the Lord give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge over Israel that thou mayst keep the law of the Lord thy God.
verses.1 Chronicles|22|13: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the Lord commanded Moses for Israel: be strong, and of good courage; do not dread, or be dismayed.
verses.1 Chronicles|22|14: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the Lord a hundred thousand talents of gold, and a million talents of silver; and brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: and timber and stone have I prepared; and thou mayst add to it.
verses.1 Chronicles|22|15: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of skilful men for every manner of work.
verses.1 Chronicles|22|16: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no account. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the Lord be with thee.
verses.1 Chronicles|22|17: And David commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
verses.1 Chronicles|22|18: Is not the Lord your God with you? and has he not given you rest on every side? for he has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before the Lord, and before his people.
verses.1 Chronicles|22|19: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the Lord your God; arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of the Lord God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the Lord.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|1: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|2: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|3: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upwards: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty eight thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|4: Twenty four thousand of these were to oversee the work of the house of the Lord; and six thousand were officers and judges:
verses.1 Chronicles|23|5: and four thousand were gatekeepers; and four thousand praised the Lord with the instruments which I made for praise.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|6: And David divided them into sections according to the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|7: Of the Gershonites there were: Laadan, and Shimei.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|8: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel three.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|9: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran; three. These were the chiefs of the fathers' houses of Laadan.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|10: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|11: And Jahath was the chief, and Ziza the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they became a father's house in one reckoning.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|12: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel; four.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|13: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should be sanctified as most holy, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|14: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|15: The sons of Moses were, Gershom, and Eliezer.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|16: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|17: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had no other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|18: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|19: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|20: Of the sons of Uzziel; Micah the first, and Isshiah the second.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|21: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|22: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but only daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them to wife.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|23: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|24: These were the sons of Levi according to the houses of their fathers; the heads of father's houses, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the house of the Lord, from the age of twenty years and upwards.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|25: For David said, The Lord God of Israel has given rest to his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem forever:
verses.1 Chronicles|23|26: and also to the Levites that they shall no more need to carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for its service.
verses.1 Chronicles|23|27: For by the last ordinances of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:
verses.1 Chronicles|23|28: because their station was at the side of the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the Lord, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;
verses.1 Chronicles|23|29: both for the showbread, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;
verses.1 Chronicles|23|30: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord, and likewise at evening;
verses.1 Chronicles|23|31: and whenever burnt sacrifices are offered to the Lord on the sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the appointed seasons, by number, according to the order commanded to them, continually before the Lord:
verses.1 Chronicles|23|32: and that they should keep the charge of the Tent of Meeting, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, for the service of the house of the Lord.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|1: The divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|2: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|3: And David and Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them up according to their offices in their service.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|4: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus they were divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen heads of fathers' houses and among the sons of Ithamar eight for the houses of their fathers.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|5: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for there were officers of the sanctuary, and officers of God, among the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|6: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, recorded them in the presence of the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers' houses of the priests and Levites: one father's house being chosen for Eleazar, and one chosen for Ithamar.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|7: Now the first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
verses.1 Chronicles|24|8: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
verses.1 Chronicles|24|9: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
verses.1 Chronicles|24|10: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
verses.1 Chronicles|24|11: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shechaniah,
verses.1 Chronicles|24|12: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
verses.1 Chronicles|24|13: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
verses.1 Chronicles|24|14: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
verses.1 Chronicles|24|15: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
verses.1 Chronicles|24|16: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Ezekiel,
verses.1 Chronicles|24|17: the twenty first to Jachin, the twenty second to Gamul,
verses.1 Chronicles|24|18: the twenty third to Delaiah, the twenty fourth to Maaziah.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|19: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the Lord, according to the form prescribed to them by the hand of Aaron their father, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded him.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|20: And the rest of the sons of Levi were: of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|21: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the chief was Isshiah.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|22: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|23: And the sons of Jeriah: Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|24: Of the sons of Uzziel; Micah: of the sons of Micah; Shamir.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|25: The brother of Micah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|26: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|27: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|28: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|29: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|30: And the sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites according to the houses of their fathers.
verses.1 Chronicles|24|31: These also cast lots in the same manner as their brethren the sons of Aaron, in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers' houses of the priests and Levites; the head of each father's house in the same manner as his younger brother.
verses.1 Chronicles|25|1: And David and the captains of the host separated for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with lyres, with lutes, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|2: of the sons of Asaph; Zechur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph, under the hands of Asaph, who prophesied according to the order of the king.
verses.1 Chronicles|25|3: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Isaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah; six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a lyre, to give thanks and to praise the Lord.
verses.1 Chronicles|25|4: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|5: all these were the sons of Heman the king's seer according to the word of God, who bade to lift up his horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.1 Chronicles|25|6: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the Lord, with cymbals, lutes, and lyres, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
verses.1 Chronicles|25|7: So the number of them, with their brethren who were instructed in the songs of the Lord, all who were skilful, was two hundred and eighty eight.
verses.1 Chronicles|25|8: And they cast lots, watch against watch, the small and the great alike, the teacher together with the pupil.
verses.1 Chronicles|25|9: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah; he with his brethren and sons were twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|10: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|11: the fourth to Izri, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|12: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|13: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|14: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brethren, twelve.
verses.1 Chronicles|25|15: the eighth to Isaiah, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|16: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|17: the tenth to Shimei, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|18: the eleventh to Azareel, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|19: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|20: the thirteenth to Shubael, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|21: the fourteenth to Mattithiah, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|22: the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|23: the sixteenth, to Hananiah, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|24: the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|25: the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|26: the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|27: the twentieth to Eliyyata, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|28: the twenty first to Hothir, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|29: the twenty second to Giddalti, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|30: the twenty third to Mahazioth, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.1 Chronicles|25|31: the twenty fourth to Romamti-ezer, his sons, and his brethren, twelve.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|1: Concerning the divisions of the gatekeepers: of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|2: And the sons of Meshelemiah were, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
verses.1 Chronicles|26|3: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elihoenai the seventh.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|4: And Obed-edom had sons, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,
verses.1 Chronicles|26|5: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|6: Also to Shemaiah his son were sons born, who ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men at arms.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|7: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|8: All these of the sons of Obed-edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were sixty two of Obed-edom.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|9: And Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, strong men, eighteen.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|10: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Shimri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)
verses.1 Chronicles|26|11: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|12: Among these were the divisions of the gatekeepers, among the chief men, having watches in the same manner as their brethren, to minister in the house of the Lord.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|13: And they cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to the houses of their fathers, for every gate.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|14: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northwards.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|15: To Obed-edom southwards; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|16: To Shuppim and Hosah westwards, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway that goes up, ward against ward.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|17: Eastwards were six Levites, northwards four a day, southwards four a day, and towards Asuppim two and two.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|18: At Parbar westwards, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|19: These are the divisions of the gatekeepers, among the sons of Korah, and among the sons of Merari.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|20: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the holy things.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|21: The sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Laadan, the heads of fathers' houses, of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|22: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, who were over the treasures of the house of the Lord.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|23: Of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
verses.1 Chronicles|26|24: and Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|25: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Isaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|26: This Shelomoth and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers' houses, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|27: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the Lord.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|28: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|29: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|30: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men at arms, one thousand seven hundred, had the oversight of Israel on this side of the Jordan westward in all the business of the Lord, and in the service of the king.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|31: Among the Hebronites was Jeriah the chief, among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men at arms at Jazer of Gilead.
verses.1 Chronicles|26|32: And his brethren, men at arms, two thousand seven hundred heads of fathers' houses, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the God, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and for the affairs of the king.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|1: Now the children of Israel after their number, namely, heads of fathers' houses and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions, who came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year; in every division were twenty four thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|2: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his division were twenty four thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|3: Of the children of Pharez the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|4: And over the division of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and his division, and Mikloth the ruler in his division were twenty four thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|5: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his division were twenty four thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|6: This is that Benaiah, who was the mighty one of the thirty, and over the thirty: and in his division was Ammizabad his son.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|7: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his division were twenty four thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|8: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth of Jirzah: and in his division were twenty four thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|9: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his division, were twenty four thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|10: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his division were twenty four thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|11: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbechai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his division were twenty four thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|12: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Antothite, of the Benyemini: and in his division were twenty four thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|13: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his division were twenty four thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|14: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his division were twenty four thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|15: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his division were twenty four thousand.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|16: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:
verses.1 Chronicles|27|17: of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the sons of Aaron, Zadok:
verses.1 Chronicles|27|18: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
verses.1 Chronicles|27|19: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:
verses.1 Chronicles|27|20: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
verses.1 Chronicles|27|21: of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Jiddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
verses.1 Chronicles|27|22: of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|23: But David did not take the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the Lord had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the heavens.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|24: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to count, but he did not finish, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; nor was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|25: And over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the towers, was Jonathan the son of Uzziah:
verses.1 Chronicles|27|26: and over those who did the work of the field for the tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:
verses.1 Chronicles|27|27: and over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
verses.1 Chronicles|27|28: and over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the low plains was Baal-hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:
verses.1 Chronicles|27|29: and over the herds which fed in the Sharon was Sharonite the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:
verses.1 Chronicles|27|30: and over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:
verses.1 Chronicles|27|31: and over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the stewards of the property which belonged to king David.
verses.1 Chronicles|27|32: And Jonathan David's uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons:
verses.1 Chronicles|27|33: and Ahithophel was the king's counsellor: and Hushai the Archite was the king's companion:
verses.1 Chronicles|27|34: and after Ahithophel came Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army was Joab.
verses.1 Chronicles|28|1: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that served the king by divisions, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the property and possessions of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the men at arms to Jerusalem.
verses.1 Chronicles|28|2: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had it in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and for the footstool of our God, and I had made ready for building:
verses.1 Chronicles|28|3: but God said to me, Thou shalt not build a house for my name, because thou hast been a man of battles, and hast shed blood.
verses.1 Chronicles|28|4: Yet the Lord God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever: for he has chosen Judah to be the ruler; and out of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel:
verses.1 Chronicles|28|5: and of all my sons, (for the Lord has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.
verses.1 Chronicles|28|6: And he said to me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be a father to him.
verses.1 Chronicles|28|7: Moreover I will establish his kingdom forever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.
verses.1 Chronicles|28|8: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the Lord, and in the hearing of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of the Lord your God: that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you forever.
verses.1 Chronicles|28|9: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the Lord searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found by thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off forever.
verses.1 Chronicles|28|10: Take heed now; for the Lord has chosen thee to build a house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.
verses.1 Chronicles|28|11: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of its houses and of its treasuries, and of its upper chambers, and of its inner rooms, and of the place of the ark with its covering,
verses.1 Chronicles|28|12: and the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the Lord, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the holy things:
