verses.2 Chronicles|35|11: And they killed the paschal lambs, and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands, and the Levites flayed them.
verses.2 Chronicles|35|12: And before they gave them to the divisions of the fathers' houses of the people, they set aside the burnt offering, to offer to the Lord, as it is written in the book of Moses. And so they did with the oxen.
verses.2 Chronicles|35|13: And they roasted the paschal lamb with fire according to the ordinance: but the other holy offerings they boiled in pots, and in cauldrons, and in pans, and carried them swiftly among all the people.
verses.2 Chronicles|35|14: And afterwards they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron were busy offering the burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.
verses.2 Chronicles|35|15: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king's seer; and the gatekeepers were posted at every gate; they might not depart from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.
verses.2 Chronicles|35|16: So all the service of the Lord was prepared on the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the Lord, according to the commandment of king Josiah.
verses.2 Chronicles|35|17: And the children of Israel who were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread for seven days.
verses.2 Chronicles|35|18: And there was no passover like that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; nor did any of the kings of Israel keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.2 Chronicles|35|19: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept.
verses.2 Chronicles|35|20: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him.
verses.2 Chronicles|35|21: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah? I come not against thee this day, but against the house with which I am at war: for God commanded me to make haste: forbear from meddling with God, who is with me, so that he does not destroy thee.
verses.2 Chronicles|35|22: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but he sought an opportunity to fight with him, and he did not hearken to the words of Necho from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.
verses.2 Chronicles|35|23: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants. Get me away; for I am grievously wounded.
verses.2 Chronicles|35|24: So his servants took him out of that chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in the tombs of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.
verses.2 Chronicles|35|25: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women spoke of Josiah in their laments to this day, and made them an ordinance in Israel: and, behold, they are written in the laments.
verses.2 Chronicles|35|26: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to that which was written in the law of the Lord,
verses.2 Chronicles|35|27: and his deeds, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|1: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father's stead in Jerusalem.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|2: Jehoahaz was twenty three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for three months in Jerusalem.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|3: And the king of Egypt deposed him at Jerusalem and mulcted the land a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|4: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and turned his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|5: Jehoiakim was twenty five years old when began to reign, and he reigned for eleven years in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord his God.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|6: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|7: And Nebuchadnezzar carried some of the vessels of the house of the Lord to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|8: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|9: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|10: And at the return of the year, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of the Lord, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|11: Zedekiah was twenty one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for eleven years in Jerusalem.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|12: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord his God, and did not humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the Lord.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|13: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: and he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning to the Lord God of Israel.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|14: Moreover all the chiefs of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much according to all the abominations of the nations; and polluted the house of the Lord which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|15: And the Lord God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, from morning till night; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:
verses.2 Chronicles|36|16: but they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until the wrath of the Lord mounted against his people, till there was no remedy.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|17: So he brought upon them the king of the Chaldeans, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion either upon young men, or virgins, old men, or feeble: he gave them all into his hand.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|18: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all these he brought to Babylon.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|19: And they burnt the house of God, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all its palaces with fire, and destroyed all its choice vessels.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|20: And those who had escaped from the sword he carried away into exile to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:
verses.2 Chronicles|36|21: to fulfil the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had made good her sabbaths: for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil seventy years.
verses.2 Chronicles|36|22: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, so that the word of the Lord spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all of his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
verses.2 Chronicles|36|23: Thus says Cyrus king of Persia, The Lord God of heaven has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has charged me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever is among you of all his people – the Lord his God be with him, and let him go up!
verses.Ezra|1|1: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
verses.Ezra|1|2: Thus says Cyrus king of Persia, The Lord God of heaven has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has charged me to build him a house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.
verses.Ezra|1|3: Whoever is among you of all his people, let his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the Lord God of Israel; (he is the God,) which is in Jerusalem.
verses.Ezra|1|4: And whoever remains in any place where he sojourns, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, besides the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Jerusalem.
verses.Ezra|1|5: Then rose up the chiefs of the fathers' houses of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit God had stirred to go up to build the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem.
verses.Ezra|1|6: And all they who were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, besides all that was willingly offered.
verses.Ezra|1|7: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the Lord, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;
verses.Ezra|1|8: those did Cyrus king of Persia bring out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and counted them out to Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.
verses.Ezra|1|9: And this is the number of them: thirty basins of gold, a thousand basins of silver, twenty nine knives,
verses.Ezra|1|10: thirty bowls of gold, silver bowls of a second sort four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.
verses.Ezra|1|11: And the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand four hundred. All these did Sheshbazzar bring, when the exiles were brought up from Babylon to Jerusalem.
verses.Ezra|2|1: Now these are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity, of those exiles whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon, and they came back to Jerusalem and Judah, everyone to his city.
verses.Ezra|2|2: They came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordechai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the children of Israel:
verses.Ezra|2|3: the children of Parosh, two thousand one hundred and seventy two.
verses.Ezra|2|4: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred and seventy two.
verses.Ezra|2|5: The children of Arah, seven hundred and seventy five.
verses.Ezra|2|6: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.
verses.Ezra|2|7: The children of Elam, one thousand two hundred and fifty four.
verses.Ezra|2|8: The children of Zattu, nine hundred and forty five.
verses.Ezra|2|9: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and sixty.
verses.Ezra|2|10: The children of Bani, six hundred and forty two.
verses.Ezra|2|11: The children of Bebai, six hundred and twenty three.
verses.Ezra|2|12: The children of Azgad, one thousand two hundred and twenty two.
verses.Ezra|2|13: The children of Adonikam, six hundred and sixty six.
verses.Ezra|2|14: The children of Bigvai, two thousand and fifty six.
verses.Ezra|2|15: The children of Adin, four hundred and fifty four.
verses.Ezra|2|16: The children of Ater (of Jehizkiah,) ninety eight.
verses.Ezra|2|17: The children of Bezai, three hundred and twenty three.
verses.Ezra|2|18: The children of Jorah, a hundred and twelve.
verses.Ezra|2|19: The children of Hashum, two hundred and twenty three.
verses.Ezra|2|20: The children of Gibbar, ninety five.
verses.Ezra|2|21: The children of Beth-lehem, one hundred and twenty three.
verses.Ezra|2|22: The men of Netophah, fifty six.
verses.Ezra|2|23: The men of Anathoth, one hundred and twenty eight.
verses.Ezra|2|24: The children of Azmaveth, forty two.
verses.Ezra|2|25: The children of Kirjath-arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty three.
verses.Ezra|2|26: The children of Ramah and Geba, six hundred and twenty one.
verses.Ezra|2|27: The men of Michmas, one hundred and twenty two.
verses.Ezra|2|28: The men of Beth-el and Ai, two hundred and twenty three.
verses.Ezra|2|29: The children of Nebo, fifty two.
verses.Ezra|2|30: The children of Magbish, one hundred and fifty six.
verses.Ezra|2|31: The children of the other Elam, one thousand two hundred and fifty four.
verses.Ezra|2|32: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.
verses.Ezra|2|33: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred and twenty five.
verses.Ezra|2|34: The children of Jericho, three hundred and forty five.
verses.Ezra|2|35: The children of Senaah, three thousand six hundred and thirty.
verses.Ezra|2|36: The priests: the children of Jedaiah of the houses of Jeshua, nine hundred and seventy three.
verses.Ezra|2|37: The children of Immer, one thousand and fifty two.
verses.Ezra|2|38: The children of Pashur, one thousand two hundred and forty seven.
verses.Ezra|2|39: The children of Harim, one thousand and seventeen.
verses.Ezra|2|40: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel of the children of Hodaviah, seventy four.
verses.Ezra|2|41: The singers: the children of Asaph, one hundred and twenty eight.
verses.Ezra|2|42: The children of the gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub the children of Hatita, the children of Shobab, in all, one hundred and thirty nine.
verses.Ezra|2|43: The temple servants; the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, and the children of Tabbaoth,
verses.Ezra|2|44: the children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,
verses.Ezra|2|45: the children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,
verses.Ezra|2|46: the children of Hagab, the children of Shalmai, the children of Hanan,
verses.Ezra|2|47: the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,
verses.Ezra|2|48: the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,
verses.Ezra|2|49: the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,
verses.Ezra|2|50: the children of Asnah, the children of Mehunim, the children of Nephusim,
verses.Ezra|2|51: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
verses.Ezra|2|52: the children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
verses.Ezra|2|53: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Thamah,
verses.Ezra|2|54: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
verses.Ezra|2|55: The children of the servants of Solomon: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda,
verses.Ezra|2|56: the children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
verses.Ezra|2|57: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth, the children of Ami.
verses.Ezra|2|58: All the temple servants, and the children of the servants of Solomon were three hundred and ninety two.
verses.Ezra|2|59: And these were they who went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer, but they could not tell their father's house, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:
verses.Ezra|2|60: the children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred and fifty two.
verses.Ezra|2|61: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz; the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:
verses.Ezra|2|62: these sought their register among those who were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore they were excluded from the priesthood as unfit.
verses.Ezra|2|63: And the governor said to them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.
verses.Ezra|2|64: The whole congregation together was forty two thousand three hundred and sixty,
verses.Ezra|2|65: besides their men servants and women servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred and thirty seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.
verses.Ezra|2|66: Their horses were seven hundred and thirty six; their mules, two hundred and forty five;
verses.Ezra|2|67: their camels, four hundred and thirty five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
verses.Ezra|2|68: And some of the chiefs of fathers' houses, when they came to the house of the Lord which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in its place:
verses.Ezra|2|69: they gave after their ability to the treasury of the work sixty one thousand drachmas of gold, and five thousand minas of silver, and one hundred priests' garments.
verses.Ezra|2|70: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
verses.Ezra|3|1: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.
verses.Ezra|3|2: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and they built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings upon it, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.
verses.Ezra|3|3: And they set the altar upon its bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings upon it to the Lord, burnt offerings morning and evening.
verses.Ezra|3|4: And they kept the feast of booths, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the prescribed form, as the duty of every day required;
verses.Ezra|3|5: and afterwards they offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the sacred appointed seasons of the Lord, and on behalf of everyone who willingly offered a free will offering to the Lord.
verses.Ezra|3|6: From the first day of the seventh month they began to offer burnt offerings to the Lord. But the foundation of the temple of the Lord was not yet laid.
verses.Ezra|3|7: They gave money also to the masons, and to the carpenters; and food, and drink, and oil, to those of Zidon, and of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from the Lebanon to the sea of Japho, according to the grant that they had from Cyrus king of Persia.
verses.Ezra|3|8: Now in the second year of their coming to the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they who were come out of the captivity to Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upwards, to superintend the work of the house of the Lord.
verses.Ezra|3|9: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren, Qadmi'el and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to superintend the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brethren the Levites.
verses.Ezra|3|10: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the Lord, they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the Lord, according to the form prescribed by David king of Israel.
verses.Ezra|3|11: And they sang responsively in praising and giving thanks to the Lord; because he is good, for his steadfast love endures for ever towards Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the Lord, because the foundation of the house of the Lord was laid.
verses.Ezra|3|12: But many of the priests and Levites and the chiefs of the fathers' houses, old men who had seen the first house; when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; but many shouted aloud for joy:
verses.Ezra|3|13: so that the people could not distinguish the sound of the shout of joy from the sound of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the sound was heard afar off.
verses.Ezra|4|1: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the exiles were building the temple to the Lord God of Israel;
verses.Ezra|4|2: then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chiefs of the fathers' houses and said to them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as you do; and we have sacrificed to him since the days of Esar-haddon king of Assyria, who brought us up here.
verses.Ezra|4|3: But Zerubbabel and Jeshua, and the rest of the chiefs of the fathers' houses of Israel, said to them, You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we ourselves alone will build to the Lord God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us.
verses.Ezra|4|4: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and frightened them off from building,
verses.Ezra|4|5: and they hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, until the reign of Darius king of Persia.
verses.Ezra|4|6: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, they wrote to him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.Ezra|4|7: And in the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, wrote to Artaxerxes, king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in the Aramic script, and translated into the Aramic tongue.
verses.Ezra|4|8: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:
verses.Ezra|4|9: then wrote Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Elamites, the Susanchites, the Dehavites, the Elamites,
verses.Ezra|4|10: and the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over, and placed in the cities of Samaria, and the rest who are on this side of the river. And now,
verses.Ezra|4|11: this is the copy of the letter that they sent to him, to Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side of the river. And now,
verses.Ezra|4|12: Be it known to the king, that the Jews who came up from thee to us are come to Jerusalem; they are building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up its walls, and joined the foundations.
verses.Ezra|4|13: Be it known now to the king, that, if this city is built, and the walls set up again, then they will not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and so the revenue of the kings will suffer damage.
verses.Ezra|4|14: Now because we feel closely bound to the king's palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king's dishonour, therefore we have sent and certified the king;
verses.Ezra|4|15: that search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful to kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city laid waste.
verses.Ezra|4|16: We make known to the king that, if this city is rebuilt and its walls set up, by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side of the river.
verses.Ezra|4|17: Then the king sent an answer to Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions who dwelt in Samaria, and to the rest beyond the river. Peace. And now,
verses.Ezra|4|18: the letter which you sent to us has been plainly read before me.
verses.Ezra|4|19: And I commanded, and search has been made, and it is found that this city of old time made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition were made in it.
verses.Ezra|4|20: And there have been mighty kings over Jerusalem, who ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid to them.
verses.Ezra|4|21: Therefore make a decree to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not rebuilt, until a further decree is given from me.
verses.Ezra|4|22: Take heed now not to be slack in this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?
verses.Ezra|4|23: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes's letter was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem to the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.
verses.Ezra|4|24: Then the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem ceased. So it ceased until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
verses.Ezra|5|1: Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews who were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, even to them.
verses.Ezra|5|2: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem: and with them were the prophets of God helping them.
verses.Ezra|5|3: At the same time came to them Tatnai, governor on this side of the river, and Shethar-boznai, and their companions, and said thus to them, Who has commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?
verses.Ezra|5|4: We then spoke to them after this manner: What are the names of the men who are engaged on this building?
verses.Ezra|5|5: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Darius: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter.
verses.Ezra|5|6: The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side of the river, and Shethar-boznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, who were on this side of the river, sent to Darius the king:
verses.Ezra|5|7: they sent a letter to him, and in it was written thus; To Darius the king, all peace.
verses.Ezra|5|8: Be it known to the king, that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is built with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goes on with diligence, and prospers in their hands.
verses.Ezra|5|9: Then we asked those elders, and said to them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?
verses.Ezra|5|10: We asked their names also, to make known to thee, that we might write the names of the men who were at their head.
verses.Ezra|5|11: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and build the house that was built these many years ago, which a great king of Israel did build and set up.
verses.Ezra|5|12: But because our fathers had provoked the God of heaven to anger, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Babylon.
verses.Ezra|5|13: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God.
verses.Ezra|5|14: And also the vessels of gold and silver of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem, and brought into the temple of Babylon, these did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered to one, whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;
verses.Ezra|5|15: and he said to him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be built on its place.
verses.Ezra|5|16: Then came the same Sheshbazzar, and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem: and since that time even until now it has been in building, and it is still not finished.
verses.Ezra|5|17: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king, let search be made in the king's treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it be so, that a decree was made by Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.
verses.Ezra|6|1: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the archives, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.
verses.Ezra|6|2: And there was found at Ahmeta, the fortress that is in the province of Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:
verses.Ezra|6|3: In the first year of Cyrus the king, the same Cyrus the king made a decree, Concerning the house of God at Jerusalem; let the house be built, the place where they offer sacrifices, and let its foundations be strongly laid; its height sixty cubits, and its breadth sixty cubits;
verses.Ezra|6|4: with three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expenses be paid out of the king's house:
verses.Ezra|6|5: and also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought to Babylon, be restored, and brought back to the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to its place, and place them in the house of God.
verses.Ezra|6|6: Now Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shethar-boznai, and your associates, the Apharsachites, who are beyond the river, keep far from hence:
verses.Ezra|6|7: let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.
verses.Ezra|6|8: Moreover I make a decree as to what you shall do for the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king's goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, expenses be given with all diligence to these men so that they are not delayed.
verses.Ezra|6|9: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine and oil, according to the word of the priests who are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:
verses.Ezra|6|10: that they may offer sacrifices of sweet savour to the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.
verses.Ezra|6|11: Also I have made a decree, that whoever shall alter this word, let a beam of a timber be pulled down from his house, and let him be lifted up and impaled thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.
verses.Ezra|6|12: And may the God who has caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and peoples, that shall put to their hand to alter this, or to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with diligence.
verses.Ezra|6|13: Then Tatnai governor on this side of the river, Shethar-boznai, and their associates, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did with diligence.
verses.Ezra|6|14: And the elders of the Jews built, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they built, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
verses.Ezra|6|15: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
verses.Ezra|6|16: And the children of Israel, the priests and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the exile, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,
verses.Ezra|6|17: and they offered at the dedication of this house of God a hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
verses.Ezra|6|18: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.
verses.Ezra|6|19: And the children of the exile kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.Ezra|6|20: For the priests and the Levites had purified themselves; all of them were pure; and they killed the passover lamb for all the children of the exile, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.
verses.Ezra|6|21: And the children of Israel who were come back out of exile, and all such as had separated themselves to them from the filthiness of the nations of the land, to seek the Lord God of Israel did eat of it.
verses.Ezra|6|22: And they kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the Lord had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
verses.Ezra|7|1: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.Ezra|7|2: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
verses.Ezra|7|3: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
verses.Ezra|7|4: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
verses.Ezra|7|5: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest: –
verses.Ezra|7|6: this Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the Lord God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the Lord his God upon him.
verses.Ezra|7|7: And there went up some of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, to Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.Ezra|7|8: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.
verses.Ezra|7|9: For upon the first day of the first month was the beginning of the going up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.
verses.Ezra|7|10: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the Lord, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.
verses.Ezra|7|11: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, learned in the words of the commandments of the Lord, and of his statutes to Israel.
verses.Ezra|7|12: Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, a perfect man. And now,
verses.Ezra|7|13: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and of his priests and Levites, in my realm, who are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, may go with thee.
verses.Ezra|7|14: For thou art sent by the king, and by his seven counsellors, to inquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which is in thy hand;
verses.Ezra|7|15: and to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,
verses.Ezra|7|16: and all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem:
verses.Ezra|7|17: that thou mayst buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meal offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.
verses.Ezra|7|18: And whatever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.
verses.Ezra|7|19: And the vessels that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God, deliver before the God of Jerusalem.
verses.Ezra|7|20: And what more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king's treasure house.
verses.Ezra|7|21: And I, even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers who are beyond the river, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done with diligence,
verses.Ezra|7|22: up to a hundred talents of silver, and up to a hundred measures of wheat, and up to a hundred bats of wine, and up to a hundred bats of oil, and salt without prescribed limit.
verses.Ezra|7|23: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be speedily done for the house of the God of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
verses.Ezra|7|24: We also notify you, that as regards any of the priests and Levites, singers, gatekeepers, servants, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.
verses.Ezra|7|25: And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God, that is in thy hand, appoint magistrates and judges, who may judge all the people that are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach them who do not know them.
verses.Ezra|7|26: And whoever will not do the law of thy God, and the law of the king, let judgment be with diligence executed upon him, whether it be for death, or for banishment, or for confiscation of goods, or for imprisonment.
verses.Ezra|7|27: Blessed be the Lord God of our fathers, which has put such a thing as this in the king's heart, to beautify the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem:
verses.Ezra|7|28: and has given me grace before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king's mighty princes. And I was strengthened as the hand of the Lord my God was upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.
verses.Ezra|8|1: Now these are the heads of their fathers' houses, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.Ezra|8|2: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel: of the sons of David, Hattush:
verses.Ezra|8|3: of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him were reckoned by genealogy one hundred and fifty males.
verses.Ezra|8|4: Of the sons of Pahath-moab, Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.
verses.Ezra|8|5: Of the sons of Shechaniah, the son of Jahaziel and with him three hundred males.
verses.Ezra|8|6: And of the sons of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.
verses.Ezra|8|7: And of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males.
verses.Ezra|8|8: And of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.
verses.Ezra|8|9: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
verses.Ezra|8|10: And of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him one hundred and sixty males.
verses.Ezra|8|11: And of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah the son of Bebai: and with him twenty eight males.
verses.Ezra|8|12: And of the sons of Azgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan; and with him a hundred and ten males.
verses.Ezra|8|13: And of the sons of Adonikam (who came in the rear,) these were their names: Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah; and with them were sixty males.
verses.Ezra|8|14: And of the sons of Bigvai, Utai and Zaccur; and with them were seventy males.
verses.Ezra|8|15: And I gathered them together at the river that runs to Ahava, and we encamped there for three days: and I inspected the people, and the priests, but found there none of the sons of Levi.
verses.Ezra|8|16: So I sent for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men: and for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.
verses.Ezra|8|17: And I sent them with commandment to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say to Iddo, and to his brother who were appointed at the place Casiphia that they should bring to us ministers for the house of God.
verses.Ezra|8|18: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brothers, eighteen;
verses.Ezra|8|19: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;
verses.Ezra|8|20: also of the temple servants, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty temple servants; all of whom were mentioned by name.
verses.Ezra|8|21: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a safe journey for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
verses.Ezra|8|22: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the road: because we had spoken to the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all those who seek him for good; but his power and his wrath are against all those who forsake him.
verses.Ezra|8|23: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he listened to our entreaty.
verses.Ezra|8|24: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,
verses.Ezra|8|25: and weighed to them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel there present, had offered:
verses.Ezra|8|26: so I weighed into their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and of silver vessels a hundred talents, and of gold a hundred talents;
verses.Ezra|8|27: also twenty bowls of gold, of a thousand darics; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
verses.Ezra|8|28: And I said to them, You are holy to the Lord; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering to the Lord God of your fathers.
verses.Ezra|8|29: Watch, and keep them, until you weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the Lord.
verses.Ezra|8|30: So the priests and the Levites took the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God.
verses.Ezra|8|31: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lie in wait by the way.
verses.Ezra|8|32: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.
verses.Ezra|8|33: Now on the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;
verses.Ezra|8|34: the whole was counted and weighed: and the weight of everything was recorded at that time.
verses.Ezra|8|35: Also the children of those who had been carried away, who were come out of the exile, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety six rams, seventy seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering to the Lord.
verses.Ezra|8|36: And they delivered the king's commissions to the king's satraps, and to the governors on this side of the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.
verses.Ezra|9|1: Now when these things were done, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands, doing according to their abominations, even of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, the Ammonite, the Moabite, the Egyptian, and the Amorite.
verses.Ezra|9|2: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the peoples of those lands: indeed, the hand of the princes and rulers has been chief in this crime.
verses.Ezra|9|3: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down appalled.
verses.Ezra|9|4: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the transgression of those who had been carried away gathered around me; and I sat appalled until the evening sacrifice.
verses.Ezra|9|5: And at the evening sacrifice I arose from my fasting; and my garment and my mantle being rent, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands to the Lord my God,
verses.Ezra|9|6: and said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to Thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our guilt has mounted to the heavens.
verses.Ezra|9|7: Since the days of our fathers we have been exceedingly guilty to this day; and for our iniquities we, our kings, and our priests, have been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to plundering, and to utter shame, as it is this day.
verses.Ezra|9|8: And now for a little moment grace has been shown by the Lord our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a secure anchorage in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.
verses.Ezra|9|9: For we were slaves; yet our God did not forsake us in our slavery but gave us grace in the sight of the kings of Persia; to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair its ruins, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.
verses.Ezra|9|10: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken Thy commandments,
verses.Ezra|9|11: which Thou hast commanded by Thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, into which you go to possess it, is an unclean land through the uncleanness of the peoples of the lands, with their abominations, for they have filled it from one end to the other with their uncleanness.
verses.Ezra|9|12: Now therefore do not give your daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters to your sons, nor seek their peace or their welfare for ever: that you may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.
verses.Ezra|9|13: And after all that which has come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great guilt, seeing that Thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and hast given us such deliverance as this;
verses.Ezra|9|14: should we again break Thy commandments, and make marriages with the peoples of these abominations? wouldst Thou not be angry with us till Thou wouldst consume us, so that there should be no remnant nor any to escape?
verses.Ezra|9|15: O Lord God of Israel, Thou are righteous: for we are left, a remnant that is escaped, as it is this day: behold, we are before Thee in our guiltiness: but we cannot stand before Thee because of this.
verses.Ezra|10|1: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had made confession, weeping and casting himself before the house of God, there assembled to him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very bitterly.
verses.Ezra|10|2: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said to Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken alien women of the peoples of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.
verses.Ezra|10|3: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all such women, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.
verses.Ezra|10|4: Arise; for it is thy task: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it.
verses.Ezra|10|5: Then Ezra arose, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel swear that they would do according to this word. And they swore.
verses.Ezra|10|6: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came there, he ate no bread, nor drank water: for he mourned because of the transgression of the exiles.
verses.Ezra|10|7: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the children of the exile, that they should gather themselves together to Jerusalem;
verses.Ezra|10|8: and that whoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of the exiles.
verses.Ezra|10|9: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together to Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the open place before the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and on account of the great rain.
verses.Ezra|10|10: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said to them, You have transgressed, and have taken alien women to increase the guilt of Israel.
verses.Ezra|10|11: Now therefore make confession to the Lord God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the peoples of the land, and from the alien women.
verses.Ezra|10|12: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice. As thou hast said, so must we do.
verses.Ezra|10|13: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand outside, nor is this a work of one day or two: for we are many who have transgressed in this thing.
verses.Ezra|10|14: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all those who have taken foreign women in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and their judges, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter is turned away from us.
verses.Ezra|10|15: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah stood out against this: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
verses.Ezra|10|16: And the children of the exile did so. And certain chiefs of the fathers' houses after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated by Ezra the priest, and they sat down on the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
verses.Ezra|10|17: And they made an end of the whole matter of the men who had taken foreign women by the first day of the first month.
verses.Ezra|10|18: And among the sons of the priests there were found such as had taken foreign women: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brothers; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.
verses.Ezra|10|19: And they gave their hand that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.
verses.Ezra|10|20: And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah;
verses.Ezra|10|21: and of the sons of Harim, Maaseiah and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah;
verses.Ezra|10|22: and of the sons of Pashur, Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah;
verses.Ezra|10|23: and of the Levites, Jozabad, and Simi, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer;
verses.Ezra|10|24: and of the singers, Eliashib; and of the gatekeepers, Shallum, and Telem, and Uri;
verses.Ezra|10|25: and of Israel: of the sons of Parosh, Ramiah, and Jizziiah, and Malchijah, and Mijamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah;
verses.Ezra|10|26: and of the sons of Elam, Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Elijah;
verses.Ezra|10|27: and of the sons of Zattu, Elioenai, Eliashib. Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza;
verses.Ezra|10|28: and of the sons of Bebai, Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai;
verses.Ezra|10|29: and of the sons of Bani, Meshullam, Maluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth;
verses.Ezra|10|30: and of the sons of Pahath-moab, Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh;
verses.Ezra|10|31: and of the sons of Harim, Eliezer, Isshiah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Simeon,
verses.Ezra|10|33: of the sons of Hashum, Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei;
verses.Ezra|10|34: of the sons of Bani, Maadai, Amram, and Uel,
verses.Ezra|10|43: Of the sons of Nebo, Joel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, and Jeiel, Benaiah.
verses.Ezra|10|44: All these had married foreign women: and some of them had wives by whom they had children.
verses.Nehemiah|1|1: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the capital,
verses.Nehemiah|1|2: that Hanani, one of my brothers, came, he and certain men of Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews who had escaped, who were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
verses.Nehemiah|1|3: And they said to me, The remnant who are left of the captivity there in the province suffer much hardship and insult: and the wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates are burned with fire.
verses.Nehemiah|1|4: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned certain days, and I fasted, and prayed before the God of heaven,
verses.Nehemiah|1|5: and said, I pray thee, O Lord God of heaven, the great and terrible God, who keeps covenant and troth to those who love him and observe his commandments:
verses.Nehemiah|1|6: let Thy ear now be attentive, and Thy eyes open, that Thou mayst hear the prayer of Thy servant, which I pray before Thee now day and night, for the children of Israel Thy servants, and I will confess the sins of the children of Israel which we have sinned against Thee: both I and my father's house have sinned.
verses.Nehemiah|1|7: We have dealt very corruptly against Thee, and have not kept the commandments, or the statutes, or the judgments, which Thou didst command Thy servant Moses.
verses.Nehemiah|1|8: Remember, I pray Thee, the word that Thou didst command Thy servant Moses, saying, If you transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:
verses.Nehemiah|1|9: but if you turn to me, and keep my commandments, and do them; though your outcasts be at the utmost parts of heaven, from there will I gather them, and I will bring them to the place which I have chosen to set my name there.
verses.Nehemiah|1|10: Now these are Thy servants and Thy people, whom Thou hast redeemed by Thy great power, and by Thy strong hand.
verses.Nehemiah|1|11: O Lord, I pray Thee, let now Thy ear be attentive to the prayer of Thy servant, and to the prayer of Thy servants, who delight to fear Thy name: and prosper, I pray Thee, Thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king's cupbearer.
verses.Nehemiah|2|1: And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that wine was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave it to the king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.
verses.Nehemiah|2|2: Wherefore the king said to me, Why is thy face sad, seeing thou art not sick? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart. Then I was very much afraid,
verses.Nehemiah|2|3: and I said to the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my face be sad, when the city, the place of the tombs of my ancestors lies waste, and its gates are consumed with fire?
verses.Nehemiah|2|4: Then the king said to me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.
verses.Nehemiah|2|5: And I said to the king, If it please the king, and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight that thou wouldst send me to Judah, to the city of the graves of my ancestors, that I may rebuild it.
verses.Nehemiah|2|6: And the king said to me, (the queen also sitting by him,) For how long shall thy journey be? and when wilt thou return? So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.
verses.Nehemiah|2|7: Moreover I said to the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may let me pass through until I come into Judah;
verses.Nehemiah|2|8: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king's forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the fortress of the temple, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into. And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.
verses.Nehemiah|2|9: Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king's letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.
verses.Nehemiah|2|10: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it displeased them greatly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.
verses.Nehemiah|2|11: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.
verses.Nehemiah|2|12: And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; and I told no one what my God had put in my heart to do at Jerusalem: nor was there any beast with me, save the beast that I rode upon.
verses.Nehemiah|2|13: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon's well, and to the dung gate, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and its gates which had been destroyed by fire.
verses.Nehemiah|2|14: Then I went on to the fountain gate and to the king's pool: but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass.
verses.Nehemiah|2|15: Then I went up in the night by the wadi, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and so returned.
verses.Nehemiah|2|16: And the rulers knew not where I had gone or what I had done; nor had I as yet told it to the Jews, or to the priests, or to the nobles, or to the rulers, or to the rest who did the work.
verses.Nehemiah|2|17: Then said I to them, You see the distress that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire: come and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, so that we no longer suffer insult.
verses.Nehemiah|2|18: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king's words that had spoken to me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.
verses.Nehemiah|2|19: But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian heard it, they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said, What is this thing that you do? will you rebel against the king?
verses.Nehemiah|2|20: Then I answered them, and said to them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but you have no portion, or right, or memorial, in Jerusalem.
verses.Nehemiah|3|1: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they built the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up its doors; even to the tower of the hundred they sanctified it, as far as the tower of Hananeel.
verses.Nehemiah|3|2: And next to him the men of Jericho built. And next to them Zaccur the son of Imri built.
verses.Nehemiah|3|3: But the fish gate did the sons of Senaah build; they also laid its beams, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
verses.Nehemiah|3|4: And next to them Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Coz repaired. And next to them Meshullam the son of Berechiah the son of Meshezabeel repaired. And next to them Zadok the son of Baanah repaired.
verses.Nehemiah|3|5: And next to them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles did not put their necks to the work of their Lord.
verses.Nehemiah|3|6: And Joiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the old gate; they laid its beams, and set up its doors, and its bolts, and its bars.
verses.Nehemiah|3|7: And next to them Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah repaired, as far as the seat of the governor beyond the river.
verses.Nehemiah|3|8: Next to him Uzziel the son of Harhaiah of the goldsmiths repaired. And next to him Hananiah one of the perfumers repaired; and they restored Jerusalem unto the broad wall.
verses.Nehemiah|3|9: And next to them Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of the half district of Jerusalem repaired.
verses.Nehemiah|3|10: And next to them Jedaiah son of Harumaph repaired, even over against his house. And next to him Hattush the son of Hashabniah repaired.
verses.Nehemiah|3|11: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hashshub the son of Pahath-moab, repaired another section, and the furnace tower.
verses.Nehemiah|3|12: And next to him Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of the half district of Jerusalem repaired, he and his daughters.
verses.Nehemiah|3|13: The valley gate did Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah repair; they built it, and set up its doors, its bolts and its bars, and a thousand cubits on the wall as far as the dung gate.
verses.Nehemiah|3|14: But the dung gate did Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of part of Beth-haccerem repair; he undertook to build it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
verses.Nehemiah|3|15: But the fountain gate did Shallun the son of Col-hozeh, the ruler of the district of Mizpah repair; he built it, and covered it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and the wall of the pool of Salah by the king's garden, as far as the stairs that go down from the city of David.
verses.Nehemiah|3|16: After him did Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half district of Beth-zur repair, as far as a point opposite the tombs of the house of David, as far as the man-made pool, and as far as the house of the warriors.
verses.Nehemiah|3|17: After him the Levites repaired, Rehum the son of Bani: next to him Hashabiah, the ruler of the half district of Keilah repaired for his area.
verses.Nehemiah|3|18: After him their brethren, Bavai the son of Henadad, the ruler of the half district of Keilah repaired.
verses.Nehemiah|3|19: And next to him Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, repaired another section over against the ascent to the armoury at the corner.
verses.Nehemiah|3|20: After him Baruch the son of Zaccai earnestly repaired another section, from the corner as far as the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
verses.Nehemiah|3|21: After him did Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Coz repair another section, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.
verses.Nehemiah|3|22: And after him the priests, the men of the plain repaired.
verses.Nehemiah|3|23: After him Benjamin and Hashshub repaired opposite their house. After him Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah repaired by his house.
verses.Nehemiah|3|24: After him Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another section, from the house of Azariah as far as the corner, and up to the turning.
verses.Nehemiah|3|25: Palal the son of Uzai, opposite the corner, and the tower which projects from the king's high house, that was by the court of the guard. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh.
verses.Nehemiah|3|26: Moreover the temple servants dwelt in the Ophel, as far as a point opposite the water gate towards the east, and the projecting tower.
verses.Nehemiah|3|27: After them the Tekoites repaired another section, opposite the great projecting tower as far as the wall of the Ophel.
verses.Nehemiah|3|28: From above the horse gate the priests repaired every one over against his house.
verses.Nehemiah|3|29: After them Zadok the son of Immer repaired opposite his house. And after him Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah, the keeper of the east gate, repaired.
verses.Nehemiah|3|30: After him Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph repaired another section. After him Meshullam the son of Berechiah repaired opposite his chamber.
verses.Nehemiah|3|31: After him Malchijah one of the goldsmiths repaired as far as the house of the temple servants and of the merchants, opposite the muster gate to the corner of the battlement.
verses.Nehemiah|3|32: And between the corner of the battlement and the sheep gate the goldsmiths and the merchants repaired.
verses.Nehemiah|3|33: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was angry, and greatly enraged, and he mocked the Jews.
verses.Nehemiah|3|34: And he spoke before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What are these feeble Jews doing? will they restore things? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish seeing they are burned?
verses.Nehemiah|3|35: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall break down their stone wall.
verses.Nehemiah|3|36: Hear, O our God; for we are despised: and turn their insolence upon their own head, and give them up for a prey in the land of captivity:
verses.Nehemiah|3|37: and do not cover their iniquity, and do not let their sin be blotted out from before Thee: for they have provoked Thee to anger before the builders.
verses.Nehemiah|3|38: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to half its height: for the people had a mind to work.
verses.Nehemiah|4|1: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were being repaired, and that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very angry,
verses.Nehemiah|4|2: and they conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion in it.
verses.Nehemiah|4|3: Nevertheless we made our prayer to our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.
verses.Nehemiah|4|4: And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is failing, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.
verses.Nehemiah|4|5: And our adversaries said, They shall neither know, nor see, until we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.
verses.Nehemiah|4|6: And it came to pass, that when the Jews who dwelt by them came, they said to us ten times, From all places where you shall return, they will be upon us.
verses.Nehemiah|4|7: Therefore in the lower places behind the wall on the bare face of the rock, I stationed the people; I stationed them according to their families, with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
verses.Nehemiah|4|8: And I looked, and rose up, and said to the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not afraid of them: remember the Lord, who is great and awe inspiring, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.
verses.Nehemiah|4|9: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known to us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, everyone to his work.
verses.Nehemiah|4|10: And it came to pass from that time onwards, that the half of my servants did the work, and the other half of them held the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the coats of mail; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.
verses.Nehemiah|4|11: They who built the wall, and they who bore burdens, loaded themselves in such a way that with one of his hands each laboured in the work, and with the other hand he held a weapon.
verses.Nehemiah|4|12: For the builders, everyone had his sword girded by his side, and so he built. And he who sounded the shofar was by me.
verses.Nehemiah|4|13: And I said to the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work is great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, far from one another.
verses.Nehemiah|4|14: In whatever place you hear the sound of the shofar, rally to us there: our God shall fight for us.
verses.Nehemiah|4|15: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.
verses.Nehemiah|4|16: Likewise at the same time I said to the people, Let everyone with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, so that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour in the day.
verses.Nehemiah|4|17: So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard who followed me, none of us put off our clothes: everyone brought his weapon with him, even to the water.
verses.Nehemiah|5|1: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.
verses.Nehemiah|5|2: For there were those who said, We, our sons, and our daughters, are many: therefore let us get corn, that we may eat, and live.
verses.Nehemiah|5|3: Some also there were who said, We have mortgaged our lands, our vineyards, and our houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.
verses.Nehemiah|5|4: There were also those who said, We have borrowed money for the king's tribute, and that upon our lands and vineyards.
verses.Nehemiah|5|5: Yet now our flesh is as good as the flesh of our brethren, our children as good as their children: and, lo, we press our sons and our daughters into slavery, and some of our daughters are pressed into slavery already: nor is it in our power to redeem them; for other men have our lands and vineyards.
verses.Nehemiah|5|6: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
verses.Nehemiah|5|7: Then I took counsel with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said to them, You make claims for debt, everyone of his brother! And I held a great assembly against them.
verses.Nehemiah|5|8: And I said to them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews, who were sold to the heathen; and will you nevertheless sell your brethren? or shall they be sold to us? Then they held their peace, and found nothing to answer.
verses.Nehemiah|5|9: Also I said, That which you do is not good: ought you not to walk in the fear of our God because of the insult of the heathen our enemies?
verses.Nehemiah|5|10: I likewise, and my brethren, and my servants, have lent them money and corn: I pray you, let us release this debt.
verses.Nehemiah|5|11: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the percentage of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that you exact of them.
verses.Nehemiah|5|12: Then they said, We will restore them, and will require nothing of them; so will we do as thou sayst. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.
verses.Nehemiah|5|13: Also I shook out my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, who does not perform this promise, even thus may he be shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised the Lord. And the people did according to this promise.
verses.Nehemiah|5|14: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even to the thirty second year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.
verses.Nehemiah|5|15: But the former governors who had been before me laid burdens upon the people, and had taken of them for bread and wine, besides forty shekels of silver; even their servants bore rule over the people: but I did not do so, because of the fear of God.
verses.Nehemiah|5|16: For I also continued in the work of this wall, nor did we buy any land: and all my servants were gathered there to the work.
verses.Nehemiah|5|17: Moreover there were at my table a hundred and fifty of the Jews and the rulers, besides those who came to us from among the nations who were round about us.
verses.Nehemiah|5|18: Now that which was prepared for one day was one ox and six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this I did not demand the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.
verses.Nehemiah|5|19: Remember me, my God, for good, according to all that I have done for this people.
verses.Nehemiah|6|1: Now it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left in it; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)
verses.Nehemiah|6|2: then Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, Come, let us meet together in one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.
verses.Nehemiah|6|3: And I sent messengers to them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?
verses.Nehemiah|6|4: So they sent to me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.
verses.Nehemiah|6|5: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand:
verses.Nehemiah|6|6: in which was written, It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says it, that thou and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause thou didst build the wall, that thou mayst be their king, according to these words.
verses.Nehemiah|6|7: And thou hast also appointed prophets to proclaim of these at Jerusalem, saying, There is a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.
verses.Nehemiah|6|8: Then I sent to him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayst, but thou dost invent them out of thy own heart.
verses.Nehemiah|6|9: For they all would have us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it shall not be done. (Now therefore, strengthen my hands.)
verses.Nehemiah|6|10: Afterwards I came to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night they will come to slay thee.
verses.Nehemiah|6|11: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who such as I could go into the temple and live? I will not go in.
verses.Nehemiah|6|12: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
verses.Nehemiah|6|13: For this cause was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and that they might have matter for an evil report, that they might taunt me.
verses.Nehemiah|6|14: My God, remember Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, who would have put me in fear.
verses.Nehemiah|6|15: So the wall was finished in the twenty fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty two days.
verses.Nehemiah|6|16: And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard that, all the nations that were about us were afraid and were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was done by our God.
verses.Nehemiah|6|17: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and the letters of Tobiah came to them.
verses.Nehemiah|6|18: For there were many in Judah sworn to him, because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.
verses.Nehemiah|6|19: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.
verses.Nehemiah|7|1: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
verses.Nehemiah|7|2: that I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.
verses.Nehemiah|7|3: And I said to them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while people are still standing there, let them shut the doors, and bar them: and appoint watches among the inhabitants of Jerusalem everyone in his watch, and everyone to be over against his house.
verses.Nehemiah|7|4: Now the city was large and great: but the people in it were few, and the houses were not yet built.
verses.Nehemiah|7|5: And my God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and found written there.
verses.Nehemiah|7|6: These are the children of the province, who went up out of the captivity, of the exile, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came back to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city,
verses.Nehemiah|7|7: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordechai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
verses.Nehemiah|7|8: the children of Parosh, two thousand one hundred and seventy two;
verses.Nehemiah|7|9: the children of Shephatiah, three hundred and seventy two;
verses.Nehemiah|7|10: the children of Arah, six hundred and fifty two;
verses.Nehemiah|7|11: the children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and eighteen;
verses.Nehemiah|7|12: the children of Elam, one thousand two hundred and fifty four;
verses.Nehemiah|7|13: the children of Zattu, eight hundred and forty five;
verses.Nehemiah|7|14: the children of Zaccai, seven hundred and sixty;
verses.Nehemiah|7|15: the children of Binnui, six hundred and forty eight;
verses.Nehemiah|7|16: the children of Bebai six hundred and twenty eight;
verses.Nehemiah|7|17: the children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred and twenty two;
verses.Nehemiah|7|18: the children of Adonikam, six hundred and sixty seven;
verses.Nehemiah|7|19: the children of Bigvai, two thousand and sixty seven;
verses.Nehemiah|7|20: the children of Adin, six hundred and fifty five;
verses.Nehemiah|7|21: the children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety eight;
verses.Nehemiah|7|22: the children of Hashum, three hundred and twenty eight;
verses.Nehemiah|7|23: the children of Bezai, three hundred and twenty four;
verses.Nehemiah|7|24: the children of Hariph, one hundred and twelve;
verses.Nehemiah|7|25: the children of Gibeon, ninety five;
verses.Nehemiah|7|26: the men of Beth-lehem and Netophah, one hundred and eighty eight;
verses.Nehemiah|7|27: the men of Anathoth, one hundred and twenty eight;
verses.Nehemiah|7|28: the men of Beth-azmaveth, forty two;
verses.Nehemiah|7|29: the men of Kirjath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty three;
verses.Nehemiah|7|30: the men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred and twenty one;
verses.Nehemiah|7|31: the men of Michmas, one hundred and twenty two;
verses.Nehemiah|7|32: the men of Beth-el and Ai, one hundred and twenty three;
verses.Nehemiah|7|33: the men of the other Nebo, fifty two;
verses.Nehemiah|7|34: the children of the other Elam, one thousand two hundred and fifty four;
verses.Nehemiah|7|35: the children of Harim, three hundred and twenty;
verses.Nehemiah|7|36: the children of Jericho, three hundred and forty five;
verses.Nehemiah|7|37: the children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred and twenty one;
verses.Nehemiah|7|38: the children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.
verses.Nehemiah|7|39: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred and seventy three;
verses.Nehemiah|7|40: the children of Immer, one thousand and fifty two;
verses.Nehemiah|7|41: the children of Pashur, one thousand two hundred and forty seven;
verses.Nehemiah|7|42: the children of Harim, one thousand and seventeen.
