verses.Job|35|10: But none says, Where is God my maker, who gives songs in the night;
verses.Job|35|11: who teaches us by the beasts of the earth, and makes us wiser by the birds of the sky?
verses.Job|35|12: There, when they cry he does not answer, because of the pride of evil men.
verses.Job|35|13: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, nor will the Almighty regard it.
verses.Job|35|14: Although thou sayst, Thou wilt not regard it, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust in him.
verses.Job|35|15: But now, because his anger does not punish, and he does not heed the multitude of the words,
verses.Job|35|16: therefore does Job open his mouth in vain, and multiplies words without knowledge.
verses.Job|36|2: Suffer me a little, and I will show thee; for I have yet words to speak on God's behalf.
verses.Job|36|3: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.Job|36|4: For truly my words are not false: one that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.
verses.Job|36|5: Behold, God is mighty, and despises not any: he is mighty in strength of wisdom.
verses.Job|36|6: He preserves not the life of the wicked: but gives to the poor their right.
verses.Job|36|7: He withdraws not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings on the throne he establishes them for ever, and they are exalted.
verses.Job|36|8: And if they are bound in fetters, and are held in cords of affliction;
verses.Job|36|9: then he declares to them their work, and their transgressions when they behave arrogantly.
verses.Job|36|10: He opens also their ear to discipline, and commands that they return from iniquity.
verses.Job|36|11: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
verses.Job|36|12: But if they do not obey, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.
verses.Job|36|13: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they do not cry when he binds them.
verses.Job|36|14: They die in youth, and their life ends in shame.
verses.Job|36|15: He delivers the poor by means of his affliction, and opens their ears by oppression.
verses.Job|36|16: He has even removed thee out of distress into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which is set on thy table is full of fatness.
verses.Job|36|17: But thou art full of the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.
verses.Job|36|18: But beware of wrath, lest he take thee away with his clenched fist: nor let the greatness of the ransom turn thee aside.
verses.Job|36|19: Will thy riches avail, that are without stint, or all the forces of thy strength?
verses.Job|36|20: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.
verses.Job|36|21: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
verses.Job|36|22: Behold, God is exalted by his power: who teaches like him?
verses.Job|36|23: Who has enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?
verses.Job|36|24: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.
verses.Job|36|25: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.
verses.Job|36|26: Behold, God is great, and we know it not, nor can the number of his years be searched out.
verses.Job|36|27: When he draws up small drops of water, they are distilled into a stream of rain;
verses.Job|36|28: which the clouds do drop and pour down on man abundantly.
verses.Job|36|29: Can anyone understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?
verses.Job|36|30: Behold, he spreads his light about him, and covers the roots of the sea.
verses.Job|36|31: For by these he judges the peoples; he gives food in abundance.
verses.Job|36|32: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it where it shall strike.
verses.Job|36|33: The noise of the storm tells of it; yea the cattle also of the rising tempest.
verses.Job|37|1: At this also my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.
verses.Job|37|2: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goes out of his mouth.
verses.Job|37|3: He directs it under the whole heaven, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.
verses.Job|37|4: After it a voice roars: he thunders with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.
verses.Job|37|5: God thunders marvellously with his voice; great things he does, which we cannot comprehend.
verses.Job|37|6: For he says to the snow, Be thou on the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.
verses.Job|37|7: He seals up the hand of every man; that all men whom He has made may know his work.
verses.Job|37|8: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.
verses.Job|37|9: Out of the chamber comes the storm: and cold out of the scattering winds.
verses.Job|37|10: By the breath of God ice is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.
verses.Job|37|11: Also he burdens the thick cloud with an overflow: the cloud scatters lightning:
verses.Job|37|12: and it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatever he commands them upon the face of the world, his land.
verses.Job|37|13: He causes it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for love.
verses.Job|37|14: Hearken to this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
verses.Job|37|15: Dost thou know how God lays his command on them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?
verses.Job|37|16: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?
verses.Job|37|17: Thou whose garments are warm, when the earth is quiet because of the south wind?
verses.Job|37|18: Canst thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong as a molten mirror?
verses.Job|37|19: Teach us what we shall say to him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.
verses.Job|37|20: Shall it be told him that I would speak? or should a man wish to be swallowed up?
verses.Job|37|21: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passes, and cleanses them.
verses.Job|37|22: Gold comes out of the north: about God is terrible majesty.
verses.Job|37|23: The Almighty, (we cannot find him out:) he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not oppress.
verses.Job|37|24: Men do therefore fear him: he regards not any who are wise of heart.
verses.Job|38|1: Then the Lord answered Job out of the storm wind, and said,
verses.Job|38|2: Who is this that darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
verses.Job|38|3: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and let me know thy answer.
verses.Job|38|4: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.
verses.Job|38|5: Who determined its measurements, if thou knowst? or who has stretched the line upon it?
verses.Job|38|6: whereupon are its foundations fastened? or who laid its corner stone;
verses.Job|38|7: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.Job|38|8: or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke forth, and issued out of the womb?
verses.Job|38|9: when I made the cloud its garment, and thick darkness a swaddling band for it,
verses.Job|38|10: and prescribed bounds for it, and set bars and doors,
verses.Job|38|11: and said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?
verses.Job|38|12: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days began; and caused the dayspring to know its place;
verses.Job|38|13: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?
verses.Job|38|14: It is changed like clay under the seal; and they stand as a garment.
verses.Job|38|15: And from the wicked their light is withheld, and the high arm shall be broken.
verses.Job|38|16: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the recesses of the depth?
verses.Job|38|17: have the gates of death been opened to thee? or hast thou seen the doors of deepest darkness?
verses.Job|38|18: hast thou comprehended the expanse of the earth? declare if thou knowst it all.
verses.Job|38|19: Where is the way where light dwells? and as for darkness, where is its place,
verses.Job|38|20: that thou shouldst take it to its bound, and that thou shouldst know the paths to its home?
verses.Job|38|21: Thou knowst it because thou wast then born, and the number of thy days is great.
verses.Job|38|22: Hast thou entered the treasuries of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasuries of the hail,
verses.Job|38|23: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
verses.Job|38|24: By what way is the light parted, or the east wind scattered upon the earth?
verses.Job|38|25: who has divided a watercourse for the torrent of rain, or a way for the lightning of thunder;
verses.Job|38|26: to cause it to rain on a land where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
verses.Job|38|27: to satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
verses.Job|38|28: Has the rain a father? or who has begotten the drops of dew?
verses.Job|38|29: out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoar frost of heaven, who has given it birth?
verses.Job|38|30: The waters are hidden as with a stone, and the face of the deep forms a solid mass.
verses.Job|38|31: Canst thou bind the chains of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?
verses.Job|38|32: canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in their season? or canst thou guide the Bear with his sons?
verses.Job|38|33: knowst thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou establish its dominion in the earth?
verses.Job|38|34: canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?
verses.Job|38|35: canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say to thee, Here we are?
verses.Job|38|36: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? or who has given understanding to the birds?
verses.Job|38|37: who can number the clouds by wisdom? or who can refill the bottles of heaven,
verses.Job|38|38: when the dust grows into a mass, and the clods cleave fast together?
verses.Job|38|39: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
verses.Job|38|40: when they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?
verses.Job|38|41: Who provides for the raven his provision? when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
verses.Job|39|1: Knowst thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?
verses.Job|39|2: canst thou number the months that they fulfil? or knowst thou the time when they bring forth?
verses.Job|39|3: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they send forth their offspring.
verses.Job|39|4: Their young ones grow strong; they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not to them.
verses.Job|39|5: Who has sent out the wild ass free? or who has loosed the bands of the onager?
verses.Job|39|6: whose house I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwellings.
verses.Job|39|7: He scorns the tumult of the city, nor does he regard the shouts of the driver.
verses.Job|39|8: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searches after every green thing.
verses.Job|39|9: Will the wild ox be willing to serve thee, or will he abide by thy crib?
verses.Job|39|10: canst thou bind the wild ox with ropes in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?
verses.Job|39|11: wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?
verses.Job|39|12: wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather it into thy barn?
verses.Job|39|13: The wing of the ostrich waves joyously; but are they the pinions and plumage of the stork?
verses.Job|39|14: For she leaves her eggs in the earth, and warms them in dust,
verses.Job|39|15: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.
verses.Job|39|16: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: though her labour is in vain of yet she is without fear;
verses.Job|39|17: because God has deprived her of wisdom, nor has he imparted to her understanding.
verses.Job|39|18: At some time she lifts up herself on high; she scorns the horse and his rider.
verses.Job|39|19: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with power?
verses.Job|39|20: Dost thou make him leap like a locust? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.
verses.Job|39|21: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength: he goes out to meet the battle.
verses.Job|39|22: He mocks at fear, and is not affrighted; nor does he turn back from the sword.
verses.Job|39|23: The quiver rattles against him, the glittering spear and the javelin.
verses.Job|39|24: He swallows the ground with fierceness and rage: nor does he believe that it is the sound of the trumpet.
verses.Job|39|25: He says among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
verses.Job|39|26: Does the hawk fly by thy wisdom, and stretch her wings towards the south?
verses.Job|39|27: does the vulture mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?
verses.Job|39|28: She dwells and abides on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.
verses.Job|39|29: From thence she swoops down on the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.
verses.Job|39|30: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are, there is she.
verses.Job|40|1: Then the Lord answered Job, and said,
verses.Job|40|2: Shall a reprover contend with the Almighty? he who reproaches God, let him answer it.
verses.Job|40|3: Then Job answered the Lord, and said,
verses.Job|40|4: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer Thee? I lay my hand upon my mouth.
verses.Job|40|5: Once I have spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
verses.Job|40|6: Then the Lord answered Job out of the storm wind, and said,
verses.Job|40|7: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
verses.Job|40|8: Wilt thou also disavow my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayst be in the right?
verses.Job|40|9: hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
verses.Job|40|10: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.
verses.Job|40|11: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold everyone that is proud, and abase him.
verses.Job|40|12: Look on everyone that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.
verses.Job|40|13: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in the hiding place.
verses.Job|40|14: Then I will also confess to thee that thy own right hand can save thee.
verses.Job|40|15: Behold now behemot, which I made with thee; he eats grass like an ox.
verses.Job|40|16: Lo now, his might is in his loins, and his force is in the muscles of his belly.
verses.Job|40|17: He stiffens his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his thighs are knit together.
verses.Job|40|18: His bones are tubes of brass; his limbs are like bars of iron.
verses.Job|40|19: He is the beginning of the ways of God: let him that made him bring near his sword to him!
verses.Job|40|20: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the wild beasts play.
verses.Job|40|21: He lies under the thorny bushes, in the cover of the reed, and fens.
verses.Job|40|22: The thorny bushes cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.
verses.Job|40|23: Behold, he drinks up a river, and hastens not: he trusts that river will thrust some food into his mouth.
verses.Job|40|24: Shall anyone take him with his eyes open? or pierce through his nose with a snare?
verses.Job|40|25: Canst thou draw out livyatan with a hook? or press down his tongue with a cord?
verses.Job|40|26: canst thou put a hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a bridle ring?
verses.Job|40|27: will he make many supplications to thee? will he speak soft words to thee?
verses.Job|40|28: will he make a covenant with thee? to take him for thy servant for ever?
verses.Job|40|29: wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy girls?
verses.Job|40|30: will the tradesmen heap up payment for him? shall they part him among the merchants?
verses.Job|40|31: canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
verses.Job|40|32: Lay thy hand upon him! thou wilt no more think of fighting.
verses.Job|41|1: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
verses.Job|41|2: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
verses.Job|41|3: Who has a claim on me from before, that I should repay him? whatever is under the whole heaven is mine.
verses.Job|41|4: I will hold my peace at him; listen to his words, the report of his power, and his graceful speech.
verses.Job|41|5: Who can uncover the face of his garment? or who can come within his double bridle?
verses.Job|41|6: who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.
verses.Job|41|7: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal:
verses.Job|41|8: one is so near to another, that no air can come between them:
verses.Job|41|9: they are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
verses.Job|41|10: His sneezings flash forth light, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
verses.Job|41|11: Out of his mouth go burning torches, and sparks of fire leap out.
verses.Job|41|12: Out of his nostrils goes smoke, as out of a seething pot and burning rushes.
verses.Job|41|13: His breath kindles coals, and a flame goes out of his mouth.
verses.Job|41|14: In his neck abides strength, and terror dances before him.
verses.Job|41|15: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm upon him; they cannot be moved.
verses.Job|41|16: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as the nether millstone.
verses.Job|41|17: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid: by reason of the crashings they are beside themselves.
verses.Job|41|18: Though the sword reaches him, it does not avail; nor the spear, the dart, or the javelin.
verses.Job|41|19: He esteems iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood:
verses.Job|41|20: the arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble:
verses.Job|41|21: darts are counted as stubble; he laughs at the shaking of a spear.
verses.Job|41|22: His underparts are like sharp potsherds: he spreads himself like a threshing sledge on the mire.
verses.Job|41|23: He makes the deep to boil like a pot: he makes the sea like a kettle.
verses.Job|41|24: After him he leaves a shining wake; one would think the deep to be hoary.
verses.Job|41|25: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
verses.Job|41|26: He beholds all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.
verses.Job|42|1: Then Job answered the Lord, and said,
verses.Job|42|2: I know that Thou canst do everything, and that no purpose of Thine can be thwarted.
verses.Job|42|3: Who is he that hides counsel without knowledge? therefore I have uttered that which I did not understand; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.
verses.Job|42|4: Hear, I beseech Thee, and I will speak: I will demand of Thee, and declare Thou unto me.
verses.Job|42|5: I have heard of Thee by the hearing of the ear: but now my eye sees Thee.
verses.Job|42|6: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.
verses.Job|42|7: And it was so, that after the Lord had spoken these words to Job, the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite; My anger burns against thee, and against thy two friends: for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, like my servant Job.
verses.Job|42|8: Therefore take for yourselves now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for to him I will show favour in doing you no disgrace, although you have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.
verses.Job|42|9: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did as the Lord commanded them: the Lord also accepted Job.
verses.Job|42|10: And the Lord restored the fortunes of Job, when he prayed for his friends: and the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before.
verses.Job|42|11: Then all his brothers came to him, and all his sisters, and all they who had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the Lord had brought upon him: every man also gave him a qesita, and everyone an earring of gold.
verses.Job|42|12: So the Lord blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.
verses.Job|42|13: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
verses.Job|42|14: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.
verses.Job|42|15: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brothers.
verses.Job|42|16: After this Job lived a hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations.
verses.Job|42|17: So Job died, being old and full of days.
verses.Psalms|1|1: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stands in the way of sinners, nor sits in the seat of scorners.
verses.Psalms|1|2: But his delight is in the law of the Lord; and in his law he meditates day and night.
verses.Psalms|1|3: And he shall be like a tree planted by streams of water, that brings forth its fruit in its season; its leaf also shall not wither; and in whatever he does he shall prosper.
verses.Psalms|1|4: Not so the wicked: but they are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
verses.Psalms|1|5: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
verses.Psalms|1|6: For the Lord knows the way of the righteous: but the way of the wicked shall perish.
verses.Psalms|2|1: Why are the nations in uproar, and the people mutter a vain thing?
verses.Psalms|2|2: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed, saying,
verses.Psalms|2|3: Let us break their bonds asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
verses.Psalms|2|4: He who sits in the heavens laughs: the Lord has them in derision.
verses.Psalms|2|5: Then shall he speak to them in his wrath, and terrify them in his burning anger.
verses.Psalms|2|6: But I have set my king upon Zion, my holy hill.
verses.Psalms|2|7: I will tell of the decree: the Lord has said to me, Thou art my son; this day have I begotten thee.
verses.Psalms|2|8: Ask of me, and I shall give thee nations for thy inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
verses.Psalms|2|9: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
verses.Psalms|2|10: Be wise now therefore, O kings: be warned, O judges of the earth.
verses.Psalms|2|11: Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.Psalms|2|12: Worship in purity, lest he be angry, and you perish from the way, for in a little while his anger will blaze. Blessed are all who put their trust in him.
verses.Psalms|3|1: A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.
verses.Psalms|3|2: Lord, how many are my enemies become! many are they who rise up against me:
verses.Psalms|3|3: many there be who say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|3|4: But Thou, O Lord, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of my head.
verses.Psalms|3|5: I cried to the Lord with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|3|6: I lie me down and sleep; I awake; for the Lord sustains me.
verses.Psalms|3|7: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
verses.Psalms|3|8: Arise, O Lord; save me, O my God: for Thou hast smitten all my enemies upon the cheek; Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.
verses.Psalms|3|9: Salvation belongs to the Lord: Thy blessing be upon Thy people. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|4|1: For the chief Musician on strings, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|4|2: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: Thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
verses.Psalms|4|3: O sons of men, how long will you turn my glory into shame? you love vanity, and seek after falsehood. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|4|4: But know that the Lord has set apart the godly man as his own: the Lord will hear when I call to him.
verses.Psalms|4|5: Tremble, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|4|6: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the Lord.
verses.Psalms|4|7: There are many who say, Who will show us good? Lord, lift Thou up the light of Thy countenance upon us.
verses.Psalms|4|8: Thou hast put more gladness in my heart than they have whose corn and wine are increased.
verses.Psalms|4|9: I will both lie down and sleep, in peace: for Thou, Lord, alone, makest me to dwell in safety.
verses.Psalms|5|1: To the chief Musician for flutes, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|5|2: Give ear to my words, O Lord, consider my meditation.
verses.Psalms|5|3: Hearken to the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for to Thee I will pray.
verses.Psalms|5|4: My voice shalt Thou hear in the morning, O Lord; in the morning I will direct my prayer to Thee; and will wait expectantly.
verses.Psalms|5|5: For Thou art not a God That hast pleasure in wickedness: nor shall evil dwell with Thee.
verses.Psalms|5|6: The boastful shall not stand in Thy sight: Thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
verses.Psalms|5|7: Thou dost destroy them that speak falsehood: the Lord abhors the bloody and deceitful man.
verses.Psalms|5|8: But as for me, I will come into Thy house in the multitude of Thy love: and in the fear of Thee I will worship towards Thy holy temple.
verses.Psalms|5|9: Lead me, O Lord, in Thy righteousness because of my enemies; make Thy way straight before my face.
verses.Psalms|5|10: For there is no sincerity in their mouth; in their heart is malice; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
verses.Psalms|5|11: Condemn them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out for the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against Thee.
verses.Psalms|5|12: But let all those that put their trust in Thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because Thou dost defend them: and let those who love Thy name be joyful in Thee.
verses.Psalms|5|13: For Thou, Lord, dost bless the righteous; Thou dost encircle him with favour as with a shield.
verses.Psalms|6|1: To the chief Musician on strings upon the Sheminith, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|6|2: O Lord, rebuke me not in Thy anger, nor chasten me in Thy hot displeasure.
verses.Psalms|6|3: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; for I am weak: O Lord, heal me; for my bones shudder;
verses.Psalms|6|4: and my soul is much affrighted. And Thou, O Lord, how long?
verses.Psalms|6|5: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul: oh save me on account of Thy steadfast love.
verses.Psalms|6|6: For in death there is no remembrance of Thee: in Sheol who shall give Thee thanks?
verses.Psalms|6|7: I am weary with my groaning: all the night I make my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
verses.Psalms|6|8: My eye is wasted because of grief; it grows weak because of all my enemies.
verses.Psalms|6|9: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity; for the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.Psalms|6|10: The Lord has heard my supplication; the Lord receives my prayer.
verses.Psalms|6|11: All my enemies will be ashamed and much affrighted: they will turn back and be confounded in a moment.
verses.Psalms|7|1: A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the Lord, concerning the words of Ethiopia the Benjamite.
verses.Psalms|7|2: O Lord my God, in Thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
verses.Psalms|7|3: lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
verses.Psalms|7|4: O Lord my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
verses.Psalms|7|5: if I have rewarded evil to him that was at peace with me; (indeed, I have rescued him that without cause is my enemy:)
verses.Psalms|7|6: let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; and let him tread down my life to the earth, and lay my honour in the dust. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|7|7: Arise, O Lord, in Thy anger, lift up Thyself against the fury of my enemies: and awake for me: Thou hast commanded judgment.
verses.Psalms|7|8: Let the congregation of the peoples compass Thee about: and for their sakes return Thou on high.
verses.Psalms|7|9: The Lord shall judge the peoples. Judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness, and according to my integrity that is in me.
verses.Psalms|7|10: O let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God tries the hearts and reins.
verses.Psalms|7|11: My defence is of God, who saves the upright in heart.
verses.Psalms|7|12: God is a righteous judge; and a God who has indignation every day.
verses.Psalms|7|13: If a man does not turn, then he will whet his sword; he has bent his bow, and made it ready.
verses.Psalms|7|14: He has also prepared for him the instruments of death; he makes arrows for the pursuers.
verses.Psalms|7|15: Behold, he travails with iniquity, and has conceived mischief, and brings forth falsehood.
verses.Psalms|7|16: He has made a pit, and has dug it out, and has fallen into the ditch which he made.
verses.Psalms|7|17: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
verses.Psalms|7|18: I will praise the Lord according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the Lord most high.
verses.Psalms|8|1: To the chief Musician upon the Gittith, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|8|2: O Lord our Lord, how majestic is Thy name in all the earth; who hast set Thy glory above the heavens.
verses.Psalms|8|3: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast Thou founded strength because of Thy enemies, that Thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.Psalms|8|4: When I behold Thy heavens, the work of Thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which Thou hast ordained;
verses.Psalms|8|5: what is man, that Thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that Thou visitest him?
verses.Psalms|8|6: Yet Thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and Thou dost crown him with glory and honour.
verses.Psalms|8|7: Thou makest him to have dominion over the works of Thy hands; Thou hast put all things under his feet:
verses.Psalms|8|8: all sheep, and oxen, and also the beasts of the field;
verses.Psalms|8|9: the birds of the sky, and the fish of the sea; whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
verses.Psalms|8|10: O Lord our Lord, how majestic is Thy name in all the earth!
verses.Psalms|9|1: To the chief Musician on Muth-labben, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|9|2: I will praise Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will relate all Thy marvellous works.
verses.Psalms|9|3: I will be glad and rejoice in Thee: I will sing praise to Thy name, O Thou most High:
verses.Psalms|9|4: when my enemies are turned back, when they stumble and perish at Thy presence.
verses.Psalms|9|5: For Thou hast maintained my right and my cause; Thou didst sit on the throne giving righteous judgment.
verses.Psalms|9|6: Thou hast rebuked the nations, Thou hast destroyed the wicked, Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.
verses.Psalms|9|7: The enemies are come to an end, in perpetual ruins: for Thou hast destroyed the cities; their memorial is perished.
verses.Psalms|9|8: But the Lord shall endure forever: he has prepared his throne for judgment.
verses.Psalms|9|9: And he will judge the world in righteousness, he will minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
verses.Psalms|9|10: The Lord also will be a stronghold for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
verses.Psalms|9|11: And they that know Thy name will put their trust in Thee: for Thou, Lord, hast not forsaken those who seek Thee.
verses.Psalms|9|12: Sing praises to the Lord, who dwells in Zion: declare among the peoples his doings.
verses.Psalms|9|13: For he avenges blood, he remembers it: he does not forget the cry of the humble.
verses.Psalms|9|14: Be gracious to me, O Lord; consider my trouble which I suffer from those who hate me, Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
verses.Psalms|9|15: that I may relate all Thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion. I will rejoice in Thy salvation.
verses.Psalms|9|16: The nations are sunk down in the pit that they have made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
verses.Psalms|9|17: The Lord is known by the judgment which he executes: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. (A Higgaion. Selah.)
verses.Psalms|9|18: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, all the nations that forget God.
verses.Psalms|9|19: For the needy shall not always be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish forever.
verses.Psalms|9|20: Arise, O Lord; let man not prevail: let the nations be judged in Thy sight.
verses.Psalms|9|21: Put them in fear, O Lord: the nations will then know themselves to be but men. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|10|1: Why standest Thou afar off, O Lord? why hidest Thou Thyself in times of trouble?
verses.Psalms|10|2: The wicked in his pride hotly pursues the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
verses.Psalms|10|3: For the wicked boasts of his heart's desire, and the greedy wretch curses and renounces the Lord.
verses.Psalms|10|4: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance thinks, He will not seek out: all his thoughts are, God is not.
verses.Psalms|10|5: His ways are always strong; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he hisses at them.
verses.Psalms|10|6: He says in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.
verses.Psalms|10|7: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
verses.Psalms|10|8: He sits in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places he murders the innocent: his eyes stealthily watch for the helpless.
verses.Psalms|10|9: He lies in wait secretly like a lion in his den: he lies in wait to catch the poor: he catches the poor, when he draws him into his net.
verses.Psalms|10|10: The helpless collapse: they bow down, and fall into his power.
verses.Psalms|10|11: He says in his heart, God has forgotten: he hides his face; he will never see it.
verses.Psalms|10|12: Arise, O Lord; O God, lift up Thy hand: forget not the humble.
verses.Psalms|10|13: Why does the wicked man renounce God? he says in his heart, Thou wilt not avenge.
verses.Psalms|10|14: Thou hast seen it; for Thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with Thy hand: the helpless man commits himself to Thee; Thou art the helper of the fatherless.
verses.Psalms|10|15: Break Thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till Thou find none left.
verses.Psalms|10|16: The Lord is King for ever and ever: the nations are perished out of his land.
verses.Psalms|10|17: Lord, Thou hast heard the desire of the humble: Thou wilt strengthen their heart, Thou wilt cause Thy ear to hear:
verses.Psalms|10|18: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, so that none shall any longer terrify innocent men from the earth.
verses.Psalms|11|1: To the chief Musician, of David. In the Lord I put my trust: how can you say to my soul, Flee like a bird to your mountain?
verses.Psalms|11|2: For, lo, the wicked bend the bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
verses.Psalms|11|3: For when the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?
verses.Psalms|11|4: The Lord in his holy temple, the Lord whose throne is in heaven, whose eyes behold, whose eyelids try, the children of men:
verses.Psalms|11|5: the Lord tries the righteous: but the wicked and him who loves violence his soul hates.
verses.Psalms|11|6: Upon the wicked he shall rain coals, fire and brimstone, and a scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.Psalms|11|7: For the Lord is righteous, he loves righteousness; the upright shall behold his face.
verses.Psalms|12|1: To the chief Musician upon the Sheminith, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|12|2: Help, Lord; for the godly man ceases; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.Psalms|12|3: They speak vanity every one with his fellow: with flattering lips and with a double heart they speak.
verses.Psalms|12|4: May the Lord cut off all flattering lips, the tongue that speaks proud things:
verses.Psalms|12|5: who have said, With our tongue we will prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
verses.Psalms|12|6: For the violence done to the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, says the Lord; I will set him in safety at whom they hiss.
verses.Psalms|12|7: The words of the Lord are pure words: silver refined in a furnace upon the ground, purified seven times.
verses.Psalms|12|8: Thou shalt keep them, O Lord, Thou shalt preserve them from this generation forever.
verses.Psalms|12|9: The wicked walk on every side, when vileness is exalted among the children of men.
verses.Psalms|13|1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|13|2: How long wilt Thou forget me O Lord? forever? how long wilt Thou hide Thy face from me?
verses.Psalms|13|3: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall my enemy be exalted over me?
verses.Psalms|13|4: Look, and hear me, O Lord my God: lighten my eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
verses.Psalms|13|5: lest my enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those who trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
verses.Psalms|13|6: But I have trusted in Thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in Thy salvation. I will sing to the Lord, because he has dealt bountifully with me.
verses.Psalms|14|1: To the chief Musician, of David. The fool has said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that does good.
verses.Psalms|14|2: The Lord looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that understood, and sought God.
verses.Psalms|14|3: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that does good, no, not one.
verses.Psalms|14|4: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the Lord.
verses.Psalms|14|5: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.Psalms|14|6: You shame the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his refuge.
verses.Psalms|14|7: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the Lord brings back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.Psalms|15|1: A Psalm of David. Lord, who shall abide in Thy tent? who shall dwell in Thy holy hill?
verses.Psalms|15|2: He that walks uprightly, and acts justly, and speaks the truth in his heart.
verses.Psalms|15|3: He that does not slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his fellow, nor takes up a reproach against his neighbour.
verses.Psalms|15|4: In whose eyes a vile person is despised; but he honours them that fear the Lord. He that swears to his own hurt, and changes not.
verses.Psalms|15|5: He that does not put out his money on interest, nor takes a bribe against the innocent. He that does these things shall never be moved.
verses.Psalms|16|1: A Michtam of David. Preserve me, O God: for in Thee do I put my trust.
verses.Psalms|16|2: I have said to the Lord, Thou art my Lord: I have no good apart from Thee;
verses.Psalms|16|3: and to the saints that are on the earth, They are the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
verses.Psalms|16|4: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names upon my lips.
verses.Psalms|16|5: The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and of my cup: Thou maintainest my lot.
verses.Psalms|16|6: The lines are fallen to me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
verses.Psalms|16|7: I bless the Lord, who gives me counsel: my reins also admonish me in the night seasons.
verses.Psalms|16|8: I have set the Lord always before me: surely he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
verses.Psalms|16|9: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoices: my flesh also dwells secure.
verses.Psalms|16|10: For Thou wilt not abandon my soul to Sheol; nor wilt Thou suffer thy holy one to see the pit.
verses.Psalms|16|11: Thou wilt make known to me the path of life: in Thy presence is fulness of joy; at Thy right hand are pleasures for evermore.
verses.Psalms|17|1: A Prayer of David. Hear the right, O Lord, attend to my cry, give ear to my prayer, from lips without deceit.
verses.Psalms|17|2: Let my sentence come forth from Thy presence; let Thy eyes behold the right.
verses.Psalms|17|3: Thou hast proved my heart; Thou hast visited it in the night: Thou hast tried me, but Thou findest nothing; let no presumptuous thought pass my lips.
verses.Psalms|17|4: Concerning the works of men, by the word of Thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the violent.
verses.Psalms|17|5: My steps have held fast to Thy paths; my feet have not slipped.
verses.Psalms|17|6: I have called upon Thee, for Thou wilt hear me, O God: incline Thy ear to me, and hear my speech.
verses.Psalms|17|7: Show marvellously Thy steadfast love, saving with Thy right hand from their enemies those who seek refuge.
verses.Psalms|17|8: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of Thy wings,
verses.Psalms|17|9: from the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.
verses.Psalms|17|10: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
verses.Psalms|17|11: They dog our footsteps; they surround us: they set their eyes to tread us down to the earth;
verses.Psalms|17|12: he is like a lion greedy for its prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.Psalms|17|13: Arise, O Lord, confront him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, by Thy sword:
verses.Psalms|17|14: from men, by Thy hand, O Lord, from men whose portion in life is of the world, and whose belly Thou fillest with Thy treasure: who have children in plenty, and who leave their abundance to their babes.
verses.Psalms|17|15: As for me, I will behold Thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with beholding Thy likeness.
verses.Psalms|18|1: To the chief Musician, of David, the servant of the Lord, who spoke to the Lord the words of this song in the day that the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul:
verses.Psalms|18|2: and he said, I will love Thee, O Lord, my strength.
verses.Psalms|18|3: The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I will trust; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
verses.Psalms|18|4: He is worthy to be praised: I will call upon the Lord: so shall I be saved from my enemies.
verses.Psalms|18|5: The bonds of death encircled me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
verses.Psalms|18|6: The cords of Sheol compassed me about: the snares of death took me by surprise.
verses.Psalms|18|7: In my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried to my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, into his ears.
verses.Psalms|18|8: Then the earth shook and trembled; and the foundations of the hills moved and were shaken, because of his anger.
verses.Psalms|18|9: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.Psalms|18|10: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.
verses.Psalms|18|11: And he rode upon a keruv, and did fly: he soared on the wings of the wind.
verses.Psalms|18|12: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him was dark water and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.Psalms|18|13: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail and coals of fire.
verses.Psalms|18|14: The Lord also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail and coals of fire.
verses.Psalms|18|15: And he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and confounded them.
verses.Psalms|18|16: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were laid bare, at Thy rebuke, O Lord, at the blast of the breath of Thy nostrils.
verses.Psalms|18|17: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.
verses.Psalms|18|18: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from those who hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.Psalms|18|19: They surprised me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay.
verses.Psalms|18|20: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.Psalms|18|21: The Lord rewards me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he recompenses me.
verses.Psalms|18|22: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.Psalms|18|23: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
verses.Psalms|18|24: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from my iniquity.
verses.Psalms|18|25: Therefore the Lord recompenses me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
verses.Psalms|18|26: With the merciful Thou wilt show Thyself merciful; with an upright man Thou wilt show Thyself upright;
verses.Psalms|18|27: with the pure Thou wilt show Thyself pure; and with the perverse Thou wilt show Thyself subtle.
verses.Psalms|18|28: For Thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
verses.Psalms|18|29: For Thou wilt light my candle: the Lord my God will enlighten my darkness.
verses.Psalms|18|30: For by Thee I run through a troop; and by my God I leap over a wall.
verses.Psalms|18|31: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the Lord is tried: he is a shield to all those who trust in him.
verses.Psalms|18|32: For who is God save the Lord? or who is a rock save our God?
verses.Psalms|18|33: It is God that girds me with strength, and makes my way perfect.
verses.Psalms|18|34: He makes my feet like hinds' feet, and sets me upon my heights.
verses.Psalms|18|35: He teaches my hands to war, so that a bow of brass is bent in my arms.
verses.Psalms|18|36: Thou hast also given me the shield of Thy salvation: and Thy right hand has supported me and Thy condescension has made me great.
verses.Psalms|18|37: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
verses.Psalms|18|38: I have pursued my enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn back till they were consumed.
verses.Psalms|18|39: I have crushed them so that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
verses.Psalms|18|40: For Thou hast girded me with strength to the battle: Thou hast subdued under me those who rose up against me.
verses.Psalms|18|41: Thou hast also made my enemies turn their backs on me; that I might destroy those who hate me.
verses.Psalms|18|42: They cried, but there was none to save them: to the Lord, but he answered them not.
verses.Psalms|18|43: Then did I beat them small like the dust before the wind: I did cast them out like the dirt in the streets.
verses.Psalms|18|44: Thou deliverest me from the strivings of the people; Thou makest me the head of nations: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
verses.Psalms|18|45: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves to me.
verses.Psalms|18|46: The strangers shall fade away, and come trembling out of their close places.
verses.Psalms|18|47: The Lord lives; and blessed is my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
verses.Psalms|18|48: It is God who avenges me, and has subdued peoples under me.
verses.Psalms|18|49: He delivers me from my enemies: indeed, thou liftest me up above those who rise up against me: Thou deliverest me from the violent man.
verses.Psalms|18|50: Therefore will I give thanks to Thee, O Lord, among the nations, and sing praises to Thy name.
verses.Psalms|18|51: Great deliverance he gives to his king; and shows steadfast love to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.Psalms|19|1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|19|2: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament proclaims his handiwork.
verses.Psalms|19|3: Day to day utters speech, and night to night expresses knowledge.
verses.Psalms|19|4: There is no speech nor are there words; their voice is not heard.
verses.Psalms|19|5: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
verses.Psalms|19|6: which is like a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoices like a strong man to run a race.
verses.Psalms|19|7: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit to the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from his heat.
verses.Psalms|19|8: The law of the Lord is perfect, restoring the soul: the testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.Psalms|19|9: The statutes of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.Psalms|19|10: The fear of the Lord is clean, enduring forever: the judgments of the Lord are true and are righteous altogether.
verses.Psalms|19|11: More to be desired are they than gold, even much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.Psalms|19|12: Moreover by them is Thy servant enlightened: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
verses.Psalms|19|13: Who can discern errors? cleanse Thou me from secret faults.
verses.Psalms|19|14: Keep back Thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be clear of much transgression.
verses.Psalms|19|15: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in Thy sight, O Lord, my rock, and my redeemer.
verses.Psalms|20|1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for David.
verses.Psalms|20|2: May the Lord hear thee in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob defend thee!
verses.Psalms|20|3: May he send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion!
verses.Psalms|20|4: May he remember all thy offerings, and accept with favour thy burnt offering! (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|20|5: May he grant thee thy heart's desire, and fulfil all thy counsel!
verses.Psalms|20|6: May we rejoice in Thy salvation, and in the name of our God set up our banner! Let the Lord fulfil all thy petitions!
verses.Psalms|20|7: Now I know that the Lord saves his anointed; that he answers him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
verses.Psalms|20|8: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will make mention of the name of the Lord our God.
verses.Psalms|20|9: They are bowed down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
verses.Psalms|20|10: Save, Lord; O King, who hears us on the day when we call.
verses.Psalms|21|1: To the chief Musicians, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|21|2: The king joys in Thy strength, O Lord; and in Thy salvation how greatly he rejoices!
verses.Psalms|21|3: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withheld the request of his lips. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|21|4: For Thou dost meet him with the blessings of goodness: Thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
verses.Psalms|21|5: He asked life of Thee, and Thou didst give it him; length of days for ever and ever.
verses.Psalms|21|6: His glory is great in Thy salvation: honour and majesty Thou dost lay upon him.
verses.Psalms|21|7: For Thou dost make him most blessed forever: Thou makest him exceeding glad with Thy countenance.
verses.Psalms|21|8: For the king trusts in the Lord, and through the steadfast love of the most High he shall not be moved.
verses.Psalms|21|9: Thy hand shall find out all Thy enemies: Thy right hand shall seize those that hate Thee.
verses.Psalms|21|10: Thou shalt make them like a fiery oven in the time of Thy anger: the Lord shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
verses.Psalms|21|11: Their fruit shalt Thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
verses.Psalms|21|12: For they intended evil against Thee: they imagined a mischievous device, but they will not succeed.
verses.Psalms|21|13: For Thou shalt make them turn their back; Thou shalt aim Thy bowstrings against the face of them.
verses.Psalms|21|14: Be Thou exalted, Lord, in Thy own strength: we will sing and praise Thy power.
verses.Psalms|22|1: To the chief Musician upon Aijeleth Shahar, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|22|2: My God, my God, why hast Thou forsaken me? why art Thou so far from helping me, from the words of my loud complaint?
verses.Psalms|22|3: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but Thou hearest not; and in the night season, and I have no rest.
verses.Psalms|22|4: But Thou art holy, O Thou That art enthroned upon the praises of Israel.
verses.Psalms|22|5: Our fathers trusted in Thee: they trusted, and Thou didst deliver them.
verses.Psalms|22|6: They cried to Thee, and were delivered: they trusted in Thee, and were not confounded.
verses.Psalms|22|7: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
verses.Psalms|22|8: All that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head,
verses.Psalms|22|9: saying, He trusts in the Lord that he will deliver him! Let him deliver him, seeing he delights in him.
verses.Psalms|22|10: But Thou art he that took me out of the womb: Thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.
verses.Psalms|22|11: I was cast upon Thee from the womb: Thou art my God from my mother's belly.
verses.Psalms|22|12: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
verses.Psalms|22|13: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
verses.Psalms|22|14: They gape upon me with their mouths, like a ravening and a roaring lion.
verses.Psalms|22|15: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is become like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
verses.Psalms|22|16: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaves to my jaws; and Thou layest me down in the dust of death.
verses.Psalms|22|17: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they seize my hands and my feet like a lion.
verses.Psalms|22|18: I can count all my bones: they look and stare upon me.
verses.Psalms|22|19: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
verses.Psalms|22|20: But be not Thou far from me, O Lord: O my strength, haste Thee to help me.
verses.Psalms|22|21: Deliver my life from the sword; my only one from the power of the dog.
verses.Psalms|22|22: Save me from the lion's mouth: for Thou hast answered me from the horns of the wild oxen.
verses.Psalms|22|23: I will declare Thy name to my brethren: in the midst of the congregation I will praise Thee.
verses.Psalms|22|24: You who fear the Lord, praise him; all you the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all the seed of Israel.
verses.Psalms|22|25: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; nor has he hid his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.
verses.Psalms|22|26: My praise shall be of Thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before those who fear him.
verses.Psalms|22|27: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: those who seek him shall praise the Lord: may your heart forever revive!
verses.Psalms|22|28: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn to the Lord: and all the families of the nations shall worship before Thee.
verses.Psalms|22|29: For the kingdom is the Lord's: and he is ruler over the nations.
verses.Psalms|22|30: All the fat ones of the earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust, and he that cannot keep alive his own soul, shall bow before him.
verses.Psalms|22|31: Their seed shall serve him; it shall be told of the Lord to the coming generation.
verses.Psalms|22|32: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, that he has done this.
verses.Psalms|23|1: A Psalm of David. The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.Psalms|23|2: He makes me to lie down in green pastures: he leads me beside the still waters.
verses.Psalms|23|3: He restores my soul: he leads me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
verses.Psalms|23|4: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for Thou art with me; Thy rod and Thy staff they comfort me.
verses.Psalms|23|5: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of my enemies: Thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runs over.
verses.Psalms|23|6: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.
verses.Psalms|24|1: A Psalm of David. The earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell in it.
verses.Psalms|24|2: For he has founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
verses.Psalms|24|3: Who shall ascend into the mountain of the Lord? or who shall stand in his holy place?
verses.Psalms|24|4: He that has clean hands, and a pure heart; who has not taken my name in vain, nor sworn deceitfully.
verses.Psalms|24|5: He shall receive a blessing from the Lord, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.Psalms|24|6: This is Jacob, the generation of those who seek him, that seek Thy face. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|24|7: Lift up your heads, O you gates; and be lifted up, you everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.Psalms|24|8: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.
verses.Psalms|24|9: Lift up your heads, O you gates; and lift them up, you everlasting doors; that the King of glory may come in.
verses.Psalms|24|10: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|25|1: Of David. To Thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.Psalms|25|2: O my God, I trust in Thee: let me not be ashamed, let not my enemies triumph over me.
verses.Psalms|25|3: Moreover let none that wait on Thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed who betray without cause.
verses.Psalms|25|4: Make me know Thy ways, O Lord; teach me Thy paths.
verses.Psalms|25|5: Lead me in Thy truth, and teach me: for Thou art the God of my salvation; for Thee do I wait all the day.
verses.Psalms|25|6: Remember, O Lord, Thy tender mercies and Thy truth; for they have been from of old.
verses.Psalms|25|7: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to Thy loyal love remember Thou me for Thy goodness' sake, O Lord.
verses.Psalms|25|8: Good and upright is the Lord: therefore does he instruct sinners in the way.
verses.Psalms|25|9: He directs the humble in justice: and he teaches the meek his way.
verses.Psalms|25|10: All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.Psalms|25|11: For Thy name's sake, O Lord, pardon my iniquity; for it is great.
verses.Psalms|25|12: What man is he that fears the Lord? him shall he teach in the way that he should choose.
verses.Psalms|25|13: His soul shall abide in prosperity; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
verses.Psalms|25|14: The counsel of the Lord is with them that fear him; and he will reveal to them his covenant.
verses.Psalms|25|15: My eyes are ever towards the Lord; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.Psalms|25|16: Turn Thee to me, and be gracious to me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.Psalms|25|17: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring me out of my distresses.
verses.Psalms|25|18: Look upon my affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
verses.Psalms|25|19: Consider my enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with a cruel hatred.
verses.Psalms|25|20: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in Thee.
verses.Psalms|25|21: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; because I wait for Thee.
verses.Psalms|25|22: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
verses.Psalms|26|1: Of David. Judge me, O Lord; for I have walked in my integrity: and I have trusted in the Lord; I shall not slip.
verses.Psalms|26|2: Examine me, O Lord, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
verses.Psalms|26|3: For Thy loyal love is before my eyes: and I have walked in Thy truth.
verses.Psalms|26|4: I have not sat with vain persons, neither do I enter the company of dissemblers.
verses.Psalms|26|5: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and I do not sit with the wicked.
verses.Psalms|26|6: I wash my hands in innocency: so I compass Thy altar, O Lord:
verses.Psalms|26|7: that I may sound the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all Thy wondrous works.
verses.Psalms|26|8: Lord, I love the habitation of Thy house, and the place where Thy glory dwells.
verses.Psalms|26|9: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:
verses.Psalms|26|10: in whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.Psalms|26|11: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity: redeem me, and be gracious unto me.
verses.Psalms|26|12: My foot stands in an even place: in the congregations I will bless the Lord.
verses.Psalms|27|1: Of David. The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the Lord is the stronghold of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.Psalms|27|2: When the wicked, my enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
verses.Psalms|27|3: Though a host should camp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.
verses.Psalms|27|4: One thing have I desired of the Lord, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the Lord, and to inquire in his temple.
verses.Psalms|27|5: For in the day of evil he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the covert of his tent he shall hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.
verses.Psalms|27|6: And now shall my head be lifted up above my enemies round about me: therefore I will offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, and I will make melody to the Lord.
verses.Psalms|27|7: Hear, O Lord, when I cry with my voice: be gracious to me, and answer me.
verses.Psalms|27|8: Of Thee my heart has said, Seek my face. Thy face, O Lord, I seek.
verses.Psalms|27|9: Hide not Thy face from me; put not Thy servant away in anger: Thou hast been my help; abandon me not, nor forsake me, O God of my salvation.
verses.Psalms|27|10: For my father and my mother have forsaken me, but the Lord will take me up.
verses.Psalms|27|11: Teach me Thy way, O Lord, and lead me in an even path, because of my enemies.
verses.Psalms|27|12: Deliver me not over to the will of my enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out violence.
verses.Psalms|27|13: Were it not that I believed I should see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.
verses.Psalms|27|14: Wait on the Lord: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thy heart: and wait on the Lord.
verses.Psalms|28|1: Of David. To Thee I will cry, O Lord; my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if Thou be silent to me, I become like those who go down into the pit.
verses.Psalms|28|2: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry to Thee, when I lift up my hands towards Thy holy sanctuary.
verses.Psalms|28|3: Drag me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbours, but there is evil in their hearts.
verses.Psalms|28|4: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
verses.Psalms|28|5: Because they give no heed to the works of the Lord, nor to the operation of his hands, he will destroy them, and not build them up.
verses.Psalms|28|6: Blessed be the Lord, because he has heard the voice of my supplications.
verses.Psalms|28|7: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoices; and with my song I will praise him.
verses.Psalms|28|8: The Lord is a strength to them, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
verses.Psalms|28|9: Save Thy people, and bless Thy inheritance: and shepherd them, and carry them forever.
verses.Psalms|29|1: A Psalm of David. Ascribe to the Lord, O you mighty, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.
verses.Psalms|29|2: Give to the Lord the glory due to his name; worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.
verses.Psalms|29|3: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters: the God of glory thunders: the Lord is upon many waters.
verses.Psalms|29|4: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is full of majesty.
verses.Psalms|29|5: The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars; yea, the Lord breaks the cedars of the Lebanon.
verses.Psalms|29|6: He makes them also skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox.
verses.Psalms|29|7: The voice of the Lord divides the flames of fire.
verses.Psalms|29|8: The voice of the Lord shakes the wilderness; the Lord shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.Psalms|29|9: The voice of the Lord makes the hinds to calve, and strips the forests bare, and in his temple everyone speaks of his glory.
verses.Psalms|29|10: The Lord sat enthroned at the flood; and he sits enthroned as King forever.
verses.Psalms|29|11: The Lord gives strength to his people; the Lord blesses his people with peace.
verses.Psalms|30|1: A Psalm and Song at the dedication of the house; of David.
verses.Psalms|30|2: I will extol Thee, O Lord; for Thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.Psalms|30|3: O Lord my God, I cried to Thee and Thou hast healed me.
verses.Psalms|30|4: O Lord, Thou hast brought up my soul from Sheol: Thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.Psalms|30|5: Sing to the Lord, O his pious ones, and give thanks to his holy name.
verses.Psalms|30|6: For his anger endures but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning.
verses.Psalms|30|7: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
verses.Psalms|30|8: Lord, by Thy favour Thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: Thou didst hide Thy face, and I was affrighted.
verses.Psalms|30|9: I cried to Thee, O Lord; and to the Lord I made supplication.
verses.Psalms|30|10: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall dust praise Thee? shall it declare Thy truth?
verses.Psalms|30|11: Hear, O Lord, and be gracious to me: Lord, be Thou my helper.
verses.Psalms|30|12: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: Thou hast loosed my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
verses.Psalms|30|13: to the end that my glory may sing praise to Thee, and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks to Thee forever.
verses.Psalms|31|1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|31|2: In Thee, O Lord, do I take refuge; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in Thy righteousness.
verses.Psalms|31|3: Incline Thy ear to me; deliver me speedily: be Thou my strong rock, a fortress of defence to save me.
verses.Psalms|31|4: For Thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for Thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.
verses.Psalms|31|5: Pull me out of the net that they have hidden for me: for Thou art my stronghold.
verses.Psalms|31|6: Into Thy hand I commit my spirit: Thou hast redeemed me, O Lord God of truth.
verses.Psalms|31|7: I hate them that regard vain idols: but I trust in the Lord.
verses.Psalms|31|8: I will be glad and rejoice in Thy loyal love: for Thou hast considered my affliction: Thou hast known the troubles of my soul;
verses.Psalms|31|9: and Thou hast not delivered me up into the hand of the enemy: Thou hast set my feet in a broad place.
verses.Psalms|31|10: Be gracious to me, O Lord, for I am in trouble: my eye is consumed with grief, my soul and my body.
verses.Psalms|31|11: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength fails because of my iniquity, and my bones are wasted away.
verses.Psalms|31|12: I am the scorn of all my adversaries, and very much of my neighbours, and a dread to my acquaintances: those who see me in the street flee from me.
verses.Psalms|31|13: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
verses.Psalms|31|14: For I have heard the slander of many: fear on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
verses.Psalms|31|15: But I trusted in Thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my God.
verses.Psalms|31|16: My times are in Thy hand: deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.
verses.Psalms|31|17: Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant: save me by Thy loyal love.
verses.Psalms|31|18: Let me not be ashamed, O Lord; for I have called upon Thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in Sheol.
verses.Psalms|31|19: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak arrogant words, proudly and contemptuously, against the righteous.
verses.Psalms|31|20: Oh how great is Thy goodness, which Thou has laid up for those who fear Thee; which Thou hast performed for those who trust in Thee in the sight of the sons of men!
verses.Psalms|31|21: Thou hidest them in the covert of Thy presence from the plots of men: Thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
verses.Psalms|31|22: Blessed be the Lord: for he has shown me his marvellous love in a strong city.
verses.Psalms|31|23: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before Thy eyes: nevertheless Thou didst hear the voice of my supplications when I cried to Thee.
verses.Psalms|31|24: O love the Lord, all his pious ones: for the Lord preserves the faithful, and plentifully repays him who acts haughtily.
verses.Psalms|31|25: Be of good courage, and let your heart be strong, all you who hope in the Lord.
verses.Psalms|32|1: Of David. A maskil. Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.Psalms|32|2: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord imputes no iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
verses.Psalms|32|3: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all the day long.
verses.Psalms|32|4: For day and night Thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|32|5: I acknowledged my sin to Thee, and my iniquity I have not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the Lord; and Thou didst forgive the iniquity of my sin. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|32|6: For this shall everyone that is godly pray to Thee in a time when Thou mayst be found: then surely the floods of great waters shall not come near him.
verses.Psalms|32|7: Thou art my hiding place; Thou shalt preserve me from trouble; Thou dost compass me about with songs of deliverance. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|32|8: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will counsel thee, with my eye upon thee.
verses.Psalms|32|9: Be not like the horse, or the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, that they come not near to thee.
verses.Psalms|32|10: Many are the sorrows of the wicked: but he that trusts in the Lord, shall be surrounded by love.
verses.Psalms|32|11: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, O you righteous: and shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart.
verses.Psalms|33|1: Rejoice in the Lord, O you righteous: praise is comely for the upright.
verses.Psalms|33|2: Praise the Lord with a lyre: make melody to him with the harp of ten strings.
verses.Psalms|33|3: Sing to him a new song; play skillfully with loud jubilations.
verses.Psalms|33|4: For the word of the Lord is right; and all his work is done in faithfulness.
verses.Psalms|33|5: He loves righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|33|6: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
verses.Psalms|33|7: He gathers the waters of the sea together like a rampart: he lays up the depths in storehouses.
verses.Psalms|33|8: Let all the earth fear the Lord: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.Psalms|33|9: For he spoke, and it was; he commanded, and it stood fast.
verses.Psalms|33|10: The Lord brings the counsel of the nations to nought: he makes the devices of the peoples to be of no effect.
verses.Psalms|33|11: The counsel of the Lord stands forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.Psalms|33|12: Happy is the nation whose God is the Lord; and the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.Psalms|33|13: The Lord looks down from heaven; he beholds all the sons of men.
verses.Psalms|33|14: From the place of his habitation he looks upon all the inhabitants of the earth;
verses.Psalms|33|15: he who fashions their hearts alike; who considers all their deeds.
verses.Psalms|33|16: There is no king saved by the multitude of a host: a mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
verses.Psalms|33|17: A horse is a vain thing for safety: nor shall he save by his great strength.
verses.Psalms|33|18: Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon those who fear him, upon those who hope in his steadfast love:
verses.Psalms|33|19: to deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
verses.Psalms|33|20: Our soul waited for the Lord: he is our help and our shield.
verses.Psalms|33|21: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.Psalms|33|22: Let Thy steadfast love, O Lord be upon us, even as we hope in Thee.
verses.Psalms|34|1: Of David, when he changed his demeanour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed.
verses.Psalms|34|2: I will bless the Lord at all time: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.Psalms|34|3: My soul shall glory in the Lord: the humble shall hear of it, and be glad.
verses.Psalms|34|4: O magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together.
verses.Psalms|34|5: I sought the Lord, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.Psalms|34|6: They looked to him, and are radiant: and their faces shall not be ashamed.
verses.Psalms|34|7: This poor man cries, and the Lord hears, and saves him out of all his troubles.
verses.Psalms|34|8: The angel of the Lord encamps round about those who fear him, and he delivers them.
verses.Psalms|34|9: O taste and see that the Lord is good: blessed is the man who trusts in him.
verses.Psalms|34|10: O fear the Lord, you saints of his: for those who fear him have no lack.
verses.Psalms|34|11: The young lions lack, and suffer hunger: but they who seek the Lord shall not want any good thing.
verses.Psalms|34|12: Come, children, hearken to me: I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|34|13: Who is the man that desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
verses.Psalms|34|14: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
verses.Psalms|34|15: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.Psalms|34|16: The eyes of the Lord are towards the righteous, and his ears are open to their cry.
verses.Psalms|34|17: The face of the Lord is against those who do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.Psalms|34|18: The righteous cry, and the Lord hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
verses.Psalms|34|19: The Lord is near to them who are of a broken heart; and he saves such as are of a contrite spirit.
verses.Psalms|34|20: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the Lord delivers him out of them all.
verses.Psalms|34|21: He keeps all his bones: not one of them is broken.
verses.Psalms|34|22: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be condemned.
verses.Psalms|34|23: The Lord redeems the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be condemned.
verses.Psalms|35|1: Of David. Strive, O Lord, with those who contend against me: fight with those who oppose me.
verses.Psalms|35|2: Take hold of shield and buckler, and rise up for my help.
verses.Psalms|35|3: Draw out also the spear, and battle axe against those who persecute me: say to my soul, I am thy salvation.
verses.Psalms|35|4: Let them be confounded and put to shame who seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion who devise my hurt.
verses.Psalms|35|5: Let them be as chaff before the wind: the angel of the Lord thrusting them.
verses.Psalms|35|6: Let their way be dark and slippery: the angel of the Lord pursuing them.
verses.Psalms|35|7: For without cause have they hid for me their net; a pit without cause have they dug for my soul.
verses.Psalms|35|8: Let destruction come upon him unawares; and let his net that he has hid catch himself: let him fall to ruin.
verses.Psalms|35|9: And my soul shall be joyful in the Lord: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
verses.Psalms|35|10: All my bones shall say, Lord, who is like Thee, who delivers the poor from him that is too strong for him, and the poor and the needy from him that robs him?
verses.Psalms|35|11: False witnesses rise up; they ask me things that I know not.
verses.Psalms|35|12: They repay me evil for good; a bereavement to my soul!
verses.Psalms|35|13: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I afflicted my soul with fasting; and as for my prayer may it return to my own bosom.
verses.Psalms|35|14: I went about as for my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one who mourns for his mother.
verses.Psalms|35|15: But when I stumble they rejoice, and gather themselves together. Wretches whom I have not known tear me in pieces without ceasing.
verses.Psalms|35|16: Like profane men, scornful mockers, they grind their teeth against me.
verses.Psalms|35|17: Lord, how long wilt Thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my only one from the lions.
verses.Psalms|35|18: I will give Thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise Thee among a numerous people.
verses.Psalms|35|19: Let not those who are wrongfully my enemies rejoice over me; or those who hate me without cause wink their eye.
verses.Psalms|35|20: For they seek not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against those who are quiet in the land.
verses.Psalms|35|21: For they open their mouths wide against me, and say, Aha, aha, our eye has seen it.
verses.Psalms|35|22: Thou hast seen, O Lord: keep no silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
