verses.Psalms|35|23: Rouse Thyself, and awake to my judgment; to my cause, my God and my Lord.
verses.Psalms|35|24: Judge me, O Lord my God, according to Thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
verses.Psalms|35|25: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so we have our desire: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
verses.Psalms|35|26: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together, those who rejoice at my hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour, those who magnify themselves against me.
verses.Psalms|35|27: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, those who favour my righteous cause: and let them say continually, Let the Lord be magnified, who has pleasure in the welfare of his servant.
verses.Psalms|35|28: And my tongue shall speak of Thy righteousness; of Thy praise all the day long.
verses.Psalms|36|1: To the chief Musician, of David the servant of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|36|2: Transgression speaks to the wicked within his heart; there is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.Psalms|36|3: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, that his iniquity cannot be found out and hated.
verses.Psalms|36|4: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he has left off being wise, and doing good.
verses.Psalms|36|5: He devises mischief upon his bed; he sets himself in a way that is not good; he does not abhor evil.
verses.Psalms|36|6: Thy steadfast love, O Lord, is in the heavens; and Thy faithfulness reaches the clouds.
verses.Psalms|36|7: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; Thy judgments are a great deep: O Lord, Thou preservest man and beast.
verses.Psalms|36|8: How excellent is Thy love, O God! therefore the children of men shelter under the shadow of Thy wings.
verses.Psalms|36|9: They are abundantly satisfied with the fatness of Thy house; and Thou makest them to drink of the river of Thy pleasures.
verses.Psalms|36|10: For with Thee is the fountain of life: in Thy light we see light.
verses.Psalms|36|11: O continue Thy steadfast love to those who know Thee; and Thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.Psalms|36|12: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.
verses.Psalms|36|13: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and are not able to rise.
verses.Psalms|37|1: Of David. Fret not thyself because of evil doers, nor be envious against the workers of iniquity.
verses.Psalms|37|2: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
verses.Psalms|37|3: Trust in the Lord, and do good; dwell in the land, and enjoy security.
verses.Psalms|37|4: Delight thyself also in the Lord; and he shall give thee the desires of thy heart.
verses.Psalms|37|5: Commit thy way to the Lord; trust also in him; and he will bring it to pass.
verses.Psalms|37|6: And he will bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment like the noonday.
verses.Psalms|37|7: Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who accomplishes wicked devices.
verses.Psalms|37|8: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself: it comes to no good.
verses.Psalms|37|9: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those who wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.
verses.Psalms|37|10: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: and thou shalt look well at his place, but he will not be there.
verses.Psalms|37|11: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.Psalms|37|12: The wicked man plots against the just, and grinds his teeth against him.
verses.Psalms|37|13: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he sees that his day is coming.
verses.Psalms|37|14: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as are of upright ways.
verses.Psalms|37|15: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
verses.Psalms|37|16: A little that a righteous man has is better than the riches of many wicked men.
verses.Psalms|37|17: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the Lord upholds the just.
verses.Psalms|37|18: The Lord knows the days of the innocent: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
verses.Psalms|37|19: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.Psalms|37|20: But the wicked and the enemies of the Lord shall perish like the glory of the meadows; they shall consume; they shall pass away in smoke.
verses.Psalms|37|21: The wicked borrows, but does not pay back: but the righteous man gives with a good grace.
verses.Psalms|37|22: For such as are blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that are cursed of him shall be cut off.
verses.Psalms|37|23: The steps of a man are ordered by the Lord: and he delights in his way.
verses.Psalms|37|24: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the Lord upholds him with his hand.
verses.Psalms|37|25: I have been young, and now am old; yet I have not seen a just man forsaken, and his seed begging bread.
verses.Psalms|37|26: He lends generously at all times; and his seed is blessed.
verses.Psalms|37|27: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
verses.Psalms|37|28: For the Lord loves justice, and forsakes not his pious ones; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.Psalms|37|29: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell in it for ever.
verses.Psalms|37|30: The mouth of the righteous speaks wisdom, and his tongue discourses justice.
verses.Psalms|37|31: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall falter.
verses.Psalms|37|32: The wicked man watches the righteous, and seeks to slay him.
verses.Psalms|37|33: The Lord will not leave him in his hand, nor allow him to be condemned when he is judged.
verses.Psalms|37|34: Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
verses.Psalms|37|35: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
verses.Psalms|37|36: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.Psalms|37|37: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
verses.Psalms|37|38: But the transgressors are destroyed together: the end of the wicked is cut off.
verses.Psalms|37|39: And the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
verses.Psalms|37|40: And the Lord will help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they take refuge in him.
verses.Psalms|38|1: A Psalm of David, for invocation.
verses.Psalms|38|2: O Lord, rebuke me not in Thy wrath: nor chasten me in Thy hot displeasure.
verses.Psalms|38|3: For Thy arrows stick fast in me, and Thy hand presses me sore.
verses.Psalms|38|4: There is no soundness in my flesh because of Thy anger; nor is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
verses.Psalms|38|5: For my iniquities are gone over my head: like a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
verses.Psalms|38|6: My wounds stink; they fester because of my foolishness.
verses.Psalms|38|7: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
verses.Psalms|38|8: For my loins are filled with burning: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.Psalms|38|9: I am feeble and sore broken: I groan by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
verses.Psalms|38|10: Lord, all my desire is before Thee; and my sighing is not hid from Thee.
verses.Psalms|38|11: My heart palpitates, my strength fails me: as for the light of my eyes, it also is gone from me.
verses.Psalms|38|12: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
verses.Psalms|38|13: And they who seek after my life lay snares for me: and they who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all the day long.
verses.Psalms|38|14: But I, like a deaf man, hear not; and like a dumb man that opens not his mouth.
verses.Psalms|38|15: Thus I was like a man that hears not, and in whose mouth are no rebukes.
verses.Psalms|38|16: For in Thee, O Lord, I hope: Thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
verses.Psalms|38|17: For I said, Lest they should rejoice over me: when my foot slips, they magnify themselves against me.
verses.Psalms|38|18: For I am ready to stumble, and my pain is continually before me.
verses.Psalms|38|19: For I will declare my iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
verses.Psalms|38|20: But my enemies are in vigorous life; and they who hate me wrongfully are many.
verses.Psalms|38|21: They also who render evil for good are my adversaries; because I follow what is good.
verses.Psalms|38|22: Forsake me not, O Lord: O my God, be not far from me.
verses.Psalms|38|23: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
verses.Psalms|39|1: To the chief Musician, for Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|39|2: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep a curb on my mouth, while the wicked man is before me.
verses.Psalms|39|3: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, had no comfort, and my pain was stirred up.
verses.Psalms|39|4: My heart was hot within me; while I was musing, the fire burned: then I spoke with my tongue,
verses.Psalms|39|5: Lord, make me to know my end, and the measure of my days, what it is; I will know how frail I am.
verses.Psalms|39|6: Behold, Thou hast made my days like handbreadths; and my age is as nothing before Thee: truly every man at his best state is altogether vanity. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|39|7: Surely every man walks in a vain show: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heaps up riches, and knows not who shall gather them.
verses.Psalms|39|8: And now, Lord, what do I wait for? my hope is in Thee.
verses.Psalms|39|9: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the base man.
verses.Psalms|39|10: I am dumb, I open not my mouth; because Thou didst it.
verses.Psalms|39|11: Remove Thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of Thy hand.
verses.Psalms|39|12: When Thou with rebukes dost correct a man for iniquity, Thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|39|13: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and give ear to my cry; keep not silence at my tears: for I am a stranger with Thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
verses.Psalms|39|14: Look away from me, that I may recover brightness, before I go hence, and am no more.
verses.Psalms|40|1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|40|2: I waited patiently for the Lord; and he inclined to me, and heard my cry.
verses.Psalms|40|3: He brought me up also out of the gruesome pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my footsteps.
verses.Psalms|40|4: And he has put a new song in my mouth, a praise to our God. Many shall see, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord.
verses.Psalms|40|5: Blessed is that man that makes the Lord his trust, and looks not to the proud, nor to such as turn aside to lies.
verses.Psalms|40|6: Many, O Lord my God, are Thy wonderful works which Thou hast done, and Thy thoughts which are towards us: none can compare with Thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
verses.Psalms|40|7: Thou dost not desire sacrifice or meal offering; Thou hast dug open my ears; burnt offering and sin offering hast Thou not required.
verses.Psalms|40|8: Then said I, Lo, I come with the scroll of the book which is written for me;
verses.Psalms|40|9: I delight to do Thy will, O my God: and Thy law is within my heart.
verses.Psalms|40|10: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I did not refrain my lips, O Lord, Thou knowst.
verses.Psalms|40|11: I have not hid Thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared Thy faithfulness and Thy salvation: I have not concealed Thy love and Thy truth from the great congregation.
verses.Psalms|40|12: Withhold not Thou Thy tender mercies from me, O Lord: let Thy steadfast love and Thy truth continually preserve me.
verses.Psalms|40|13: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: my iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of my head: therefore my heart fails me.
verses.Psalms|40|14: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me: O Lord, make haste to help me.
verses.Psalms|40|15: Let them be ashamed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be turned backward and put to shame who wish me evil.
verses.Psalms|40|16: Let them be appalled because of their shame who say concerning me, Aha, aha.
verses.Psalms|40|17: Let all those who seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee: let such as love Thy salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified.
verses.Psalms|40|18: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord takes thought for me: Thou art my help and my deliverer; delay not, O my God!
verses.Psalms|41|1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|41|2: Blessed is he who considers the poor: the Lord will deliver him in the day of evil.
verses.Psalms|41|3: The Lord preserves him, and keeps him alive; he is called happy upon the earth: and Thou wilt not deliver him to the will of his enemies.
verses.Psalms|41|4: The Lord strengthens him upon the bed of sickness: whenever he is prostrate Thou recoverest him in his illness.
verses.Psalms|41|5: I said, Lord, be gracious to me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against Thee.
verses.Psalms|41|6: My enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
verses.Psalms|41|7: And if one comes to see me, he speaks vanity: his heart gathers iniquity to itself; when he goes abroad, he tells it.
verses.Psalms|41|8: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me they devise my hurt.
verses.Psalms|41|9: An evil disease, say they, cleaves fast to him: and from where he lies he shall rise up no more.
verses.Psalms|41|10: Even my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who did eat of my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
verses.Psalms|41|11: But Thou, O Lord, be gracious to me, and raise me up, that I may pay them back.
verses.Psalms|41|12: By this I know that Thou favourest me, because my enemy does not triumph over me.
verses.Psalms|41|13: And as for me, Thou upholdest me in my integrity, and settest me before Thy face for ever.
verses.Psalms|41|14: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
verses.Psalms|42|1: To the chief Musician, A Maschil, for the sons of Korah.
verses.Psalms|42|2: As the hart pants after the water brooks, so my soul pants after Thee, O God.
verses.Psalms|42|3: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?
verses.Psalms|42|4: My tears have been my bread day and night, while they say to me all the day, Where is thy God?
verses.Psalms|42|5: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: how I was wont to pass on with the throng, leading them in procession to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, a crowd keeping holiday.
verses.Psalms|42|6: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why dost thou moan within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
verses.Psalms|42|7: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: because I remember Thee from the land of Jordan and the hills of Hermon, from the mount Mizar.
verses.Psalms|42|8: Deep calls to deep at the noise of Thy cataracts: all Thy waves and Thy billows are gone over me.
verses.Psalms|42|9: Yet the Lord will command his steadfast love in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, a prayer to the God of my life.
verses.Psalms|42|10: I will say to God my rock, Why hast Thou forgotten me? why go I mourning under the oppression of the enemy?
verses.Psalms|42|11: Like a deadly wound in my bones, my enemies taunt me; while they say daily to me, Where is thy God?
verses.Psalms|42|12: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why moanest thou within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
verses.Psalms|43|1: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
verses.Psalms|43|2: For Thou art the God of my strength: why dost Thou cast me off? why go I mourning under the oppression of the enemy?
verses.Psalms|43|3: O send out Thy light and Thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me to Thy holy hill, and to Thy dwelling places.
verses.Psalms|43|4: Then will I go to the altar of God, to God my exceeding joy: and I will praise thee with the lyre, O God my God.
verses.Psalms|43|5: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why dost thou moan within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
verses.Psalms|44|1: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Maschil.
verses.Psalms|44|2: We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us, what work Thou didst in their days, in the times of old:
verses.Psalms|44|3: how Thou didst drive out nations with Thy hand, and didst plant them; how Thou didst batter the peoples, and cast them out.
verses.Psalms|44|4: For they did not get the land in possession by their own sword, nor did their own arm save them: but Thy right hand, and Thy arm, and the light of Thy countenance, because Thou didst favourably accept them.
verses.Psalms|44|5: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
verses.Psalms|44|6: Through Thee will we push down our enemies: through Thy name will we tread those under who rise up against us.
verses.Psalms|44|7: For I trust not in my bow, nor shall my sword save me.
verses.Psalms|44|8: But Thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put to shame those who hated us.
verses.Psalms|44|9: In God we have gloried all the day long, and we praise Thy name for ever. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|44|10: Yet, Thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and Thou goest not forth with our armies.
verses.Psalms|44|11: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they who hate us take plunder for themselves.
verses.Psalms|44|12: Thou hast given us like sheep to be eaten: and hast scattered us among the nations.
verses.Psalms|44|13: Thou sellest Thy people for no great gain, and hast not put high their prices.
verses.Psalms|44|14: Thou dost make us a taunt to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to those round about us.
verses.Psalms|44|15: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.Psalms|44|16: My confusion is before me all the day, and the shame of my face has covered me,
verses.Psalms|44|17: For the voice of him that taunts and blasphemes; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
verses.Psalms|44|18: All this is come upon us; yet we have not forgotten Thee, nor have we been false to Thy covenant.
verses.Psalms|44|19: Our heart is not turned back, nor have our steps declined from Thy way;
verses.Psalms|44|20: though Thou hast sore broken us in the place of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.Psalms|44|21: If we had forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
verses.Psalms|44|22: would not God search this out? for he knows the secrets of the heart.
verses.Psalms|44|23: But for Thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are reckoned as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.Psalms|44|24: Awake, why sleepest Thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.
verses.Psalms|44|25: Why dost Thou hide Thy face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
verses.Psalms|44|26: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaves to the earth.
verses.Psalms|44|27: Arise for our help, and redeem us for the sake of Thy steadfast love.
verses.Psalms|45|1: To the chief Musician, to Shoshannim, A Maschil for the sons of Korah. A Song of loves.
verses.Psalms|45|2: My heart overflows with a goodly matter: I relate my verses for the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
verses.Psalms|45|3: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God has blessed thee for ever.
verses.Psalms|45|4: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O mighty warrior: thy glory and thy majesty.
verses.Psalms|45|5: And in thy majesty ride prosperously on in the cause of truth and for the sake of righteousness; and let thy right hand teach thee terrible things.
verses.Psalms|45|6: Thy arrows are sharp: the people fall under thee: they sink into the heart of the king's enemies.
verses.Psalms|45|7: Thy throne, of God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a sceptre of equity.
verses.Psalms|45|8: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, has anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.Psalms|45|9: All thy garments are fragrant with myrrh, and aloes, and cassia: out of the ivory palaces stringed instruments have made thee glad.
verses.Psalms|45|10: Kings' daughters are among thy favourites: upon thy right hand stands the queen in gold of Ophir.
verses.Psalms|45|11: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thy ear; forget also thy own people, and thy father's house;
verses.Psalms|45|12: so shall the king desire thy beauty: for he is thy lord; and do homage to him.
verses.Psalms|45|13: And O daughter of Tyre, the rich among the people, shall entreat thy favour with a gift.
verses.Psalms|45|14: The king's daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is inwrought with gold.
verses.Psalms|45|15: She shall be brought to the king in embroidered garments: the virgins, her companions that follow her, shall be brought to thee.
verses.Psalms|45|16: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be led: they shall enter the king's palace.
verses.Psalms|45|17: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou shalt make princes in all the earth.
verses.Psalms|45|18: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise Thee for ever and ever.
verses.Psalms|46|1: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song to Alamoth.
verses.Psalms|46|2: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.Psalms|46|3: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth change, and though the mountains are moved in the midst of the sea;
verses.Psalms|46|4: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|46|5: There is a river, whose streams make glad the city of God, the holiest dwelling place of the most High.
verses.Psalms|46|6: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her at the dawn of day.
verses.Psalms|46|7: Nations raged, kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
verses.Psalms|46|8: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|46|9: Come, behold the works of the Lord, who has made desolations in the earth.
verses.Psalms|46|10: He makes wars to cease to the end of the earth; he breaks the bow, and cuts the spear in sunder; he burns the chariots in the fire.
verses.Psalms|46|11: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.Psalms|46|12: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|47|1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.Psalms|47|2: O clap your hands, all you peoples; shout to God with the voice of triumph.
verses.Psalms|47|3: For the Lord most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.
verses.Psalms|47|4: He subdues peoples under us, and nations under our feet.
verses.Psalms|47|5: He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob whom he loves. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|47|6: God is gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a shofar.
verses.Psalms|47|7: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises to our King, sing praises.
verses.Psalms|47|8: For God is the King of all the earth: sing a Maschil psalm.
verses.Psalms|47|9: God reigns over the nations: God sits upon the throne of his holiness.
verses.Psalms|47|10: The nobles of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong to God: he is greatly exalted.
verses.Psalms|48|1: A Song, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.Psalms|48|2: Great is the Lord, and highly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.
verses.Psalms|48|3: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth: mount Zion, the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.Psalms|48|4: God is known in her palaces for a fortress.
verses.Psalms|48|5: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they came on together.
verses.Psalms|48|6: As soon as they saw, they were astounded; they were affrighted; they rushed away.
verses.Psalms|48|7: Fear took hold of them there, and pain, like a woman in travail.
verses.Psalms|48|8: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
verses.Psalms|48|9: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God: may God establish it for ever. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|48|10: We have thought of Thy steadfast love, O God, in the midst of Thy temple.
verses.Psalms|48|11: According to Thy name, O God, so is Thy praise to the ends of the earth: Thy right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.Psalms|48|12: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of Thy judgments.
verses.Psalms|48|13: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: count her towers.
verses.Psalms|48|14: Mark well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that you may tell it to the generation following.
verses.Psalms|48|15: For such is God, our God, for ever and ever: he will be our guide to the death.
verses.Psalms|49|1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.Psalms|49|2: Hear this, all the peoples; give ear, all the inhabitants of the world:
verses.Psalms|49|3: both low and high, rich and poor, together.
verses.Psalms|49|4: My mouth shall speak wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be understanding.
verses.Psalms|49|5: I will incline my ear to a parable: I will open my riddle to the lyre.
verses.Psalms|49|6: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my persecutors compasses me about?
verses.Psalms|49|7: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
verses.Psalms|49|8: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:
verses.Psalms|49|9: for the redemption of their soul is too dear, and he leaves it for ever:
verses.Psalms|49|10: that he might still live for ever, and not see the pit.
verses.Psalms|49|11: When he sees that wise men die, that the fool and the brutish person perish together, and leave their wealth to others:
verses.Psalms|49|12: their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.
verses.Psalms|49|13: Nevertheless man abides not in honour: he is like the beasts that perish.
verses.Psalms|49|14: This is their way in their folly: and their posterity who approve their sayings. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|49|15: Like sheep they are appointed to Sheol; death shall be their shepherd; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their form shall waste away in Sheol, leaving behind their dwelling.
verses.Psalms|49|16: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol: for he shall receive me. (Sheol.)
verses.Psalms|49|17: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
verses.Psalms|49|18: for when he dies he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.
verses.Psalms|49|19: Though while he lives he blesses his soul: and though men praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself:
verses.Psalms|49|20: it shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.
verses.Psalms|49|21: Man that is in honour, and understands not, is like the beasts that perish.
verses.Psalms|50|1: A Psalm of Asaph. The mighty one, God, the Lord, has spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun to the going down thereof.
verses.Psalms|50|2: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God has shone forth.
verses.Psalms|50|3: Our God comes, and does not keep silence: a fire devours before him, and it is very tempestuous round about him.
verses.Psalms|50|4: He calls to the heavens above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.
verses.Psalms|50|5: Gather my pious ones together to me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
verses.Psalms|50|6: And the heavens declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|50|7: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, thy God.
verses.Psalms|50|8: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices; and thy burnt offerings are continually before me.
verses.Psalms|50|9: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.
verses.Psalms|50|10: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
verses.Psalms|50|11: I know all the birds of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.
verses.Psalms|50|12: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
verses.Psalms|50|13: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
verses.Psalms|50|14: Offer to God a thanksgiving; and pay thy vows to the most High:
verses.Psalms|50|15: and call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
verses.Psalms|50|16: But to the wicked man God says, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldst take my covenant in thy mouth?
verses.Psalms|50|17: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and dost cast my words behind thee.
verses.Psalms|50|18: When thou didst see a thief, then thou didst consort with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.
verses.Psalms|50|19: Thou givest thy mouth free rein for evil, and thy tongue frames deceit.
verses.Psalms|50|20: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou dost slander thy own mother's son.
verses.Psalms|50|21: These things hast thou done, and if I kept silence, thou wouldst think that I was altogether such a one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set the matter before thy eyes.
verses.Psalms|50|22: Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.
verses.Psalms|50|23: Whoever offers praise glorifies me: and to him that orders his way aright I will show the salvation of God.
verses.Psalms|51|1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David,
verses.Psalms|51|2: when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bath-sheba.
verses.Psalms|51|3: Be gracious to me, O God, according to Thy steadfast love: according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
verses.Psalms|51|4: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
verses.Psalms|51|5: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.
verses.Psalms|51|6: Against Thee, Thee alone, have I sinned, and done that which is evil in Thy sight: so that Thou art justified in Thy sentence, and clear in Thy judgment.
verses.Psalms|51|7: Behold, I was shaped in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
verses.Psalms|51|8: Behold, Thou desirest truth in the inward parts: therefore teach me wisdom in the inmost heart.
verses.Psalms|51|9: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
verses.Psalms|51|10: Make me to hear joy and gladness: that the bones which Thou hast broken may rejoice.
verses.Psalms|51|11: Hide Thy face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.
verses.Psalms|51|12: Create in me a clean heart, O God and renew a steadfast spirit within me.
verses.Psalms|51|13: Cast me not away from Thy presence; and take not Thy holy spirit from me.
verses.Psalms|51|14: Restore to me the joy of Thy salvation; and uphold me with a willing spirit.
verses.Psalms|51|15: Then I will teach transgressors Thy ways; and sinners shall return to Thee.
verses.Psalms|51|16: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, Thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of Thy righteousness.
verses.Psalms|51|17: O Lord, open my lips; and my mouth shall rehearse Thy praise.
verses.Psalms|51|18: For Thou desirest not sacrifice; or else I would give it: Thou delightest not in burnt offering.
verses.Psalms|51|19: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, Thou wilt not despise.
verses.Psalms|51|20: Do good in Thy favour to Zion: build Thou the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.Psalms|51|21: Then shalt Thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon Thy altar.
verses.Psalms|52|1: To the chief Musician, A Maschil of David,
verses.Psalms|52|2: when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said to him, David is come to the house of Ahimelech.
verses.Psalms|52|3: Why boastest thou thyself of evil, O mighty man? the love of God endures for all time.
verses.Psalms|52|4: Thy tongue devises mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
verses.Psalms|52|5: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than speaking righteousness. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|52|6: Thou lovest all devouring words, a deceitful tongue.
verses.Psalms|52|7: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy tent, and root thee out of the land of the living. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|52|8: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
verses.Psalms|52|9: lo, this is the man who made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
verses.Psalms|52|10: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the love of God for ever and ever.
verses.Psalms|52|11: I will give Thee thanks for ever, because Thou hast done it: and I will wait on Thy name, for it is good, before Thy saints.
verses.Psalms|53|1: To the chief Musician on Mahalath, A Maschil of David.
verses.Psalms|53|2: The fool has said in his heart, There is no God. They have acted corruptly, and they have done abominable iniquity: there is none that does good.
verses.Psalms|53|3: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any man of discernment, that did seek God.
verses.Psalms|53|4: Is every one of them dross? are they altogether filthy? is there no one who does good? No, not even one.
verses.Psalms|53|5: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread: and do not call upon God?
verses.Psalms|53|6: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God has scattered the bones of him that encamps against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God has rejected them.
verses.Psalms|53|7: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God brings back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.Psalms|54|1: To the chief Musician for strings, A Maschil of David,
verses.Psalms|54|2: when the Ziphim came and said to Saul, Does not David hide himself with us?
verses.Psalms|54|3: Save me, O God, by Thy name, and judge me by Thy strength.
verses.Psalms|54|4: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.Psalms|54|5: For strangers are risen up against me, and violent men seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|54|6: Behold, God is my helper: the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
verses.Psalms|54|7: He rewards evil to my enemies: O, cut them off in Thy truth.
verses.Psalms|54|8: I will sacrifice a free will offering to Thee: I will praise Thy name, O Lord; for it is good.
verses.Psalms|54|9: For he has delivered me out of all trouble: and my eye has gazed upon my enemies.
verses.Psalms|55|1: To the chief Musician for strings, A Maschil of David.
verses.Psalms|55|2: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not Thyself from my supplication.
verses.Psalms|55|3: Attend to me, and answer me: I sob in my complaint, and make moan;
verses.Psalms|55|4: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they persecute me.
verses.Psalms|55|5: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
verses.Psalms|55|6: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror has overwhelmed me.
verses.Psalms|55|7: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then I would fly away, and be at rest.
verses.Psalms|55|8: Lo, then I would wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|55|9: I would hasten to find a refuge for myself from the windy storm and the tempest.
verses.Psalms|55|10: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.Psalms|55|11: Day and night they go about it upon its walls: mischief also and trouble are in the midst of it.
verses.Psalms|55|12: Wickedness is in the midst of it: oppression and fraud depart not from her streets.
verses.Psalms|55|13: For it was not an enemy who taunted me; then I could have borne it: nor was it one who hated me who did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
verses.Psalms|55|14: but it was Thou, a man my equal, my companion, and my familiar friend.
verses.Psalms|55|15: We took sweet counsel together, and walked to the house of God in company.
verses.Psalms|55|16: Let death spread its oblivion upon them, and let them go down alive into Sheol: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
verses.Psalms|55|17: As for me, I will call upon God; and the Lord shall save me.
verses.Psalms|55|18: Evening, and morning, and at noon, I pray, and cry aloud: and he hears my voice.
verses.Psalms|55|19: He has delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many who strove with me.
verses.Psalms|55|20: God who is enthroned from olden time, shall hear and afflict them (Selah;) those who dread no changes, and do not fear God.
verses.Psalms|55|21: He has put forth his hands against such as are at peace with him: he has broken his covenant.
verses.Psalms|55|22: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
verses.Psalms|55|23: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verses.Psalms|55|24: But Thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in Thee.
verses.Psalms|56|1: To the chief Musician, upon Jonath-elem-rechokim, A Michtam of David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath.
verses.Psalms|56|2: Be gracious to me, O God: for men long to swallow me up; all day long the foeman oppresses me.
verses.Psalms|56|3: My enemies daily long to swallow me up, for they are many who fight against me, O Thou most High.
verses.Psalms|56|4: When I am afraid, I will trust in Thee.
verses.Psalms|56|5: In God, I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear; what can flesh do to me?
verses.Psalms|56|6: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.Psalms|56|7: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, as they wait for my soul.
verses.Psalms|56|8: Shall they escape by iniquity? in Thy anger cast down the peoples, O God.
verses.Psalms|56|9: Thou dost count my wanderings: put my tears into Thy bottle: are they not in Thy book?
verses.Psalms|56|10: When I cry to Thee, then shall my enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.
verses.Psalms|56|11: In God, I will praise his word: in the Lord, I will praise his word.
verses.Psalms|56|12: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
verses.Psalms|56|13: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will pay Thee my offerings of thanksgiving.
verses.Psalms|56|14: For Thou hast delivered my soul from death, yea, my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living!
verses.Psalms|57|1: To the chief Musician, Al-taschith, a Michtam of David, when he fled from Saul in the cave.
verses.Psalms|57|2: Be gracious to me, O God, be gracious to me: for my soul trusts in Thee: and in the shadow of Thy wings will I take refuge, until calamities be overpast.
verses.Psalms|57|3: I will cry to God most high; to God who performs all things for me.
verses.Psalms|57|4: He will send from heaven, and save me; he scorns him who would swallow me up. (Selah.) God shall send forth his steadfast love and his truth.
verses.Psalms|57|5: My soul is among lions: and I lie down among those who are aflame, the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.Psalms|57|6: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let Thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.Psalms|57|7: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have dug a pit before me, into the midst of which they are fallen themselves. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|57|8: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast: I will sing and give praise.
verses.Psalms|57|9: Wake up, my glory; awake, the harp and the lyre: I will awake the dawn.
verses.Psalms|57|10: I will praise Thee, O Lord, among the peoples: I will sing to Thee among the nations.
verses.Psalms|57|11: For Thy love is great unto the heavens, and Thy truth to the clouds.
verses.Psalms|57|12: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let Thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.Psalms|58|1: To the chief Musician, Al-taschith, A Michtam of David.
verses.Psalms|58|2: Do you indeed speak righteousness in private? do you judge uprightly, O you sons of men?
verses.Psalms|58|3: No, in your hearts you work wickedness; your hands deal out violence on the earth.
verses.Psalms|58|4: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they err from birth, speaking lies.
verses.Psalms|58|5: Their poison is like the poison of a snake: they are like the deaf adder that stops its ear;
verses.Psalms|58|6: which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
verses.Psalms|58|7: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the fangs of the young lions, O Lord.
verses.Psalms|58|8: Let them melt away like waters which run continually: when he aims his arrows, let them be as if cut in pieces;
verses.Psalms|58|9: like the slimy track of a snail which disappears: like the untimely births of a woman, that have not seen the sun.
verses.Psalms|58|10: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall sweep them away as with a whirlwind, both the green and the burning.
verses.Psalms|58|11: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.Psalms|58|12: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily there is a God who judges in the earth.
verses.Psalms|59|1: To the chief Musician, Al-taschith, A Michtam of David; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.
verses.Psalms|59|2: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God: defend me from those who rise up against me.
verses.Psalms|59|3: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
verses.Psalms|59|4: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: fierce men are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Lord.
verses.Psalms|59|5: They run and prepare themselves for no fault of mine: awake to help me, and behold.
verses.Psalms|59|6: Thou therefore, O Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to punish all the nations: be not gracious to any wicked traitors. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|59|7: They return at evening: they howl like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.Psalms|59|8: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who hears?
verses.Psalms|59|9: But Thou, O Lord, shalt laugh at them; Thou shalt have all the nations in derision.
verses.Psalms|59|10: Upon Thee, O my strength, will I wait: for God is my fortress.
verses.Psalms|59|11: God who loves me shall come to meet me: God shall let me gaze upon my enemies.
verses.Psalms|59|12: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by Thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
verses.Psalms|59|13: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.
verses.Psalms|59|14: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may be no more: and let them know that God rules in Jacob to the ends of the earth. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|59|15: And at evening let them return; and let them howl like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.Psalms|59|16: Let them wander up and down for food, and murmur if they have not their fill.
verses.Psalms|59|17: But I will sing of Thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of Thy steadfast love in the morning: for Thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my distress.
verses.Psalms|59|18: To Thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my fortress, and the God who loves me.
verses.Psalms|60|1: To the chief Musician upon Shushan-eduth, A Michtam of David, to teach;
verses.Psalms|60|2: when he strove with Mesopotamia and with Aram-zobah, and Joab returned, and smote twelve thousand of Edom in the valley of salt.
verses.Psalms|60|3: O God, Thou hast cast us off, Thou hast shattered us, Thou hast been angry; O turn Thyself to us again.
verses.Psalms|60|4: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; Thou hast broken it: heal its breaches; for it totters.
verses.Psalms|60|5: Thou hast shown Thy people hard things: Thou hast made us drink the wine of staggering.
verses.Psalms|60|6: Thou hast given a banner to those who fear Thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|60|7: That Thy beloved ones may be delivered; save with Thy right hand, and answer me.
verses.Psalms|60|8: God has spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
verses.Psalms|60|9: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of my head; Judah is my sceptre;
verses.Psalms|60|10: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast my shoe: Philistia, cry aloud because of me.
verses.Psalms|60|11: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.Psalms|60|12: Hast thou not rejected us, O God? so that Thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.
verses.Psalms|60|13: Give us help against the foe: for vain is the help of man.
verses.Psalms|60|14: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is who will tread down our enemies.
verses.Psalms|61|1: To the chief Musician, on strings, Of David.
verses.Psalms|61|2: Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.
verses.Psalms|61|3: From the end of the earth I will cry to Thee, when my heart faints. lead me to the rock that is too high for me.
verses.Psalms|61|4: For Thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
verses.Psalms|61|5: I will abide in Thy tent for ever: I will trust in the covert of Thy wings. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|61|6: For Thou, O God, hast heard my vows: Thou hast granted the heritage of those who fear Thy name.
verses.Psalms|61|7: Prolong the king's life: may his years be as many generations.
verses.Psalms|61|8: May he be enthroned before God for ever: O appoint love and truth, that they may preserve him.
verses.Psalms|61|9: So will I sing praise to Thy name for ever, as I perform my vows day by day.
verses.Psalms|62|1: To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|62|2: My soul waits in silence only for God: from him comes my salvation.
verses.Psalms|62|3: He alone is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress: I shall not be greatly moved.
verses.Psalms|62|4: How long will you seek to overwhelm a man? You will be all of you demolished like a leaning wall, or a tottering fence.
verses.Psalms|62|5: They even devise to thrust him down from his majesty: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|62|6: My soul waits in silence only for God; for my expectation is from him.
verses.Psalms|62|7: He alone is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
verses.Psalms|62|8: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
verses.Psalms|62|9: Trust in him at all times; you people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|62|10: Men of low degree are mere breath, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than air.
verses.Psalms|62|11: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
verses.Psalms|62|12: God has spoken once: twice have I heard this; that power belongs to God.
verses.Psalms|62|13: But love is also Thine, when Thou renderest to every man according to his work.
verses.Psalms|63|1: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.
verses.Psalms|63|2: O God, Thou art my God; earnestly I seek Thee: my soul thirsts for Thee, my flesh longs for Thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
verses.Psalms|63|3: to see Thy power and Thy glory, as I have seen Thee in the sanctuary.
verses.Psalms|63|4: Because Thy steadfast love is better than life, my lips shall praise Thee.
verses.Psalms|63|5: Thus will I bless Thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in Thy name.
verses.Psalms|63|6: My soul is satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth praises Thee with joyful lips:
verses.Psalms|63|7: when I remember Thee upon my bed, and meditate on Thee in the night watches.
verses.Psalms|63|8: Because Thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of Thy wings I will rejoice.
verses.Psalms|63|9: My soul clings to Thee: Thy right hand upholds me.
verses.Psalms|63|10: But those who seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.Psalms|63|11: They shall be given over to the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
verses.Psalms|63|12: But the king shall rejoice in God; everyone who swears by him shall glory: for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be stopped.
verses.Psalms|64|1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|64|2: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.Psalms|64|3: Hide me from the secret council of the wicked; from the tumult of the workers of iniquity:
verses.Psalms|64|4: who have whetted their tongue like a sword, aimed their arrows of bitter words:
verses.Psalms|64|5: to shoot the innocent man in secret; suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
verses.Psalms|64|6: They encourage one another in an evil matter: they speak of laying snares secretly; they say, Who shall see them?
verses.Psalms|64|7: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: for the inward thought of man, and the heart, is deep.
verses.Psalms|64|8: But God shoots his arrow at them: suddenly their wounds are on them.
verses.Psalms|64|9: So they make their own tongue a stumbling to themselves; all that see them shake the head.
verses.Psalms|64|10: And all men are afraid, and they declare the work of God; for they wisely consider of his doing.
verses.Psalms|64|11: The just man shall be glad in the Lord, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
verses.Psalms|65|1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David, a Poem.
verses.Psalms|65|2: Praise awaits Thee, O God, in Zion: and to Thee shall the vow be performed.
verses.Psalms|65|3: O Thou that hearest prayer, to Thee shall all flesh come.
verses.Psalms|65|4: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, Thou shalt purge them away.
verses.Psalms|65|5: Happy is the man whom Thou choosest, and causest to approach to Thee, that he may dwell in Thy courts: we will be satisfied with the goodness of Thy house, Thy holy temple.
verses.Psalms|65|6: By terrible things in righteousness wilt Thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of the farthest sea.
verses.Psalms|65|7: Who by his strength places the mountains in position; who is girded with power:
verses.Psalms|65|8: who stills the noise of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the tumult of the peoples.
verses.Psalms|65|9: They also who dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at Thy signs: Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.Psalms|65|10: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: Thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: Thou providest corn for them, for so Thou hast prepared it.
verses.Psalms|65|11: Watering her furrows abundantly, settling her ridges: Thou makest it soft with showers: Thou blessest its growth.
verses.Psalms|65|12: Thou crownest the year with Thy goodness; and Thy paths drop fatness.
verses.Psalms|65|13: The pastures of the wilderness drop moisture: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
verses.Psalms|65|14: The meadows are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
verses.Psalms|66|1: To the chief Musician, A Poem, a Psalm. Make a joyful noise to God, all the earth:
verses.Psalms|66|2: sing to the glory of his name: make his praise glorious.
verses.Psalms|66|3: Say to God, How terrible are Thy works! through the greatness of Thy power shall Thy enemies cringe before Thee.
verses.Psalms|66|4: All the earth shall worship Thee, and shall sing to Thee; they shall sing to Thy name. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|66|5: Come and see the works of God: terrible is his doing towards the children of men.
verses.Psalms|66|6: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the river on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
verses.Psalms|66|7: He rules by his power forever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|66|8: O bless our God, you peoples, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
verses.Psalms|66|9: who has kept our soul in life, and has not suffered our foot to be moved.
verses.Psalms|66|10: For Thou, O God, hast tested us: Thou hast tried us, as silver is refined.
verses.Psalms|66|11: Thou hast brought us into the net; Thou hast laid affliction upon our loins.
verses.Psalms|66|12: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but Thou didst bring us out into abundance.
verses.Psalms|66|13: I will go into Thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay Thee my vows,
verses.Psalms|66|14: which my lips have uttered, and my mouth has spoken, when I was in trouble.
verses.Psalms|66|15: I will offer unto Thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the sweet smoke of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|66|16: Come and hear, all you that fear God, and I will declare what he has done for my soul.
verses.Psalms|66|17: I cried to him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
verses.Psalms|66|18: If I had looked on wickedness with my heart, the Lord would not have heard:
verses.Psalms|66|19: but verily God has heard me; he has attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.Psalms|66|20: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor removed his steadfast love from me.
verses.Psalms|67|1: To the chief Musician on strings, A Psalm, a Poem.
verses.Psalms|67|2: God be gracious to us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|67|3: that Thy way may be known upon earth, Thy salvation among all nations.
verses.Psalms|67|4: Let the peoples praise Thee, O God; let all the peoples give thanks to Thee.
verses.Psalms|67|5: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for Thou shalt judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations upon earth. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|67|6: Let the peoples praise Thee, O God; let all the peoples give Thee thanks.
verses.Psalms|67|7: The earth has yielded her increase; and God, our own God, shall bless us.
verses.Psalms|67|8: God shall bless us; and let all the ends of the earth fear him.
verses.Psalms|68|1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm, a Poem of David.
verses.Psalms|68|2: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: and let those who hate him flee before him.
verses.Psalms|68|3: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
verses.Psalms|68|4: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: and let them joyfully exult.
verses.Psalms|68|5: Sing to God, sing praises to his name: extol him who rides upon the clouds; Jah is his name: and rejoice before him.
verses.Psalms|68|6: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of widows, is God in his holy habitation.
verses.Psalms|68|7: God makes the lonely ones dwell in a house: he brings out the prisoners into prosperity; but the rebellious dwell in a parched land.
verses.Psalms|68|8: O God, when Thou didst go out before Thy people, when Thou didst march through the wilderness; (Selah;)
verses.Psalms|68|9: the earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
verses.Psalms|68|10: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby Thou didst strengthen Thy inheritance, when it languished.
verses.Psalms|68|11: Thy flock found a dwelling in it: Thou, O God, preparest of Thy goodness for the poor.
verses.Psalms|68|12: The Lord gives the word: great is the company of those who bear the tidings.
verses.Psalms|68|13: Kings of armies flee, they flee: and she who dwells in the house divides the spoil.
verses.Psalms|68|14: When you lie among the sheep folds you shall shine as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her pinions with yellow gold.
verses.Psalms|68|15: When the Almighty scatters kings in it, snow falls in Zalmon.
verses.Psalms|68|16: O mighty hill, O hill of Bashan; O high peaked hill, hill of Bashan:
verses.Psalms|68|17: why dost thou look askance, O high peaked hill, at the mountain which God has desired for his abode? truly the Lord will dwell there forever.
verses.Psalms|68|18: The chariots of God are twice ten thousand, thousands upon thousands: the Lord is among them: Sinai in holiness!
verses.Psalms|68|19: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts from men; yea, from the rebellious also, that the Lord God might dwell there.
verses.Psalms|68|20: Blessed be the Lord who day by day bears our burden. God is our salvation. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|68|21: He That is our God is the God of salvations; and to God the Lord belong the issues of death.
verses.Psalms|68|22: But God will smite through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such as goes on still in his trespasses.
verses.Psalms|68|23: The Lord said, I will bring back from Bashan, I will bring them back from the depths of the sea:
verses.Psalms|68|24: that thy foot may wade in blood; and the tongue of thy dogs have its portion of thy enemies.
verses.Psalms|68|25: They see Thy processions, O God; the processions of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
verses.Psalms|68|26: The singers go before, the players on instruments follow after; among them are maidens beating tambourines.
verses.Psalms|68|27: Bless God in the congregations, the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
verses.Psalms|68|28: There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
verses.Psalms|68|29: Thy God has commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which Thou hast wrought for us,
verses.Psalms|68|30: out of Thy temple at Jerusalem, whither kings shall bring Thee gifts.
verses.Psalms|68|31: Rebuke the wild beast of the reed grass, the company of bulls with the calves of the peoples, who seek to ingratiate themselves with pieces of silver; the prodigality of nations desiring to approach Thee.
verses.Psalms|68|32: Nobles shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands to God.
verses.Psalms|68|33: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth; O sing praise to the Lord; (Selah;)
verses.Psalms|68|34: to him that rides upon the heavens of heavens, which are of old; lo, he sends out his voice, a mighty voice.
verses.Psalms|68|35: Ascribe strength to God: his majesty is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.
verses.Psalms|68|36: O God, Thou art terrible out of Thy holy places: the God of Israel: he gives strength and power to his people. Blessed is God.
verses.Psalms|69|1: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, Of David.
verses.Psalms|69|2: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in to my soul.
verses.Psalms|69|3: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, and the flood overwhelms me.
verses.Psalms|69|4: I am weary with my crying: my throat is dried: my eyes fail while I wait for my God.
verses.Psalms|69|5: They who hate me without cause are more than the hairs of my head: they who would destroy me are many, who hate me wrongfully.
verses.Psalms|69|6: What I took not away, that must I restore. O God, Thou knowst my folly; and my sins are not hid from Thee.
verses.Psalms|69|7: Let not those who wait on Thee, O Lord God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those who seek Thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
verses.Psalms|69|8: Because for Thy sake I have borne insult; confusion has covered my face.
verses.Psalms|69|9: I am become a stranger to my brothers, and an alien to my mother's children.
verses.Psalms|69|10: For the zeal of Thy house has eaten me up; and the taunts of those who taunt Thee are fallen upon me.
verses.Psalms|69|11: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that became a reproach to me.
verses.Psalms|69|12: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
verses.Psalms|69|13: They who sit in the gate talk of me; and I am the song of drunkards.
verses.Psalms|69|14: But as for me, let my prayer be to Thee, O Lord, in an acceptable time: O God, in the greatness of Thy steadfast love hear me, in the truth of Thy salvation.
verses.Psalms|69|15: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.Psalms|69|16: Let not the waterflood overwhelm me, nor let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
verses.Psalms|69|17: Hear me, O Lord; for Thy love is good: turn towards me according to the multitude of Thy compassion.
verses.Psalms|69|18: And hide not Thy face from Thy servant; for I am in trouble: answer me speedily.
verses.Psalms|69|19: Draw near to my soul, and redeem it: ransom me because of my enemies.
verses.Psalms|69|20: Thou knowst my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: my adversaries are all before Thee.
verses.Psalms|69|21: Insult has broken my heart; and I am sick: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
verses.Psalms|69|22: And they gave me poison in my food; and for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.Psalms|69|23: Let their table become a snare before them: and when they are at peace, let it be a trap.
verses.Psalms|69|24: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
verses.Psalms|69|25: Pour out Thy indignation upon them, and let Thy fierce anger overtake them.
verses.Psalms|69|26: Let their habitation be desolate; let none dwell in their tents.
verses.Psalms|69|27: For they persecute him whom Thou hast smitten; and they tell of the pain of those whom Thou hast wounded.
verses.Psalms|69|28: Add iniquity to their iniquity: and let them not be admitted to Thy vindication.
verses.Psalms|69|29: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
verses.Psalms|69|30: But I am afflicted and in pain: let thy salvation, O God, set me on high.
verses.Psalms|69|31: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
verses.Psalms|69|32: And it shall please the Lord better than an ox or a bullock that has horns and hoofs.
verses.Psalms|69|33: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and let your hearts revive, you who seek God.
verses.Psalms|69|34: For the Lord hears the poor, and despises not his prisoners.
verses.Psalms|69|35: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and everything that moves therein.
verses.Psalms|69|36: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
verses.Psalms|69|37: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell there.
verses.Psalms|70|1: To the chief Musician, of David, for invocation.
verses.Psalms|70|2: Make haste, O God, to deliver me; to help me, O Lord.
verses.Psalms|70|3: Let them be ashamed and confounded who seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, who desire my hurt.
verses.Psalms|70|4: Let them be turned back because of their shame who say, Aha, aha.
verses.Psalms|70|5: Let all those who seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee: and let such as love Thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
verses.Psalms|70|6: But I am poor and needy: make haste to me, O God: Thou art my help and my deliverer; delay not, O Lord.
verses.Psalms|71|1: In thee, O Lord, do I take refuge: let me never be put to confusion.
verses.Psalms|71|2: Deliver me in Thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline Thy ear to me, and save me.
verses.Psalms|71|3: Be Thou my strong habitation, to which I may continually resort; which Thou hast appointed to save me; for Thou art my rock and my fortress.
verses.Psalms|71|4: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked man, out of the hand of the unrighteous and violent man.
verses.Psalms|71|5: For Thou art my hope, O Lord God: Thou art my trust from my youth.
verses.Psalms|71|6: By Thee have I been sustained from the womb: Thou art he who took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise is continually of Thee.
verses.Psalms|71|7: I am as a marvel to many; but Thou art my strong refuge.
verses.Psalms|71|8: Let my mouth be filled with Thy praise and with Thy glory all the day.
verses.Psalms|71|9: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength fails me.
verses.Psalms|71|10: For my enemies speak against me; and they who watch for my soul take counsel together,
verses.Psalms|71|11: saying, God has forsaken him: pursue and catch him; for there is none to deliver him.
verses.Psalms|71|12: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste to help me.
verses.Psalms|71|13: Let them be confounded and consumed who are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour who seek my hurt.
verses.Psalms|71|14: But as for me, I will hope continually, and will praise Thee yet more and more.
verses.Psalms|71|15: My mouth shall rehearse Thy righteousness and Thy salvation all the day; for I cannot count them.
verses.Psalms|71|16: I will come to celebrate the mighty acts of the Lord God: I will make mention of Thy righteousness, Thine alone.
verses.Psalms|71|17: O God, Thou hast taught me from my youth: and I still declare Thy wondrous deeds.
verses.Psalms|71|18: Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have related Thy strength to this generation, and Thy power to everyone that is to come.
verses.Psalms|71|19: Thy righteousness also, O God, reaches the high heavens, who hast done great things.
verses.Psalms|71|20: O God, who is like Thee! Thou who hast shown me many and grievous troubles, restore me to life again, and bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.Psalms|71|21: Increase my greatness, and turn to comfort me.
verses.Psalms|71|22: I too will praise Thee with the harp, speaking of Thy truth, O my God: to Thee will I sing with the lyre, O Thou Holy One of Israel.
verses.Psalms|71|23: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing to Thee; and my soul, which Thou hast redeemed.
verses.Psalms|71|24: My tongue also shall tell of Thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought to shame, who seek my hurt.
verses.Psalms|72|1: For Solomon. Give the king Thy judgments, O God, and Thy righteousness to the king's son.
verses.Psalms|72|2: That he may judge Thy people with righteousness, and Thy poor with justice.
verses.Psalms|72|3: Let the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills, by righteousness.
verses.Psalms|72|4: May he judge the cause of the poor of the people, may he save the children of the needy, and break the oppressor in pieces.
verses.Psalms|72|5: May they fear Thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
verses.Psalms|72|6: May he come down like rain upon the mown grass: like showers that water the earth.
verses.Psalms|72|7: In his days let the righteous flourish; and let there be abundance of peace till the moon is no more.
verses.Psalms|72|8: May he have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river to the ends of the earth.
verses.Psalms|72|9: Let them who dwell in the wilderness bow down before him, and his enemies lick the dust.
verses.Psalms|72|10: May the kings of Tarshish and of the isles bring presents: let the kings of Seba and Sheba offer gifts.
verses.Psalms|72|11: And may all kings fall down before him; all nations serve him.
verses.Psalms|72|12: For he shall deliver the needy when he cries; the poor also, and him who has no helper.
verses.Psalms|72|13: He will spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
verses.Psalms|72|14: He will redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
verses.Psalms|72|15: Long may he live, and may the gold of Sheba be given to him: and let prayer be continually offered for him: let them bless him all the day.
verses.Psalms|72|16: May there be abundance of corn in the land: may it rustle on the tops of the mountains: may its fruit be like the Lebanon: and may they flourish in the city like the grass of the earth.
verses.Psalms|72|17: May his name endure forever: may his name continue as long as the sun: and may men bless themselves by him: let all nations call him happy!
verses.Psalms|72|18: Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, who does wondrous things alone.
verses.Psalms|72|19: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
verses.Psalms|72|20: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
verses.Psalms|73|1: A Psalm of Asaph. Truly God is good to Israel, to such as are of a clean heart.
verses.Psalms|73|2: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
verses.Psalms|73|3: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.Psalms|73|4: For there are no pangs at their death; their body is firm.
verses.Psalms|73|5: They are not in trouble as other men; nor are they plagued like other men.
verses.Psalms|73|6: Therefore pride is their necklace; violence covers them like a garment.
verses.Psalms|73|7: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
verses.Psalms|73|8: They deride, and wickedly speak oppression: they speak loftily.
verses.Psalms|73|9: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue struts through the earth.
verses.Psalms|73|10: Therefore his people return here: and abundant waters are drained out by them.
verses.Psalms|73|11: And they say, How does God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
verses.Psalms|73|12: Behold, these are the wicked, always at ease; they increase in riches.
verses.Psalms|73|13: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency;
verses.Psalms|73|14: for all the day I have been stricken, and chastised every morning.
verses.Psalms|73|15: If I had said, I will speak thus; behold, I should have offended against the generation of Thy children.
verses.Psalms|73|16: So I pondered how I might understand this, but it was too wearisome for me.
verses.Psalms|73|17: Until I entered the sanctuary of God; then I understood their end.
verses.Psalms|73|18: Surely Thou dost set them in slippery places: Thou dost cast them down into destruction.
verses.Psalms|73|19: How are they brought into desolation in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
verses.Psalms|73|20: As a dream when one awakes; so, O Lord, on awaking, Thou shalt despise their image.
verses.Psalms|73|21: When my heart was embittered, and I was pricked in my reins;
verses.Psalms|73|22: then I was foolish and ignorant: I was like a beast before Thee.
verses.Psalms|73|23: But I am continually with Thee: Thou holdest my right hand.
verses.Psalms|73|24: Thou shalt guide me with Thy counsel, and afterwards receive me to honourable state.
verses.Psalms|73|25: Whom have I in heaven but Thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside Thee.
verses.Psalms|73|26: My flesh and my heart fail: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
verses.Psalms|73|27: For, lo, they that are far from Thee shall perish: Thou hast destroyed all those who go astray from Thee.
verses.Psalms|73|28: But as for me, the nearness of God is my good: I have made the Lord God my refuge, that I may relate all Thy works.
verses.Psalms|74|1: A Maschil of Asaph. O God, why hast Thou cast us off for ever? why does Thy anger smoke against the sheep of Thy pasture?
verses.Psalms|74|2: Remember Thy congregation, which Thou hast purchased of old; the tribe of Thy inheritance, which Thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein Thou hast dwelt.
verses.Psalms|74|3: Lift up Thy feet to the perpetual desolations; the enemy has destroyed everything in the sanctuary.
verses.Psalms|74|4: Thy enemies roar in the midst of thy meeting place; they set up their signs for signs:
verses.Psalms|74|5: they are known as swingers of axes upwards in the thick forest:
verses.Psalms|74|6: and now they break down its carved work altogether with hatchet and with hammers.
verses.Psalms|74|7: They have burned Thy sanctuary with fire, to the ground: they have defiled the dwelling place of Thy name.
verses.Psalms|74|8: They have said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the meeting places of God in the land.
verses.Psalms|74|9: We see not our signs: there is no longer a prophet: nor is there among us any that knows how long.
verses.Psalms|74|10: O God, how long shall the adversary insult? shall the enemy blaspheme Thy name for ever?
verses.Psalms|74|11: Why dost Thou withdraw Thy hand, even Thy right hand? out of Thy bosom with it! destroy!
verses.Psalms|74|12: for God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.Psalms|74|13: Thou didst divide the sea by Thy strength: Thou didst break the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
verses.Psalms|74|14: Thou didst crush the heads of livyatan: thou didst give him for food to the desert people.
verses.Psalms|74|15: Thou didst split open springs and wadis: Thou didst dry up the ever flowing streams.
verses.Psalms|74|16: The day is Thine, the night also is Thine: Thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
verses.Psalms|74|17: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: Thou hast made summer and winter.
verses.Psalms|74|18: Remember this, how the enemy has insulted the Lord, and how a base people have blasphemed Thy name.
verses.Psalms|74|19: O deliver not the soul of Thy turtledove to the wild beast: forget not the congregation of Thy poor for ever.
verses.Psalms|74|20: Look upon the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full, the habitations of cruelty.
verses.Psalms|74|21: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise Thy name.
verses.Psalms|74|22: Arise, O God, plead Thy own cause: remember how the foolish man insults Thee daily.
verses.Psalms|74|23: Forget not the voice of Thy enemies: the tumult of those who rise up against Thee increases continually.
verses.Psalms|75|1: To the chief Musician, Al-taschith, A Psalm of Asaph, A Poem.
verses.Psalms|75|2: To Thee, O God, we give thanks; we give thanks; for Thy name is near; men declare Thy wondrous works.
verses.Psalms|75|3: Surely I shall take the appointed time; I will judge with equity.
verses.Psalms|75|4: When the earth and all its inhabitants are dissolved, I bear up the pillars of it. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|75|5: I said to the arrogant, Deal not arrogantly! and to the wicked, Lift not the horn.
verses.Psalms|75|6: Lift not your horn on high: speak not with an insolent neck.
verses.Psalms|75|7: For judgment comes neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the desert peaks:
verses.Psalms|75|8: but God is the judge: he puts one down, and sets up another.
verses.Psalms|75|9: For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup, with foaming wine; it is full of mixture; and he pours out of the same: but its dregs, shall all the wicked of the earth drain and drink.
verses.Psalms|75|10: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.Psalms|75|11: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
verses.Psalms|76|1: To the chief Musician on strings, A Psalm of Asaph, A Poem.
verses.Psalms|76|2: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.
verses.Psalms|76|3: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place is in Zion.
verses.Psalms|76|4: There he broke the flashing arrows, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|76|5: Thou art glorious and excellent, coming down from the mountains of prey.
verses.Psalms|76|6: The stouthearted are bereft of reason, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
verses.Psalms|76|7: At Thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, he is put to sleep, together with chariot and horse.
verses.Psalms|76|8: Thou, even Thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in Thy sight when once Thou art angry?
verses.Psalms|76|9: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
verses.Psalms|76|10: When God arose to judgment, to save all the humble of the earth. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|76|11: Surely the wrath of man shall praise Thee: Thou wilt gird Thyself with the remainder of wrath.
verses.Psalms|76|12: Vow, and pay to the Lord your God: let all that be round about him bring presents to him that is to be feared.
verses.Psalms|76|13: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
verses.Psalms|77|1: To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Asaph.
verses.Psalms|77|2: To God I will cry aloud: aloud to God. O, hear me!
verses.Psalms|77|3: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my hand is stretched out in the night, and rests not: my soul refuses to be comforted.
verses.Psalms|77|4: I remember God, and moan: I meditate, and my spirit faints. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|77|5: Thou holdest fast my eyelids: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.Psalms|77|6: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.Psalms|77|7: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I meditate with my heart: and my spirit makes diligent search.
verses.Psalms|77|8: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
verses.Psalms|77|9: Is his steadfast love clean gone forever? does his promise fail for evermore?
