verses.Psalms|77|10: Has God forgotten to be gracious? has he in anger shut up his tender mercies? (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|77|11: And I said, I am sick at heart, for the right hand of the most High has changed.
verses.Psalms|77|12: I will remember the works of the Lord: surely I will remember Thy wonders of old.
verses.Psalms|77|13: I will meditate also on all Thy work, and muse on Thy doings.
verses.Psalms|77|14: Thy way, O God, is in holiness: who is so great a God as our God?
verses.Psalms|77|15: Thou art the God That doest wonders: Thou hast declared Thy strength among the people.
verses.Psalms|77|16: Thou hast with Thy arm redeemed Thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|77|17: The waters saw Thee, O God, the waters saw Thee: they were afraid: the depths also trembled.
verses.Psalms|77|18: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: Thy arrows also went abroad.
verses.Psalms|77|19: The voice of Thy thunder was in the whirlwind: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
verses.Psalms|77|20: Thy way was in the sea, and Thy path in the great waters, and Thy footsteps were not known.
verses.Psalms|77|21: Thou didst lead Thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.Psalms|78|1: A Maschil of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.Psalms|78|2: I will open my mouth with a parable: I will utter riddles concerning ancient times:
verses.Psalms|78|3: of that which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
verses.Psalms|78|4: We will not hide them from their children, relating to the latter generation the praises of the Lord, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he has done.
verses.Psalms|78|5: For he established a Testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
verses.Psalms|78|6: that the generation to come might know them, the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
verses.Psalms|78|7: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
verses.Psalms|78|8: and that they might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not steadfast with God.
verses.Psalms|78|9: The children of Ephraim were as archers, carrying bows, who turned back in the day of battle.
verses.Psalms|78|10: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to follow his law;
verses.Psalms|78|11: and forgot his works, and his wonders that he had shown them.
verses.Psalms|78|12: Marvellous things he did in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.Psalms|78|13: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand like a heap.
verses.Psalms|78|14: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
verses.Psalms|78|15: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.
verses.Psalms|78|16: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.Psalms|78|17: And they sinned yet more against him, rebelling against the most High in the wilderness.
verses.Psalms|78|18: And they tempted God in their heart by asking food for their craving.
verses.Psalms|78|19: And they spoke against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
verses.Psalms|78|20: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide meat for his people?
verses.Psalms|78|21: Therefore the Lord heard this, and was angry: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;
verses.Psalms|78|22: because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:
verses.Psalms|78|23: though he commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
verses.Psalms|78|24: and rained down manna upon them to eat, and gave them of the corn of heaven.
verses.Psalms|78|25: Man ate the bread of angels: he sent them provision to the full.
verses.Psalms|78|26: He caused an east wind to blow in the sky: and by his power he brought on the south wind.
verses.Psalms|78|27: And he rained meat upon them like dust, and feathered birds like the sand of the sea:
verses.Psalms|78|28: and he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
verses.Psalms|78|29: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
verses.Psalms|78|30: they were not yet sated with their lust: whilst their meat was still in their mouths,
verses.Psalms|78|31: the wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the young men of Israel.
verses.Psalms|78|32: For all this they sinned still, and did not believe in his wondrous works.
verses.Psalms|78|33: Therefore he ended their days with emptiness, and their years with trouble.
verses.Psalms|78|34: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and earnestly inquired after God.
verses.Psalms|78|35: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.
verses.Psalms|78|36: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouths, and they lied to him with their tongues.
verses.Psalms|78|37: For their heart was not steadfast with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.
verses.Psalms|78|38: But he was full of compassion, forgiving iniquity, and he did not destroy them: often he turned away his anger, not stirring up all his wrath.
verses.Psalms|78|39: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passes away, and comes not again.
verses.Psalms|78|40: How often did they rebel against him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
verses.Psalms|78|41: They turned back also and tempted God, and pained the Holy One of Israel.
verses.Psalms|78|42: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
verses.Psalms|78|43: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
verses.Psalms|78|44: and had turned their canals into blood; and their floods, so that they could not drink.
verses.Psalms|78|45: He sent swarms of gnats among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.Psalms|78|46: He gave also their increase to the destroying locust, and their labour to the swarming locust.
verses.Psalms|78|47: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycamore trees with frost.
verses.Psalms|78|48: He gave over their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.Psalms|78|49: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, an embassy of evil messengers.
verses.Psalms|78|50: He levelled a path for his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
verses.Psalms|78|51: and smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the first of their strength in the tents of Ham:
verses.Psalms|78|52: but made his own people to go out like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.Psalms|78|53: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.Psalms|78|54: And he brought them to his holy border, to the mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
verses.Psalms|78|55: He cast out nations before them, and apportioned to them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
verses.Psalms|78|56: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
verses.Psalms|78|57: but turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.Psalms|78|58: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their carved idols.
verses.Psalms|78|59: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
verses.Psalms|78|60: so that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent where he made his dwelling among men;
verses.Psalms|78|61: and delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.
verses.Psalms|78|62: He gave his people over also to the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
verses.Psalms|78|63: The fire consumed their young men; and their virgins had no marriage song.
verses.Psalms|78|64: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
verses.Psalms|78|65: Then the Lord awoke as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouts by reason of wine.
verses.Psalms|78|66: And he smote his enemies backward: he put upon them a perpetual reproach.
verses.Psalms|78|67: And he rejected the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
verses.Psalms|78|68: but chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.
verses.Psalms|78|69: And he built his sanctuary like the high heavens, like the earth which he has established for ever.
verses.Psalms|78|70: And chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
verses.Psalms|78|71: from following the ewes that gave suck, he brought him to be shepherd of Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
verses.Psalms|78|72: So he tended them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
verses.Psalms|79|1: A Psalm of Asaph. O God, heathen nations are come into Thy inheritance; Thy holy temple they have defiled; they have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
verses.Psalms|79|2: The dead bodies of Thy servants they have given to be food to the birds of the sky, the flesh of Thy pious ones to the beasts of the earth.
verses.Psalms|79|3: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.
verses.Psalms|79|4: We are become a taunt to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to those round about us.
verses.Psalms|79|5: How long, Lord? wilt Thou be angry for ever? will Thy jealousy burn like fire?
verses.Psalms|79|6: Pour out Thy wrath upon the nations that do not know Thee, and upon the kingdoms that do not call upon Thy name.
verses.Psalms|79|7: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.
verses.Psalms|79|8: O remember not against us former iniquities: let Thy tender mercies speedily come to meet us: for we are brought very low.
verses.Psalms|79|9: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Thy name: and deliver us, and forgive our sins, for Thy name's sake.
verses.Psalms|79|10: Why should the nations say, Where is their God? let the revenging of the blood of Thy servants which is shed be made manifest among the nations, and before our eyes.
verses.Psalms|79|11: Let the groaning of the prisoners come before thee; according to the greatness of Thy power preserve a remnant of those who are appointed to die;
verses.Psalms|79|12: and render to our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their insult, wherewith they have insulted Thee, O Lord.
verses.Psalms|79|13: So we Thy people and the sheep of Thy pasture will give Thee thanks for ever: we will relate Thy praise to all generations.
verses.Psalms|80|1: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, A Testimony, A Psalm of Asaph.
verses.Psalms|80|2: Give ear, O shepherd of Israel, that leadest Joseph like flock, Thou who art enthroned upon the keruvim, shine forth.
verses.Psalms|80|3: Before Ephraim, and Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up Thy might, and come to save us.
verses.Psalms|80|4: Restore us, O God, and cause Thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.Psalms|80|5: O Lord God of hosts, how long wilt Thou be angry against the prayer of Thy people?
verses.Psalms|80|6: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears; and hast given them tears to drink in great measure.
verses.Psalms|80|7: Thou makest us a strife to our neighbours: and our enemies mock as they please.
verses.Psalms|80|8: Restore us, O God of hosts, and cause Thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.Psalms|80|9: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt, Thou hast cast out nations, and planted it.
verses.Psalms|80|10: Thou didst clear a space for it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
verses.Psalms|80|11: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the mighty cedars with its boughs.
verses.Psalms|80|12: She sent out her boughs to the sea, and her branches to the river.
verses.Psalms|80|13: Why hast Thou then broken down her fences, so that all they who pass by the way do pluck her fruit?
verses.Psalms|80|14: The boar out of the wood ravages it, and the wild beast of the field devours it.
verses.Psalms|80|15: Return, we beseech Thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and be mindful of this vine;
verses.Psalms|80|16: and of the stock which Thy right hand has planted, and the branch that Thou madest strong for Thyself.
verses.Psalms|80|17: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of Thy countenance.
verses.Psalms|80|18: Let Thy hand be upon the man of Thy right hand, upon the son of a man whom Thou madest strong for Thyself.
verses.Psalms|80|19: So shall we not turn back from Thee: revive us and we will call upon Thy name.
verses.Psalms|80|20: Restore us, O Lord God of hosts, cause Thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.Psalms|81|1: To the chief Musician upon the Gittith, Of Asaph.
verses.Psalms|81|2: Sing aloud to God our strength: make a joyful noise to the God of Jacob.
verses.Psalms|81|3: Raise a song, sound the timbrel, the sweet lyre, with the harp.
verses.Psalms|81|4: Blow a shofar at the new moon, at the full moon on our feast day.
verses.Psalms|81|5: For this is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
verses.Psalms|81|6: This he ordained in Joseph for testimony, when he went out over the land of Egypt. I heard the language of him whom I had not known, saying,
verses.Psalms|81|7: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands are freed from the basket.
verses.Psalms|81|8: Thou didst call in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|81|9: Hear, O my people, and I will testify against thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken to me:
verses.Psalms|81|10: there shall be no strange god among thee; nor shalt thou worship any foreign deity.
verses.Psalms|81|11: I am the Lord thy God who brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.Psalms|81|12: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.
verses.Psalms|81|13: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might follow their own counsels.
verses.Psalms|81|14: Oh that my people would hearken to me, and Israel would walk in my ways!
verses.Psalms|81|15: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.
verses.Psalms|81|16: Let the haters of the Lord cringe before him: and their punishment should last forever.
verses.Psalms|81|17: But he would feed him with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock I will satisfy thee.
verses.Psalms|82|1: A Psalm of Asaph. God stands in the congregation of God; he judges among the judges.
verses.Psalms|82|2: How long will you judge unjustly, and respect the persons of the wicked? (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|82|3: Judge the cause of the poor and fatherless: vindicate the afflicted and needy.
verses.Psalms|82|4: Deliver the poor and destitute: rescue them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.Psalms|82|5: They know not, nor do they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
verses.Psalms|82|6: I had said, You are angels, all of you sons of the most High;
verses.Psalms|82|7: Nevertheless, you shall die like a man, and fall as one man, O princes.
verses.Psalms|82|8: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for Thou shalt possess all the nations.
verses.Psalms|83|1: A Poem, A Psalm of Asaph.
verses.Psalms|83|2: Do not keep silence, O God: do not hold Thy peace, and be still, O God.
verses.Psalms|83|3: For lo, Thy enemies make a tumult: and they who hate Thee have lifted up the head.
verses.Psalms|83|4: They take crafty counsel against Thy people, and consult against Thy hidden ones.
verses.Psalms|83|5: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
verses.Psalms|83|6: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against Thee:
verses.Psalms|83|7: the tents of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
verses.Psalms|83|8: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.Psalms|83|9: Assyria also is joined with them: they are the strong arm of the children of Lot. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|83|10: Do to them as to Midian; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the wadi of Kishon:
verses.Psalms|83|11: who perished at En-dor: they became like dung on the earth.
verses.Psalms|83|12: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: and all their princes like Zebah, and Zalmunna:
verses.Psalms|83|13: who said, Let us seize for our possession the pastures of God.
verses.Psalms|83|14: O my God, make them like the whirling chaff: like the stubble before the wind.
verses.Psalms|83|15: As the fire burns a wood, and as the flame sets the mountains on fire;
verses.Psalms|83|16: so pursue them with thy tempest, and terrify them with thy storm.
verses.Psalms|83|17: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O Lord.
verses.Psalms|83|18: Let them be confounded and affrighted forever; and let them be put to shame, and perish:
verses.Psalms|83|19: that men may know that thou alone, whose name is the Lord, art the most high over all the earth.
verses.Psalms|84|1: To the chief Musician upon the Gittith, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.Psalms|84|2: How lovely are Thy dwelling places, O Lord of hosts!
verses.Psalms|84|3: My soul longs, indeed, it faints for the courts of the Lord: my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
verses.Psalms|84|4: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young. Thy altars, O Lord of hosts, my King, and my God –
verses.Psalms|84|5: happy are they who dwell in Thy house: they are ever praising thee. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|84|6: Happy is the man whose strength is in Thee; in whose heart are Thy highways,
verses.Psalms|84|7: who, passing through the valley of Baca, turn in into a waterspring; moreover, the early rain covers it with blessings.
verses.Psalms|84|8: They go from strength to strength, every one of them appears before God in Zion.
verses.Psalms|84|9: O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|84|10: Behold, O God, our shield, and look upon the face of Thy anointed.
verses.Psalms|84|11: For a day in Thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be at the threshold in the house of my God, than dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.Psalms|84|12: For the Lord God is a sun and shield: the Lord will give grace and honour: no good thing will he withhold from those who walk uprightly.
verses.Psalms|84|13: O Lord of hosts, happy is the man who trusts in Thee.
verses.Psalms|85|1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.Psalms|85|2: Lord, Thou hast been favourable to Thy land: Thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
verses.Psalms|85|3: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of Thy people, Thou hast pardoned all their sin. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|85|4: Thou hast withdrawn all Thy wrath: Thou hast turned from the fierceness of Thy anger.
verses.Psalms|85|5: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and cause Thy anger towards us to cease.
verses.Psalms|85|6: Wilt Thou be angry with us forever? Wilt Thou draw out Thy anger to all generations?
verses.Psalms|85|7: Wilt Thou not revive us again: that Thy people may rejoice in Thee?
verses.Psalms|85|8: Show us thy mercy, O Lord, and grant us Thy salvation.
verses.Psalms|85|9: I will hear what God the Lord will speak: for he will speak peace to his people, and to his pious ones: but let them not turn back to folly.
verses.Psalms|85|10: Surely his salvation is near to them who fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.Psalms|85|11: Love and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.Psalms|85|12: Truth will spring out of the earth; and righteousness will look down from heaven.
verses.Psalms|85|13: The Lord moreover shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield its increase.
verses.Psalms|85|14: Righteousness shall go before him, and walk in the way of his steps.
verses.Psalms|86|1: A Prayer of David. Incline Thy ear, O Lord, hear me: for I am poor and needy.
verses.Psalms|86|2: Preserve my soul; for I am godly: O Thou my God, save Thy servant who trusts in Thee.
verses.Psalms|86|3: Be gracious to me, O Lord: for I cry to Thee daily.
verses.Psalms|86|4: Rejoice the soul of Thy servant: for to Thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.Psalms|86|5: For Thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and of bountiful love towards all those who call upon Thee.
verses.Psalms|86|6: Give ear, O Lord, to my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
verses.Psalms|86|7: On the day of my trouble I will call upon Thee: for Thou wilt answer me.
verses.Psalms|86|8: Among the gods there is none like Thee, O Lord; nor are there any works like Thine.
verses.Psalms|86|9: All nations whom Thou hast made shall come and prostrate themselves before Thee, O Lord; and shall glorify Thy name.
verses.Psalms|86|10: For Thou art great, and doest wondrous things: Thou art God alone.
verses.Psalms|86|11: Teach me Thy way, O Lord; I will walk in Thy truth: make my heart single to fear Thy name.
verses.Psalms|86|12: I will thank Thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify Thy name for evermore.
verses.Psalms|86|13: For great is Thy steadfast love towards me: and Thou hast delivered my soul from the depths of Sheol.
verses.Psalms|86|14: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assembly of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set Thee before them.
verses.Psalms|86|15: But Thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and bountiful in love and truth.
verses.Psalms|86|16: O turn to me, and have mercy upon me; give Thy strength to Thy servant, and save the son of Thy handmaid.
verses.Psalms|86|17: Show me a sign for good; that they who hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because Thou, Lord, hast helped me, and comforted me.
verses.Psalms|87|1: A Psalm for the sons of Korah, A Poem. His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.Psalms|87|2: The Lord loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.Psalms|87|3: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|87|4: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to those who know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia, saying, Such a man was born there.
verses.Psalms|87|5: But of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
verses.Psalms|87|6: The Lord shall record, when he registers the peoples, that this man was born there. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|87|7: And singers and dancers alike, shall say, All my springs are in Thee.
verses.Psalms|88|1: A Poem, A Psalm for the sons of Korah, to the chief Musician upon Mahalath Leannoth, A Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.
verses.Psalms|88|2: O Lord God of my salvation, when I cry in the night before Thee:
verses.Psalms|88|3: let my prayer come before Thee: incline Thy ear to my cry;
verses.Psalms|88|4: for my soul is sated with evils: and my life draws near to Sheol.
verses.Psalms|88|5: I am reckoned with those who go down into the pit: I am like a man who has no strength:
verses.Psalms|88|6: free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom Thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from Thy hand.
verses.Psalms|88|7: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
verses.Psalms|88|8: Thy wrath lies hard upon me, and Thou dost overwhelm me with all Thy waves. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|88|9: Thou hast put away my acquaintances far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination to them: I am shut up, and I cannot come out.
verses.Psalms|88|10: My eye is dim by reason of affliction: Lord, I have called daily upon Thee, I have stretched out my hands to Thee.
verses.Psalms|88|11: Wilt Thou show wonders to the dead? shall the shades arise and praise Thee? (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|88|12: Shall Thy steadfast love be reported in the grave? or Thy faithfulness in Abaddon?
verses.Psalms|88|13: Shall Thy wonders be known in the dark? and Thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.Psalms|88|14: But to Thee have I cried, O Lord; and in the morning shall my prayer attend Thee.
verses.Psalms|88|15: Lord, why dost Thou cast off my soul? why dost Thou hide Thy face from me?
verses.Psalms|88|16: I am afflicted and close to death from my youth up. I suffer Thy terrors, I am numb.
verses.Psalms|88|17: Thy fierce wrath goes over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.
verses.Psalms|88|18: They come round about me daily like water; they compass me about together.
verses.Psalms|88|19: Friend and companion hast Thou put far from me, my acquaintances are in darkness.
verses.Psalms|89|1: A Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.
verses.Psalms|89|2: I will sing of the steadfast love of the Lord for ever: with my mouth I will make known Thy faithfulness to all generations.
verses.Psalms|89|3: For I have said, The world is built by love: Thou dost establish Thy faithfulness in the very heavens.
verses.Psalms|89|4: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn to David my servant,
verses.Psalms|89|5: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|89|6: And the heavens shall praise Thy wonders, O Lord: Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
verses.Psalms|89|7: For who in the skies can be compared to the Lord? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened to the Lord?
verses.Psalms|89|8: A God dreaded in the great council of the holy ones, and had in reverence by all those round about him.
verses.Psalms|89|9: O Lord God of hosts, O Lord, who is strong like Thee? and Thy faithfulness is round about Thee.
verses.Psalms|89|10: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof rise up, Thou stillest them.
verses.Psalms|89|11: Thou hast trodden down Rahab like carrion; Thou hast scattered Thy enemies with Thy strong arm.
verses.Psalms|89|12: The skies are Thine, the earth also is Thine: the world and the fulness thereof, Thou hast founded them.
verses.Psalms|89|13: The north and the south, Thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in Thy name.
verses.Psalms|89|14: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is Thy hand, and high is Thy right hand.
verses.Psalms|89|15: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Thy throne: love and truth shall go before Thee.
verses.Psalms|89|16: Happy is the people that know the joyful note: they shall walk, O Lord, in the light of Thy countenance.
verses.Psalms|89|17: In Thy name they rejoice all the day: and in Thy righteousness they are exalted.
verses.Psalms|89|18: For Thou art the glory of their strength: and in Thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
verses.Psalms|89|19: For our shield belongs to the Lord; and our king to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.Psalms|89|20: Then Thou didst speak in vision to Thy pious one, and didst say, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; have exalted one chosen out of the people.
verses.Psalms|89|21: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
verses.Psalms|89|22: with whom my hand shall be established: my arm also shall strengthen him.
verses.Psalms|89|23: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
verses.Psalms|89|24: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and strike down those who hate him.
verses.Psalms|89|25: But my faithfulness and my steadfast love shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
verses.Psalms|89|26: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
verses.Psalms|89|27: He shall cry to me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
verses.Psalms|89|28: Also I will make him firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
verses.Psalms|89|29: I will keep my truth with him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
verses.Psalms|89|30: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne like the days of heaven.
verses.Psalms|89|31: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
verses.Psalms|89|32: if they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
verses.Psalms|89|33: then I will punish their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with strokes.
verses.Psalms|89|34: Nevertheless I will not utterly take my steadfast love from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
verses.Psalms|89|35: My covenant I will not break, nor alter that which has issued from my lips.
verses.Psalms|89|36: Once I have sworn by my holiness that I will not fail unto David.
verses.Psalms|89|37: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne shall be like the sun before me.
verses.Psalms|89|38: It shall be established for ever like the moon, and the witness in the sky is sure. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|89|39: But Thou hast cast off and rejected, Thou hast been angry with Thy anointed.
verses.Psalms|89|40: Thou hast renounced the covenant of Thy servant: Thou hast profaned his crown to the ground.
verses.Psalms|89|41: Thou hast broken down all his fences; Thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.
verses.Psalms|89|42: All that pass by the way plunder him: he is a taunt to his neighbours.
verses.Psalms|89|43: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his adversaries; Thou hast made all his enemies rejoice.
verses.Psalms|89|44: Thou hast also turned back the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
verses.Psalms|89|45: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
verses.Psalms|89|46: The days of his youth Thou hast shortened: Thou hast covered him with shame. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|89|47: How long, Lord? wilt Thou hide Thyself forever? shall Thy wrath burn like fire?
verses.Psalms|89|48: Remember how short my time is: for what nothingness hast Thou created all the sons of men!
verses.Psalms|89|49: What man is he that lives, and shall not see death, but shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? (Sheol.)
verses.Psalms|89|50: Lord, where are Thy former oaths of steadfast love which Thou didst make to David in Thy faithfulness?
verses.Psalms|89|51: Remember, Lord, the disgrace of Thy servants: how I bear in my bosom the insults of all the many peoples,
verses.Psalms|89|52: wherewith Thy enemies have insulted, O Lord; wherewith they have insulted the footsteps of Thy anointed.
verses.Psalms|89|53: Blessed be the Lord for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
verses.Psalms|90|1: A Prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, Thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
verses.Psalms|90|2: Before the mountains were brought forth, and before ever Thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, Thou art God.
verses.Psalms|90|3: Thou turnest man back to dust; and sayst, Return, you children of men.
verses.Psalms|90|4: For a thousand years in Thy sight are but like yesterday when it is past, and like a watch in the night.
verses.Psalms|90|5: Thou engulfest them; they are like sleepers; they are like the short lived grass in the morning.
verses.Psalms|90|6: In the morning it flourishes, and fades; by evening it is withered and dry.
verses.Psalms|90|7: For we are consumed by Thy anger, and by Thy wrath are we terrified.
verses.Psalms|90|8: Thou hast set our iniquities before Thee, our secret sins in the light of Thy countenance.
verses.Psalms|90|9: For all our days are passed away in Thy wrath: we spend our years like a tale that is told.
verses.Psalms|90|10: The days of our years are seventy; or if by reason of special strength, eighty years; yet their pride is but trouble and wretchedness; it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
verses.Psalms|90|11: Who knows the power of Thy anger? even according to Thy fear, so is Thy wrath.
verses.Psalms|90|12: So teach us to number our days, that we may get a heart of wisdom.
verses.Psalms|90|13: Return, O Lord, how long? and relent concerning Thy servants.
verses.Psalms|90|14: O satisfy us in the morning with Thy steadfast love; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.Psalms|90|15: Make us glad according to the days wherein Thou hast afflicted us, and the years in which we have seen evil.
verses.Psalms|90|16: Let Thy work appear to Thy servants, and Thy glory to their children.
verses.Psalms|90|17: And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us: and establish the work of our hands upon us; O prosper it, the work of our hands.
verses.Psalms|91|1: He that dwells in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.Psalms|91|2: I will say of the Lord, who is my refuge and my fortress: (my God; in him will I trust,)
verses.Psalms|91|3: that he will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
verses.Psalms|91|4: He shall cover thee with his pinions, and under his wings shalt thou find refuge: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
verses.Psalms|91|5: Thou shalt not be afraid of the terror by night; nor of the arrow that flies by day;
verses.Psalms|91|6: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness; nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
verses.Psalms|91|7: A thousand shall fall at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come near thee.
verses.Psalms|91|8: Only with thy eyes shalt thou behold and see the recompense of the wicked; because Thou O Lord, art my refuge.
verses.Psalms|91|9: Thou hast made the most High Thy habitation.
verses.Psalms|91|10: No evil shall befall thee, nor shall any plague come near thy dwelling.
verses.Psalms|91|11: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
verses.Psalms|91|12: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.Psalms|91|13: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the crocodile shalt thou trample under foot.
verses.Psalms|91|14: Because he has set his delight upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
verses.Psalms|91|15: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
verses.Psalms|91|16: With long life I will satisfy him, and show him my salvation.
verses.Psalms|92|1: A Psalm, A Poem for the Sabbath day.
verses.Psalms|92|2: It is a good thing to give thanks to the Lord, and to sing praise to Thy name, O most High:
verses.Psalms|92|3: to relate Thy steadfast love in the morning, and Thy faithfulness every night,
verses.Psalms|92|4: upon an instrument of ten strings and upon the harp; to the melody of the lyre.
verses.Psalms|92|5: For Thou, Lord, hast made me glad through Thy work: I will triumph in the works of Thy hands.
verses.Psalms|92|6: O Lord, how great are Thy works! and Thy thoughts are very deep.
verses.Psalms|92|7: A brutish man does not know; nor does a fool understand this.
verses.Psalms|92|8: When the wicked spring like grass, and when all the workers of iniquity flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed forever:
verses.Psalms|92|9: but Thou, Lord, art most high for evermore.
verses.Psalms|92|10: For, lo, Thy enemies, O Lord, for lo, Thy enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.Psalms|92|11: But my horn shalt Thou exalt like the horn of a wild ox: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
verses.Psalms|92|12: My eye has seen the downfall of my enemies, and my ears have heard the doom of the wicked who rise against me.
verses.Psalms|92|13: The righteous man flourishes like the palm tree: he grows like a cedar in the Lebanon.
verses.Psalms|92|14: Those that are planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.Psalms|92|15: They still bring forth fruit in old age; they are fat and flourishing;
verses.Psalms|92|16: to declare that the Lord is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.Psalms|93|1: The Lord reigns, he is clothed with majesty; the Lord is robed; he has girded himself with strength: the world also is established, that it cannot be moved.
verses.Psalms|93|2: Thy throne is established of old: Thou art from everlasting.
verses.Psalms|93|3: The floods have lifted up, O Lord, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their roaring.
verses.Psalms|93|4: The Lord on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, than the mighty waves of the sea.
verses.Psalms|93|5: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becomes Thy house, O Lord, for length of days.
verses.Psalms|94|1: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongs; O God, to whom vengeance belongs, shine forth!
verses.Psalms|94|2: Lift up Thyself, Thou judge of the earth: render to the proud their recompense.
verses.Psalms|94|3: Lord, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
verses.Psalms|94|4: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
verses.Psalms|94|5: They crush Thy people, O Lord, and afflict Thy heritage.
verses.Psalms|94|6: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
verses.Psalms|94|7: Yet they say, The Lord shall not see, nor shall the God of Jacob regard it.
verses.Psalms|94|8: Understand, you brutish among the people: and fools, when will you be wise?
verses.Psalms|94|9: He That planted the ear, shall he not hear? he That formed the eye, shall he not see?
verses.Psalms|94|10: He That chastises nations, shall he not correct? he That teaches man knowledge?
verses.Psalms|94|11: The Lord knows the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
verses.Psalms|94|12: Blessed is the man whom Thou dost chasten, O Lord, and teachest him out of Thy law,
verses.Psalms|94|13: that Thou mayst give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
verses.Psalms|94|14: For the Lord will not cast off his people, nor will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.Psalms|94|15: But judgment shall return to righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.Psalms|94|16: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
verses.Psalms|94|17: Unless the Lord had been my help, my soul had soon dwelt in silence.
verses.Psalms|94|18: When I said, My foot slips; Thy steadfast love, O Lord, held me up.
verses.Psalms|94|19: When my cares within me were many, Thy comforts would cheer my soul.
verses.Psalms|94|20: Shall the seat of iniquity, framing mischief by law, have fellowship with Thee?
verses.Psalms|94|21: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
verses.Psalms|94|22: But the Lord has become my defence; and my God, the rock of my refuge.
verses.Psalms|94|23: And he brings upon them their own iniquity, and he cuts them off in their own wickedness; the Lord our God cuts them off.
verses.Psalms|95|1: O Come, let us sing to the Lord: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
verses.Psalms|95|2: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.
verses.Psalms|95|3: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods.
verses.Psalms|95|4: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the mountain peaks are his also.
verses.Psalms|95|5: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.
verses.Psalms|95|6: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the Lord our maker;
verses.Psalms|95|7: for he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the flock of his hand: today even, if you will only hearken to his voice!
verses.Psalms|95|8: Do not harden your hearts as in Meribah, as in the day of Massa in the wilderness:
verses.Psalms|95|9: when your fathers tempted me, proved me, even though they saw my deeds.
verses.Psalms|95|10: Forty years long did I loathe this generation and I said, It is a people that errs in their heart, and that do not know my ways:
verses.Psalms|95|11: whereupon I swore in my anger that they should not enter into my rest.
verses.Psalms|96|1: O Sing to the Lord a new song: sing to the Lord, all the earth.
verses.Psalms|96|2: Sing to the Lord, bless his name; announce his salvation from day to day.
verses.Psalms|96|3: Declare his glory among the nations, his wonders among all the peoples.
verses.Psalms|96|4: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.
verses.Psalms|96|5: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.
verses.Psalms|96|6: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.Psalms|96|7: Ascribe to the Lord, O families of the peoples, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.
verses.Psalms|96|8: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due to his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.Psalms|96|9: O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness: tremble before him, all the earth.
verses.Psalms|96|10: Say among the nations that the Lord reigns: the world also is established so that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people with equity.
verses.Psalms|96|11: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;
verses.Psalms|96|12: let the field be joyful, and all that is in it: then shall all the trees of the wood sing for joy.
verses.Psalms|96|13: Before the Lord: for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth: he shall judge the world in righteousness, and the people in his faithfulness.
verses.Psalms|97|1: The Lord reigns; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad.
verses.Psalms|97|2: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the foundation of his throne.
verses.Psalms|97|3: A fire goes before him, and burns up his enemies round about.
verses.Psalms|97|4: His lightnings lightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
verses.Psalms|97|5: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.Psalms|97|6: The heavens declared his righteousness, and all the peoples saw his glory.
verses.Psalms|97|7: Confounded be all they who serve carved idols, who boast themselves of idols: bow down before him, all you gods.
verses.Psalms|97|8: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of Thy judgments, O Lord.
verses.Psalms|97|9: For Thou, Lord, art high above all the earth: Thou art exalted far above all gods.
verses.Psalms|97|10: You that love the Lord, hate evil! he preserves the souls of his pious ones; he delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.Psalms|97|11: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.Psalms|97|12: Rejoice in the Lord, O you righteous; and give thanks to his holy name.
verses.Psalms|98|1: A Psalm. O sing to the Lord a new song; for he has done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm have gained him the victory.
verses.Psalms|98|2: The Lord has made known his salvation: his righteousness he has revealed in the sight of the nations.
verses.Psalms|98|3: He has remembered his love and his truth towards the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.Psalms|98|4: Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
verses.Psalms|98|5: Sing to the Lord with the lyre; with the lyre, and the voice of psalm.
verses.Psalms|98|6: With trumpets and sound of a shofar make a joyful noise before the Lord, the King.
verses.Psalms|98|7: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they who dwell therein.
verses.Psalms|98|8: Let the rivers clap their hands: let the mountains sing for joy together.
verses.Psalms|98|9: Before the Lord; for he comes to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
verses.Psalms|99|1: The Lord reigns; let the peoples tremble: he is enthroned upon the keruvim; let the earth be moved.
verses.Psalms|99|2: The Lord is great in Zion; and he is high above all the peoples.
verses.Psalms|99|3: Let them praise Thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
verses.Psalms|99|4: O mighty king, who loves justice, Thou hast established equity; Thou dost execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.Psalms|99|5: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
verses.Psalms|99|6: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among those who call upon his name; they called upon the Lord, and he answered them.
verses.Psalms|99|7: He spoke to them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
verses.Psalms|99|8: Thou didst answer them, O Lord our God: a forgiving God wast Thou to them, though Thou didst take vengeance for their misdeeds.
verses.Psalms|99|9: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the Lord our God is holy.
verses.Psalms|100|1: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth.
verses.Psalms|100|2: Serve the Lord with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
verses.Psalms|100|3: Know that the Lord he is God: it is he who made us, and we belong to him; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.Psalms|100|4: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful to him, and bless his name.
verses.Psalms|100|5: For the Lord is good; his steadfast love endures forever; and his faithfulness to all generations.
verses.Psalms|101|1: A Psalm of David, I will sing of loyal love and justice: to Thee, O Lord, I will sing.
verses.Psalms|101|2: I will celebrate with a Maschil psalm the way of integrity. O when wilt Thou come to me? I will walk within my house in the integrity of my heart.
verses.Psalms|101|3: I will set no wicked thing before my eyes: I hate the work of those who turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
verses.Psalms|101|4: A perverse heart shall depart from me: I will know no evil matter.
verses.Psalms|101|5: Whoever secretly slanders his neighbour, him I will cut off: him that has a high look and a proud heart I will not suffer.
verses.Psalms|101|6: My eyes are upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walks in the way of integrity, he shall serve me.
verses.Psalms|101|7: He that works deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that tells lies shall not remain in my sight.
verses.Psalms|101|8: Morning by morning I will destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all the evildoers from the city of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|102|1: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he faints, and pours out his complaint before the Lord.
verses.Psalms|102|2: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry reach Thee.
verses.Psalms|102|3: Hide not Thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline Thy ear to me: in the day when I call, answer me speedily.
verses.Psalms|102|4: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned like a hearth.
verses.Psalms|102|5: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; so that I forget how to eat my bread.
verses.Psalms|102|6: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones cleave to my skin.
verses.Psalms|102|7: I am like an owl of the wilderness: I am like a night flier of the desert.
verses.Psalms|102|8: I watch, and am like a lonely sparrow upon the house top.
verses.Psalms|102|9: My enemies insult me all the day; and they that are mad against me swear by me.
verses.Psalms|102|10: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
verses.Psalms|102|11: because of Thy indignation and Thy wrath: for Thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
verses.Psalms|102|12: My days are like an evening shadow; and I am withered like grass.
verses.Psalms|102|13: But Thou, O Lord, sittest enthroned forever; and Thy name endures to all generations.
verses.Psalms|102|14: Thou wilt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for it is time to favour her; for the set time is come.
verses.Psalms|102|15: For Thy servants hold her stones dear, and cherish her very dust.
verses.Psalms|102|16: So the nations shall fear the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth Thy glory.
verses.Psalms|102|17: For the Lord builds up Zion, he appears in his glory.
verses.Psalms|102|18: He heeds the prayer of the destitute, and does not despise their prayer.
verses.Psalms|102|19: This shall be written for the generation to come: so that a people yet unborn shall praise the Lord.
verses.Psalms|102|20: For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the Lord behold the earth;
verses.Psalms|102|21: to hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those who are appointed to death;
verses.Psalms|102|22: that men may declare the name of Lord in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
verses.Psalms|102|23: when the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.
verses.Psalms|102|24: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
verses.Psalms|102|25: I say, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: Thou whose years endure to all generations.
verses.Psalms|102|26: Of old Thou hast laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of Thy hands.
verses.Psalms|102|27: They shall perish, but Thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall grow old like a garment; Thou shalt change them like a cloak, and they will pass away:
verses.Psalms|102|28: but Thou art the same, and Thy years shall have no end.
verses.Psalms|102|29: The children of Thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before Thee.
verses.Psalms|103|1: Of David. Bless the Lord, O my soul: and all that is within me bless his holy name.
verses.Psalms|103|2: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
verses.Psalms|103|3: who forgives all thy iniquities; who heals all thy diseases;
verses.Psalms|103|4: who redeems thy life from the pit; who encircles thee with love and compassion;
verses.Psalms|103|5: who satisfies thy old age with good; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.
verses.Psalms|103|6: The Lord executes righteousness, and judgment for all that are oppressed.
verses.Psalms|103|7: He made known his ways to Moses, his acts to the children of Israel.
verses.Psalms|103|8: The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in steadfast love.
verses.Psalms|103|9: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger forever.
verses.Psalms|103|10: He has not dealt with us after our sins; nor repaid us according to our iniquities.
verses.Psalms|103|11: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his steadfast love towards those who fear him.
verses.Psalms|103|12: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.Psalms|103|13: As a father pities his children, so the Lord pities those who fear him.
verses.Psalms|103|14: For he knows our frame; he remembers that we are dust.
verses.Psalms|103|15: As for man, his days are like grass: like a flower of the field, so he blooms.
verses.Psalms|103|16: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone; and its place knows it no more.
verses.Psalms|103|17: But the steadfast love of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting upon those who fear him, and his righteousness to children's children;
verses.Psalms|103|18: to such as keep his covenant, and to those who remember his commandments to do them.
verses.Psalms|103|19: The Lord has established his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom rules over all.
verses.Psalms|103|20: Bless the Lord, you angels of his, you mighty ones who perform his bidding, hearkening to the voice of his word.
verses.Psalms|103|21: Bless the Lord, all his hosts; you ministers of his, who do his pleasure.
verses.Psalms|103|22: Bless the Lord, all his works in all places of his dominion. Bless the Lord, O my soul!
verses.Psalms|104|1: Bless the Lord, O my soul. O Lord my God Thou art very great, Thou art clothed with glory and majesty.
verses.Psalms|104|2: Who covers himself with light as with a garment: who stretches out the heavens like a curtain:
verses.Psalms|104|3: who lays the beams of his chambers in the waters: who makes the clouds his chariot: who walks upon the wings of the wind:
verses.Psalms|104|4: who makes the winds his messengers; the flames of fire his ministers:
verses.Psalms|104|5: who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed forever.
verses.Psalms|104|6: Thou didst cover it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
verses.Psalms|104|7: At Thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of Thy thunder they hastened away;
verses.Psalms|104|8: they went up the mountains; they flowed down the valleys to the place which Thou didst found for them.
verses.Psalms|104|9: Thou didst set a bound that they might not pass over; that they might not turn back to cover the earth.
verses.Psalms|104|10: He sends the springs into the valleys; they flow between the hills:
verses.Psalms|104|11: they give drink to every wild beast: the wild asses quench their thirst.
verses.Psalms|104|12: Beside them dwell the birds of the sky; from among the branches they sing.
verses.Psalms|104|13: He waters the hills from his upper chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of Thy works.
verses.Psalms|104|14: He causes the grass to grow for the cattle, and plants for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
verses.Psalms|104|15: and wine that makes glad the heart of man; oil to brighten his face; and bread which sustains the heart of man.
verses.Psalms|104|16: The trees of the Lord have their fill; the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;
verses.Psalms|104|17: where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the cypress trees are her house.
verses.Psalms|104|18: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the badgers.
verses.Psalms|104|19: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knows his going down.
verses.Psalms|104|20: Thou makest darkness, and it is night; when all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
verses.Psalms|104|21: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
verses.Psalms|104|22: The sun rises, they slink away, and lay them down in their dens.
verses.Psalms|104|23: Man goes forth to his work and to his labour until the evening.
verses.Psalms|104|24: O Lord, how manifold are Thy works! in wisdom hast Thou made them all: the earth is full of Thy creatures.
verses.Psalms|104|25: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are creeping things innumerable, both small and great beasts.
verses.Psalms|104|26: There go the ships: there are the dolphins, whom Thou hast made to play therein.
verses.Psalms|104|27: These wait all upon Thee; that Thou mayst give them their food in due season.
verses.Psalms|104|28: Thou givest it to them; they gather it: Thou openest Thy hand, they are filled with good.
verses.Psalms|104|29: Thou hidest Thy face, they are troubled: Thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
verses.Psalms|104|30: Thou sendest forth Thy breath, they are created: and Thou renewest the face of the earth.
verses.Psalms|104|31: May the glory of the Lord endure forever: let the Lord rejoice in his works.
verses.Psalms|104|32: He looks on the earth, and it trembles: he touches the hills, and they smoke.
verses.Psalms|104|33: I will sing to the Lord as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
verses.Psalms|104|34: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will rejoice in the Lord.
verses.Psalms|104|35: The sinners will be consumed out of the earth, and the wicked will be no more. Bless thou the Lord, O my soul. Hallelujah!
verses.Psalms|105|1: O Give thanks to the Lord; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
verses.Psalms|105|2: Sing to him, sing psalms to him: talk of all his wondrous works.
verses.Psalms|105|3: Glory in his holy name: let the heart of those who seek the Lord rejoice.
verses.Psalms|105|4: Seek the Lord, and his strength: seek his face continually.
verses.Psalms|105|5: Remember his marvellous works that he has done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.Psalms|105|6: O seed of Abraham his servant, you children of Jacob his chosen ones.
verses.Psalms|105|7: He is the Lord our God: his judgments are over all the earth.
verses.Psalms|105|8: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;
verses.Psalms|105|9: which he made with Abraham, and his oath to Isaac;
verses.Psalms|105|10: and confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
verses.Psalms|105|11: saying, To thee I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
verses.Psalms|105|12: when they were but a few men in number; of little account, and sojourners there:
verses.Psalms|105|13: when they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
verses.Psalms|105|14: he suffered no man to do them wrong: but he reproved kings for their sakes; saying,
verses.Psalms|105|15: Touch not my anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.Psalms|105|16: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he broke every staff of bread.
verses.Psalms|105|17: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a servant:
verses.Psalms|105|18: whose foot they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
verses.Psalms|105|19: until the time that his word came to pass: the word of the Lord had tested him.
verses.Psalms|105|20: The king sent and loosed him: and the ruler of the people let him go free.
verses.Psalms|105|21: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
verses.Psalms|105|22: to bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his elders wisdom.
verses.Psalms|105|23: So Israel came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.Psalms|105|24: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
verses.Psalms|105|25: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal craftily with his servants.
verses.Psalms|105|26: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
verses.Psalms|105|27: They performed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.Psalms|105|28: He sent darkness, and made it dark, and they did not rebel against his word.
verses.Psalms|105|29: He turned their water into blood, and slew their fish.
verses.Psalms|105|30: Their land swarmed with frogs, in the chambers of their kings.
verses.Psalms|105|31: He spoke, and there came swarms of gnats, and lice in all their borders.
verses.Psalms|105|32: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
verses.Psalms|105|33: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and broke the trees of their country.
verses.Psalms|105|34: He spoke, and the swarming locust came, and the hopping locust without number,
verses.Psalms|105|35: and they did eat up every plant in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
verses.Psalms|105|36: Then he smote all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
verses.Psalms|105|37: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one who stumbled among their tribes.
verses.Psalms|105|38: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them had fallen on them.
verses.Psalms|105|39: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
verses.Psalms|105|40: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with bread from heaven.
verses.Psalms|105|41: He opened the rock, and the water gushed out; it ran in the dry places like a river.
verses.Psalms|105|42: For he remembered his holy promise to Abraham his servant.
verses.Psalms|105|43: And he brought out his people with joy, and his chosen ones with gladness:
verses.Psalms|105|44: and gave them the lands of the nations: and they seized the labour of the peoples;
verses.Psalms|105|45: that they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Hallelujah!
verses.Psalms|106|1: Hallelujah; O give thanks to the Lord; for he is good: for his steadfast love endures for ever.
verses.Psalms|106|2: Who can utter the mighty acts of the Lord? who can declare all his praise?
verses.Psalms|106|3: Happy are they who maintain justice, and do righteousness at all times.
verses.Psalms|106|4: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou showest favour to Thy people: O visit me with Thy salvation;
verses.Psalms|106|5: that I may see the good of Thy chosen ones, that I may rejoice in the gladness of Thy nation, that I may glory with Thy inheritance.
verses.Psalms|106|6: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
verses.Psalms|106|7: Our fathers in Egypt paid no heed to Thy wonders; they did not remember the multitude of Thy deeds of lovingkindness; and they rebelled against Thee at the Sea, at the Red Sea.
verses.Psalms|106|8: But he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make known his mighty power.
verses.Psalms|106|9: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
verses.Psalms|106|10: And he saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.Psalms|106|11: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
verses.Psalms|106|12: Then they believed his words; they sang his praise.
verses.Psalms|106|13: They soon forgot his works; they did not wait for his counsel:
verses.Psalms|106|14: but lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tried God in the desert.
verses.Psalms|106|15: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
verses.Psalms|106|16: And they envied Moses in the camp, Aaron the Lord's holy one.
verses.Psalms|106|17: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
verses.Psalms|106|18: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
verses.Psalms|106|19: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped a molten image.
verses.Psalms|106|20: Thus they exchanged their glory for the likeness of an ox that eats grass!
verses.Psalms|106|21: They forgot God who had saved them, who had done great things in Egypt;
verses.Psalms|106|22: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red Sea.
verses.Psalms|106|23: Therefore he said that he would destroy them. had not Moses his chosen one stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
verses.Psalms|106|24: Moreover, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
verses.Psalms|106|25: but murmured in their tents, and did not hearken to the voice of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|106|26: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, swearing to overthrow them in the wilderness:
verses.Psalms|106|27: to cast out their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
verses.Psalms|106|28: Then they joined themselves to Baal-peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.Psalms|106|29: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds: and the plague broke out upon them.
verses.Psalms|106|30: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
verses.Psalms|106|31: And that was counted to him for righteousness to all generations for evermore.
verses.Psalms|106|32: And they angered him at the waters of Meribah, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
verses.Psalms|106|33: because they angered his spirit, so that he spoke rashly with his lips.
verses.Psalms|106|34: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the Lord commanded them:
verses.Psalms|106|35: but were mingled among the nations, and learned their works:
verses.Psalms|106|36: and they served their idols, which became a snare to them.
verses.Psalms|106|37: And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to idols,
verses.Psalms|106|38: and shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
verses.Psalms|106|39: Thus they were defiled with their own works, and went astray in their doings.
verses.Psalms|106|40: Therefore was the wrath of the Lord kindled against his people, and he abhorred his inheritance.
verses.Psalms|106|41: So he gave them into the hand of the nations; and they that hated them ruled over them.
verses.Psalms|106|42: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
verses.Psalms|106|43: Many times did he deliver them; but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low through their iniquity.
verses.Psalms|106|44: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
verses.Psalms|106|45: and he remembered for them his covenant, and relented according to the abundance of his steadfast love.
verses.Psalms|106|46: Moreover he caused them to be pitied by all their captors.
verses.Psalms|106|47: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to Thy holy name, and to triumph in Thy praise.
verses.Psalms|106|48: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Hallelujah!
verses.Psalms|107|1: O Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good: for his steadfast love endures for ever.
verses.Psalms|107|2: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
verses.Psalms|107|3: and gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
verses.Psalms|107|4: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; they found no city to dwell in.
verses.Psalms|107|5: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
verses.Psalms|107|6: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble; he delivered them out of their distresses.
verses.Psalms|107|7: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
verses.Psalms|107|8: Let them praise the Lord for his steadfast love, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.Psalms|107|9: For he has satisfied the longing soul, and filled the hungry soul with goodness.
verses.Psalms|107|10: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, bound in affliction and iron;
verses.Psalms|107|11: because they had rebelled against the words of God, and rejected the counsel of the most High:
verses.Psalms|107|12: so that he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
verses.Psalms|107|13: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.Psalms|107|14: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke their bands asunder.
verses.Psalms|107|15: Let them praise the Lord for his steadfast love, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.Psalms|107|16: For he has broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron asunder.
verses.Psalms|107|17: The foolish were afflicted on account of their sinful way, and their iniquities.
verses.Psalms|107|18: Their soul abhorred all manner of food; for they came near the gates of death.
verses.Psalms|107|19: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.Psalms|107|20: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their destructions.
verses.Psalms|107|21: Let them praise the Lord for his steadfast love, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.Psalms|107|22: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
verses.Psalms|107|23: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
verses.Psalms|107|24: these saw the works of the Lord, and his wonders in the deep.
verses.Psalms|107|25: For he commanded, and raised the stormy wind, which lifted up the waves thereof.
verses.Psalms|107|26: They mount up to the sky, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted away because of trouble.
verses.Psalms|107|27: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits' end.
verses.Psalms|107|28: Then they cry to the Lord in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distresses.
verses.Psalms|107|29: He makes the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
verses.Psalms|107|30: Then are they glad because they are quiet; and he brings them to their desired haven.
verses.Psalms|107|31: Let them praise the Lord for his steadfast love, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.Psalms|107|32: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
verses.Psalms|107|33: He turns rivers into a wilderness, and watersprings into dry ground;
verses.Psalms|107|34: a fruitful land into barrenness, because of wickedness of those who dwell therein.
verses.Psalms|107|35: He turned the wilderness into a pool of water, and dry ground into watersprings.
verses.Psalms|107|36: And there he makes the hungry to dwell, and they establish a city for habitation;
verses.Psalms|107|37: and sow fields, and plant vineyards, which yield fruits of increase.
verses.Psalms|107|38: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and does not let their cattle decrease.
verses.Psalms|107|39: When they are diminished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow:
verses.Psalms|107|40: he pours contempt upon nobles, and causes them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way:
verses.Psalms|107|41: yet he sets the poor on high from affliction, and makes his families like a flock.
verses.Psalms|107|42: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
verses.Psalms|107|43: Whoever is wise, let them consider these things, and let them observe the loving acts of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|108|1: A Poem, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|108|2: My heart is firm, O God; I will sing, I will give praise; my glory likewise.
verses.Psalms|108|3: Awake the harp and the lyre: I will awaken the dawn.
verses.Psalms|108|4: I will praise Thee, O Lord, among the peoples: and I will sing praises to Thee among the nations.
verses.Psalms|108|5: For Thy steadfast love is great above the heavens: and Thy truth reaches the clouds.
verses.Psalms|108|6: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and Thy glory above all the earth;
verses.Psalms|108|7: that Thy beloved ones may be delivered: save with Thy right hand, and answer me.
verses.Psalms|108|8: God has spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
verses.Psalms|108|9: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of my head; Judah is my sceptre;
verses.Psalms|108|10: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast my shoe; over Philistia I will cry in triumph.
verses.Psalms|108|11: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me to Edom?
verses.Psalms|108|12: Hast Thou not rejected us, O God? so that Thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.
verses.Psalms|108|13: Give us help against the foe: for vain is the help of man.
verses.Psalms|108|14: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is who will tread down our enemies.
verses.Psalms|109|1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. Keep not silent, O God of my praise;
verses.Psalms|109|2: for the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
verses.Psalms|109|3: For they have compassed me about with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
verses.Psalms|109|4: In return for my love they are my accusers; whilst I have nothing but prayer.
verses.Psalms|109|5: And they have repaid me evil for good, and hatred for my love, saying:
verses.Psalms|109|6: Set a wicked man over him: and let an adversary stand at his right hand.
verses.Psalms|109|7: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer be turned into sin.
verses.Psalms|109|8: Let his days be few; and let another take his possessions.
verses.Psalms|109|9: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.Psalms|109|10: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
verses.Psalms|109|11: Let the creditor seize everything that he has, and let strangers spoil his labour.
verses.Psalms|109|12: Let there be none to extend kindness to him: nor let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
verses.Psalms|109|13: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.Psalms|109|14: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the Lord; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.Psalms|109|15: Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
verses.Psalms|109|16: Because he remembered not to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy man, and the brokenhearted to their death.
verses.Psalms|109|17: For he loved cursing, and it came to him: and he delighted not in blessing, and it was far from him.
verses.Psalms|109|18: And he clothed himself with cursing like his garment, and it came into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
verses.Psalms|109|19: Let it be to him as the garment which he puts on, and for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
verses.Psalms|109|20: This is what my adversaries seek to obtain from the Lord, and they who speak evil against my soul.
verses.Psalms|109|21: But do Thou for me, O God the Lord, for Thy name's sake: because Thy steadfast love is good, deliver Thou me.
verses.Psalms|109|22: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
verses.Psalms|109|23: I am gone like the shadow at evening: I am shaken off like the locust.
verses.Psalms|109|24: My knees totter through fasting; and my flesh fails of fatness.
verses.Psalms|109|25: I have become a taunt to them: when they see me they shake their heads.
verses.Psalms|109|26: Help me, O Lord my God: O save me according to Thy steadfast love:
verses.Psalms|109|27: that they may know that this is Thy hand; that Thou, Lord, hast done it.
verses.Psalms|109|28: Let them curse, but bless Thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let Thy servant rejoice.
verses.Psalms|109|29: Let my adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a robe.
verses.Psalms|109|30: I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.Psalms|109|31: For he stands at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those who would condemn him to death.
verses.Psalms|110|1: A Psalm of David. The Lord says to my master, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thy enemies thy footstool.
verses.Psalms|110|2: The Lord shall send thy mighty sceptre out of Zion: rule in the midst of thy enemies.
verses.Psalms|110|3: Thy people offered themselves willingly in the majesty of their holiness, on the day of thy battle; when still the dew of thy youth was upon thee, fresh from the womb of dawn.
verses.Psalms|110|4: The Lord has sworn, and will not change his mind, Thou shalt be a priest forever, after the manner of Melchizedek.
verses.Psalms|110|5: The Lord is at thy right hand, he crushes kings on the day of his wrath.
verses.Psalms|110|6: He judges among the nations: their land is full of dead bodies; he will shatter heads over many countries.
verses.Psalms|110|7: He will drink of the brook in the way: therefore will he lift up the head.
verses.Psalms|111|1: Hallelujah! I will praise the Lord with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.Psalms|111|2: The works of the Lord are great, sought out by all who love them.
verses.Psalms|111|3: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endures for ever.
verses.Psalms|111|4: He has made his wonderful works to be remembered: the Lord is gracious and full of compassion.
verses.Psalms|111|5: He has given food to those who fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
verses.Psalms|111|6: He has declared to his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the nations.
verses.Psalms|111|7: The works of his hands are truth and justice; all his commandments are sure.
verses.Psalms|111|8: They stand fast for ever and ever, done in truth and uprightness.
verses.Psalms|111|9: He sent redemption to his people: he has commanded his covenant forever: holy and reverend is his name.
verses.Psalms|111|10: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they who do his commandments: his praise endures forever.
verses.Psalms|112|1: Hallelujah! Happy is the man who fears the Lord, who delights greatly in his commandments.
verses.Psalms|112|2: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.Psalms|112|3: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endures for ever.
verses.Psalms|112|4: Light rises in the darkness for the upright: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and just.
verses.Psalms|112|5: A good man lends with a good grace: he conducts his affairs justly.
verses.Psalms|112|6: Surely he shall never be moved: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
verses.Psalms|112|7: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is firm, trusting in the Lord.
verses.Psalms|112|8: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he gaze upon his enemies.
verses.Psalms|112|9: He has distributed freely, he has given to the poor; his righteousness endures for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
verses.Psalms|112|10: The wicked man shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall come to nought.
verses.Psalms|113|1: Hallelujah! Give praise, O servants of the Lord, praise the name of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|113|2: Blessed be the name of the Lord from this time forth and for evermore.
verses.Psalms|113|3: From the rising of the sun to its setting, the Lord's name is to be praised.
verses.Psalms|113|4: The Lord is high above all nations, and his glory is above the heavens.
verses.Psalms|113|5: Who is like the Lord our God, who is enthroned on high,
verses.Psalms|113|6: and yet looks far down to behold the things that are in heaven, and on the earth!
verses.Psalms|113|7: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts the needy out of the ashheap;
verses.Psalms|113|8: that he may set him with nobles, with the nobles of his people.
verses.Psalms|113|9: He makes the barren woman to keep house, and be a joyful mother of children. Hallelujah!
verses.Psalms|114|1: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
verses.Psalms|114|2: Judah became his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.
verses.Psalms|114|3: The sea saw it, and fled: the Jordan was driven back.
verses.Psalms|114|4: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like young sheep.
verses.Psalms|114|5: What ails thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? thou Jordan, that thou art driven back?
verses.Psalms|114|6: You mountains, that you skip like rams; and you little hills, like lambs?
verses.Psalms|114|7: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;
