verses.Psalms|114|8: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
verses.Psalms|115|1: Not to us, O Lord, not to us, but to Thy name give glory, for Thy steadfast love, and for Thy truth.
verses.Psalms|115|2: Why should the nations say, Where is now their God?
verses.Psalms|115|3: But our God is in the heavens: he has done whatever he has pleased.
verses.Psalms|115|4: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
verses.Psalms|115|5: They have mouths, but they cannot speak: eyes have they, but they cannot see:
verses.Psalms|115|6: they have ears, but they cannot hear: noses have they, but they cannot smell:
verses.Psalms|115|7: they have hands, but they cannot feel: feet have they, but they cannot walk: nor can they speak through their throat.
verses.Psalms|115|8: They who make them are like them; so is everyone who trusts in them.
verses.Psalms|115|9: O Israel, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.
verses.Psalms|115|10: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.
verses.Psalms|115|11: You who fear the Lord, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.
verses.Psalms|115|12: The Lord has been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.Psalms|115|13: He will bless those who fear the Lord, both small and great.
verses.Psalms|115|14: May the Lord increase you more and more, you and your children.
verses.Psalms|115|15: May you be blessed of the Lord who made heaven and earth.
verses.Psalms|115|16: The heavens are the heavens of the Lord: but he has given the earth to the children of men.
verses.Psalms|115|17: The dead cannot praise the Lord, nor can any who go down into silence.
verses.Psalms|115|18: But we will bless the Lord from this time forth and for evermore. Hallelujah!
verses.Psalms|116|1: I love the Lord who hears my voice and my supplications.
verses.Psalms|116|2: Because he has inclined his ear to me, therefore I will call upon him as long as I live.
verses.Psalms|116|3: The cords of death surrounded me, and the pains of Sheol seized upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.Psalms|116|4: Then I called upon the name of the Lord; O Lord, I beseech Thee, deliver my soul.
verses.Psalms|116|5: Gracious is the Lord, and just; and our God is merciful.
verses.Psalms|116|6: The Lord preserves the simple: I was brought low, and he saved me.
verses.Psalms|116|7: Return to thy rest, O my soul; for the Lord has dealt bountifully with thee.
verses.Psalms|116|8: For Thou hast delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
verses.Psalms|116|9: I will walk before the Lord in the land of the living.
verses.Psalms|116|10: I kept faith even when I said, I am greatly afflicted.
verses.Psalms|116|11: I said in my haste, Every man is false.
verses.Psalms|116|12: How can I repay the Lord for all his benefits toward me?
verses.Psalms|116|13: I will raise the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|116|14: I will pay my vows to the Lord now in the presence of all his people.
verses.Psalms|116|15: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his pious ones.
verses.Psalms|116|16: O Lord, truly I am Thy servant; I am Thy servant, the son of Thy handmaid: Thou hast loosed my bonds.
verses.Psalms|116|17: I will offer to Thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and I will call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|116|18: I will pay my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people,
verses.Psalms|116|19: in the courts of the Lord's house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
verses.Psalms|117|1: O Praise the Lord, all you nations: praise him all you peoples.
verses.Psalms|117|2: For his love for us is great: and the truth of the Lord endures for ever. Hallelujah!
verses.Psalms|118|1: O Give thanks to the Lord; for he is good: for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|118|2: Let Israel now say, that his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|118|3: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|118|4: Let those now who fear the Lord say, that his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|118|5: Out of my distress I called upon the Lord: the Lord answered me with liberation.
verses.Psalms|118|6: The Lord is on my side; I will not fear: what can a man do to me?
verses.Psalms|118|7: The Lord takes my part with those who help me: therefore I shall gaze upon those who hate me.
verses.Psalms|118|8: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to put confidence in man.
verses.Psalms|118|9: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in princes.
verses.Psalms|118|10: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord I cut them off.
verses.Psalms|118|11: They compassed me about; indeed, they surrounded me: but in the name of the Lord I cut them off.
verses.Psalms|118|12: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched like a fire of thorns: for in the name of the Lord I cut them off.
verses.Psalms|118|13: Thou didst push me hard that I might fall: but the Lord helped me.
verses.Psalms|118|14: The Lord is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
verses.Psalms|118|15: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: the right hand of the Lord does valiantly.
verses.Psalms|118|16: The right hand of the Lord is exalted: the right hand of the Lord does valiantly.
verses.Psalms|118|17: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|118|18: The Lord has chastised me severely: but he has not given me up to death.
verses.Psalms|118|19: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go in to them, and I will praise the Lord:
verses.Psalms|118|20: this is the gate of the Lord, into which the righteous shall enter.
verses.Psalms|118|21: I will give Thee thanks, for Thou hast answered me, and art become my salvation.
verses.Psalms|118|22: The stone which the builders rejected has become the head stone of the corner.
verses.Psalms|118|23: This is the Lord's doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.
verses.Psalms|118|24: This is the day which the Lord has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.Psalms|118|25: Save us, O Lord, we pray Thee: we pray Thee, O Lord, prosper us.
verses.Psalms|118|26: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord: we have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|118|27: God is the Lord, who has shown us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, to the horns of the altar.
verses.Psalms|118|28: Thou art my God, and I will praise Thee: my God, I will exalt Thee.
verses.Psalms|118|29: O give thanks to the Lord; for he is good: for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|119|1: Happy are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the law of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|119|2: Happy are they who keep his testimonies and seek him with the whole heart.
verses.Psalms|119|3: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
verses.Psalms|119|4: Thou hast commanded Thy precepts to be kept diligently.
verses.Psalms|119|5: O that my ways were directed to keep Thy statutes!
verses.Psalms|119|6: Then should I not be ashamed, when I observe all Thy commandments.
verses.Psalms|119|7: I shall give Thee thanks with uprightness of heart, when I learn Thy righteous judgments.
verses.Psalms|119|8: I will keep Thy statutes: O do not forsake me utterly.
verses.Psalms|119|9: Wherewith shall a young man keep his way pure? by guarding it according to Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|10: With my whole heart I have sought Thee: O let me not wander from Thy commandments.
verses.Psalms|119|11: Thy word have I hid in my heart, that I might not sin against Thee.
verses.Psalms|119|12: Blessed art Thou, O Lord: teach me Thy statutes.
verses.Psalms|119|13: With my lips I have declared all the judgments of Thy mouth.
verses.Psalms|119|14: I have rejoiced in the way of Thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
verses.Psalms|119|15: I will meditate in Thy precepts, and observe Thy ways.
verses.Psalms|119|16: I will delight myself in Thy statutes: I will not forget Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|17: Deal bountifully with Thy servant, that I may live, and keep Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|18: Open Thou my eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of Thy law.
verses.Psalms|119|19: I am a stranger on the earth: do not hide Thy commandments from me.
verses.Psalms|119|20: My soul is consumed with the longing that it has to Thy judgments at all times.
verses.Psalms|119|21: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, who wander from Thy commandments.
verses.Psalms|119|22: Remove insult and contempt from me; for I have kept Thy testimonies.
verses.Psalms|119|23: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but Thy servant did meditate on Thy statutes.
verses.Psalms|119|24: Thy testimonies also are my delight; they are my counsellors.
verses.Psalms|119|25: My soul cleaves to the dust: revive me according to Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|26: I have declared my ways, and Thou didst hear me: teach me Thy statutes.
verses.Psalms|119|27: Make me to understand the way of Thy precepts: so I shall talk of Thy wondrous works.
verses.Psalms|119|28: My soul melts away for heaviness: strengthen me according to Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|29: Remove from me the way of falsehood: and graciously bestow Thy law upon me.
verses.Psalms|119|30: I have chosen the way of truth: Thy judgments have I laid before me.
verses.Psalms|119|31: I have held fast to Thy testimonies: O Lord, put me not to shame.
verses.Psalms|119|32: I will run the way of Thy commandments, for therein Thou dost enlarge my heart.
verses.Psalms|119|33: Teach me, O Lord, the way of Thy statutes; and I shall keep it to the end.
verses.Psalms|119|34: Give me understanding, and I shall keep Thy law; and I shall observe it with my whole heart.
verses.Psalms|119|35: Make me to go in the path of Thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
verses.Psalms|119|36: Incline my heart to Thy testimonies, and not to unjust gain.
verses.Psalms|119|37: Turn away my eyes from beholding vanity; and give me life in Thy way.
verses.Psalms|119|38: Confirm to Thy servant Thy word, which relates to the fear of Thee.
verses.Psalms|119|39: Turn away my insult which I fear: for Thy judgments are good.
verses.Psalms|119|40: Behold, I have longed after Thy precepts: give me life in Thy righteousness.
verses.Psalms|119|41: And let Thy promises of steadfast love come to pass for me, O Lord; even Thy salvation; according to Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|42: So shall I have wherewith to answer him who insults me: for I trust in Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|43: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in Thy judgments.
verses.Psalms|119|44: So shall I keep Thy law continually for ever and ever.
verses.Psalms|119|45: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek Thy precepts.
verses.Psalms|119|46: I will also speak of Thy testimonies before kings, and will not be ashamed.
verses.Psalms|119|47: And I will delight myself in Thy commandments, which I have loved.
verses.Psalms|119|48: My hands also will I lift up to Thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate on Thy statutes.
verses.Psalms|119|49: Remember the word to Thy servant, whereby Thou hast given me hope.
verses.Psalms|119|50: This is my comfort in my affliction: for Thy word has revived me.
verses.Psalms|119|51: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet I have not declined from Thy law.
verses.Psalms|119|52: When I remembered thy judgments of old, O Lord, I took comfort.
verses.Psalms|119|53: Horror has taken hold of me because of the wicked who forsake Thy law.
verses.Psalms|119|54: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.Psalms|119|55: I have remembered Thy name, O Lord, in the night, and have kept Thy law.
verses.Psalms|119|56: This was my lot, because I kept Thy precepts.
verses.Psalms|119|57: The Lord is my portion: I have said that I would keep Thy words.
verses.Psalms|119|58: I entreated Thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful to me according to Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|59: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet to Thy testimonies.
verses.Psalms|119|60: I made haste, and delayed not to keep Thy commandments.
verses.Psalms|119|61: Bands of wicked men have robbed me: but I have not forgotten Thy law.
verses.Psalms|119|62: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to Thee because of Thy righteous judgments.
verses.Psalms|119|63: I am a companion of all those who fear Thee, and of those who keep Thy precepts.
verses.Psalms|119|64: The earth, O Lord, is full of Thy steadfast love: teach me Thy statutes.
verses.Psalms|119|65: Thou hast dealt well with Thy servant, O Lord, according to Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|66: Teach me good discernment and knowledge: for I have believed Thy commandments.
verses.Psalms|119|67: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now I observe Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|68: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me Thy statutes.
verses.Psalms|119|69: The proud have smeared me with a lie: but I will keep Thy precepts with my whole heart.
verses.Psalms|119|70: Their heart is gross like fat, but I delight in Thy law.
verses.Psalms|119|71: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn Thy statutes.
verses.Psalms|119|72: The law of Thy mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.Psalms|119|73: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn Thy commandments.
verses.Psalms|119|74: They who fear Thee will see me and be glad, because I have hoped in Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|75: I know, O Lord, that Thy judgments are right, and that in faithfulness Thou has afflicted me.
verses.Psalms|119|76: Let Thy steadfast love be my comfort, according to Thy word to Thy servant.
verses.Psalms|119|77: Let Thy mercies come to me, that I may live: for Thy law is my delight.
verses.Psalms|119|78: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me with guile: but I will meditate on Thy precepts.
verses.Psalms|119|79: Let those who fear Thee turn to me, and those who have known Thy testimonies.
verses.Psalms|119|80: Let my heart be sound in Thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
verses.Psalms|119|81: My soul faints for Thy salvation: I hope in Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|82: My eyes fail with longing for Thy word, saying, When wilt Thou comfort me?
verses.Psalms|119|83: For I am become like a wineskin in the smoke; yet I do not forget Thy statutes.
verses.Psalms|119|84: How many are the days of Thy servant? when wilt Thou execute judgment on those who persecute me?
verses.Psalms|119|85: The proud have dug pits for me, which are not according to Thy law.
verses.Psalms|119|86: All Thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help Thou me.
verses.Psalms|119|87: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not Thy precepts.
verses.Psalms|119|88: In Thy steadfast love spare my life; so I shall keep the testimony of Thy mouth.
verses.Psalms|119|89: For ever, O Lord; Thy word stands fast in the heavens.
verses.Psalms|119|90: Thy faithfulness endures to all generations: Thou hast established the earth, and it stands firm.
verses.Psalms|119|91: They continue this day according to Thy ordinances: for all are Thy servants.
verses.Psalms|119|92: Unless Thy law had been my delights, I should have perished in my affliction.
verses.Psalms|119|93: I will never forget Thy precepts: for with them Thou hast given me life.
verses.Psalms|119|94: I am Thine, save me; for I have sought Thy precepts.
verses.Psalms|119|95: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider Thy testimonies.
verses.Psalms|119|96: I have seen an end of every purpose: but Thy commandment is exceedingly broad.
verses.Psalms|119|97: O how I love Thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
verses.Psalms|119|98: Thy commandments make me wiser than my enemies: for they are ever with me.
verses.Psalms|119|99: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for Thy testimonies are my meditation.
verses.Psalms|119|100: I understand more than the elders, because I keep Thy precepts.
verses.Psalms|119|101: I have restrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|102: I have not departed from Thy judgments: for Thou hast taught me.
verses.Psalms|119|103: How sweet are Thy words to my palate! sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.Psalms|119|104: Through Thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
verses.Psalms|119|105: Thy word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
verses.Psalms|119|106: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep Thy righteous judgments.
verses.Psalms|119|107: I am afflicted very much: revive me, O Lord, according to Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|108: Accept I beseech Thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, and teach me Thy ordinances.
verses.Psalms|119|109: My soul is continually in my hand: yet I have not forgotten Thy law.
verses.Psalms|119|110: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I have not strayed from Thy precepts.
verses.Psalms|119|111: Thy testimonies I have taken as a heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.Psalms|119|112: I have inclined my heart to perform Thy statutes always, to the end.
verses.Psalms|119|113: I hate men of vain thoughts: but Thy law I love.
verses.Psalms|119|114: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|115: Depart from me, you evildoers: for I will keep commandments of my God.
verses.Psalms|119|116: Uphold me according to Thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.Psalms|119|117: Hold me up, and I shall be safe: and I will watch Thy statutes continually,
verses.Psalms|119|118: Thou hast trodden down all those who stray from Thy statutes: for their deceit is vain.
verses.Psalms|119|119: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love Thy testimonies.
verses.Psalms|119|120: My flesh shudders for fear of Thee; and I am afraid of Thy judgments.
verses.Psalms|119|121: I have done justice and righteousness: leave me not to my oppressors.
verses.Psalms|119|122: Be surety for Thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
verses.Psalms|119|123: My eyes fail with watching for Thy salvation, and for the word of Thy righteousness.
verses.Psalms|119|124: Deal with Thy servant according to Thy steadfast love, and teach me Thy statutes.
verses.Psalms|119|125: I am Thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know Thy testimonies.
verses.Psalms|119|126: It is time to act for the Lord: they have made void Thy law.
verses.Psalms|119|127: Therefore I love Thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
verses.Psalms|119|128: Therefore I esteem all Thy precepts to be entirely right; and I have loathed every false way.
verses.Psalms|119|129: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore my soul keeps them.
verses.Psalms|119|130: The unfolding of Thy words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.
verses.Psalms|119|131: With open mouth I pant: because I long for Thy commandments.
verses.Psalms|119|132: Look upon me, and be gracious unto me, as is Thy wont towards those who love Thy name.
verses.Psalms|119|133: Order my steps in Thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.Psalms|119|134: Deliver me from the oppression of man: and I will keep Thy precepts.
verses.Psalms|119|135: Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant; and teach me Thy statutes.
verses.Psalms|119|136: Rivers of water run down from my eyes, because they do not keep Thy law.
verses.Psalms|119|137: Righteous art Thou, O Lord and upright are Thy judgments.
verses.Psalms|119|138: Thou hast commanded Thy testimonies in righteousness and in great faithfulness.
verses.Psalms|119|139: My zeal consumes me, because my enemies have forgotten Thy words.
verses.Psalms|119|140: Thy word is very pure: therefore Thy servant loves it.
verses.Psalms|119|141: I am small and despised: yet I do not forget Thy precepts.
verses.Psalms|119|142: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and Thy law is truth.
verses.Psalms|119|143: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me: yet Thy commandments are my delights.
verses.Psalms|119|144: Thy testimonies are righteous forever: give me understanding, and I shall live.
verses.Psalms|119|145: I cry with my whole heart; answer me, O Lord: I will keep Thy statutes.
verses.Psalms|119|146: I cry to Thee; save me, and I shall keep Thy testimonies.
verses.Psalms|119|147: I rise before dawn, and I cry out: my hope is in Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|148: My eyes open before the night watches, that I may meditate on Thy saying.
verses.Psalms|119|149: Hear my voice according to Thy steadfast love: O Lord, revive me according to Thy judgment.
verses.Psalms|119|150: Those who follow after mischief draw near: they are far from Thy law.
verses.Psalms|119|151: Thou art near, O Lord; and all Thy commandments are truth.
verses.Psalms|119|152: Concerning Thy testimonies, I have known of old that Thou hast founded them forever.
verses.Psalms|119|153: Consider my affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget Thy law.
verses.Psalms|119|154: Plead my cause, and deliver me: give me life according to Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|155: Salvation is far from the wicked; for they seek not Thy statutes.
verses.Psalms|119|156: Great are Thy compassions, O Lord: give me life as is Thy wont.
verses.Psalms|119|157: Many are my persecutors and my enemies; yet I do not decline from Thy testimonies.
verses.Psalms|119|158: I behold transgressors, and I am grieved; because they keep not Thy saying,
verses.Psalms|119|159: Consider how I love Thy precepts: revive me, O Lord, according to Thy steadfast love.
verses.Psalms|119|160: The sum of Thy word is truth: and every one of Thy righteous judgments endures for ever.
verses.Psalms|119|161: Princes have persecuted me without cause: but my heart stands in awe of Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|162: I rejoice at Thy word, like one who finds great spoil.
verses.Psalms|119|163: I hate and abhor lying: but Thy law I love.
verses.Psalms|119|164: Seven times a day I praise Thee because of Thy righteous judgments.
verses.Psalms|119|165: Great peace have they who love Thy law: and nothing can make them stumble.
verses.Psalms|119|166: Lord, I have hoped for Thy salvation, and I have done Thy commandments.
verses.Psalms|119|167: My soul has kept Thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
verses.Psalms|119|168: I have kept Thy precepts and Thy testimonies: for all my ways are before Thee.
verses.Psalms|119|169: Let my cry come before Thee, O Lord: give me understanding according to Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|170: Let my supplication come before Thee: deliver me according to Thy word.
verses.Psalms|119|171: My lips shall utter praise, for Thou hast taught me Thy statutes.
verses.Psalms|119|172: My tongue shall sing of Thy word: for all Thy commandments are just.
verses.Psalms|119|173: Let Thy hand help me; for I have chosen Thy precepts.
verses.Psalms|119|174: I long for Thy salvation, O Lord; and Thy law is my delight.
verses.Psalms|119|175: Let my soul live, and it shall praise Thee; and let Thy judgment help me.
verses.Psalms|119|176: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek out Thy servant; for I do not forget Thy commandments.
verses.Psalms|120|1: A Song of Degrees. In my distress I cried to the Lord, and he heard me.
verses.Psalms|120|2: Deliver my soul, O Lord, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
verses.Psalms|120|3: What shall be given to thee? or what shall be done to thee, thou false tongue?
verses.Psalms|120|4: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of the broom tree.
verses.Psalms|120|5: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
verses.Psalms|120|6: My soul has long dwelt with haters of peace.
verses.Psalms|120|7: I am a man of peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.Psalms|121|1: A Song of Degrees. I will lift up my eyes to the hills From whence comes my help?
verses.Psalms|121|2: My help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
verses.Psalms|121|3: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he who keeps thee will not slumber.
verses.Psalms|121|4: Behold, he who keeps Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.Psalms|121|5: The Lord is thy keeper: the Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.Psalms|121|6: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.Psalms|121|7: The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
verses.Psalms|121|8: The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and for evermore.
verses.Psalms|122|1: A Song of Degrees of David. I was glad when they said to me, Let us go into the house of the Lord:
verses.Psalms|122|2: when our feet stood within thy gates, O Jerusalem;
verses.Psalms|122|3: O Jerusalem, built as a city that is compact together:
verses.Psalms|122|4: there the tribes used to go up, the tribes of the Lord, an appointed practice for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|122|5: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
verses.Psalms|122|6: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they who love thee shall prosper:
verses.Psalms|122|7: peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
verses.Psalms|122|8: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
verses.Psalms|122|9: For the sake of the house of the Lord our God I will seek thy good.
verses.Psalms|123|1: A Song of Degrees. To Thee I lift up my eyes, O Thou who dwellest in the heavens.
verses.Psalms|123|2: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the Lord our God, until he shall be gracious to us.
verses.Psalms|123|3: Be gracious to us, O Lord, be gracious to us: for we are overfilled with contempt.
verses.Psalms|123|4: Our soul is overfilled with the scorn of those who are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
verses.Psalms|124|1: A Song of Degrees of David. If not for the Lord who was with us, let Israel now say –
verses.Psalms|124|2: if not for the Lord who was with us, when men rose up against us:
verses.Psalms|124|3: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their anger was kindled against us:
verses.Psalms|124|4: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul:
verses.Psalms|124|5: then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
verses.Psalms|124|6: Blessed be the Lord, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.Psalms|124|7: Our soul is escaped like a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
verses.Psalms|124|8: Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
verses.Psalms|125|1: A Song of Degrees. They who trust in the Lord shall be like mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abides for ever.
verses.Psalms|125|2: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Lord is round about his people from henceforth and forever.
verses.Psalms|125|3: For the sceptre of wickedness shall not rest upon the share allotted to the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands to do wrong.
verses.Psalms|125|4: Do good, O Lord, to those who are good, and to those who are upright in their hearts.
verses.Psalms|125|5: As for such as turn aside to their crooked ways, the Lord shall lead them away with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
verses.Psalms|126|1: A Song of Degrees. When the Lord brought back the captivity of Zion, we were like men in a dream.
verses.Psalms|126|2: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then they said among the nations, The Lord has done great things for them.
verses.Psalms|126|3: The Lord has done great things for us; we are glad.
verses.Psalms|126|4: Bring back our captivity, O Lord, like the streams in the south.
verses.Psalms|126|5: They who sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.Psalms|126|6: He who goes weeping on his way, bearing a bag of seed, shall come back with a joyful shout, carrying his sheaves.
verses.Psalms|127|1: A Song of Degrees for Solomon. Unless the Lord builds the house, they who build it labour in vain: unless the Lord keeps the city, the watchman stays awake in vain.
verses.Psalms|127|2: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of toil: for truly to his beloved he gives tranquillity.
verses.Psalms|127|3: Lo, children are a heritage of the Lord: and the fruit of the womb is a reward.
verses.Psalms|127|4: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man; so are the children of one's youth.
verses.Psalms|127|5: Happy is the man that has his quiver full of them: they shall not be put to shame, but they shall speak with their enemies in the gate.
verses.Psalms|128|1: A Song of Degrees. Happy is everyone who fears the Lord; who walks in his ways.
verses.Psalms|128|2: For thou shalt eat the labour of thy hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
verses.Psalms|128|3: Thy wife shall be like a fruitful vine in the recesses of thy house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
verses.Psalms|128|4: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed who fears the Lord.
verses.Psalms|128|5: The Lord shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
verses.Psalms|128|6: And thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.
verses.Psalms|129|1: A Song of Degrees. Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
verses.Psalms|129|2: many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.Psalms|129|3: The ploughers ploughed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
verses.Psalms|129|4: The Lord is righteous: he has cut asunder the cord of the wicked.
verses.Psalms|129|5: Let them be confounded and turned back, all who hate Zion.
verses.Psalms|129|6: Let them be like the grass upon the housetops, which withers before it is plucked:
verses.Psalms|129|7: wherewith the mower fills not his hand; nor he who binds sheaves his bosom.
verses.Psalms|129|8: Nor do they who go by say, The blessing of the Lord be upon you: we bless you in the name of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|130|1: A Song of Degrees. Out of the depths I have cried to Thee, O Lord.
verses.Psalms|130|2: Lord, hear my voice: let Thy ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
verses.Psalms|130|3: If Thou, Lord, shouldst mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?
verses.Psalms|130|4: But there is forgiveness with Thee, that Thou mayst be feared.
verses.Psalms|130|5: I wait for the Lord, my soul waits, and in his word I hope.
verses.Psalms|130|6: My soul waits for the Lord more than they who watch for the morning: more than watchmen for the morning.
verses.Psalms|130|7: Let Israel hope in the Lord: for with the Lord there is steadfast love, and with him is plenteous redemption.
verses.Psalms|130|8: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
verses.Psalms|131|1: A Song of Degrees of David. Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor my eyes lofty: nor do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
verses.Psalms|131|2: Surely I have stilled and quieted myself, like a weaned child beside his mother: my soul within me is like a weaned child.
verses.Psalms|131|3: Let Israel hope in the Lord from henceforth and for ever.
verses.Psalms|132|1: A Song of Degrees. Lord, remember to David's favour all his afflictions:
verses.Psalms|132|2: how he swore to the Lord, and vowed to the mighty God of Jacob:
verses.Psalms|132|3: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
verses.Psalms|132|4: I will not give sleep to my eyes, slumber to my eyelids,
verses.Psalms|132|5: until I find out a place for the Lord, a habitation for the mighty One of Jacob.
verses.Psalms|132|6: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
verses.Psalms|132|7: We will go into his dwelling places: we will worship at his footstool.
verses.Psalms|132|8: Arise, O Lord, to Thy resting place; Thou, and the ark of Thy strength.
verses.Psalms|132|9: Let Thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let Thy pious ones shout for joy.
verses.Psalms|132|10: For Thy servant David's sake do not turn away the face of Thy anointed.
verses.Psalms|132|11: The Lord has sworn in truth to David; he will not turn from it; One of the sons of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
verses.Psalms|132|12: If thy children will keep my covenant and my Testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
verses.Psalms|132|13: For the Lord has chosen Zion: he has desired it for his habitation.
verses.Psalms|132|14: This is my resting place forever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
verses.Psalms|132|15: I will abundantly bless her provisions: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.Psalms|132|16: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her pious ones shall shout aloud for joy.
verses.Psalms|132|17: There will I make the horn of David to shoot up: I have set up a lamp for my anointed.
verses.Psalms|132|18: His enemies I will clothe with shame: but upon himself his crown will flourish.
verses.Psalms|133|1: A Song of Degrees of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to dwell together in unity!
verses.Psalms|133|2: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, running down upon the beard, the beard of Aaron: running down over the hem of his garments:
verses.Psalms|133|3: like the dew of Hermon descending upon the mountains of Zion: for there the Lord has commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
verses.Psalms|134|1: A Song of Degrees. Behold, bless the Lord, all you servants of the Lord, who stand by night in the house of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|134|2: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the Lord.
verses.Psalms|134|3: May the Lord who made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
verses.Psalms|135|1: Hallelujah! Praise the name of the Lord; praise him, O servants of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|135|2: You who stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God,
verses.Psalms|135|3: Hallelujah! for the Lord is good: sing praises to his name; for it is pleasant.
verses.Psalms|135|4: For the Lord has chosen Jacob to himself, Israel for his peculiar possession.
verses.Psalms|135|5: For I know that the Lord is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.Psalms|135|6: Whatever the Lord wishes, he has done in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
verses.Psalms|135|7: He causes vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he makes lightnings for the rain; he brings the wind out of the treasuries.
verses.Psalms|135|8: It was he who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast;
verses.Psalms|135|9: who sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants;
verses.Psalms|135|10: who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
verses.Psalms|135|11: Sihon king of the Amorite, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan;
verses.Psalms|135|12: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel his people.
verses.Psalms|135|13: Thy name, O Lord, endures forever; and Thy renown, O Lord, throughout all generations.
verses.Psalms|135|14: For the Lord will judge the cause of his people, and he will relent concerning his servants.
verses.Psalms|135|15: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
verses.Psalms|135|16: They have mouths, but they cannot speak; eyes have they, but they cannot see;
verses.Psalms|135|17: they have ears, but they cannot hear; nor is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.Psalms|135|18: May they who make them become like them; and everyone who trusts in them.
verses.Psalms|135|19: Bless the Lord, O house of Israel: bless the Lord, O house of Aaron:
verses.Psalms|135|20: Bless the Lord, O house of Levi: you who fear the Lord, bless the Lord.
verses.Psalms|135|21: Blessed be the Lord out of Zion, he who dwells at Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
verses.Psalms|136|1: O Give thanks to the Lord; for he is good: for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|136|2: O give thanks to the God of gods: for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|136|3: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|136|4: To him who alone does great wonders: for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|136|5: To him who by understanding made the heavens: for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|136|6: To him who stretched out the earth above the waters: for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|136|7: To him who made great lights: for his steadfast love endures forever:
verses.Psalms|136|8: the sun to rule by day: for his steadfast love endures forever:
verses.Psalms|136|9: the moon and stars to rule by night: for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|136|10: To him who smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his steadfast love endures forever:
verses.Psalms|136|11: and brought out Israel from among them: for his steadfast love endures forever:
verses.Psalms|136|12: with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|136|13: To him who divided the Red Sea asunder: for his steadfast love endures forever:
verses.Psalms|136|14: and made Israel pass through the midst of it: for his steadfast love endures forever:
verses.Psalms|136|15: but overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red Sea: for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|136|16: To him who led his people through the wilderness: for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|136|17: To him who smote great kings: for his steadfast love endures forever:
verses.Psalms|136|18: and slew mighty kings: for his steadfast love endures forever:
verses.Psalms|136|19: Sihon king of the Amorite: for his steadfast love endures forever:
verses.Psalms|136|20: and Og the king of Bashan: for his steadfast love endures forever:
verses.Psalms|136|21: and gave their land for a heritage: for his steadfast love endures forever:
verses.Psalms|136|22: a heritage to Israel his servant: for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|136|23: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his steadfast love endures forever:
verses.Psalms|136|24: and has delivered us from our enemies: for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|136|25: Who gives bread to all flesh: for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|136|26: O give thanks to the God of heaven: for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.Psalms|137|1: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
verses.Psalms|137|2: We hung our lyres upon the willows in its midst.
verses.Psalms|137|3: For there they who carried us away captive asked us for a song; and they who spoiled us asked us for mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
verses.Psalms|137|4: How shall we sing the Lord's song in a foreign land?
verses.Psalms|137|5: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
verses.Psalms|137|6: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I do not set Jerusalem above my highest joy.
verses.Psalms|137|7: Remember, O Lord, against the children of Edom the day of Jerusalem, when they said, Rase it, rase it, to its very foundations.
verses.Psalms|137|8: O daughter of Babylon, marked for devastation; happy is he who shall repay thee thy recompense for what thou hast done to us.
verses.Psalms|137|9: Happy is he who shall seize and dash thy little ones against the rock.
verses.Psalms|138|1: Of David. I will praise Thee with my whole heart: before princes I will sing praise to Thee.
verses.Psalms|138|2: I will bow down towards Thy holy temple, and praise Thy name for Thy steadfast love, and for Thy truth: for Thou hast magnified Thy word above all Thy name.
verses.Psalms|138|3: In the day when I cried Thou didst answer me, and didst strengthen me with strength in my soul.
verses.Psalms|138|4: All the kings of the earth shall give Thee thanks, O Lord, when they hear the words of Thy mouth.
verses.Psalms|138|5: Yea, they shall sing of the ways of the Lord: for great is the glory of the Lord.
verses.Psalms|138|6: Though the Lord be high, yet he takes note of the lowly: but the haughty he knows from afar.
verses.Psalms|138|7: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, Thou wilt revive me: Thou shalt stretch out Thy hand against the wrath of my enemies, and Thy right hand shall save me.
verses.Psalms|138|8: May the Lord accomplish his purpose concerning me: Thy steadfast love, O Lord, endures forever: do not forsake the works of Thy own hands.
verses.Psalms|139|1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. O Lord, Thou hast searched me, and known me.
verses.Psalms|139|2: Thou knowst my sitting down and my rising up, Thou understandest my thought afar off.
verses.Psalms|139|3: Thou hast measured my going and my lying down, and Thou art acquainted with all my ways.
verses.Psalms|139|4: For no word is yet on my tongue, and lo, O Lord, Thou knowst it all.
verses.Psalms|139|5: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid Thy hand upon me.
verses.Psalms|139|6: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
verses.Psalms|139|7: Where shall I go from Thy spirit? or where shall I flee from Thy presence?
verses.Psalms|139|8: If I ascend up into heaven, Thou art there: if I make my bed in Sheol, behold, Thou art there.
verses.Psalms|139|9: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
verses.Psalms|139|10: even there shall Thy hand lead me, and Thy right hand shall hold me.
verses.Psalms|139|11: If I say, Surely only darkness shall cover me; and the light be night about me,
verses.Psalms|139|12: even the darkness is not dark for Thee, but the night shines like the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to Thee.
verses.Psalms|139|13: For Thou hast formed my reins: Thou hast knit me together in my mother's womb.
verses.Psalms|139|14: I will praise Thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are Thy works; and my soul knows that right well.
verses.Psalms|139|15: My frame was not hidden from Thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
verses.Psalms|139|16: Thy eyes did see my unshaped flesh; for in Thy book all things are written: the days also in which they are to be fashioned, and for it too there was one of them.
verses.Psalms|139|17: How precious also are Thy thoughts to me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
verses.Psalms|139|18: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I awake, I am still with Thee.
verses.Psalms|139|19: Surely Thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, you bloody men,
verses.Psalms|139|20: who speak against Thee wickedly, and Thy enemies, who take Thy name in vain.
verses.Psalms|139|21: Do I not hate, O Lord, those who hate Thee? and do I not strive with those who rise up against Thee?
verses.Psalms|139|22: I hate them with the utmost hatred: I count them my enemies.
verses.Psalms|139|23: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
verses.Psalms|139|24: and see if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
verses.Psalms|140|1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.Psalms|140|2: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
verses.Psalms|140|3: who devise mischiefs in their heart; continually they stir up wars.
verses.Psalms|140|4: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; a spider's venom is under their lips. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|140|5: Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man: who have purposed to trip up my feet.
verses.Psalms|140|6: The proud have hidden a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set traps for me. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|140|7: I said to the Lord, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O Lord.
verses.Psalms|140|8: O God the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Thou hast screened my head in the day of battle;
verses.Psalms|140|9: grant not, O Lord, the desires of the wicked man: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|140|10: As for the head of those who compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.Psalms|140|11: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, so that they do not rise up again.
verses.Psalms|140|12: Let not a slanderer be established in the earth: let evil hunt the violent man to his overthrow.
verses.Psalms|140|13: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
verses.Psalms|140|14: Surely the righteous shall give thanks to Thy name: the upright shall dwell in Thy presence.
verses.Psalms|141|1: A Psalm of David. Lord, I cry to Thee: make haste to me; give ear to my voice, when I cry to Thee.
verses.Psalms|141|2: Let my prayer be set forth before Thee like incense; and the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
verses.Psalms|141|3: Set a guard, O Lord, to my mouth; keep watch over the door of my lips.
verses.Psalms|141|4: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked deeds with men who work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
verses.Psalms|141|5: Let the righteous strike me in kindness: and let him rebuke me; it shall be as oil for my head: let not my head refuse it: but still shall my prayer be against their evil plight.
verses.Psalms|141|6: When their judges are thrown down upon the rocks, then they will hear how sweet were my words.
verses.Psalms|141|7: As when one cuts and breaks up wood on the earth, so are our bones strewn at the mouth of Sheol.
verses.Psalms|141|8: But my eyes are towards Thee, O God the Lord: in Thee I seek refuge; do not pour away my life.
verses.Psalms|141|9: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, and the traps of the workers of iniquity.
verses.Psalms|141|10: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets, whilst I escape.
verses.Psalms|142|1: A Maschil of David; A Prayer when he was in the cave.
verses.Psalms|142|2: I cry to the Lord with my voice; with my voice I make my supplication to the Lord.
verses.Psalms|142|3: I pour out my complaint before him; I declare my trouble before him.
verses.Psalms|142|4: When my spirit faints within me, then Thou knowst my path. In the way wherein I walk they have hidden a snare for me.
verses.Psalms|142|5: I look on my right hand, and behold, but there is no man that knows me: I have nowhere to flee; no man cares for my soul.
verses.Psalms|142|6: I cried to Thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
verses.Psalms|142|7: Attend to my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
verses.Psalms|142|8: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to Thy name: the righteous shall crown themselves in me; for Thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
verses.Psalms|143|1: A Psalm of David. Hear my prayer, O Lord, give ear to my supplications: in Thy faithfulness answer me, in thy righteousness.
verses.Psalms|143|2: And enter not into judgment with Thy servant: for in Thy sight shall no man living be justified.
verses.Psalms|143|3: For the enemy has persecuted my soul; he has trodden my life down to the ground; he has made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
verses.Psalms|143|4: Therefore my spirit faints within me; my heart within me is appalled.
verses.Psalms|143|5: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Thy works; I muse on the work of Thy hands.
verses.Psalms|143|6: I stretch forth my hands to Thee: my soul thirsts after Thee, like a thirsty land. (Selah.)
verses.Psalms|143|7: Answer me speedily, O Lord: my spirit fails: do not hide Thy face from me, lest I be like those who go down into the pit.
verses.Psalms|143|8: Cause me to hear Thy words of steadfast love in the morning; for in Thee do I trust: cause me to know the way in which I should walk; for I lift up my soul to Thee.
verses.Psalms|143|9: Deliver me, O Lord, from my enemies: I flee to Thee to hide me.
verses.Psalms|143|10: Teach me to do Thy will; for Thou art my God: let Thy good spirit lead me into a level land.
verses.Psalms|143|11: Revive me, O Lord, for Thy name's sake: for Thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.Psalms|143|12: And in Thy mercy cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul: for I am Thy servant.
verses.Psalms|144|1: Of David. Blessed be the Lord my rock, who teaches my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
verses.Psalms|144|2: my gracious one, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdues my people under me.
verses.Psalms|144|3: Lord, what is man, that Thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that Thou makest account of him!
verses.Psalms|144|4: Man is like a breath: his days are like a shadow that passes away.
verses.Psalms|144|5: Bow Thy heavens, O Lord, and come down: touch the mountains, that they may smoke.
verses.Psalms|144|6: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out Thy arrows, and destroy them.
verses.Psalms|144|7: Send Thy hand from above; rescue me, and deliver me out of many waters, from the hand of strangers;
verses.Psalms|144|8: whose mouth speaks vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.Psalms|144|9: I will sing a new song to Thee, O God: upon a harp of ten strings I will sing praises to Thee.
verses.Psalms|144|10: It is he who gives salvation to kings: who delivers David his servant from the hurtful sword.
verses.Psalms|144|11: Rescue me, and deliver me from the hand of strangers, whose mouth speaks vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.Psalms|144|12: For our sons are as plants grown up in their youth; our daughters as corner stones, polished after the fashion of a palace:
verses.Psalms|144|13: our garners are full, affording all manner of store: our sheep bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
verses.Psalms|144|14: our oxen are heavy laden: there is no breach or migration: and there is no loud cry in our streets.
verses.Psalms|144|15: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: happy is that people, whose God is the Lord.
verses.Psalms|145|1: A Praise of David. I will extol Thee, my God, O king; and I will bless Thy name for ever and ever.
verses.Psalms|145|2: Every day I will bless Thee; and I will praise Thy name for ever and ever.
verses.Psalms|145|3: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
verses.Psalms|145|4: One generation shall praise Thy works to another, and shall declare Thy mighty acts.
verses.Psalms|145|5: I will speak of the glorious splendour of Thy majesty, and of Thy wondrous works.
verses.Psalms|145|6: And men shall speak of the might of Thy terrible acts: and I will declare Thy greatness.
verses.Psalms|145|7: They shall utter the fame of Thy great goodness, and shall sing of Thy righteousness.
verses.Psalms|145|8: The Lord is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of abundant love.
verses.Psalms|145|9: The Lord is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
verses.Psalms|145|10: All Thy works shall praise Thee, O Lord; and Thy pious ones shall bless Thee.
verses.Psalms|145|11: They shall speak of the glory of Thy kingdom, and talk of Thy power;
verses.Psalms|145|12: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
verses.Psalms|145|13: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Thy dominion endures throughout all generations.
verses.Psalms|145|14: The Lord upholds all that fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
verses.Psalms|145|15: The eyes of all wait upon Thee; and Thou givest them their food in due season.
verses.Psalms|145|16: Thou openest Thy hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
verses.Psalms|145|17: The Lord is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
verses.Psalms|145|18: The Lord is near to all those who call upon him, to all who call upon him in truth.
verses.Psalms|145|19: He will fulfil the desire of those who fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.Psalms|145|20: The Lord preserves all those who love him: but all the wicked he will destroy.
verses.Psalms|145|21: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
verses.Psalms|146|1: Hallelujah! Praise the Lord, O my soul.
verses.Psalms|146|2: While I live I will praise the Lord: I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
verses.Psalms|146|3: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
verses.Psalms|146|4: His breath goes forth, he returns to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
verses.Psalms|146|5: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the Lord his God:
verses.Psalms|146|6: who made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that is in them: who keeps truth forever.
verses.Psalms|146|7: Who executes judgment for the oppressed: who gives bread to the hungry. The Lord looses the prisoners:
verses.Psalms|146|8: the Lord opens the eyes of the blind: the Lord raises those who are bowed down: the Lord loves the righteous:
verses.Psalms|146|9: the Lord preserves the strangers; he relieves the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he makes crooked.
verses.Psalms|146|10: The Lord shall reign forever, thy God, O Zion, to all generations. Hallelujah!
verses.Psalms|147|1: Praise the Lord: for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant; praise is comely.
verses.Psalms|147|2: The Lord builds Jerusalem: he gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.Psalms|147|3: He heals the brokenhearted, and binds up their wounds.
verses.Psalms|147|4: He counts the number of the stars; he calls them all by their names.
verses.Psalms|147|5: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
verses.Psalms|147|6: The Lord upholds the humble: he casts the wicked down to the ground.
verses.Psalms|147|7: Sing to the Lord with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the lyre to our God:
verses.Psalms|147|8: who covers the heaven with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow upon the mountains.
verses.Psalms|147|9: He gives to the beast its food, and to the young ravens which cry.
verses.Psalms|147|10: He delights not in the strength of the horse: he takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.Psalms|147|11: The Lord takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his steadfast love.
verses.Psalms|147|12: Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem; praise Thy God, O Zion.
verses.Psalms|147|13: For he has strengthened the bars of thy gates; he has blessed thy children within thee.
verses.Psalms|147|14: He makes peace in Thy borders, and fills thee with the finest of the wheat.
verses.Psalms|147|15: He sends forth his commandment upon the earth: his word runs very swiftly.
verses.Psalms|147|16: He gives snow like wool: he scatters the hoar frost like ashes.
verses.Psalms|147|17: He casts forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
verses.Psalms|147|18: He sends out his word, and melts them: he causes his wind to blow: they run as water.
verses.Psalms|147|19: He declares his Word to Jacob, his statutes and his judgments to Israel.
verses.Psalms|147|20: He has not dealt so with any other nation: and as for his ordinances they have not known them. Hallelujah!
verses.Psalms|148|1: Hallelujah! Praise the Lord from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
verses.Psalms|148|2: Praise him, all his angels: praise him, all his hosts.
verses.Psalms|148|3: Praise him, sun and moon: praise him, all you stars of light.
verses.Psalms|148|4: Praise him, heavens of heavens, and you waters that are above the heavens.
verses.Psalms|148|5: Let them praise the name of the Lord: for he gave command, and they were created.
verses.Psalms|148|6: And he established them for ever and ever: he has made a decree which shall not pass.
verses.Psalms|148|7: Praise the Lord from the earth, O monsters, and all deeps:
verses.Psalms|148|8: fire, and hail; snow, and vapours; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
verses.Psalms|148|9: mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
verses.Psalms|148|10: beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and winged birds:
verses.Psalms|148|11: kings of the earth, and all peoples; princes, and all judges of the earth:
verses.Psalms|148|12: both young men, and girls; old men, and children:
verses.Psalms|148|13: let them praise the name of the Lord: for his name alone is exalted; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
verses.Psalms|148|14: He also has exalted the horn of his people, a praise for all his pious ones; even for the children of Israel, a people near to him. Hallelujah!
verses.Psalms|149|1: Hallelujah! Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise is sounded in the congregation of the pious.
verses.Psalms|149|2: Let Israel rejoice in him who made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.Psalms|149|3: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises to him with the timbrel and lyre.
verses.Psalms|149|4: For the Lord takes pleasure in his people: he will beautify the humble with salvation.
verses.Psalms|149|5: Let the pious be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
verses.Psalms|149|6: The high praises of God are in their mouth, and a two edged sword in their hand;
verses.Psalms|149|7: to execute vengeance upon the nations, chastisements upon the peoples;
verses.Psalms|149|8: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.Psalms|149|9: to execute upon them the judgment written: it is an honour to all his pious ones. Hallelujah!
verses.Psalms|150|1: Hallelujah! Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.Psalms|150|2: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his exceeding greatness.
verses.Psalms|150|3: Praise him with the sound of the shofar: praise him with the harp and lyre.
verses.Psalms|150|4: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and the pipe.
verses.Psalms|150|5: Praise him upon sounding cymbals: praise him upon loud clashing cymbals.
verses.Psalms|150|6: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord. Hallelujah!
verses.Proverbs|1|1: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
verses.Proverbs|1|2: to know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
verses.Proverbs|1|3: to receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
verses.Proverbs|1|4: to give prudence to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
verses.Proverbs|1|5: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain to wise counsels:
verses.Proverbs|1|6: to understand a proverb, and a figure; the words of the wise, and their riddles.
verses.Proverbs|1|7: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.Proverbs|1|8: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and do not forsake the law of thy mother:
verses.Proverbs|1|9: for they shall be a graceful garland for thy head, and chains about thy neck.
verses.Proverbs|1|10: My son, if sinners entice thee, do not consent.
verses.Proverbs|1|11: If they say, Come with us, let us lie in wait for blood, let us lurk for the innocent without cause:
verses.Proverbs|1|12: let us swallow them up alive like Sheol; and whole, like those who go down into the pit:
verses.Proverbs|1|13: we shall find all precious goods; we shall fill our houses with spoil:
verses.Proverbs|1|14: throw in thy lot among us; we shall all have one purse:
verses.Proverbs|1|15: my son, do not walk in the way with them; restrain thy foot from their path:
verses.Proverbs|1|16: for their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed blood.
verses.Proverbs|1|17: For no heed is taken of the net which is spread in the sight of any bird.
verses.Proverbs|1|18: And they lie in wait for their blood; they lurk for their lives.
verses.Proverbs|1|19: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy of gain; it takes away the life of its owner.
verses.Proverbs|1|20: Wisdom cries aloud in the street; she utters her voice in the squares:
verses.Proverbs|1|21: she cries in the chief place of concourse, at the entrances of the gates: in the city she utters her words, saying,
verses.Proverbs|1|22: How long, you simple ones, will you love being simple? and how long, O scorners, will you delight in scoffing, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.Proverbs|1|23: turn at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit to you, I will make known to you my words.
verses.Proverbs|1|24: Because I have called, and you refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
verses.Proverbs|1|25: but you have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
verses.Proverbs|1|26: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear comes upon you;
verses.Proverbs|1|27: when your fear comes like a storm, and your calamity comes like a tempest; when distress and anguish come upon you.
verses.Proverbs|1|28: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they will not find me:
verses.Proverbs|1|29: for they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the Lord:
verses.Proverbs|1|30: they would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
verses.Proverbs|1|31: Therefore they shall eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
verses.Proverbs|1|32: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the erring of fools shall destroy them.
verses.Proverbs|1|33: But he who listens to me shall dwell safely, and shall be at ease without fear of evil.
verses.Proverbs|2|1: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and treasure up my commandments with thee;
verses.Proverbs|2|2: so that thou incline thy ear to wisdom, and apply thy heart to understanding indeed,
verses.Proverbs|2|3: if thou criest after wisdom, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;
verses.Proverbs|2|4: if thou seekest her like silver, and searchest for her as for hidden treasures;
verses.Proverbs|2|5: then shalt thou understand the fear of the Lord, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.Proverbs|2|6: For the Lord gives wisdom: out of his mouth come knowledge and understanding.
verses.Proverbs|2|7: He lays up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a shield to those who walk uprightly,
verses.Proverbs|2|8: to keep the paths of justice; and he preserves the way of his pious ones.
verses.Proverbs|2|9: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and justice and equity, every good path:
verses.Proverbs|2|10: for wisdom shall enter thy heart, and knowledge be pleasant to thy soul;
verses.Proverbs|2|11: discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
verses.Proverbs|2|12: to deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man who speaks perverse things;
verses.Proverbs|2|13: who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.Proverbs|2|14: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of the wicked;
verses.Proverbs|2|15: whose ways are crooked, and who are underhand in their paths:
verses.Proverbs|2|16: to deliver thee from the strange woman, from the alien woman who speaks so smoothly;
verses.Proverbs|2|17: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God.
verses.Proverbs|2|18: For her house inclines to death, and her paths to the dead.
verses.Proverbs|2|19: None that go to her return, nor do they regain the paths of life:
verses.Proverbs|2|20: that thou mayst walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.Proverbs|2|21: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the innocent shall remain in it.
verses.Proverbs|2|22: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the faithless shall be rooted out of it.
verses.Proverbs|3|1: My son, forget not my law; but let thy heart keep my commandments:
verses.Proverbs|3|2: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.
verses.Proverbs|3|3: Let not loyal love and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thy heart:
verses.Proverbs|3|4: so shalt thou find grace and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
verses.Proverbs|3|5: Trust in the Lord with all thy heart; and do not lean upon thy own understanding.
verses.Proverbs|3|6: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verses.Proverbs|3|7: Be not wise in thy own eyes: fear the Lord, and depart from evil.
verses.Proverbs|3|8: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
verses.Proverbs|3|9: Honour the Lord with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thy increase:
verses.Proverbs|3|10: so shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy vats shall burst with new wine.
verses.Proverbs|3|11: My son, do not despise the chastening of the Lord; nor be weary of his correction:
verses.Proverbs|3|12: for the Lord reproves him whom he loves: even as a father the son in whom he delights.
verses.Proverbs|3|13: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, and the man who gets understanding.
verses.Proverbs|3|14: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and its gain than fine gold.
verses.Proverbs|3|15: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared to her.
verses.Proverbs|3|16: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand are riches and honour.
verses.Proverbs|3|17: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
verses.Proverbs|3|18: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold on her: and happy are those who hold her fast.
verses.Proverbs|3|19: The Lord by wisdom founded the earth; by understanding he established the heavens.
verses.Proverbs|3|20: By his knowledge the depths were broken up, and the clouds drop down dew.
verses.Proverbs|3|21: My son, let them not depart from thy eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
verses.Proverbs|3|22: so shall they be life to thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
verses.Proverbs|3|23: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
verses.Proverbs|3|24: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: indeed, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
verses.Proverbs|3|25: Be not afraid of sudden fear, nor of the ruin of the wicked, when it comes.
verses.Proverbs|3|26: For the Lord shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being caught.
verses.Proverbs|3|27: Withhold not good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thy hand to do it.
verses.Proverbs|3|28: Say not to thy neighbour, Go, and come back, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
verses.Proverbs|3|29: Do not devise evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwells securely by thee.
verses.Proverbs|3|30: Do not strive with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
verses.Proverbs|3|31: Do not envy the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
verses.Proverbs|3|32: For the underhand man is abomination to the Lord: and he shares his counsel with the righteous.
verses.Proverbs|3|33: The curse of the Lord is in the house of the wicked: but he blesses the habitation of the just.
verses.Proverbs|3|34: Surely he scorns the scorners: but he gives grace to the humble.
verses.Proverbs|3|35: The wise shall inherit honour: but fools shall get shame.
verses.Proverbs|4|1: Hear, you children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
verses.Proverbs|4|2: For I give you good doctrine, forsake not my law.
verses.Proverbs|4|3: For I was my father's son, tender and the only one in the sight of my mother.
verses.Proverbs|4|4: He taught me also, and said to me, Let thy heart hold fast to my words: keep my commandments, and live.
verses.Proverbs|4|5: Get wisdom, get understanding: do not forget it; nor decline from the words of my mouth.
verses.Proverbs|4|6: Do not forsake her, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
verses.Proverbs|4|7: The beginning of wisdom is, Get wisdom: therefore use all your means to acquire understanding.
verses.Proverbs|4|8: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she will bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
verses.Proverbs|4|9: She shall give to thy head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she bestow on thee.
verses.Proverbs|4|10: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
verses.Proverbs|4|11: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in paths of rectitude.
verses.Proverbs|4|12: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be confined; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
verses.Proverbs|4|13: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.
verses.Proverbs|4|14: Do not enter into the path of the wicked, and do not go in the way of evil men.
verses.Proverbs|4|15: Avoid it, do not pass by it, turn from it, and pass on.
verses.Proverbs|4|16: For they sleep not, unless they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
verses.Proverbs|4|17: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
verses.Proverbs|4|18: But the path of just men is like the gleam of sunlight, that shines ever more brightly until the height of noonday.
verses.Proverbs|4|19: The way of the wicked is like darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
verses.Proverbs|4|20: My son, attend to my words; incline thy ear to my sayings.
verses.Proverbs|4|21: Let them not depart from thy eyes; keep them in the midst of thy heart.
verses.Proverbs|4|22: For they are life to those who find them, and health to all their flesh.
verses.Proverbs|4|23: Keep thy heart with the greatest vigilance; for out of it are the issues of life.
verses.Proverbs|4|24: Put away from thee a dissembling mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.
verses.Proverbs|4|25: Let thy eyes look right on, and let thy eyelids look straight before thee.
verses.Proverbs|4|26: Make even the path of thy foot, and let all thy ways be firm.
verses.Proverbs|4|27: Do not turn to the right hand or to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
verses.Proverbs|5|1: My son, attend to my wisdom, and bend thy ear to my understanding:
verses.Proverbs|5|2: that thou mayst preserve discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.
verses.Proverbs|5|3: For the lips of a strange woman drip honey, and her mouth is smoother than oil:
verses.Proverbs|5|4: but her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two edged sword.
verses.Proverbs|5|5: Her feet go down to death: her steps take hold of Sheol.
verses.Proverbs|5|6: She is far from measuring her way of life; her paths wander, and she is ignorant.
verses.Proverbs|5|7: Hear me now therefore, O children, and do not depart from the words of my mouth.
verses.Proverbs|5|8: Remove thy way far from her, and do not come near the door of her house:
verses.Proverbs|5|9: lest thou give thy vigour to others, and thy years to the cruel one:
verses.Proverbs|5|10: lest strangers be filled with thy strength; and thy labours go to the house of a stranger:
verses.Proverbs|5|11: and thou moan when thy end comes, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
verses.Proverbs|5|12: and thou say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof!
verses.Proverbs|5|13: And I have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor bent my ear to those who instructed me!
verses.Proverbs|5|14: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
verses.Proverbs|5|15: Drink waters out of thy own cistern, and running waters out of thy own well.
verses.Proverbs|5|16: So will thy spring be dispersed abroad, and streams of water will flow in the broad places.
verses.Proverbs|5|17: Let them be only thy own, and not strangers' with thee.
verses.Proverbs|5|18: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
verses.Proverbs|5|19: A loving hind and a pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.
verses.Proverbs|5|20: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of an alien?
verses.Proverbs|5|21: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the Lord, and he ponders all his goings.
verses.Proverbs|5|22: His own iniquities shall trap the wicked man, and he shall be caught fast in the cords of his sins.
verses.Proverbs|5|23: He shall die for want of instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
verses.Proverbs|6|1: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast struck thy palms for a stranger,
verses.Proverbs|6|2: if thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, caught with the sayings of thy mouth:
verses.Proverbs|6|3: do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy neighbour; go, abase thyself, and importune thy neighbour.
verses.Proverbs|6|4: Give no sleep to thy eyes, nor slumber to thy eyelids.
verses.Proverbs|6|5: Deliver thyself like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, and like a bird from the hand of the fowler.
verses.Proverbs|6|6: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
verses.Proverbs|6|7: which having no guide, overseer, or ruler;
verses.Proverbs|6|8: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
verses.Proverbs|6|9: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
verses.Proverbs|6|10: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.Proverbs|6|11: so shall thy poverty come like a marauder, and thy want like an armed man.
verses.Proverbs|6|12: A base person, a wicked man, is one that walks with a crowed mouth,
verses.Proverbs|6|13: that winks with his eyes, that taps with his feet, that points with his fingers;
verses.Proverbs|6|14: perverseness is in his heart; he devises mischief continually; he sows discord.
verses.Proverbs|6|15: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
verses.Proverbs|6|16: There are six things which the Lord hates, and seven which are an abomination to him:
verses.Proverbs|6|17: a proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
verses.Proverbs|6|18: a heart that devises wicked thoughts, feet that are swift in running to mischief,
verses.Proverbs|6|19: a false witness that breathes out lies, and one that sows discord among brethren.
verses.Proverbs|6|20: My son, keep thy father's commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.Proverbs|6|21: bind them continually upon thy heart, and tie them about thy neck.
verses.Proverbs|6|22: When thou walkest, it shall lead thee; when thou liest down, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
verses.Proverbs|6|23: For the commandment is a lamp; and law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
verses.Proverbs|6|24: to keep thee from the evil woman, from the smoothness of the tongue of an alien.
verses.Proverbs|6|25: Lust not after her beauty in thy heart; nor let her take thee with her eyelids.
verses.Proverbs|6|26: For by means of a harlot a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.
verses.Proverbs|6|27: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
verses.Proverbs|6|28: Can one walk upon hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
verses.Proverbs|6|29: So he that goes in to his neighbour's wife; whoever touches her shall not go unpunished.
verses.Proverbs|6|30: Do not men despise a thief, even if he steals to satisfy his soul when he is hungry?
verses.Proverbs|6|31: And if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
verses.Proverbs|6|32: He who commits adultery with a woman lacks understanding: he who does that destroys his soul.
verses.Proverbs|6|33: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
verses.Proverbs|6|34: For jealousy is the rage of a man: and he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.Proverbs|6|35: He will not regard any ransom; nor will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
verses.Proverbs|7|1: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
verses.Proverbs|7|2: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thy eye.
verses.Proverbs|7|3: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the tablet of thy heart.
verses.Proverbs|7|4: Say to wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:
verses.Proverbs|7|5: that they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the alien woman who makes smooth her words.
verses.Proverbs|7|6: For at the window of my house I looked out through my lattice,
verses.Proverbs|7|7: and beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
verses.Proverbs|7|8: passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,
verses.Proverbs|7|9: in the twilight, in the evening, in the blackness of a dark night:
verses.Proverbs|7|10: and, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of a harlot, and wily of heart.
verses.Proverbs|7|11: (She is noisy and ungovernable: her feet do not remain in her house:
verses.Proverbs|7|12: now is she outside, now in the streets, and she lies in wait at every corner.)
verses.Proverbs|7|13: So she caught hold of him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said to him,
verses.Proverbs|7|14: I have had to sacrifice peace offerings; this day have I paid my vows.
verses.Proverbs|7|15: So I came out to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
verses.Proverbs|7|16: I have decked my bed with coverings, with tapestry of Egyptian yarn.
verses.Proverbs|7|17: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.Proverbs|7|18: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us delight ourselves with loves.
verses.Proverbs|7|19: For my husband is not at home, he is gone a long journey:
verses.Proverbs|7|20: he has taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the full moon.
verses.Proverbs|7|21: With her much fair speech she causes him to yield, with the smoothness of her lips she seduces him.
verses.Proverbs|7|22: He goes after her at once, as an ox goes to the slaughter, and as a man in chains to the chastisement of a fool;
verses.Proverbs|7|23: till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hastens to the snare, and knows not that it is for his life.
verses.Proverbs|7|24: Hearken to me now therefore, O you children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
verses.Proverbs|7|25: Let not thy heart decline to her ways, do not go astray in her paths.
verses.Proverbs|7|26: For she has cast down many wounded: and many strong men have been slain by her.
verses.Proverbs|7|27: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the chambers of death.
verses.Proverbs|8|1: Does not wisdom call? and understanding put forth her voice?
verses.Proverbs|8|2: She stands at the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet.
verses.Proverbs|8|3: She cries out at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in of the doors.
