verses.Daniel|5|21: and he was driven from the sons of men; and his heart was made like the beasts, and his dwelling was with the wild asses: he was fed with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven; until he came to know that the most high God rules in the kingdom of men, and that he appoints over it whomever he pleases.
verses.Daniel|5|22: And thou His son, O Belshazzar, hast not humbled thy heart, though thou knewest all this:
verses.Daniel|5|23: but hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee, and thou, and thy lords, thy wives, and thy concubines, have drunk wine in them; and thou hast praised the gods of silver, and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which do not see, hear, or know: and the God in whose hand thy breath is, and whose are all thy ways, thou hast not glorified:
verses.Daniel|5|24: then was the part of the hand sent from him; and this writing was written.
verses.Daniel|5|25: And this is the writing that was written, MENE MENE TEKEL UPHARSIN.
verses.Daniel|5|26: This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE; God has numbered thy kingdom, and brought it to an end.
verses.Daniel|5|27: TEKEL; Thou are weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.
verses.Daniel|5|28: Persia; Thy kingdom is divided, and given to Medes and PERES.
verses.Daniel|5|29: Then commanded Belshazzar, and they clothed Daniel in scarlet, and put a chain of gold about his neck, and made a proclamation concerning him, that he should rule as the third in the kingdom.
verses.Daniel|5|30: In that night Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans was slain.
verses.Daniel|6|1: And Darius the Mede received the kingdom, being about sixty two years old.
verses.Daniel|6|2: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom a hundred and twenty satraps, who should be over the whole kingdom;
verses.Daniel|6|3: and over these were three presidents; of whom Daniel was one: that these satraps might give account to them, so that the king should have no loss.
verses.Daniel|6|4: Then this Daniel became distinguished above the presidents and satraps, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.
verses.Daniel|6|5: Then the presidents and satraps sought to find a pretext against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find no pretext or fault; seeing that he was faithful, nor was any error or fault to be found in him.
verses.Daniel|6|6: Then said these men, We shall not find any pretext against this Daniel, unless we find it against him in connection with the law of his God.
verses.Daniel|6|7: Then these presidents and satraps came hurriedly to the king, and said thus to him, king Darius, live for ever.
verses.Daniel|6|8: All the presidents of the kingdom, the prefects, and the satraps, the counsellors, and the governors, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a firm decree, that whoever makes petition of any God or man for thirty days, save of thee, O king, he shall be cast into the lion's den.
verses.Daniel|6|9: Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing, that it be not changed, according to the law of Medes and Persia, which is unalterable.
verses.Daniel|6|10: Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree.
verses.Daniel|6|11: Now when Daniel came to know that the writing was signed, he went into his house; (now he had windows open in his chamber towards Jerusalem, and he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.)
verses.Daniel|6|12: Then these men came hurriedly, and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God.
verses.Daniel|6|13: Then they came near, and spoke before the king concerning the king's decree; Hast thou not signed a decree, that every man that shall make petition of any God or man within thirty days, save of thee, O king, shall be cast into the lions' den? The king answered and said, The thing is true, according to the law of Medes and Persia, which is unalterable.
verses.Daniel|6|14: Then they answered and said before the king, That Daniel who is of the children of the exiles of Judah, does not regard thee, O king, or the decree that thou hast signed, but makes his petition three times a day.
verses.Daniel|6|15: Then the king, when he heard these words, was much distressed, and set his heart on Daniel to rescue him: and he laboured till the going down of the sun to rescue him.
verses.Daniel|6|16: Then these men came hurriedly to the king, and said to the king, Know, O king, that it is the law of Medes and Persia that no decree or statute which the king establishes may be changed.
verses.Daniel|6|17: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the lions' den. Now the king spoke and said to Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will rescue thee.
verses.Daniel|6|18: And a stone was brought, and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that nothing might be changed concerning Daniel.
verses.Daniel|6|19: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting: nor were entertainments brought before him: and his sleep fled from him.
verses.Daniel|6|20: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste to the lions' den.
verses.Daniel|6|21: And when he came to the den, he cried out in a tone of anguish to Daniel: and the king spoke and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living God, is thy God, whom thou servest continually, able to rescue thee from the lions?
verses.Daniel|6|22: Then Daniel said to the king, O king, live for ever.
verses.Daniel|6|23: My God has sent his angel, and has shut the lions' mouths, that they have not hurt me: seeing that I was found innocent before him; and also before thee, O king, have I done no wrong.
verses.Daniel|6|24: Then the king was exceedingly glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he had trusted in his God.
verses.Daniel|6|25: And the king commanded, and they brought those men who had accused Daniel, and they cast them into the lions' den, them, their children, and their wives; and the lions had the mastery of them, and broke all their bones in pieces before they reached the bottom of the den.
verses.Daniel|6|26: Then king Darius wrote to all the peoples, nations, and tongues, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied to you.
verses.Daniel|6|27: I make a decree, That in every dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel: for he is the living God, and steadfast forever, and his kingdom is one which shall not be destroyed, and his dominion shall be even to the end.
verses.Daniel|6|28: He delivers and rescues, and he works signs and wonders in heaven and in earth, who has delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.
verses.Daniel|6|29: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.
verses.Daniel|7|1: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream and visions of his head as he lay upon his bed: then he wrote the dream, and told the sum of the matter.
verses.Daniel|7|2: Daniel spoke and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the heaven stirred up the great sea.
verses.Daniel|7|3: And four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse from one another.
verses.Daniel|7|4: The first was like a lion, and had eagle's wings: I beheld till its wings were plucked off, and it was lifted up from the earth, and made to stand upon two feet like a man, and a man's heart was given to it.
verses.Daniel|7|5: And behold, another beast, a second one, like a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and it had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth: and thus it was said to it, Arise, devour much flesh.
verses.Daniel|7|6: After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a bird; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.
verses.Daniel|7|7: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet: and it was different from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.
verses.Daniel|7|8: I considered the horns, and behold, there came up among them another little horn, before which three of the first horns were plucked up by the roots: and, behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of man, and a mouth speaking great things.
verses.Daniel|7|9: As I looked, thrones were placed, and an ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of whose head was like the pure wool: his throne was fiery flames, its wheels being burning fire.
verses.Daniel|7|10: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: a thousand thousands served him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: they sat in judgment, and the books were opened.
verses.Daniel|7|11: I looked then because of the sound of the great words which the horn spoke: and as I looked the beast was slain, and its body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.
verses.Daniel|7|12: And as for the rest of the beasts, their dominion was taken away: yet their lives were prolonged for a season and a time.
verses.Daniel|7|13: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like a son of man came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.
verses.Daniel|7|14: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all the peoples, nations, and tongues, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom one that shall not be destroyed.
verses.Daniel|7|15: As for me Daniel, my spirit was grieved in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head affrighted me.
verses.Daniel|7|16: I came near to one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth of all this. So he told me, and made known to me the meaning of the things.
verses.Daniel|7|17: These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, who shall arise out of the earth.
verses.Daniel|7|18: But the holy ones of the Most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.
verses.Daniel|7|19: Then I wished to know the truth of the fourth beast, which was different from all the others, exceedingly dreadful, the teeth of which were of iron, and its nails of brass; which devoured, broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with his feet;
verses.Daniel|7|20: and of the ten horns that were on its head, and of the other horn which came up, and before which three fell; that horn which had eyes, and a mouth that spoke very great things, and which appeared greater than its fellows.
verses.Daniel|7|21: I beheld, and the same horn made war with the holy ones, and prevailed against them;
verses.Daniel|7|22: until the ancient of days came, and judgment was given for the holy ones of the Most High; and the time came that the holy ones possessed the kingdom.
verses.Daniel|7|23: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be a fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be different from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.
verses.Daniel|7|24: And the ten horns are ten kings that shall arise out of this kingdom: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be different from the former ones, and he shall subdue three kings.
verses.Daniel|7|25: And he shall speak great words against the Most High, and shall wear out the holy ones of the Most High, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand for a season and seasons and half a season.
verses.Daniel|7|26: But they shall sit in judgment, and his dominion shall be taken away, to be consumed and destroyed to the end.
verses.Daniel|7|27: And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdoms under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the holy ones of the Most High, whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.
verses.Daniel|7|28: Here is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much affrighted me, and my colour changed: but I kept the matter in my heart.
verses.Daniel|8|1: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared to me, even to me Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first.
verses.Daniel|8|2: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I was at Shushan the capital, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.
verses.Daniel|8|3: Then I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns: and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.
verses.Daniel|8|4: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, was not there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and magnified himself.
verses.Daniel|8|5: And as I was considering, behold, a he goat came from the west across the face of the whole earth, and did not touch the ground: and the goat had a conspicuous horn between its eyes.
verses.Daniel|8|6: And it came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran at him in the fury of his power.
verses.Daniel|8|7: And I saw it come close to the ram, and it was enraged against him, and smote the ram, and broke his two horns: and the ram had no power to stand before it, but he cast him down to the ground, and trampled upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.
verses.Daniel|8|8: Therefore the he goat grew very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and instead of it came up four conspicuous ones towards the four winds of heaven.
verses.Daniel|8|9: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which grew exceedingly great, towards the south, and towards the east, and towards the land of beauty.
verses.Daniel|8|10: And it grew great, even to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and trampled upon them.
verses.Daniel|8|11: Yes, it magnified itself even to the prince of the host, and from him the daily sacrifice was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.
verses.Daniel|8|12: And for an appointed time it was flagrantly set against the daily sacrifice, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.
verses.Daniel|8|13: Then I heard one holy one speaking, and another holy one said to that certain one who spoke, How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?
verses.Daniel|8|14: And he said to me, For two thousand and three hundred evenings and mornings; then shall the sanctuary be restored.
verses.Daniel|8|15: And it came to pass, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me what looked like a man.
verses.Daniel|8|16: And I heard a man's voice between the banks of Ulai, who called, and said, Gabriel, make this man understand the vision.
verses.Daniel|8|17: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said to me, Understand, O son of man: for the vision is for the time of the end.
verses.Daniel|8|18: Now as he was speaking with me, I fell into a deep sleep on my face towards the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.
verses.Daniel|8|19: And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the latter end of the indignation: for it is for the appointed time of the end.
verses.Daniel|8|20: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Medes and Persia.
verses.Daniel|8|21: And the rough he goat is the king of Javan: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
verses.Daniel|8|22: As for the horn which was broken, in place of which four others arose, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not with his power.
verses.Daniel|8|23: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and one who understands riddles, shall arise.
verses.Daniel|8|24: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy remarkably, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.
verses.Daniel|8|25: And through his cunning also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand, and shall magnify himself in his heart, and without difficulty he shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.
verses.Daniel|8|26: And the vision of the evenings and the mornings which was told is true: but seal up the vision; for it refers to many days hence.
verses.Daniel|8|27: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick certain days; afterwards I rose up, and did the king's business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood it.
verses.Daniel|9|1: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of Medes, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;
verses.Daniel|9|2: in the first year of his reign I Daniel considered in the books the number of the years, whereof the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.
verses.Daniel|9|3: And I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:
verses.Daniel|9|4: and I prayed to the Lord my God, and made my confession, and said, O Lord, the great and dreadful God, keeping covenant and troth to those who love him, and to those who keep his commandments;
verses.Daniel|9|5: we have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, and have turned aside from Thy precepts and from Thy judgments:
verses.Daniel|9|6: for we have not hearkened to Thy servants the prophets, who spoke in Thy name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.
verses.Daniel|9|7: O Lord, righteousness belongs to Thee, but to us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to all Israel, who are near, and who are far off, through all the countries whither Thou hast driven them, because of their trespass which they have trespassed against Thee.
verses.Daniel|9|8: O Lord, to us belongs confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against Thee.
verses.Daniel|9|9: To the Lord our God belongs mercies and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against him;
verses.Daniel|9|10: for we have not obeyed the voice of the Lord our God, to follow his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.
verses.Daniel|9|11: Yea, all Israel have transgressed Thy law, and have turned aside, so as not to obey Thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.
verses.Daniel|9|12: And he has confirmed his word, which he spoke against us, and against our judges who judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven there has not been done the like of what has been done against Jerusalem,
verses.Daniel|9|13: as it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet we did not offer our prayer before the Lord our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand Thy truth.
verses.Daniel|9|14: Therefore the Lord has watched over the evil, and brought it upon us: for the Lord our God is righteous in all his works which he has done: for we did not obey his voice.
verses.Daniel|9|15: And now, O Lord our God, who hast brought Thy people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and hast gotten Thee renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.
verses.Daniel|9|16: O Lord, according to all Thy righteousness, I pray Thee, let Thy anger and Thy fury be turned away from Thy city of Jerusalem Thy holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and Thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us.
verses.Daniel|9|17: Now therefore, O our God, hear the prayer of Thy servant, and his supplications, and cause Thy face to shine upon Thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord's sake.
verses.Daniel|9|18: O my God, incline Thy ear, and hear; open Thy eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by Thy name: for we do not present our supplications before Thee because of our righteousnesses, but because of Thy great mercies.
verses.Daniel|9|19: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, hearken and act; delay not, for Thy own sake, O my God: for Thy city and Thy people are called by Thy name.
verses.Daniel|9|20: And whilst I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the Lord my God for the holy mountain of my God;
verses.Daniel|9|21: whilst I was still speaking in prayer, the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, approached close to me in swift flight about the time of the evening sacrifice.
verses.Daniel|9|22: And he made me understand, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding.
verses.Daniel|9|23: At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment went out, and I am come to declare it; for thou art greatly beloved: therefore look into the word, and consider the vision.
verses.Daniel|9|24: Seventy weeks are decreed concerning thy people and concerning thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end to sins, and to atone for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up vision and prophet, and to anoint the most holy place.
verses.Daniel|9|25: Know therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem until an anointed prince, shall be seven weeks: then for sixty two weeks it shall be built again, with squares and moat, but in a troubled time.
verses.Daniel|9|26: And after sixty two weeks shall an anointed one be cut off, and none will be left to him: and the people of a prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and his end shall be with a flood, and to the end of the war desolations are decreed.
verses.Daniel|9|27: And he shall make a strong covenant with many for one week: and during half of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the offering to cease; and upon the wing of abominations shall come one who makes desolate, until the decreed destruction is poured out on the desolator.
verses.Daniel|10|1: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the word was true, and for a long period ahead; and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.
verses.Daniel|10|2: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.
verses.Daniel|10|3: I ate no pleasant bread, nor did meat or wine come into my mouth, nor did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.
verses.Daniel|10|4: And on the twenty fourth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel;
verses.Daniel|10|5: I lifted up my eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz:
verses.Daniel|10|6: his body also was like the beryl, and his face like the appearance of lightning, and his eyes like torches of fire, and his arms and his feet in colour like burnished brass, and the sound of his words like the voice of a multitude.
verses.Daniel|10|7: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men who were with me did not see the vision; but a great trembling fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.
verses.Daniel|10|8: So I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comely appearance was horribly changed, and I retained no strength.
verses.Daniel|10|9: Yet I heard the sound of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, I was in a deep sleep on my face, and my face towards the ground.
verses.Daniel|10|10: And, behold, a hand touched me, which set me trembling on my knees and on the palms of my hands.
verses.Daniel|10|11: And he said to me, O Daniel, thou man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak to thee, and stand upright: for to thee am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word to me, I stood trembling.
verses.Daniel|10|12: Then said he to me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that thou didst set thy heart to understand and to humble thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, and I am come because of thy words.
verses.Daniel|10|13: But the guardian angel of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty one days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief angels, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.
verses.Daniel|10|14: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days: for the vision is for days yet to come.
verses.Daniel|10|15: And when he had spoken such words to me, I set my face towards the ground, and I became dumb.
verses.Daniel|10|16: And, behold, one in the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spoke, and said to him that stood before me, O my lord, by reason of the vision my pains have come upon me, and I retain no strength.
verses.Daniel|10|17: For how can the servant of my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, there remains now no strength in me, nor is there breath left in me.
verses.Daniel|10|18: Then again came one in the likeness of a man, and touched me and strengthened me,
verses.Daniel|10|19: and said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, and be resolute. And when he had spoken to me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.
verses.Daniel|10|20: Then he said to me, Dost thou know why I have come to thee? But now I will return to fight with the guardian angel of Persia: and when I depart from him, lo, the guardian angel of Javan shall come.
verses.Daniel|10|21: But I will tell thee that which is inscribed in the true record: and none stands fast with me against these, except your guardian angel, Michael.
verses.Daniel|11|1: As for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood up to confirm and to strengthen him.
verses.Daniel|11|2: And now will I tell thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia: and the fourth shall be far richer than all of them: and when he has grown strong through his riches, he shall stir up all against the kingdom of Javan.
verses.Daniel|11|3: And a mighty king shall stand up, who shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
verses.Daniel|11|4: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided towards the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion with which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, and go to others besides those.
verses.Daniel|11|5: And the king of the south shall be strong, but one of his princes shall be stronger than he, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.
verses.Daniel|11|6: And at the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king's daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of her arm; nor shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they who brought her, and he who begot her, and he who strengthened her in those times.
verses.Daniel|11|7: But from a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his place: he shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:
verses.Daniel|11|8: and he shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes, and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall abstain for some years from attacking the king of the north.
verses.Daniel|11|9: But he shall come into the kingdom of the king of the south, and shall return to his own land.
verses.Daniel|11|10: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, even to his fortress.
verses.Daniel|11|11: And the king of the south shall be moved with anger, and shall come out and fight with him, with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.
verses.Daniel|11|12: And when he has taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down tens of thousands: but he shall not prevail.
verses.Daniel|11|13: For the king of the north shall again set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with abundant supplies.
verses.Daniel|11|14: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the renegades of thy people shall exalt themselves to fulfil the vision; but they shall stumble.
verses.Daniel|11|15: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mound, and seize a well fortified city and the arms of the south shall not withstand, nor his chosen people, for they shall have no strength to withstand.
verses.Daniel|11|16: But he who comes against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the land of beauty, and in his hand shall be destruction.
verses.Daniel|11|17: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, but he shall make peace with him: and he shall give him the daughter of women, to destroy it: but she shall not stand or remain his.
verses.Daniel|11|18: After this he shall turn his face to the isles, and shall take many: but a commander shall put an end to his insult; indeed, he shall cause his insult to return upon him.
verses.Daniel|11|19: Then he shall turn his face towards the strongholds of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.
verses.Daniel|11|20: Then there shall stand up in his place one who shall send an exactor of taxes throughout glory of the kingdom, but within a few days he shall be destroyed, but not in anger, or in battle.
verses.Daniel|11|21: And in his place shall stand up a vile person, to whom the honour of the kingdom has not been given: but he shall come in without difficulty, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
verses.Daniel|11|22: And the force of the flood shall be swept away before him, and shall be broken; even the prince of the covenant.
verses.Daniel|11|23: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.
verses.Daniel|11|24: He shall enter without difficulty even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, or his fathers' fathers; he shall scatter among them prey, and spoil, and riches: and he shall devise schemes against the strongholds, but only for a time.
verses.Daniel|11|25: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall devise schemes against him.
verses.Daniel|11|26: For those who eat his food shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.
verses.Daniel|11|27: And both these kings' hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for the end is yet to come at the time appointed.
verses.Daniel|11|28: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart shall be set against the holy covenant; and he shall work his will, and return to his own land.
verses.Daniel|11|29: At the time appointed he shall return, and come towards the south; but it shall not be at the latter time as it was at the former.
verses.Daniel|11|30: For ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall lose heart and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant, and do his will; he shall even return, and have an understanding with those who forsake the holy covenant.
verses.Daniel|11|31: And arms shall stand up on his part, and they shall profane sanctuary and fortress, and shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall set up the abomination that makes desolate.
verses.Daniel|11|32: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he seduce by flatteries: but the people who know their God shall be strong, and prevail.
verses.Daniel|11|33: And they who understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, some days.
verses.Daniel|11|34: Now when they shall fall, they shall receive a little help: but many shall join themselves to them with flatteries.
verses.Daniel|11|35: And some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to refine, and to make them white, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for the time appointed.
verses.Daniel|11|36: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak astonishing things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that which is determined shall be done.
verses.Daniel|11|37: Nor shall he regard the gods of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.
verses.Daniel|11|38: But in his place he shall honour the god of strongholds, and a god whom his fathers did not know shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and costly things.
verses.Daniel|11|39: And he shall deal with the strongest fortresses with the help of a foreign god; those whom he acknowledges, he will magnify with honour: and he shall make them rulers over many, and shall divide the land for a price.
verses.Daniel|11|40: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a storm, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.
verses.Daniel|11|41: He shall enter also into the land of beauty, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand – Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
verses.Daniel|11|42: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.
verses.Daniel|11|43: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall follow in his train.
verses.Daniel|11|44: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall affright him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to do away with many.
verses.Daniel|11|45: And he shall plant the tents of his palace between the seas and the holy mountain of beauty; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.
verses.Daniel|12|1: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great chief angel, who stands for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation till that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one who shall be found written in the book.
verses.Daniel|12|2: And many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
verses.Daniel|12|3: And they who are wise shall shine like the brightness of the firmament; and they who turn many to righteousness like the stars for ever and ever.
verses.Daniel|12|4: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, until the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.
verses.Daniel|12|5: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood two others, the one on this side of the bank of the River, and the other on that side of the bank of the River.
verses.Daniel|12|6: And one said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the River, How long shall it be to the end of the wonders?
verses.Daniel|12|7: And I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the River, when he lifted up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, and swore by the One who lives for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and a half; and when the crushing of the power of the holy people shall have been completed, all these things shall be finished.
verses.Daniel|12|8: And I heard, but I did not understand: then I said, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?
verses.Daniel|12|9: And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.
verses.Daniel|12|10: Many shall purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
verses.Daniel|12|11: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that makes desolate be set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.
verses.Daniel|12|12: Happy is he who waits, and reaches a thousand three hundred and thirty five days.
verses.Daniel|12|13: But go thou thy way till the end be: for thou shalt rest, and stand up for thy allotted portion at the end of the days.
verses.Hosea|1|1: The word of the Lord that came to Hoshea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Jehizkiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
verses.Hosea|1|2: When the Lord spoke at first with Hoshea, the Lord said to Hoshea, Go take to thee a wife of harlotry and children of harlotry; for the land has lewdly gone astray from the Lord.
verses.Hosea|1|3: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; who conceived, and bore him a son.
verses.Hosea|1|4: And the Lord said to him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will visit the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will bring the kingdom of the house of Israel to an end.
verses.Hosea|1|5: And it shall come to pass on that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.
verses.Hosea|1|6: And she conceived again, and bore a daughter. And God said to him, Call her name Lo-ruhamah (Unpitied:) for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel to forgive them at all.
verses.Hosea|1|7: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the Lord their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.
verses.Hosea|1|8: Now when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.
verses.Hosea|1|9: Then God said, Call his name Lo-ammi (Lo-ammi:) for you are not my people, and I will not be your God.
verses.Hosea|2|1: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be like the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured or numbered; and it shall come to pass, that instead of that which was said to them, You are not my people, it shall be said to them, You are the sons of the living God.
verses.Hosea|2|2: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.
verses.Hosea|2|3: Say to your brothers, Ammi (My people;) and to your sisters, Ruhamah (Pitied.)
verses.Hosea|2|4: Contend with your mother, contend: for she is not my wife, nor am I her husband: let her therefore put away her harlotry out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
verses.Hosea|2|5: lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.
verses.Hosea|2|6: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they are the children of harlotry.
verses.Hosea|2|7: For their mother has played the harlot: she who conceived them has acted shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.
verses.Hosea|2|8: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall against her, that she shall not find her paths.
verses.Hosea|2|9: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not catch them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then she shall say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then it was better with me than now.
verses.Hosea|2|10: For she did not know that it was I who gave her the corn, and the wine, and the oil, and multiplied silver and gold for her, which they used for the Baal.
verses.Hosea|2|11: Therefore I will take back my corn in its time, and my wine in its season, and will take away my wool and my flax which were to cover her nakedness.
verses.Hosea|2|12: And now I will uncover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of my hand.
verses.Hosea|2|13: I will also bring all her mirth to an end, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her appointed times.
verses.Hosea|2|14: And I will blight her vines and her fig trees, concerning which she has said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the wild beasts shall eat them.
verses.Hosea|2|15: And I will visit upon her the days of the Baalim, on which she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgot me, says the Lord.
verses.Hosea|2|16: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her.
verses.Hosea|2|17: And will give her her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor (Troubling) for a Gate of Hope: and she shall respond there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.Hosea|2|18: And it shall be on that day, says the Lord, that thou shalt say, Ishi (my Husband;) and shalt no more say to me Baali (my Master.)
verses.Hosea|2|19: For I will take away the names of the Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be mentioned by their name.
verses.Hosea|2|20: And on that day I will make a covenant for them with the wild beasts, and with the birds of the sky, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them lie down in safety.
verses.Hosea|2|21: And I will betroth thee to me for ever; and I will betroth thee to me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in loyal love, and in mercies.
verses.Hosea|2|22: And I will betroth thee to me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the Lord.
verses.Hosea|2|23: And it shall come to pass on that day, that I will respond, says the Lord; I will answer the heavens, and they shall answer the earth;
verses.Hosea|2|24: and the earth shall answer the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall answer Jezreel.
verses.Hosea|2|25: And I will sow her to me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them that were not my people. Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my God.
verses.Hosea|3|1: Then the Lord said to me, Go yet, love a women who is beloved by a paramour, and an adulteress, according to the love of the Lord towards the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love cakes of raisins.
verses.Hosea|3|2: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for a homer of barley, and a letekh of barley:
verses.Hosea|3|3: And I said to her, Thou shalt remain as mine for many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not belong to another man: so will I also be towards thee.
verses.Hosea|3|4: For the children of Israel shall remain for many days, having no king, nor prince, nor sacrifice, nor pillar, nor efod, nor terafim:
verses.Hosea|3|5: afterwards the children of Israel shall return, and seek the Lord their God, and David their king; and shall come trembling to the Lord and his goodness in the latter days.
verses.Hosea|4|1: Hear the word of the Lord, you children of Israel: for the Lord has a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor love, nor knowledge of God in the land.
verses.Hosea|4|2: There is swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery; they break all bounds, and blood leads to blood.
verses.Hosea|4|3: Therefore shall the land mourn, and everyone that dwells in it shall languish, along with the wild beasts, and the birds of the sky; indeed, the fish of the sea also shall be taken away.
verses.Hosea|4|4: Yet let no man strive, and let none accuse: for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.
verses.Hosea|4|5: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.
verses.Hosea|4|6: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.
verses.Hosea|4|7: As they were increased, the more they sinned against me: I will change their glory into shame.
verses.Hosea|4|8: They feed on the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.
verses.Hosea|4|9: And it shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them for their doings.
verses.Hosea|4|10: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit harlotry, and shall not increase: because they have ceased to take heed to the Lord.
verses.Hosea|4|11: Harlotry and wine and new wine take away the heart.
verses.Hosea|4|12: My people ask counsel of a piece of wood, and their staff declares to them! For the spirit of harlotry has caused them to err, and they have gone astray lewdly from under their God.
verses.Hosea|4|13: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and terebinths, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters commit harlotry, and your daughters in law commit adultery.
verses.Hosea|4|14: I will not punish your daughters when they commit harlotry, nor your daughters in law when they commit adultery: for they themselves go aside with harlots, and they sacrifice with prostitutes: therefore the people that does not understand shall be trodden down.
verses.Hosea|4|15: Though thou, Israel, dost play the harlot, let not Judah also be guilty; and do not come to Gilgal, nor go up to Beth-aven, nor swear, As the Lord lives.
verses.Hosea|4|16: For Israel is headstrong like a headstrong heifer: now shall the Lord feed them as a lamb in a broad pasture?
verses.Hosea|4|17: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.
verses.Hosea|4|18: Their drunken bout is over; their lewd orgy is done; they have had their fill of love; their shield is disgrace.
verses.Hosea|4|19: The wind has bound her up in its wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
verses.Hosea|5|1: Hear this, O priests; and hearken, O house of Israel; and give ear, O house of the king; for yours is the judgment, because you have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
verses.Hosea|5|2: And the apostates are deep dyed in slaughter, and I am rejected by them all.
verses.Hosea|5|3: I know Ephraim and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest harlotry, and Israel is defiled.
verses.Hosea|5|4: Their doings will not allow them to return to their God: for the spirit of harlotry is in the midst of them, and they have not known the Lord.
verses.Hosea|5|5: And the pride of Israel does testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim stumble in their iniquity; Judah also shall stumble with them.
verses.Hosea|5|6: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the Lord; but they shall not find him; he has withdrawn himself from them.
verses.Hosea|5|7: They have dealt treacherously against the Lord: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
verses.Hosea|5|8: Blow the shofar in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry loud at Beth-aven, They are after thee, O Benjamin.
verses.Hosea|5|9: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel I have made known that which shall surely be.
verses.Hosea|5|10: The princes of Judah are like them that remove the landmark: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
verses.Hosea|5|11: Ephraim is oppressed and crushed in judgment, because he willingly walked after vanity.
verses.Hosea|5|12: Therefore will I be to Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.
verses.Hosea|5|13: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to king Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, nor cure you of your wound.
verses.Hosea|5|14: For I will be to Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and there shall be none to deliver.
verses.Hosea|5|15: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me, saying,
verses.Hosea|6|1: Come, and let us return to the Lord: for he has torn, and he will heal us; he has smitten, and he will bind us up.
verses.Hosea|6|2: After two days he will revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his presence.
verses.Hosea|6|3: Let us therefore know, let us follow on to know the Lord: his going forth is sure as the morning; and he shall come to us as the rain, as the latter rain that waters the earth.
verses.Hosea|6|4: O Ephraim, what shall I do to thee? O Judah, what shall I do to thee? for your love is like a morning cloud, and as the early dew that early passes away.
verses.Hosea|6|5: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgment goes forth like the light.
verses.Hosea|6|6: For I desired loyal love, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
verses.Hosea|6|7: But they, like Adam, have transgressed the covenant; there have they dealt treacherously against me.
verses.Hosea|6|8: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity; it is polluted with blood.
verses.Hosea|6|9: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so does the company of priests; they murder on the way to Shechem: for they commit lewdness.
verses.Hosea|6|10: I have seen a horrible thing in the house of Israel: there harlotry is found in Ephraim, Israel is defiled:
verses.Hosea|6|11: also, O Judah, there is a harvest appointed for thee. When I would have returned the captivity of my people,
verses.Hosea|7|1: when I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was uncovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief comes in, and the bandits raid without.
verses.Hosea|7|2: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.
verses.Hosea|7|3: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
verses.Hosea|7|4: They are all adulterers, like an oven heated by the baker; he rests from stoking the fire; from the time of the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.
verses.Hosea|7|5: On the day of our king, the princes were sick with the heat of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
verses.Hosea|7|6: For they made ready their heart like an oven, whilst they lie in wait: their baker sleeps all the night; in the morning it burns like a flaming fire.
verses.Hosea|7|7: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calls to me.
verses.Hosea|7|8: Ephraim, he has mingled himself among the peoples; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
verses.Hosea|7|9: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knows it not: yea, grey hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knows not.
verses.Hosea|7|10: And the pride of Israel testifies to his face: and they do not return to the Lord their God, nor seek him for all this.
verses.Hosea|7|11: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
verses.Hosea|7|12: As they go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down like the birds of the sky; I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.
verses.Hosea|7|13: Woe to them! for they have fled from me: destruction to them! because they have transgressed against me: I would have redeemed them, but they have spoken lies against me.
verses.Hosea|7|14: And they have not cried to me with their heart, though they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.
verses.Hosea|7|15: Though I have trained them and strengthened their arms, yet do they devise mischief against me.
verses.Hosea|7|16: They turn to them, but to no avail: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.Hosea|8|1: Set the shofar to thy mouth. He shall come like an eagle against the house of the Lord, because they have transgressed my covenant, and rebelled against my law.
verses.Hosea|8|2: Israel shall cry to me, My God, we know thee.
verses.Hosea|8|3: Israel has cast off that which is good: the enemy shall pursue him.
verses.Hosea|8|4: They have set up kings, but not from me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold they have made themselves idols, that they may be cut off.
verses.Hosea|8|5: Thy calf, O Samaria, has cast thee off; my anger burns against them: how long will it be before they attain to innocency?
verses.Hosea|8|6: For from Israel was it also: the workman made it; it is not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
verses.Hosea|8|7: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the stormwind: it has no stalk: the bud that shall yield no meal: if perhaps it yields, strangers shall swallow it up.
verses.Hosea|8|8: Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the nations like a useless vessel.
verses.Hosea|8|9: For they are gone up to Ashur, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim has hired lovers.
verses.Hosea|8|10: Though they have hired lovers among the nations, now I will gather them; and in a little while they will tremble at the burden of a king and princes.
verses.Hosea|8|11: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sin, the altars have been to him a cause of sinning.
verses.Hosea|8|12: Though I write for him the great things of my law, they are reckoned a strange thing.
verses.Hosea|8|13: As for the sacrifices that they burn for me, let them slaughter the flesh, and eat it; the Lord desires them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and punish their sins: they shall return to Egypt.
verses.Hosea|8|14: For Israel has forgotten his Maker, and builds palaces; and Judah has multiplied fortified cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour their palaces.
verses.Hosea|9|1: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: for thou hast gone lewdly astray from thy God, thou hast loved a harlot's pay upon every cornfloor.
verses.Hosea|9|2: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail her.
verses.Hosea|9|3: They shall not dwell in the Lord's land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean food in Assyria.
verses.Hosea|9|4: They shall not pour out wine offerings to the Lord, neither shall they be pleasing to him: their sacrifices shall be to them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread shall be for their hunger only; it shall not come into the house of the Lord.
verses.Hosea|9|5: What will you do on the solemn day, and on the day of the feast of the Lord?
verses.Hosea|9|6: For, lo, they are gone from destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the treasuries for their silver, nettles, shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tents.
verses.Hosea|9|7: The days of punishment are come, the days of recompense are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the man of spirit is mad; because of the multitude of thy iniquity, great is the hatred.
verses.Hosea|9|8: The watchman of Ephraim with my God, the prophet; a fowler's snare is in all his ways, and enmity in the house of his God.
verses.Hosea|9|9: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will punish their sins.
verses.Hosea|9|10: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the first ripe fruit in the fig tree at her first season: but when they came to Baal-peor, they dedicated themselves to that shame; and they became detestable like the thing which they loved.
verses.Hosea|9|11: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird; no birth, and no pregnancy, and no conception.
verses.Hosea|9|12: Though they bring up their children, yet I will bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: woe also to them when I depart from them!
verses.Hosea|9|13: Ephraim, as I saw Tyre, is planted in pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the slayer.
verses.Hosea|9|14: Give them, O Lord: what wilt Thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
verses.Hosea|9|15: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of my house: I will love them no more: all their princes are rebellious.
verses.Hosea|9|16: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay the beloved fruit of their womb.
verses.Hosea|9|17: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken to him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
verses.Hosea|10|1: Israel is an emptied vine; how should he bring forth fruit to himself? as his fruit increased, so has he multiplied his altars; the more goodly was his land, so did he improve his pillars.
verses.Hosea|10|2: Their heart is divided; now they shall be found guilty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their pillars.
verses.Hosea|10|3: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we did not fear the Lord; what then should a king do for us?
verses.Hosea|10|4: They have spoken mere words; with empty oaths they make a covenant: this judgment springs up like hemlock in the furrows of the field.
verses.Hosea|10|5: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth-aven: for its people shall mourn over it, and its priests that rejoiced on it, for its glory, because it is departed from it.
verses.Hosea|10|6: It shall be also carried to Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
verses.Hosea|10|7: As for Samaria, her king is cut off like the foam on the surface of water.
verses.Hosea|10|8: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
verses.Hosea|10|9: O Israel, thou hast sinned more than in the days of Gibeah: there they have remained: shall not war overtake them, those children of iniquity, as in Gibeah?
verses.Hosea|10|10: When I so desire, I will chastise them; and the peoples shall be gathered against them, when they are harnessed for labour in their two furrows.
verses.Hosea|10|11: And Ephraim is like a heifer well taught, that loves to tread out the corn; but I passed over her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plough, and Jacob shall break his clods.
verses.Hosea|10|12: Sow for yourselves by righteousness, reap by the scale of love; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the Lord, till he comes and rains righteousness upon you.
verses.Hosea|10|13: You have ploughed wickedness, you have reaped iniquity; you have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
verses.Hosea|10|14: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy peoples, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
verses.Hosea|10|15: So has Beth-el done to you because of your great wickedness: at day break was the king of Israel utterly cut off.
verses.Hosea|11|1: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
verses.Hosea|11|2: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed to the Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
verses.Hosea|11|3: It was I who taught Ephraim to walk, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
verses.Hosea|11|4: I drew them with human cords, with leading strings of love: and I was to them as they that lift off the yoke from their jaws, and I held food out to them.
verses.Hosea|11|5: He should not have returned to the land of Egypt; nor should Assyria have been their king.
verses.Hosea|11|6: Because they refused to return, the sword shall abide in his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.
verses.Hosea|11|7: And my people are bent on turning away from me: though they called them to rise, none at all would raise himself.
verses.Hosea|11|8: How shall I give thee up, O Ephraim? how shall I surrender thee, O Israel? how shall I make thee like Admah; how shall I set thee like Zeboyim? my heart is turned within me, all my compassion is kindled.
verses.Hosea|11|9: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger, I will not turn to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not come as an enemy.
verses.Hosea|11|10: They shall walk after the Lord, who shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall come trembling from the west.
verses.Hosea|11|11: They shall come trembling like a bird out of Egypt and like a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, says the Lord.
verses.Hosea|12|1: Ephraim compasses me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah still rules with God, and is faithful with holy ones.
verses.Hosea|12|2: Ephraim guards the wind, and follows after the east wind: he daily increases lies and desolation; and they make an alliance with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.
verses.Hosea|12|3: The Lord has also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways: according to his doings will he recompense him.
verses.Hosea|12|4: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he strove with God:
verses.Hosea|12|5: and he strove with an angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication to him: he would find him in Beth-el, and there he would speak with us.
verses.Hosea|12|6: But the Lord is the God of hosts; The Lord is his name.
verses.Hosea|12|7: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep troth and justice, and wait on thy God continually.
verses.Hosea|12|8: As for the merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loves to oppress.
verses.Hosea|12|9: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found wealth for myself: in all my labours they shall find no iniquity in me that were sin.
verses.Hosea|12|10: But I am the Lord thy God from the land of Egypt. I will yet make thee dwell in tents, as in the days of the appointed feast.
verses.Hosea|12|11: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similes by means of the prophets.
verses.Hosea|12|12: Indeed, Gilead is iniquitous; they are become mere vanity; in Gilgal they have sacrificed bullocks: their altars are like droppings on the furrows of the field.
verses.Hosea|12|13: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.
verses.Hosea|12|14: And by a prophet the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
verses.Hosea|12|15: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood guilt upon him, and his Lord shall requite his reproach on him.
verses.Hosea|13|1: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling; he exalted himself in Israel; but when he became guilty through the Baal, he died.
verses.Hosea|13|2: And now they sin more and more, and have made for themselves molten images of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men who sacrifice kiss calves.
verses.Hosea|13|3: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the dew that passes early away, as the chaff that is driven with the wind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the window.
verses.Hosea|13|4: Yet I am the Lord thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou knowst no god but me: for there is no saviour besides me.
verses.Hosea|13|5: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
verses.Hosea|13|6: When they were fed, they became full; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore they have forgotten me.
verses.Hosea|13|7: Therefore I will be to them as a lion: as a leopard by the way I will observe them:
verses.Hosea|13|8: I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and I will rend their closed up heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.
verses.Hosea|13|9: O Israel thou hast destroyed thyself; for thou art against me, against thy help.
verses.Hosea|13|10: Where is thy king, that he may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou didst say, Give me a king and princes?
verses.Hosea|13|11: I give thee a king in my anger, and take him away in my wrath.
verses.Hosea|13|12: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is laid in store.
verses.Hosea|13|13: The pangs of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for this is no time to tarry, at the moment of childbirth.
verses.Hosea|13|14: I would ransom them from the power of Sheol; I would redeem them from death: O death where are thy plagues? O Sheol, where is thy destruction? compassion shall be hidden from my eyes.
verses.Hosea|13|15: Though he be fertile among the reed grass, an east wind shall come, the wind of the Lord shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all precious vessels.
verses.Hosea|14|1: Samaria shall be found guilty, for she has rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
verses.Hosea|14|2: O Israel, return to the Lord thy God; for thou hast stumbled in thy iniquity.
verses.Hosea|14|3: Take with you words, and turn to the Lord: say to him, Forgive all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so we will offer the words of our lips instead of calves.
verses.Hosea|14|4: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: nor shall we say any more to the work of our hands, You are our gods: for in Thee the fatherless finds mercy.
verses.Hosea|14|5: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for my anger is turned away from him.
verses.Hosea|14|6: I will be as the dew to Israel: he shall flower like the lily, and cast forth his roots like the Lebanon.
verses.Hosea|14|7: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like the Lebanon.
verses.Hosea|14|8: They who dwell in his shadow, shall return; they shall revive like corn, and blossom like the vine: their fragrance shall be like the wine of Lebanon.
verses.Hosea|14|9: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I answer him and look on him: I am like a leafy cypress tree; from me is thy fruit found.
verses.Hosea|14|10: Whoever is wise, let him understand these things: whoever is prudent let him know them; for the ways of the Lord are right, and the just do walk in them: but the transgressors shall stumble in them.
verses.Joel|1|1: The word of the Lord that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
verses.Joel|1|2: Hear this, you old men, and give ear, all you inhabitants of the land. Has such a thing been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?
verses.Joel|1|3: Tell your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.
verses.Joel|1|4: That which the cutting locust has left, the swarming locust has eaten; and that which the swarming locust has left, the hopping locust has eaten; and that which the hopping locust has left, the destroying locust has eaten.
verses.Joel|1|5: Awake, drunkards, and weep; and howl, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.
verses.Joel|1|6: For a nation is come up upon my land, mighty, and without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the fangs of a lioness.
verses.Joel|1|7: He has laid my vine waste, and splintered my fig tree: he has made it clean bare, and cast it down; its branches are made white.
verses.Joel|1|8: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
verses.Joel|1|9: The meal offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the Lord; the priests, the Lord's ministers, mourn.
verses.Joel|1|10: The field is wasted, the land mourns; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languishes.
verses.Joel|1|11: Be ashamed, O you farmers; wail, O you vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.
verses.Joel|1|12: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languishes; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, all the trees of the field, are withered because joy is withered away from the sons of men.
verses.Joel|1|13: Gird yourselves, and lament, you priests: wail, you ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, you ministers of my God: for the meal offering and the drink offering is withheld from the house of your God.
verses.Joel|1|14: Sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of the Lord your God, and cry to the Lord.
verses.Joel|1|15: Alas for the day! for the day of the Lord is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
verses.Joel|1|16: Is not the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
verses.Joel|1|17: The seed shrivels under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.
verses.Joel|1|18: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
verses.Joel|1|19: O Lord, to thee do I cry: for the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame has burned all the trees of the field.
verses.Joel|1|20: Even beasts of the field cry to Thee: for the water courses are dried up, and the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
verses.Joel|2|1: Blow the shofar in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the Lord comes, for it is near at hand;
verses.Joel|2|2: a day of darkness and of gloom, a day of clouds and of thick darkness. Like twilight spread over the mountains, a great people and a mighty; there has not been ever the like, nor shall there be any more such after them, to the years of many generations.
verses.Joel|2|3: A fire devours before them; and behind them blazes a flame: the land is like the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; and nothing escapes them.
verses.Joel|2|4: The appearance of them is like the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so do they run.
verses.Joel|2|5: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains they leap; like the noise of a flame of fire that devours the stubble, like a strong people set in battle array.
verses.Joel|2|6: At their presence the peoples are in anguish: all faces are covered with blackness.
verses.Joel|2|7: They run like mighty men; they climb the wall like men of war; and they march everyone on his ways; and they do not break their ranks:
verses.Joel|2|8: nor does one thrust another; they walk everyone in his path: and they burst through the weapons; they are not wounded.
verses.Joel|2|9: They run to and fro in the city; they run upon the wall, they climb up into the houses; they enter in at the windows like a thief.
verses.Joel|2|10: The earth quakes before them; the heavens tremble: the sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining:
verses.Joel|2|11: and the Lord utters his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he who executes his word is strong: for the day of the Lord is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
verses.Joel|2|12: Yet even now, says the Lord, turn to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
verses.Joel|2|13: and rend your hearts, and not your garments, and turn to the Lord your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and great in love, and repents of evil.
verses.Joel|2|14: Who knows whether he will not turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind him; a meal offering and a drink offering for the Lord your God?
verses.Joel|2|15: Blow the shofar in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:
verses.Joel|2|16: gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those who suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth from his chamber, and the bride out of her pavilion.
verses.Joel|2|17: Let the priests, the ministers of the Lord, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O Lord, and give not Thy heritage to reproach, that the nations should rule over them: why should they say among the peoples, Where is their God?
verses.Joel|2|18: Then the Lord was zealous for his land, and pitied his people.
verses.Joel|2|19: And the Lord answered and said to his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and you shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the nations:
verses.Joel|2|20: but I will remove far off from you the northern one, and will drive him into a barren and desolate land, with his face towards the eastern sea, and his hinder part toward the western sea, and his foulness shall come up, and his ill savour shall ascend, though he has done great things.
verses.Joel|2|21: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the Lord will do greater things.
verses.Joel|2|22: Be not afraid, O beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness shall spring, for the tree bears its fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.
verses.Joel|2|23: Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in the Lord your God: for he has given you the former rain in due measure, and he has brought down for you the rain in the first month, the former rain, and the latter rain.
verses.Joel|2|24: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the vats shall overflow with wine and oil.
verses.Joel|2|25: And I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten, the hopping locust, and the destroying locust, and the cutting locust, my great army which I sent among you.
verses.Joel|2|26: And you shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the Lord your God, who has dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
verses.Joel|2|27: And you shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the Lord your God, and there it is none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.
verses.Joel|3|1: And it shall come to pass afterwards, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy; your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:
verses.Joel|3|2: and also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.
verses.Joel|3|3: And I will exhibit wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.
verses.Joel|3|4: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the coming of the great and the terrible day of the Lord.
verses.Joel|3|5: And it shall come to pass, that whoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem there shall be those that escape, as the Lord has said, and among the remnant those whom the Lord shall call.
verses.Joel|4|1: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring back the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.Joel|4|2: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will enter into judgment with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and have divided up my land.
verses.Joel|4|3: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for a harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.
verses.Joel|4|4: Moreover, what are you to me, O Tyre and Zidon, and all the provinces of Philistia? will you render retribution on my behalf? and if you render retribution on my behalf, swiftly and speedily will I return your retribution upon your own head.
verses.Joel|4|5: Because you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly treasures:
verses.Joel|4|6: the children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have you sold to the children of the Grecians that you might remove them far from their border.
verses.Joel|4|7: Behold, I will raise them out of the place to which you have sold them, and will return your retribution upon your own head:
verses.Joel|4|8: and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the Lord has spoken it.
verses.Joel|4|9: Proclaim this among the nations; Prepare war, stir up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:
verses.Joel|4|10: beat your ploughshares into swords, and your pruning-hooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
verses.Joel|4|11: Hasten, and come, all you nations, and gather yourselves together round about: cause Thy mighty ones to come down there, O Lord.
verses.Joel|4|12: Let the nations be stirred up, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the nations round about.
verses.Joel|4|13: Put in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, tread down; for the press is full, the vats overflow; for their wickedness is great.
verses.Joel|4|14: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.
verses.Joel|4|15: The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
